tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 1 bod kyi rig gnas lo rgyus dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs : 9 (18)

tei:div.tei:p: ༄30bo—ster—bstsar——chag5sgyub sa ri mcho la ma 'i rwakhu2 ca ṭ+wāṃ 0 tshi ba krordordosdu ཿ ṣā 0༷༷5rngurwa 0 /༷ 2tshitharngurdo~Xtsāsdutshisdu~Xdzipyi 5༵8831 dzi bede kyi mtho rgyus rig gnas dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha gdams bsgrigs/spyi'i 'done thengs 1rngaXwa5 ༷wawa 01 ༷wa//6/wapu1༷༷sduwathasmowaskrewawawa'iwasawawasmospujiwawawawawawa2wawawawawawawa'i75snyesgrewasnyertebyesnyeṭ+wāṃsnyerte skrerdoyāX ༵2'i2dzi5 snyewa wa ༵byewawa~X sngi0k+ṣiṃ shābyetshoXstodhitwe t+t+waṃshādīhūṃsdu~Xṭ+wāṃtsāsmo'i0(yā

sno' rna raspurkalha /ltaspuke4spyo/༷༷/me pa// dzi/ // po/ r+ghaṃ(spyo/spyo45༷snanadzipa/4mi ñtsa6phuli9spyo'i 'don thengs 8pabod rang skyong ljongs srid gros lo rgyus rig gnas dpyaX ༷/ / ḍi ༷ rdorda rdo/na/ khang

dkar chaga'aphags pa lha sku phreng rim byon/'phags pa lha sku phreng dang po/ (1)'phags pa lha sku phreng gnyis pa/ (7)'phags pa lha sku phreng gsum pa/ (22)'phags pa lha sku phreng bzhi pa/ (36)'phags pa lha sku phreng lnga pa/ (44)'phags pa lha sku phreng drug pa/ (52)'phags pa lha sku phreng bdun pa/ (69)'phags pa lhu sku phreng brgyad pa/ (149)'phags pa lha sku phreng dgu pa/ (149)'phags pa lha sku phreng bcu pa/ (153)'phags pa lha sku phreng bcu gcig pa/ (165)zhi lcags dkon gsum sogs bla khagazhi ba lha sku phreng rim byon/ (193)lcags rwa sprul sku sku phreng rim byon/ (200)dkon rdor sprul sku sku phreng rim byon/ (202)1

gru thang rgya ra sprul sku sku phreng rim byon/ (204)de min sprul sku 'bring chung khag (206)chab mdo bla dgon gyi lo rgyas dang sgrig gzhi/chos gzhis dang / gtong sgo dgon lag sogs/chab mdo bla dgon gyi lo rgyus rags rim/ (207)rtse shod bla dgon gyi sgrig gzhi/ (225)chos gzhis dang gtong sgo/ dgon lag sogs/ (238)dgon pa'i 'dul sgrig kun spyod/ (261)rgyun srol gyi dus ston byed sgo/ (281)chab mdo dgon gyi gdan rabs rim byon/ (290)chab mdo bla dgon gyi srid kyi 'khur 'dzin pa rim byon/ (294)zhar byung / deb 'di'i rgyu cha'i skor gyi gsal bshad/ (295)

'phags pa lha sku phreng rim byon/'phags pa lha sku phreng dang po/'phags pa lha'i sku'i 'khrungashā rabs kyi rnam sprul bzhes tshul skor 'phags pa lha sku phreng dang po rgyal ba 'phags pa lha'i rnam thar sogs lo rgyus kyi chos 'byung dpe rnying 'ga' zhig ltar na/ sku'i skyes rabs sngon ma dka' ba dpal rtsegs dang / phag mo gru pa/ skabs gar spre'u sogs kyi skyes rabs bzhes tshul mang dag cig gsal yang / thun mong gdul bya'i snang ngor dngos mthong gi mdzad rim rnams las/ skabs 'dir 'god byar cung zad mi 'tsham dag re zhig ma spros par btang snyoms su bzhaga'aphags pa lha sku phreng dang po rgyal ba 'phags pa lha ni/ 〈rnam thar〉las gang de'i 'khrungs yul‘‘longs spyod kyi 'byor pa du ma dang ldan pa'i long po gnyan chen thang lha gnas pa'i mdun/ rno pa zhes bya ba'i 'dabs su chags shing / bye brag mkha' lding la kha zhes bya bar yab ku cor rtogs ldan sangs rgyas dpal zhes rje tsong kha pa sogs skyes bu dam pa drug cur nye ba bsten nas mdo sngags kyi chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsan bsam gnang bas 1

thugs rab che la/ sgrub pa kho nar gzhol zhing / chu chen la mi bying bar 'byor pa dang / ku cor glang ma rdzong dang rgya chu pha ri'i rtse gnyis la phar 'phur tshur 'phur mdzad pa'i mthu rtsal ldan pa/ gzhan yang brag la zhabs rjes mang po 'jog pa sogs grub rtags ngo mtshar can thon pa zhig yod skad (ku cor zhes pa lo rgyus yig rnying ltar na‘‘sngar lho smad ku cor nas mi sde tshan cig thon nas nyang po rgya nang gi lung sul zhig bzungs pas khul der ku cor zhes ming chags’’lugs gsal)yum sangs rgyas mtsho mo zhes spo bo ye gang nas byon pa/ rje tsong kha pa dang chos rje bde bzhin gshegs pa'i lung gis zin pa zhig yin skad dang / yab yum de gnyis la sras gnyis dang sras mo gcigayum mi gcig pa'i sras gcig dang bcas sku mched bzhi yod pa las sras bgres pa chos kyi grags par yab kyis mtshan dkon mchog 'byung gnas su btags/ sras sku mched gsum gyi 'bring po 'khas grub 'jam dbyangs gzhon nu (yum mi gcig pa zhes pa de nyid yin tshod) chos 'phags las rab tu byung mtshan 'jam dbyangs gzhon nur gsol/ sras chung ba rgyal ba 'phags pa lha gang nyid rab byung bdun pa'i sa lug(1429)lor 'khrungs/gang 'di'i 〈rnam thar chen mo〉las chu lug la 'khrungs pa mdzad 'dug kyang /yi ge nor ba'i skyon du song ba nges te 'dir 〈dga' ldan chos 'byung〉dang /shākya lha dbang gis mdzad pa'i 〈zhal snga bka' brgyud thun mong min pa'i chos 'byung〉zhes pa ltar byas shing / de ni rje tsong kha pa 'das nas lo bcu dgu song zin pa de yin/ rgyal ba 'phags pa lha lug lor 'khrungs pa dang /long po glang mjug gi brag la yig drug rang byon shar ba dus mtshungs byung skad 'dugagang 'di dgung grangs gsum du yab kyis dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa gnang 2

zhing / mtshan 'jam dpal du gsol/ yab kyi drung nas dbang dang rjes gnang sogs kyi chosi bka' mang du gsan/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang grags pa bshes gnyen zhes pa gnyis phyag bris 'bri klog gis dge rgan du bsten/dgung lo brgyad du son skabs sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags las rab tu byung zhing / chos 'phags kyis khyod rdzu 'phrul can cig 'dug pas mo'u gal gyi bu zhes ming thogs gsungs par nga layo'aphags pa lha ’zer ba yin zhes zhus pas mtshan de ltar mdzad/ snga rting du slob dpon nam rin pa dang /slob dpon mgon po/ dka' bcu pa nam blo/ lho brag grub chen gyi dngos slob rtogs ldan brtson 'grus 'bum/ byang sems shākya rin chen dpal/rgyal sras shar lung pa/ chog rje khrus khang lo ts+tsha ba/ drung pa 'jam dbyangs gzhon nu sogs mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi bla ma bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi tsam bsten nas gangs ri'i khrod 'dir dri ma med pa'i chos lugs yod do cog gi chos bka' man ngag dang bcas legs par gsan/dgung grangasamo bzhi bcur son pa rab byung brgyad pa'i sa khyi (147ṭ+wāṃ)lor 'brog ri bo dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du byon nas 'jam dbyangs chos rje dang / 'jam dbyangs gtsang pa bdun brgyud kyi snga pa ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan pas mkhan po dang / mdo sngags kyi bdag po rab 'byams pa bkros rgyal mtshan gyis slob dpon/ sems dpa' chen po dpal ldan don grub pas gsang ston bcas mdzad de dad pa'i dge slong bcu tshogs kyi dbus su bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom bzhes legs par bskyangs/gang nyid rnam kun gzhi gsum gyi phyag len dang / thun drug gi nyams len chags med du mdzad cing / ldung ba byung na de ma thag bshags pa 3

gnang / mtha' gru gang sa nas skye bo drag zhan bar mas phul ba'i 'bul dngos gang byung thams cad sprang po ngan slong la zas skom gyi sbyin pa'am/rten gsum bzhengs pa/ bla ma dang dge 'dun gyi 'dus sder bsnyen bkur gnang ba sogs dge rtsa kho nar gtong gnang mdzad pa las/ khe spog dang gsog 'jog ye nas mi mdzad pa'i rnam thar bzang pos kun gyi yid dbang 'phrog pa'i gnas su gyur/ kong po dang long po/ byang 'brog dbus gtsang / mdo stod smad sogs mtha' grub gang du phebs kyang khrom tshogs thams cad la smon lam gsung ba dang / thams cad la las rgyu 'bras kho na'i chos bka' gsung ba/ bstan pa la zhugs pa thams cad la rang rang gi grub mtha'i ༅na legs par phyis nas sangs rgyas kyi bka' ni yang dag pa mtshan mas grub pas thams cad la phyogs lhung dang chags sdang bral bar mdzad pa/snying po'i don la gzhol ba rnams la snyan brgyud kyi lta khrid dang / phyag chen chos drug mi tra khrid drug nā ro'i chos drug dus 'khor sbyor drugagasang 'dus rim lnga/ lam 'bras dang lam rim sogs kyi khrid dang man ngag du ma mdzad de sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshad sgrub gnyis ka'i sgo nas 'dzin skyong spel gsum mdzad pa'i bkrin bskyangs/dgon sde dang sgrub sde gsar 'dzugs bskyangs pa'ang dper na/ yer pa lha ri snying po dang / long po ri bo chos 'phel/ bkris brag ra// 'kha' spyod ri khrod/ stod sman steng ri khrod/ len ri khrod/ shag ti phug sogs la sgrub sde btsugs/ bkris chos lung dang / nyi zla thang / nyi ma gling /dpag mda' bsam grub gling / krang gnas sgor/ 'phrang kha gdong /thang grwa byang chub gling / dga' ldan/ zla ba thang / de mo blo gsal gling /rgu bkris sgang / ye gang du theg chen byams pa gling / spo stod sgang nag 4

sgang / spo bo chu mdo dgon/ kaḥnam dgon rnying / lho chos khri thang /'jang zhabs su gru kha dgon/ rgyu ri bo che/ bde skyid nyi ma gling sogs dgon sde mang du phyag btab pa dang / de rnams la sku gsung thugs rten yang bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsar bzhengs bskyangs/ bshad rgyud 'dzin pa'i grwa tshang yang dper na/ bkra shis lung du 'dus pa 'phags lugs kyi 'chad srol rgyud smad ji bzhin dang / cabye thang dang nyi ma gling du kyai rdo rje rngog lugs kyi 'chad srol/ thang grar bde mchog ngam rdzong lugs/ dga' ldan du sman bla'i chos grwa/ de mor phar phyin/ rgyu ri bo cher 'dul ba/ ye gang du dbu ma bcas kyi 'chad nyan btsugs te mdo sngags kyi bstan pa rgya cher spel bar mdzad/brtsam chos kyang 〈bde mchog snyan brgyud kyi dkyil 'khor zin bris che chung 〉dang 〈spyi don blo gsal mgul rgyan〉sogs mang du mdzad/zhal slob ni/ drung pa 'jam dbyangs gzhon nu dang drung pa sangs rgyas dpal gnyis ni rgyal ba 'phags pa lha dang chos phar gsan tshur gsan gnang gi yod pa/ gzhan yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen grwa chung yon tan rgya mtsho/ drung grub chen pa/ drung gtsang pa/ bla ma nyi ma rgyal mtshan/slob dpon dge 'dun 'phel/ mkhan chen zla ba bzang po/ bla ma 'phags mchog bshes gnyen// sa/ma/sa brtan nyi ma 'od zer/ gnas brtan kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sangs rgyas dpal 'byor(yig cha 'ga' shas su 'di nyid kyang rgyal ba 'phags pa lha dang yab gcig pa yin lugs gsal )bla ma zhi ba lha che ba (mtshan dngos dpal ldan mchog grub/ rgyal sras zhi ba lha'i sprul pa yin par gras/sa pas zhi ba lha zhes mtshan chags ) grub thob ngag dbadwa dpal mchog (thog mar rgyal ba 'ephags lha'i mdzo rdzi gnang ba dang de 5

nas rab tu byung ste zhal slob tu gyur ) sogs zhal slob mang du byung zhing /de dag las stod kyi dkon mchog 'byung gnas ni sras kyi thu bo rgyal tshab chos rje yin/ de min yul sde gzhan gyi bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po gang 'di'i zhal slob tu gyur pa yang / sgam po chos rje/ ra lung chos rje/ rta rna chos rje/ rgya ston chos rje/ byang chub rin chen/ zla dgon chos rje/ rdza dgon chos rje/ dpal 'bar chos rje/ rdzi tho chos rje/ ko shar chos rje/gsang phu chos rje legs pa chos 'byor/ slob dpon zhi ba lha chung ba (mtshan dngos kun tu bzang po phyis 'phags pa lha sku phreng gnyis pa 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyis bla mar bsten/ slob dpon nam mkha' dpal ('dis phyis 'phags pa lha sku phreng gnyis pa bsnyen rdzogs kyi mkhan po gnang ) spang ri sgang pa chos rje kun dga' lhun grub/ kun mkhyen go ram pa'i gdan sar rab byams pa dbang phyug lhun grub sogs zhal slob kyang mang du byung 'dugadagung grangs zhe dgu bzhes pa rab byung brgyad pa'i me lug (14〈7)hor zla 11tshes 24nyin brag gsum mtsho chu'i phu/ sgam nang lung pa zhes bya bar zhi ba chos kyi dbyings su gshegs/sku gdung ril po thog mar mda' phu mdo chen dgon du gdan drangs/de nas bla ma byang chub snying pos thabs mkhas gnang nas bkris chos lung du gdan drangs te gser sdong bkris 'od 'bar du bzhugs su gsol zhes grags/ gang gi mdzad pa'i cha shas da lam phyogs sgrig zhus pa 'di dag ni zhal slob thugs sras dkon mchog 'byung gnas kyis brtsams gnang ba'i 〈rgyal ba 'phags pa lha'i rnam par thar pa byin rlabs kyi chu rgyun 〉zhes pa'i dpe rnying bris ma zhig dang / rab byung bcu gcig pa'i lcags 'brug (1640)lo 6 dzha

phan bde cho sa rje mkhas grub shākya lha dbang gis brtsams gnang ba'i 'phags pu lha sku phreng dang po nas bzhi pa 'tsho gzhes kyi skabs bar sku phreng na rim gyi mdzad rnam 〈zhal snga bka' brgyud thun mong min pa'i chos 'byung 〉zhes bya ba bris ma/ rab 'byams pa blo bzang dbang phyug gis brtsams gnang ba'i 'phags pa lha sku phreng dang po nas drug pa 'tsho gzhes bar gyi mdzad pa rags rim 〈zhal snga bka' brgyud chos 'byung phan bde chos rjes mdzad pa'i 'phro mthud 〉ces pa'i bris ma bcasagazhir bzung phyogs sgrig zhus/'phags pa lha sku phreng gnyis pa/'phags pa lha sku phreng ṅgenyis pa/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas ni sku gong ma zhing du gshegs nas lo ngo nyi shu song ba rab byung dgu pa'i me yos ( 1507)lo yab rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug sangs rgyas bkra shis dang yum chos ldan sgrol ma gnyis kyi sras su chos khang rtsa zhes par sku 'khrungs/gang 'di 'khrungs ma thag nas ngo mtshar can gyi rtags mtshan mang du byung bas/ skabs der skye bo kun gyis 'phags pa lha'i sku skye yine tshod kyi gleng tshul mgrin gcig tu byed pa ma zad/ gang nyid gsung byon mkhyin tsam nas ‘‘nga 'phags pa lha yin’’zhes yang yang gsung gi yod skad kyang / sku gong ma gshegs khar bla ma nyi ma rgyal mtshan sogs bu chen (zhal slob ) rnams nas yang srid myur byon yong ba dang sa phyogs gang du byon rgyu sogs kyi zhal gsung dgos lugs nan che zhus par‘‘ngas khyed tsho 'tshol ba zhig yong rgyu las/khyod tshos nga batrel na bub yong’’zhes bka' slob dam nan gnang ba'i gshis kyis de'i yang srid 'di nyid dgung grangs bcu dgur ma son bar du bu chen 7

sus kyang brtag dpyad gdan 'dren zhu mkhan byung med/ 'on kyang srung ma'i mcho 'phrul lta bus thugs rgyud yang yang bskul bas gang nyid nas lan mang bros phebs rtsis gnang ba dang / lan cig chos khang rtsa ba'i chu rong si/ 'gram brag rdo chen po zhig yod pa der gab nas zhag gsum bzhugs pas brag rdo der sku lus yongs rdzogs kyi rjes mal shin tu gsal ba yod skad dang /snyede rjes sku mtshams dam por bzhugs su bcug drung gyong thod sprul sku zhes par dbu skra gtsugs phud phul ba'i mtshan‘‘lha ri sangs rgyas’’zhes gsol/de'i zhal snga las bka' chos mang du gsan gang 'di'i 〈gsan yig〉las/‘‘drung pa gyong thod sprul sku'i drung du thog mar skra phud phul nas dge bsnyen zhus/bar du 'khor lo bde mchog dril bu dang bka' gdam be bum dmar po la sogs pa/ sman bla rjes gnang thob pa'i bla ma lags’’zhes gsungs/drung pa bsod nams rgyal po zhes bya ba'i drung nas gtum mo zhag bdun chos drug la sogs pa chos bka' mang du gsan/ de rjes rtse lha sgang du sgam po mkhan chen shākya bzang po'i drung nas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes pa dang chos bka' mang du gsan/ de skabs karma mi bskyod rdo rje khams phyogs nas kong po khul phebs pas gang 'di'i drung nas kyang phag mo dang phyag chen sogs gsan/ de dus skun gzhi zhig byung bas chos khang rtsa bar phyir log phebs rjes snyun gzhi dwangs nas rnam rol bka' bcu pa ku dkar ri khrod nas gdan drangs te phyag bris slob pa dang bshes springs dang spyod mjug sogs gzhung mang du gsan/ yab kyi drung nas kyang bka' lung man ngag du ma gsan zhing /sku mtshams su bzhugs/dgung grangs bcu dgur bzhes lo gzim khang nas bros te de mo la brgyud dga' ldan du phebs/ slob dpon nam mkha' dpal gyis mkhan po 8

dang / de mo slob dpon bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis las slob/ slob dpon lha dbang dpal 'byor gyis gsang ston mdzad nas bsnyen par rdzogs/mkhan chen lapha'aphags pa'i dgongs pa mkha' ltar yongs su khyab’’ces sogs kyi bstod pa tshig bcad bris phul gnang bar mkhan chen nas4'di nga la mi 'os khyed rang gi bstod pa lags pas phar 'bul lo’’zhes gsungs/de skabs mkhan slob gong gsal drung nas chos bka' du ma gsan/dgung grangs nyer gcig bzhes skabs rtse lha sgang nas mkhan chen pas gdan drangs te phebs pa dang / de gar yab kyang chos khang rtsa nas gdan drangs shing / yab sras mjal 'dzoms kyis mnyes tshan dpag med mdzad/zhag shas lhan bzhugs ring yab kyi drung nas mi tra khrid drug sogs bka' chos mang du gsan 〈gsan yig〉las/ pyodrin can bla ma bud+dha'i mtshan can 'di/thog mar bdag gi lus skyed bar du ni/ chos dang zang zing gnyiyokyis legs par bskyangs/ dam chos mi tra khrid drug dbang khrid dang chos dbang dpag med thob pa'i bla ma lags’’zhes gsungs/ de nas‘‘lo nyer gsum thog la khams su phyin’’zhes gsungs pa ltar spo bo ye gang dang / chu mdo/ sum rdzong sogs su byon te dge tshul slong sgrub mkhan mang por sdom pa 'bogs pa dang / mi tra khrid drug dang / snying po don gsum sogs kyi chos 'khor mang du bskor de nas nag shod nas gdan 'dren byung bas phebs te wig bkris chos lung dang chos rdzong / ri lu bum khang sogs su yun ring bzhugs/ long pa bkra shis chos lung gi gtsug lag khang zhig gso mdzad mkhan gtong gnang mdzad/de nas sbud mdar phebs shing / chos rje chos dbang grags pa'i gdan sa phul/ chos rje legs pa bzang po slar yang bla mar bskos/ der 9

ban dpon cig gi sbud mda'i chos rje na rim la bstod pa dgos zhes zhus pas bzhugs gral de gar phyag bris gnang nas tshogs 'don btsugs/ de nas ldem gshis la phebs/ sgar du sngags grwa btsugs/ de skabs rta dang gnag phyugs 'bul mi mang bas yab rje'i drung du nag smad kyi dgon 'debs dgos lugs kyi bka' yig dang 'brel rta drel mang po 'bul rgyu bskur genang ba dang /de mo lar chos thebs su rta sum cu skor dang / rgu skyog por nor bzhi bcu tsam bskur/ sgar gyi grwa pa dang de skor bcas kyi dgon khag thams cad la rta 'agled gnang /de nas tsha ba'i khul phebs shing / de skabs smar khams nas gdan 'dren bskyar ma slebs/ yab rjes bka' bris ba mang che ched gtong gis nag smad kyi dgon pa btab yod pas dgon ming 'dogs dgos lugs gsungs par‘‘sangs rgyas byang sems kyi lung bstan ltar bkris chos sde zhes thogs’’gsungs pa'i bka' lan bstsal/ de skabs yab dgung grangs bzhi bcu rtsa dgu dang / gang nyid dgung grangs nyer lnga bzhes pa lcags yos lo yin par grags/de nas sgo mo te 'gram du phebs shing / de skabs khul der dgon tshan lnga yod 'dug pa rnams tshang ma zhal mthun byung 'don ltar mu tig 'gram du phyogs gcig tu bsdoms nas dgon chen zhig btab/ dbyar gnas la dbyar khas len gyi dge 'dun pa lnga brgya lhag tsam byung / gang nyid nas dgon dang mang tshogs la chos bka' mang du bstsal/ chos dbar gung gseng skabs gzim khang gi rdo bsags par dge 'dun pa dang bla ma chos rje thams cad kyang phebs/ de skabs 'bul ba gang byung rnams cha gsum du bgos te cha gcig phan bde'i lha chen bzhengs rgyu la bzhag cha gcig der 10

dgon pa 'debs rgyu 'i thebs/ cha gcig sgar pa'i mthun rkyen du bzhagagang gi yum dang dbon 'jam dpal gnyis dgon pa'i zhib tshags byed por bskos/de nas nyag bre'i phyogs nas gdan 'dren byung bas der phebs shing /chos rje shākya rin chen dang / chos rje nam mkha' seng ge sogs dpon slob brgya phrag gang gi drung nas bka' chos zhu bar phebs/ de skabs sgar gyi sngags grwa yang brgya dang lnga bcu skor yod pas sgar tshan chen po chags/ tsha ba mkhar ldeng gru khar zhal snga gong ma'i ('phags pa lha sku phreng dang po )dgon pa bde skyid nyi ma gling du phebs shing / dgon pa phyag tu 'bul bzhes kyis bla ma rgyal mtshan bkra shis bla mar bskos/de nas sa tham rgyal po'i gdan 'dren zhu mi byung bar byon rtsis kyang sa smad khul gyi bla ma dang chos rje thams cad kyis 'jang 'di sdig rngam che/ rgyu la brnab/ chos mi go/ bslu brid mkhas pas bar chad 'ong nyen che bas 'byon par mi 'thad ces zhus pas bshol/ de skabs kong po bkra shis phan bder lha chen bzhengs par nang rten gser sku dang li sku bsdoms drug cu skor gyis gtsos sku gsung thugs rten khal rgyab bzhi tsam dang / de min 'khar rnga dang / ting / gos chen sogs khal rgyab bzhi lhag tsam bcas dang / lha chen mi tshad dgu pa'i sku rgyu long ba'i zangs gser dang dngul chu bcas pa bstsal/ sum pa'i zam pa zhig bzo dang / li thang khul nang 'khrug che tsam byung bar zhi 'jags yong thabs mdzad/de rjes li thang la phebs bzhugs skabs 'jang gi dmag gsang thabs kyis slebs nas li thang grong bskor bas gang nyid bar 'dum du byon pas dmag mi rnams kyi mtshon chas sku la reg par nye ba sogs kyi sdig sdig sna 11

tshogs byas pa ma zad/ jakwa chen po de khri'u zhig gi steng bsdad nas ral gri sdeg rtsis byas kyang shub nas ma thon pas kho pa ya mtshan skyes te‘‘ha ha khyod don ci la 'ong’’zhes zhus par‘‘dmag ma byed ces zhu bar 'ong ba lags’’gsungs des‘‘dmag byas pas khyod la ci gnod’’zer bar/ ‘‘khyod rang tshor sdig pa chen po 'ong’’gsungs pas/ ‘‘nged tsho'i sdig pa khyod kyis zhur dgos pa e yin’’zer gang des‘‘sdig pa nged kyis khur mi dgos te dge ba byas na bsod nams nged kyis thob’’zhes sogs gsungs pas jakwa shin tu dad nas bka' la nyan pa byung zhing / dus de rang la sa tham rgyal po'i pho brang steng glo bur du 'brug sgra chen po byung ba dang / kun gyi mthong snang du 'brug gi lce'i steng du rab byung ba rnam sbyar dang paṇa zhwa ser po bzhes pa zhig gi phyag tu po ti bsnams yod pa de pho brang gi thog steng bor ba lta skabs 〈dam chos pad+ma dkar po〉yin pas rgyal blon thams cad dga' mgu yi rang byung bas slar yang 'phags pa lha gdan 'dren zhu mi btang 'byor dang dus mtshungs dam ga sgar nas bang chen btang ba lam du 'phrad pas de bas ngo mtshar du gyur tshul grags/gang 'di nyid kyi gsung las‘‘lo nyer dgu'i thog tu babs pa'i tshe/ a ka'i li thang zhes bya der/ 'jang sa tham rgyal po'i dmag dang thug gri mdung sogs kyi mtshon chas bdag brtegs kyang / bdag zhed pa'i snang ba cang ma mchis/ lar dkon cog gsum gyi bka' drin las/ dmag dpon rnams rang gis dbang du bsdus/ rang ci zer kha la nyan pa byung / sa tham nas chos kyi rgyal po des/ rtag rten 'brel 'brug sgra chen po byung / der bltas pas 'brug gi lce steng na/ rten rab byung rnam sbyar gon pa zhig yar bzhengs nas dam chos po ti bsnams/ de pho brang thog tu bskyur ba las/bltas pasaci dam chos pad dkar 'dug rtag rten 'brel bzang zhes gdan 12

'dren byung / bdag the tshom med par 'jang yul phyin’’zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'jang yul nas jakwa dang pha ke rgyal po gnyis kyis gdan drangs te li thang nas zla ba gcig dang zhag nyi shu'i thog sa tham la phebs 'byor byung zhing der sa tham rgyal po 'jam dbyangs grags pas shin tu gus pas zhabs spyi bor blangs/ gang des spyan ras gzigs kyi lha khrid sogs kyi chos bka' gnang de nas sa tham rgyal po des‘‘chos rje khyod kong por 'khrungs pa dang nga rgya nag gi sa char bsdad pa gnyis dang lan mjal ba 'di sngon gyi smon lam gyi 'brel ba bzang po yod pas yin gshis/ rab la 'dir rgyun bzhugs/ de ltar ma byung kyang lo gsum/ thar lo gcig ma bzhugs par thabs med’’ces nan zhu byas kyang‘‘yun ring 'dug mi khom da lam rgyal po khyed dang 'phrad pa sems dga'/ rgyal po khyed kyis chosatshogo zhing / rten gsum mang po bzhengs yod zer yang / rgyal dmag bod du slebs dus mi mang po bsad/rten gsum mang po bshigs skad 'dug pas/ da phyin bod la dmag mi byed pa dang / dgon sde dang rten gsum la mi gnod pa byed dgos’’zhes gsungs par/ sa tham rgyal pos‘‘ngos chos ma go ba min te rgya nag rgyal pos sa mtha' srung bar bzhag pas da dung yang gtan du dmag mi byed pa'i thabs ni med/ lo skor tsam zhig dmag mi byed pa'i dam bca' 'bul/ dgon sde dang rten gsum bshig 'dod med de/ rta nag rab 'a byams pa dang gser mdog pa rnams kyis dmag dpon byas byung bas bzhag thabs ma byung /lar be+en rde thams cad kyis dmag mi byed par khag 'khyag na nged kyis kyang ben rdo dang rten gsum mi gnod pa'i khas len 'bul’’zhes zhus par/ gang des‘‘ben rde thams cad bgros nas btang ba yin pas ben rdo thams cad kyi khag mi 'khyag kyang / nged rang gi kha la nyan pa'i dgon pa rnams kyis dmag 1 ni

mi byed pa ni thub/ gang ltar lo skor gyi dam bca' 'di las ma 'gal ba mdzod’’ces bka' bkod gnang / de nas pho brang mgo rbad ces par gdan drangs/ pho brang gang du byon pas bla ma rnams kyis yi ge mang po sbyar yod pa'i nang don du la las sa tham rgyal po la sras sgraklegacan 'dzin yin zer ba dang / 'bri chu sbrul gyi dpe dang sbyar ba sogs bris yod pas/ sa tham rgyal pos sras sgra gcan 'dzin tsam gyi sngags pa nga la mi thob/ sbrul gyis bskor ba zer ba de yang bzang po ma red pas/ rtsom bde mo rang ma shes pa 'dra bar snang / yi ge 'di rnams la gzigs nas nyid kyis phyag bris shig gnang bar zhu zhes zhus don de ma thag gang des‘‘phyogs bzhir blon chen dpung dang gshom gros kyis/ nye dbang tshogs kyis lha min bcom pa bzhin phyogs mtshams kun la bka' yis 'khor lo bsgyur/ chos rgyal chen po'i byams brtses skyong zhes grags’’zhes sogs kyi bka' rtsom bris gnang ba sbyar bas/rgyal po kho rang gis tshar gcig bton/ tshar gcig lo ts+tsha ba la thon gsungs nas mnyan ‘‘khyod la bu chen mang po yod pas de rnams kyis phyogs thams cad la chos shod du chug dge 'dun gyi sde tshugs 'dir bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs dgos zhes nan gyis zhus shing / rgya rigs dang jag rigs/ rdzong dpon sogs nas 'bul ba gtos che phul/ rgyal po 'jam dbyangs grags pa dang mjal 'phrad yang yang byung / li thang khul gyi dgon sder phyag bris gnang ste/ sa tham rgyal pos lo bcu gnyis bar dmag mi byed pa'i khas len dam bca' yod pas thugs bder bzhugs zhes gsung kyang khong tshos lags so ma zhus par chags sdang gi 'thab rtsod sgo du ma nas bslangs/ 'on kyang rang rang gi las tshul la babs pa'i rtsod 'khrugs slong ba po dag gtan brlag tu btang ba tsam las/ ben de spyi dang sde dgon la 14

gnod 'tshe med par rgyal posardokyang dam bca' tshad du bskyal/ de —nas rkang po (kong po ) phyogs su byon rtsis kyis lha'u dag la phebs shing / de skabs bo da ri bo dga' ldan nas chos rje khri thog pa chos skyong rgya mtsho la zur bzhugs pa paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa/ 'bras spungs nas thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho bcas kyis bka' yig bstsal 'byor nang‘‘'jang zhabs su rje'i bstan pa la dgongs nas bzhugs dgos’’zhes gsungs pa dang / 'jang zhabs kyi skya ser kun gyis kyang bshol 'debs gdan 'dren 'byor bas/ khams stod smad dang spo bo/ kong po phyogs kyi dge sde thams cad la mang bskol gnadwa sbyin dang / dbus gtsang khul gyi dgon sder 'gyed dang mang bskol 'bul skyel du dge slong blo bzang bkris can mngag4rdzong bskyangs/ de nas mngar 'gu yul du phebs la sgang du dgon pa btab gong ma'i ('jang sa tham rgyal po mnga' 'og nas las khral dang bzo bo rgya mi btang / lha khang du rgya yig mdzad/ 'jang zhabs nas ban khral bsdus pa bcas gdul bya gong 'phel du bzhugs muras tham gong mas (rgyal po )‘‘rdzong sngon dang tshwa kha rdzong gi dbar 'dir yang dgon pa zhig 'debs dgos’’zhus pas/ 'brang rwa zer ba'i dgon pa btab/ de nas sa tham rgyal pos pho brang du gdan drangs te zla gcig tsam bzhugs ring rgyal po 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i thugs bzhes yongs su gang ba'i bka' chos nyin mtshan sbrel nas gnang bar 'bul ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa phul/ de nas lcagagarta lo la sgang dang 'grang rar phebs bzhugs skabs nub cig mnal lam du lung bāstan ngo mtshar can byung ba bka' bcu pa blo gros kyis yi ger bkod/ de nas lhu la ru phebs shing / rje rin po che lhu la legs pa dpal la 15

gnang ba'i thub dbang rgya gar ma byin rlabs can de phul/ de skabs gling gyang ra dang / ldog lta ba/ bya khra 'go pa'i dbon po rnams kyis sku srog la bsdo ba'i log sgrub yang yang byas par gau bo dbon po dang mi nyag jag pa rnams ma bzod pas gnyer pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang bcas pa nas de rnams la dmag stib gshom pa la/ zhal snga rin po che ('phags pa lha )bka' nan chen pos bzlog thabs gnang yang ma thub pas/ gang des bon po rnams la bya btang gnang skabs de skabs4gnyer pas dmag byas/ bla mas bya btang’’zer nas khrel mkhan yang byung yod/ slar yang bang chen gtong ba gnang yang bden pa ma bzung bas mthar bon dgon gsum ka dmag gis brlags pas/ bon po rgan pa rnams yid ches dad pa thob pa byung skad/de nas kong po nas yab rje'i gdan 'dren 'byor bar/ 'jang gi bshol dwogs kyis thabs mkhas mdzad sgar yar phebs pa dang rgyal po la de lugs kyi bka' shog zhib rgyas gnang / de nas rim pas kong phyogs su phebs/ yab rje'i drung gi bkris phan bdes gtsos pa'i dgon sde thams cad dang rgyu dngos kyi 'bul chen phul/ yab sras mjal 'phrad legs tshogs che bar mdzad/ de nas bkris chos lung du phebs/ bla ma bkris bra ra bas chos rje sangs rgyas dpal 'byor sprul sku sadan drangs nas sku gzhogs su byon pas bka' lung man ngag thams cad lhug par gnang / nag shod nas skar chen gdan 'dren nan che bar byung yang phebs ma thub pas sku tshab tu chos rje ngag dbang sgar pa brdzangs/ sprul sku dpal 'byor bkris de mo chos sde'i bla mar bskos/ chos rje legs pa don grub dang slob dpon grags pa rgyal mtshan gnyis kyis ri kha sang seng du gdan drangs/ de nas yab rjes gdan drangs nas mda' rab tu chos 'khor bskor/ de dus khams stod 16

rismad nas dgon sde thams cad kyis gdan 'dren nan zhu byas pas/ gnyis su byung yangaka gcig 'di nga rang ma mos/ gnas mjal 'di sngar nas 'gro 'dod yod kyang bod kyi sde bdag tsho skyong dar dka' ba 'dra bsam pas phyi shol du song / sgra mi snyan pa'i tshe sgrub 'di la bsngags pa chen po 'dug pas 'dis go chod dam bsam pa yin te/ slob dpon pa'i gsung lugs dang bcas thog la phog mi phog ci yin kyang da lam nas gnas mjal 'gro ba thag bcad pa yin gsungs nas grwa pa yang dge tshul gtsang ma lhung bskyed 'khar gsil 'dzin pa nyi shu tsam gyis bskor chibs hrag sogs gtan nas ma mdzad par byon pa yang / phyogs phyogs nas bshol btab pa dang / mjal mkhan mang bas 'byon lam la 'gor che ba dang / brag phug dgon du phebs 'phral/ 'jang zhabs nas 'bul skyel bas snga 'gros bang chen 'byor bas de nag shod du phebs/ de skabs nag shod stod smad 'khrugs rtsod chen po byung bar gang des bzhugs sgar nas rta brgya tham pa dang / gnag phyugs sogs rgyu dngos phangs med gnang ste 'khrugs pa zhi bar mdzad/ de rjes rdzi thor bzhugs skabs dmag sgar sde pa'i sras shig yod pa de 'jam dbyangs gtsang pa bdun rgyud kyi lnga pa ba so chos rje'i sku skye yin pa lung bstan yang byung tshulagyis 'di nyid cis kyang rab tu byung dgos gsungs pas/ dpon tshang nas‘‘yi ge bslab mi dgos pa zhig kyang byung / lung bstan 'khrul med byung na phul bas chog7ces zhus pas sgar du gdan drangs nas rab tu byung ste mtshan‘‘lha dbang chos kyi rgyal mtshan’’du gsol/de nas chos khri thang du zla ba ril po gsum bzhugs shing / bzhed rtsa chos sde sogs dge 'dun gyi 'du tshogs dpag tu med pa byung bar mdo sngags kyi zab chos mang du bstsal/ de nas chab mdo nas gdan 'dren byung don 17

chibs sgyur bskyangs te rje drung dge 'dun bkris pa nas ser sbrengs gi sna drangs te zam sne nas phebs bsu zhus/ bzhugs khri gsar brtsegs thog bzhugs su gsol rjes smon lam dang 〈snying po don gsum〉sogs gsung chos gnang / skabs der zhal snga 'phags pa sangs rgyas gang gis mkhan po dang rje drung gis las slob mdzad nas chos rje ngag gi dbang po bsnyen rdzogs bzhes/gzhan yang gang gi drung nas dge tshul slong sgrub mkhan sum brgya lhag tsam byung /lcags rwar byams chen bzhengs par rab gnas kyang mdzad/de nase bkris chos lung du phebs shing / skabs der long po'i sde pa rnams kyis nyi zla thang gi sa cha thob ris phul bas/ nyi zla thang gi dgon pa btab pa dang / rten rgyal ba byams pa gser zangs las grub pa mtho nyer gnyis yod pa zhig bzhengs gnang mdzad pa dang chos sde yang btsugs/ rje nyid kyi gsungs las‘‘slar khams phyogs kyi gdul byas gdan drangs nas lo gsum bar du chab mdor bsdad/ 'bul ba dang zhabs tog dpag med byung ba de dag chud zos ma song bar yar slebs nas nyi zla'i dgon pa btab/lha khang dang byams chen chos sde grub par byas’’zhes gsungs pa ltar byung yod pa dang / de skabs rje nyid dang chos rje ngag dbang yab sras gnyis ka nyi zla thang du bde mchog gi ljags bsnyen mdzad/ sku mtshams grol rjes chol mi gro sgang steng du byams pa bzhengs par rab gnas la gdan drangs par 'byon ma thub kyang / tshes grangs dus sgo bkag nas nyi zla thang nas rab gnas mdzad/bar thag nyin lam lnga drug chod rung / long po nas so ba char pa ltar babs shing / nas 'bru lnga byams pa'i thugs kar lo mang po'i bar du zug pas kun kyang yid ches dad pa lhag par skyes pa byung /de nas phan bder phebs shing / skabs der chos rje ngag dbang 18

khams la laphebs nas gzhi srung dbon po kun bzang yod thog rdo rgyal gyis nyi zla thang la bzhugs pas/ zhal snga rin po che phebs kyang dgon pa gtad mi nyan pas/ phyi ras grang so sor dmag brda gnang sde phebs shing / lha dga' la byon skabs rnal lam du byang sems blo gros 'od zer byon nas ‘‘gnod pa byung dus bzod pa mi sgom na bzod pa nam tsamad+ngha sgom/ gnod lan gnod pas 'jal na skye bo mi nag pa dang khyad par ci yod/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis snyigs dus kyi sems can rnams kyi don mdzad par khyed btang nas khyed kyi mdzad pa 'di 'dra ba ngo mi tsha'am’’gsungs pas/da len lung bstan 'di ltar byung zhing / don la yang de ltar bden pas dmag byed thabs mi 'dug ces drung skor dbu chen pa rnams la gsungs pas/khong rnams kyis don du dmag mi byed kyang 'phral gang gra sgrig cig byas na 'dun ma'i khyad par 'ong bas de ga'i 'phros mdzad dgos zhus pas de ltar mdzad/ chode rjes chos rje ngag dbang spo bo nas byon pa dang / de mo sprul sku gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i yon bdag mchod yon thams cad kha 'chams te dmag dpung che bar bsdus te/ phan bde'i chab dkar nag gnyis kar slebs nas dmag thog tu zhal lnga rin po che 'byon nam mi 'byon zhus pas/ngo ma chog par 'byon par shar zhing dmag rnams gnas gzhi la phyogs nyin dmag mi rnams kyis lam bar la ra lug ba glang mang po bsad nas lam thog tu ra lug dang ba glang gi stod khog smad khog phral ba mang po gzigs pas dmag sgar du byon pa nyid chos rje ngag dbang dang slob dpon sprul sku sogs bla ma slob dpon dang dmag dpon thams cad sku gzhogs su bsdus pas/ngas nyi zla thang gi dgon pa lha rten dngarnyabacas pa bzhengs pa yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang sems can gyi bde skyid la e phan bsam pa yin kyang /19

'di'i don du dmag las byed pa yin na/ bla ma slob dpon dang dge 'dun pas dmag gi ming btags par yang rang gi sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la gnod cing / de ring gcig pu'i sems can nyes med bsad pa 'di rkyang pas sems la bskyod pa'i thabs mi 'dug pas/ sems can spyi'i bde skyid la gnod na dgon gyi dgos pa med/ da khyod rang rnams kyi rang nyi zla thang gi dgon pa dang nga gnyis 'dem ka gyis/ tshig 'di ma gtogs yod re gsungs nas dbu bzung bzhes pas/ thams cad thabs dang bral nas 'a/ga gsum nas dmag rnams gyis/ dmag tshan 'di 'dzom nas don med du gyis dgos pa sangs rgyas mdog ro med pa zhes bskur 'debs kyang zhus par grags/de nas phan bder bzhugs skabs nyang long gnyis ka nas gdan 'dren drag po byung bas 'byor par zhal bzhes mdzad pa la‘‘da ni drug cu'i skag la slebs’’zhes sogs dang‘‘slob dpon bco lnga nyi shu tshun bya bral mdzad la dbus ri bskor’’ces sogs lung bstan zhib rgyas byung bas/ nyang long phyogs su byon rgyu bshol te bka' shog mdzad/ chas bsgyur bya bral mdzad nas byon par thag bcad pa'i rnal lam du tsa ri phyogs nas mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i glu gar mang po mdzad cing bsu ba'i rnam pa byung zhing / ḍa dril sil khrol che bas rnal sad/ de nas tsa ri phyogs nas mkha' 'gro ma zhig slob dpon mjal ba dang sku tshe brtan bzhugs 'bul bar dngos su byung bas// de ska bas bla ma dbu che 'ga' res nas gnas mjal phebs pa 'di 'o rgyal che zhing / dbus gtsang gi sde pa tsho stobs che bas thogs 'gor ci 'dra 'ong mi shes 'dug pas lung bstan rnams su‘‘gnas chen bgrod dang myur lam pho nya bsten/ gang rung byas na brgya cu rtsa bzhi thub’’ces sku tshe bsring thabs 'dra bar gsungs 20

'dug pa da lam mkha' 'gro ma 'di yang tshad ldan yongs grags su snang ba'i rten 'brel 'grigs pa 'dug ces yang yang nan skyed nas zhus pas/sangayorgyas kyi bstan pa la gnod na nga tshe ring ba la dgos pa med pas/ tshe bsring thabs rnams ma slebarnga sdo bar du dgon de gar bzhugs/ der 'bul ba bzhes nas yar byon pas/ gnas lung yar sgrol der nyi shu gnyis nyin snyung gzhi byung zhing / nyer gsum la gad chags shing ra nang du phebs/ sku tshe brtan bzhugs su stod smad kyi dgon thams cad la mang bskol sogs sku rim rgya chen po sgrub/ phyag phyir drung tsho ba gnyis dang de skor gyi 'tsho byed gang mkhas thams cad kyis gsol sman zhus kyang / sku khams bde skyid ma byung bar yon mchod rnams kyis gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab pas sprul pa'i sku 'byon pa'i zhal chem gnang ste/ rje dbon rin po che'i mdzad pa'i rnam thar gsol 'debs las‘‘slar go/nga bdag sogs 'gro ba thams cad la/ brtse bar dgongs nas myur ba nyid du ni zhing 'dir skyo shas bdag sogs tshim par mdzod/ bslu med skyabs mgon khyed la gsol ba 'debs’’zhes gsungs pa ltar de nas dgung lo drug cu bzhes pa'i rab byung dgu pa me pho stag (1566) lo'i hor zla bcu gcig par sku gshegs/ tshes bcu bzhi'i zhogs pa thugs daspa ma grol gyi bar du jo bo dpal ldan skyabs pas mchog tu gus pa'i zhabs tog phun sum tshogs par sgrub/ de nas sku gdung rin po che bkris phan bder gdan drangs nas/ dgung zhag gi ring chos rje ngag gi dbang po dang slob dpon sprul sku/ slob dpon rab 'byams pa sogs dbu chen bu slob thams cad 'tshogs nas gdung mchod la brtson par mdzad cing /dgung zhag grol nas chos lugs grub mtha' ris su med pa'i kong phyogs kyi dgon pa che chung med pa thams cad nas dge 'dun pa rnams gdan drangs 21

pa'i ser tshogs chen mo mdzad/ btsun ma'i dgon chung tshun gyi bla ma thams cad dang khrom tshogs thams cad la mar 'gyed ston mo sogs lha mgu klu mgu'i rgyu dngos phangs med btang / de nas ma 'gyangs bar dngul gdung rin po che bzhengs te sku gdung ril bzhugs mdzad nas rab gnas dang yon 'bul sogs dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i thabs rgya chen po bsgrub par mdzad do/zhal snga rin po che 'phags pa sangs rgyas gang 'diro zal slob kyang thugs sras kyi thu bo lha dbang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang / nam mkha' rgyal mtshan sogs mkhas sgrub gnyis ldan gyi bla ma dang slob dpon mang du byung yod/'phags pa lha sku phreng gsum pa/'phags pa lha sku phreng gsum pa mthong ba don ldan ni rab byung bcu pa'i me yos ( 1567)lo long po stod pa zhes par yab o rgyan dang yum bkra shis lha mo'i sras su bltams/dgung grangs lngar bzhes skabs nyang po sang sing zhes bya ba nas rje gong mas rtsa gra gnas brtan rgya mi dang dge slong don grub legs pa gnyis la dad rten gnang ba'i gser sku dang na bza' skor sogs ngo ma dang ngo 'dra re bcas yab yum gyi khyim mtshes zhig tu gnas g.yar gyis gdan 'dren zhus nas spyan lam du bstar bar ngo ma rnams ma 'dres/ par bzhes pa sogs ngos 'dzin ches gsal ba mang po byung bas bkra shis chos lung nas slob dpon dkon mchog grags pa dang / dbon po rin po che rgyal po/ dpon zil gnon sogs yon mchod bka' bgros kyis chung srid mchog sprul rin po che bkra shis chos lung du gdan drangs/ de gar yang sku gong ma'i mchod rdzas 22

'ga' zhig yod pa rnams la'ang ngos 'dzin mdzad/ de nas mi ring bar bkris phan bder gdan drangs shingaka sku gong mas yun ring bcibs myong ba'i chibs chen nor bu shangs dkar zhes pa zhig yod pa des kyang gang nyid la dga' tshor rnam pa tshad med byas pas khrom tshogs rnams ngo mtshar yid chesachisu gyur/de nas de mo lar gdan drangs te sku gong ma'i gser sdong la rab gnas mdzad cing / dgung grangs lnga nas brgyad par kong khul dgon khag rnams su gdan 'dren gar zhus par phebs pa dang / gtso cher bkris phan bde de mo lha khang dang pho brang lcang lo can du bzhugs/ 'bri klog sogs nyer mkho'i rig gnas dang gsang bde 'jigs gsum gyi dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs sogs chos bka' mang po'i dbang lung rnams ngag dbang shākya rgyal mtshan gyi drung nas gsan sbyong bskyangs/ de nas khams phyogs nas gdan zhur chos rje ngag gi dbang po phebs kyang de 'phral chibs sgyur ma thub cing / rjes su phebs rgyu'i zhal bzhes gnang / dgung grangs brgyad pa rab byung bcu pa shing khyi (1574)lo phan bde'i gdan sar mkhan chen nam mkha' rgya mtsho dang / 'chad nyan pa slob dpon dge legs rgya mtsho/ gnyer pa bsod nams grags pa bcas bskos nas rab byung bcu pa shing phag ( 1575)lo phan bde'i gdan pa nas bzhugs sgar btegs te long po bkra shis chos lung du phebs shing / zom por ngag dbang dpal 'byor gyis thugs sam rten rgya dngul gyi sgrol ma dang / sgam po zhabs drung bkra shis rnam rgyal gyis chos rje sangs rgyas dpal 'byor nas stazhengs pa'i zhal snga'i bka' 'bum gser bris glegs bam gnyis sogs 'bul ba gtos che bstar/mda' rgya tshal du phebs skabs ngag dbang shākya rgyal mtshan pas mkhan 23

po rgyal tshab sangs rgyas 'byung gnas kyis las slob/ slob dpon rin po che dge legs rgya mtshos zhu ba po dus bgo zhus te dge tshul gyi sdom bzhes bskyangs/mtshan gyi thog mar 'phags pa ni mkhan chen rin po ches gsol/ ‘‘bsod nams rnam par rgyal ba'i dbang po'i sde’’zhes pa ni rgyal tshab rin po che (sangs rgyas 'byung gnas) la chos skyong gi lung bstan pa ltar gsol bar mdzad/ de ri kha sang sing gi chos rje dang stag phu chos rje sogs nyang long gi skya ser mtha' dag chos 'brel gyis tshim par mdzad/ lha ri ma thang sogs bya rgyud kyi skya ser mtha' yas pa'i don mdzad nas rngod a rigs thang du phebs/der sku gzhag gi grwa tshang btsugs nas 'chad nyan slob dpon chos dar rgya mtsho bskos/ dpal 'bar du byon par chos rje rin po che grags pa dang nang so gnyis kas zhabs spyi bor blangs/ chos khri thang du phebs/ pas chos rje ngag gi dbang po dang / rje drung lha dbang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dbu ri chos rje dkon mchog legs grub sogs gong ma'i dbu chen rnams kyis gtsos pa'i lho stod smad kyi skya ser mtha' dag zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mjal bar 'dus/dbang bka' smon lam sogs so so'i thugs 'dod gang bar mdzad/ spo bo sde dgon thams cad kyis gdan drangs nas spro bo phar lung tshur lung yul dgon tshang ma'i 'bul gsol zhabs tog mtha' yas shing / wa'u dag mgon khang bla ma dang / 'bur 'og bla ma bka' bcu pa sangs rgyas 'od zer/the gsar dgon gyi bla ma tshul khrims blo gros sogs kyis gdan drangs/dbang lung smon lam sogs kyis re ba gang bar mdzad/spo mda' nas mgon po bsod nams kyis gdan drangs/ rgyal po nag 'thing gi dge rtsar 'bul chen phul/ dgon 'debs pa'i zhu ba phul kyang zhal bzhes ma mdzad/ der tsha ba stod smad kyi khrom tshogs tshad med 'dus24

chab mdo byams pa gling du gdan drangs pas der phebs/ rje drung shes rab dbang po dang grwa tshang lnga'i bla mas thog drangs/ 'dus pa thams cad mchog tu dad par gyur pas/ sku gsung thusas rten dngos spyad bsam gyis mi khyab pa phul/ bzhugs khri chen po'i thog nas nyin re bzhin smon lam dbang chos bstsal la/ snyan ngag kun tu bzang po'i rigs kyi thugs rtsom yang mang bar mdzad/ sar sgong chos rjes gdan drangs te/ tshe dpag med gser sku bzhengs pa la rab gnas zhus pas/ phyag nas zug pa dang mar me 'dzin pa sogs ngo mtshar che bar byung / rje btsun tsong kha pa'i phyag dril sogs rten gsum dngos spyad spung che bar phul/ de nas chos khri thang du byon nas dbyar gnas mdzad/ lho khog gi bla ma dge 'dun dpag tu med pa 'tshogs par zab chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ dbyar gnas grol 'phral spo bor phebs par kha mchu che bar byung yang bar 'dum mdzad pas mdun ma zhi 'jags su gyur/rgya ston pas gdan drangs te bde stong du phebs/ rgya ston drung pa dang thugs yid gcig 'dres su gyur/ de bar yab sras mnyam bzhugs mdzad nas 'phags pa lha'i bka' 'bum bde mchog snyan rgyud grub snying gi skor sogs gong ma'i bka' lung man ngag thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'bul bzhes bskyangs/ sa tham rgyal po mi nyag jakwa pa/ go bo dbon po rnams kyis gdan 'dren zhus kyang chos rje ngag dbang dang rje drung lha dbang sogs bu chen rnams bka' bgros mdzad de/ 'phags pa rin po che sku na phra bas re zhig thag ring 'byon par mi 'thad/ 'on kyang sa tham rgyal po de rje gong ma'i dus nas 'dul skal lta bur 'dug pas/ rgyal po'i thugs skong ched slob dpon rgyal tshab rin po che rang 'byon par 'thad pa'i bka' bgros shar te slob dpon sgar pa 'jang zhabs su phebs/ de dus cor pa jag pa dang go bo 25

dbon nang ma mthun pa'i bar mdzad pa sogs lo shas thogs/de nas sa tham du phebs pas rgyal po dang rgyal tshab slob dpon mjal 'phrad legs par byung ste/ 'phags pa rin po che sku na phra yang mjal ba snga phyi yod pas/ zhu yig dang bcas gdan 'dren drag po gtong rgyu yin cing /sgar pa phyir ma phebs par khyod rang slob dpon yar 'byon mi nyan zer ba dang / gdan 'dren 'phral mar btang / slob dpon sgar pa smar khams skor du bzhugasda/ 'phags pa rin po che yang chos rje ngag dbang gis gdan drangs nas spo bo phar lung tshur lung dang / ye gang nang / sna7 rda 'byag rgyangs sogs thams cad du phebs/ spo bo chu mdo pa dang / kaḥnam pa'i dbar 'khrug chen langs te bar pa sus kyang ma thub pas/ 'phags pa rin po che g.yul thog tu phebs nas g.yul mtshams phye ste sde 'khrug zhi 'jags mdzad/sde dgon gnyis ka nas 'bul ba phul/ de nas 'jang gis gdan drangs nas tsha ba them thog tu phebs dus/ 'u yan tshe dbang rgyal po dang dpon mgon po bsod nams kha mchu che bar 'dug par 'dum mdzad nas kha mchu 'phar ma mi byed pa dang slar dgra 'dzin mi byed pa'i bka' bsgo dam bzhag mdzad/ de bzhin shog sum pa dang zing gsum mkhar kha mchu chen po byung bar yang rgyu dngos phangs med gnang ste 'khrug chen gyi 'dum mdzad/ de nas mi nyag jag pa'i gnyer pa wa lcag dang / sa tham rgyal po gdan 'dren pa rgyal po zul shel dang / rgya ja dbon po rnams byung bas sa tham du byon/bsu ba 'bul zhabs tshad med par byas/ rgyal po chen pos zhabs spyi bor blangs/ tshe dbang sogs zab chos gang 'dod du gnang bas rgyal po'i thugs bzhed yongs su rdzogs par mdzad/ khrom tshogs mang ma rnams skad rigs mi gcig pas don ma go yang / gsung gi nga ro rnams drung du nye ba 26

rnams la ha cang mi che zhing / thag ring du gnas pa rnams la ha cang mi chung bas thams cad ngo mtshar shin tu dad par gyur/ yun ring bzhugs par nan zhus mdzad kyang / de lo byon phyis pas rgya tshad stabs kyis zhag nyer bzhi las ma bzhugs/ jag pa shog bzhi'i mnga' khul du lo gsum bzhugs pa'i zhal bzhes gnang bas/ rgyal khang pho brang thams cad la rab gnas rgyas par mdzad/ rgyal gdong kur rtsi 'og dang / rdo khang rdzong dang / tsha lhas skor la phebs bzhugs kyis pa ra thang du phebs nas der sa 'dus che bas/sa dge rnying bka' brgyud/ kamartsotshang pa sogs phyogs ris med pa'i skya ser 'du tshogs che ba 'tshogs/ dbang bka' smon lam sogs so sor 'dod chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ de dus spom mda' nas dpon mgon po bsod nams kyis spom mda'i sa mal sde dgon gzhis su phul nas dpon tshang rgyal po'i kha chems yin pas dgon 'debs rgyur nan zhu byas par‘‘sku gong ma'i dgon gnas rnying pa rnams nyams skyon med khar/ gsar 'debs kyi dgos pa mi 'dug na'ang kho rang blo kha rdzogs par mi 'dug na/ bon po tsho dang 'dod pa mthun pa byung na’’dgon 'debs pa'i zhal bzhes gnang ste/ rje dbon rgyal tshab slob dpon rnamame phebs nas bon po tsho dang gros bstun/rgyal shod ban sgar ltar 'du khang gcig nang mnyam durtso tshogs kyang gral dang 'don cha so so bya rgyu dang / skyid sdug khyad med par ban bzang bon bzang du byas te/ dpon tshang gi khang pa de rang gzim khang du mdzad/ 'bo dgon tshan lnga/ gsa' dgon tshan drug brag gnor gnyis/ phya chu bar tshun gyi so sor spyi khang re bzo bar mdzad/ sa bgos khang tshan bzung / spyi khang 'ga' zhig bzo skrun thon pa der bon po rnams blo log skyes te mchod yon gnyis ka bkrong rgyur thag bcad kyang / rgyal tshab rin po che ni rdzu sprul gyis 27

bkrong ma thub/ dpon mgon po bsod nams rkyen dbang du song / de nas sang nyin der 'bo dgon pa rnams kyi ra mda' slebs pas mi ngan rnams bros/ spo mda' tshur lon te slar ban bon med kyi ser dmag sde che bar 'dus pas/ kho pa rnams kyis bshags pa phul/ dgon pa'i lha khang sogs zhib tshags byed par dbon po bka' bcu pa dang gnyer pa rgyal mtshan bkra shis sogs bzhas/ slodza dpon rin po che dang yab rje sprul pa'i sku'i sgar gnyis ka 'phags pa rin po che sku gzhogs su byon pas/ 'ba' pas gdan drangs/ 'bul zhabs tshad med par byas te dbus pa dang 'phrag mi kha mchu chen po snang ba de yang 'dum par mdzad nas smar khams su yab sras gsum ka mnyam du bzhugs/ rgyal tshab rin po ches snyan skul zhus nas/ lha mo dud gsol ma'i yig cha rgyas pa bka' rtsom yang gnang / gzhan yang zhu ba po so so'i 'dod mos ltar bka' rtsom mang du gnang / slar sa tham rang du byon nas rgyal po dang mjal 'dzoms yang yang mdzad cing / lo gsum bzhi phebs rgyu bshol bas/ 'jang zhabs su lo mang bzhugs/ der bzhugs ring rgya dmag gis khul der dmag gshom yang yang byas kyang / 'phages pa lha'i bka' gang gnang bsgrubs pa las/ yul sder gnod 'tshe ma byas pas 'jang bod gnyis kar phan thogs chen po byung yod/ de nas chab mdo byams pa gling nas gdan 'dren yang yang zhus pas/rgyal po la thabs mkhas kyis bka' shog gnang nye skor gyi rdzong dpon dang go bo dbon po sogs kyis bshol kyang ma gsan par chibs kha bsgyur te rim gyis tsha ba spom mdar phebs nas dgon par rab gnas mdzad cing / gangs dkar bden bzhi zhes pa'i ming yang gnang / snga sor spom mda'i kha mchu'i dus su sgar chen yang tsha ba phab so bar du phebs/ der thub dbang deng 28

byams pa/ 'jam dbyangs/ phyag rdor/ spyan ras gzigs/ sgrol ma/rnam sras rta brgyad/ rje tsong kha pa dang bcas pa zhal gzigs pa'i phyag bris zhal thang bzhengs pa phan bde na bzhugs/de nas chab mdo byams pa gling du byon pas/ bsu ba dang 'bul zhabs tshad med pa zhus te/ ma ra thang gi bzhugs khri'i thog nas rje tsong kha pa che mo drung ku cor la gnang ba'i snying po don gsum gyi khrid rgyas pa de gsung chos su gnang / de nas chab mdo khri thog tu bzhugs pa'i gsol ba patab kyang zhal gyis ma bzhes rje drung lha dbang de dus chab mdo'i chos rje mdzad bzhin par yin yang / gling stod smad kha mchu'i rkyen gyis thugs ma dgyes par rta tshag tu byon pas/ khong phyir gdan drangs nas sngar lugs ltar mdzad pa zhu ba dang / nged rang yang bsnyen rdzogs dang dbang bka' rjes gnang sogs kyang zhu dgos yod gsungs pas/ rje drung rin po che lha dbang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po/ slob dpon rgyal tshab rin po ches las slob/ nub gling slob dpon shes rab blo gros pas gsang ston/ lcang ra rab 'byams pas dus bgo/ khu dbyug rab 'byams pa dge legs dpal bzang gis zhu ba po zhus te/ las grel ba dge slong brgya phrag gi dbus su/rje 'phags pa lha mchog nas dgung grangs nyer brgyad la phebatshos pa/ rgyal ba zhes pa shing rta (1594) lo hor zla dgu pa'i yar tshes brgyad la bsnyen rdzogs bzhes/ rje drung rin po che nas slar yang khri thog bzhugs pa'i bka' skul gnang yang ma gsan par/ cirje drung rang gis thugs 'khur gtso bor bzhes te chab mdo spyi chen dang bcas zhu nan ches pas/ byang sems (shes rab bzang po ) rin po che'i gdan rabs bcu gsum pa'i khri thog tu phebs shing / zab chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ bar mdzad/ de lo 'jang gi rgya dmag 29

'ba' khul 'byor zhing / rje mthong ba don ldan gang nyid rab gnas su gdan 'dren zhu bar rgyal blon tharma sa cad kyi zhu yig dang go bo dbon po sogs slebs kyang phebs ma thub/ chos rje ngag dbang gi dgongs rdzogs sgrub par slob dpon rgyal tshab rin po che byon/ rje drung rin po ches bsgrub thabs rgya mtsho sogs bka' chos phul bar lo gcig bar chab mdor bzhugaṭar /'phags pa lha mchog nas spyan ras gzigs kyi zhing bkod rgya nag lugs thang mo che grwa tshang gi phyag bris gnang / gzhan yang zhu ba po so so'i 'dod chos su gsol 'debs dang smon lam gyi rim pa sogs mang du mdzad/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i gser gdung chen po bzhengs pa'i zhal bkod dang gzungs 'bul rab gnas rgyas par gnang /sku gzhog grwa tshang gi slob dpon byams pa bsod nams shes rab la bsko gzhag gnang / 'dan cho sa 'khor gling du gdan 'dren zhus kyang spo bo'i chos sde khag gsum nang 'khrugajim 'jags par bar mdzad par spo bo ra byon/bka' bkod do dam mdzad pas 'khrug pa zhi 'jags kyis phan thogs che bar mdzad/ chu mdo dang chos rdzong sogs grwa rim khag la mi hra'i khrid drug gi dbang lung rjes gnang bcas pa bka' drin bskyangs/ gdung rten bkra shis 'od 'bar gdan drangs te/ gzungs gzhug thams cad rje rang gis mdzad de dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgo nas rab gnas rgyas par mdzad/ sum rdzong dang chos rdzong / lcags rta/ mda' zhing / ra ngag dgon/ wa'u stag bcas kyi spyi blar de mo sprul sku/ bsko gzhag mdzad/ de skabs srung ma'i mnga' gsol dang chos skyong gi bstod skul/ bsang mchod/ zhal gdams bslab bya sogs bka' rtsom yang ma nga du camadzad/ de dus phan bde nas slob dpon rin po che nam mkha' rgya mtshos gtso mdzad bka' brgyud stod smad 30

thams cad kyis kong phyogs su gdan 'dren zhus kyang re zhig byon ma thub/chos khrir phebs skabs rje drung gis rta tshag tu gad na drangs nas 'bul chen btegs shibotshe dbang dang mgon po'i rje gnang / sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang so gas rme nga du phul/ rje drung shes rab dbang po'i sprul sku rab tu byung ba'i 4 /khan po mdzad/ bka' lung man ngag sogs mang du gnang / chos rjes ngag dbang gi sprul sku long po nas byon pa la/ ja 'dren dang gdan 'dren gnang ste/ sku gzhogs su phebs nas rab tu byung bar mdzad de/ngag dbang chos 'byor bzang po zhes mtshan du gsol/ phug yul ba kong po'e kha mchu zhi bar mdzad pas phug yul sde pas dbang ris mnga' zhabs dang bcas pa phul/ de dus slob dpon de mo sprul skus zhu skul ltar/ bsang yig snyan ngag gis brgyan pa de yang bka' rtsom gnang / rje drung rin po ches rta tshag tu gdan drangs te 'bul chen bsam gyis mi khyab pa phul/ rgyal shod dang nag shod kyi yul dgon tshang mas gdan drangs/ gar byon thams cad du khrom tshogs che zhing / 'khrug pa me'i chung med pa tshang ma bar 'dum gnang ste zhi 'jags mdzad/ rngon pa dang sdig bshags phul ba dang / bsnyen gnas dang yig drug gi khas ri rgya klung rgya dgon sde so so'i zhal bdag zhu ba/chos khrims sdom pa/ dge slong dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa zhu ba/ dbang chos zhu ba sogs mtha' yas pa byung / nag shod 'phags lung skyog ma ra grags pa ltar/ rgya dkar nag gi rten gsumrobyin rlabs can dang / ge sar gyi phyag mtshan ral gri sogs rten chas rtsa che mang po dang / rta norashra khrab sgogs zang zin gi dngos po bsam las 'das pa byung bar snang / de nagalcags ra ra phebs pas/ snga sor de skor du sde pa dbang grags kyis zhe bsun mang du byas pes bshags pa 'bul ba 31

la slebs/ chibs pa phul ba des kyang phyag 'tshal zhing / me tog gi char babs pa dang 'ja' sprin sogs sngar ma mthong ba'i ya mtshan mang po mthong bas kun yid 'phrog par gyur/ sngon 'brel gyi rigs sad pas/ de snga dkar lugs kho nar dad kyang / de nyin nas blo sna rtsa ba nas 'gyur te mchi ma'ang mi chad pa shor/ sangs rgyas dngos kyi mos gus thob pas da ni skye ba dang tshe rabs thams cad du re sa skyabs gnas gzhan mi 'tshol bas/ de nyin nas skra bcad lus bsgyur nas/ phyag phyir bka' bzhin bsgrubs pa tha na mdzo rdzi dang a drung gyis gsungs na'ang byed pa lags zhus pas khyod rang kha zhe med pa de ltar yin na/ skra bcad lus bsgyur byed mi dgos par/ sde pa dril gsar rkang gnyis dang / phug yul sde pa'i sa cha mi sde bla ris cho skal du phul byung ba 'di dag lcags rwar la grwa tshang btsugs te de'i chos gzhis gyis la bla ma dang grwa tshang gi phogs dang gsol ba 'bas tog thams cad khyed kyis byed pa dang / mi sde lha sde thams cad byams kyis bskyangs shing 'khrugs rtsod med par gyis dang / chos skal des kyang / da lta'i bsam pa de ye ma 'gyur na tsho mkha' 'gro chos skyong gis rjes su bzung bas/ de bzhin mdzod gsungs te/chos skyong che chung gi rjes gnang dang tshe dbang brgya rtsa gnang ste/ lcags rī'i gzhis gnyer du bskos/ de nas sde pa rang dgon du bzhugs na/ dgon pa'i sgrig la gnod par 'dug pas rdzong gsar du brtsegs te/ rab gnas su gdan 'dren zhus/phan bde nas gdan 'dren pa snga dus nas phyag phyir 'brang mus yod pa dang / slar yang gdan 'dren skyar ma slebs nas phebs rtsis mdzad pa la/chab mdo nas spyi dgos kyi gdan 'dren spungs che ba dang / be re'i gdan 'dren nan che ba'ang phyag phyir 'brang / de nas a rigs thang du slebs pa 32

dang / chab mdo nas gdan 'dren bskyar ma dang / gangs dkar bde chen sogs tsha ba'i dbo/na sde rnams kyis gdan 'dren dang / be ri rgyal po'i gdan 'dren pa bcas thams cad 'dzoms/ 'on kyang rje drung rin po che snyung gzhi drag po byung bas gdan 'dren pa rnams re zhig phyir phebs dgos shar/ kong po'i gdan 'dren pa 'ga' zhig phyag phyir 'brang / grwa pa gnyis la rje gong ma'i rgya khri rnying ma gcig dang gsol lcog rag shan ma byin can de gnyis gnang nas/ 'di gnyis gar slebs der nga rang slebs 'ong bas bkal song zhig gsungs pa la/ phyag mdzod pa kong por byon pa la mi dga' bas bkal sa'i mdzo ma bskur/ grwa pa gnyis kyis khur nas 'ong yang /kha ba che bas rkang pa 'tshig ste/ lcags la la rtsa nas /ma rigs thang pa'i tshong pa phyir 'ong ba la bskur nas/ sde pa dbang grags kyis lcags rwa blangs pas/phyis su sprul pa'i sku long por smyorakhrungs kyang kong po nas gdan drangs par/sde pa dbang grags kyis gdan drangs pas lung bstan la yid ches thob/de nas rta tshag tu byon/ rje drung rin po che la sku tshe brtan bzhugs dang / tshe mgon zung 'brel gyi rjes gnang mang po dang smo brtsegs dang rnam 'joms kyi dbang byabs 'khrus dang bcas pa gnang / be ri rgyal po'i mi sna dang chos sgar ba'i ja 'dren slebs khar/ chab mdo ba'i ja 'dren nan zhu slebs rung phebs ma thub/ de nas slar yang chu drag mdar be ri rgyal po gzhung gi ja 'dren slebs/ de nas gangs dkar bde chen la phebs pas/be ri rgyal po yang phyag 'bul du slebs/ der dgon pa'i mkhar las dang ban khral bsdu ba/ bca' ba khrims gsum sogs kyi bka' shog kyang gnang /chu yos (16rkya2) sog yul nas rje thams cad mkhyen pa yon tan rgya mtsho mchog dbus phyogs su chibs kha bsgyur ba'i gtam snyan dang / 'phags pa 33

lha mchog sog yul du spyan 'dren pa so so'i rgyal po rnams kyi zhu yig dang /phyag mdzod seng ge'i zhu yig dang mi sna mang bar slebs nas—nan zhus mdzad kyang / rje thams cad mkhyen pa dang mjal 'dod che yang / sog ngo/'i rgyal po tsho dang 'phrad na rang dbang 'dus pa zhig mi yong gsungs nas zha14 bzhes ma mdzad/ de skabs be ri rgyal po sogs rang phyogs kyi mchod yon shes/ yod thams cad nas 'khyug tsam phebs na gang phyir phan che bas phebs par 'thad lugs zhu ba phul 'dug kyang gsan dgongs ma mdzad pangani/ khyi lo zhing khams su gshegs rgyu de dus nas dgongs pa yod kyang ma sa/sungaṭasdo pa red ces dad pa lha ga tu snye'aphel/ be ri rgyal po'i tsha ba stod sku lha ngang yag gi 'dab zhol du sa/dan drangs/ rgyal po dang rgyal mo/ sras don yod rgyal/ chos sgar ba rgyal rigs dpon rigs sogs dang / sde thos/ so so nas 'bul ba cher btegs shing / dbang chos smon lam tshad med par gnang /'dan chos 'khor gling pa nas gdan 'dren drag po byung ba dang ri chab kyi cha/dun ma mdzad rtsis la/ rje drung rin po che snyung gzhi byung bas gdan 'dren yang slebs/ sku tshe mi bstan par gzigs nas glo bur du yar byon/chos khri thang du phebs nas/ tshes bcu'i mchod pa rgyas par mdzad de/lcam myo/da' chos rje dang tsha 'phong drung pa sogaṭashrī phyag phyi'i bla ma rnams so so'i gdan sar byon/ sgar chos khri ru bzhugs/ chibs hrag drung 'khor rta tshag tu phebs te sku tshe bstan bzhugs dang tshe mabo/na zung 'brel gyi dbang yang yang du phul/ lcags rwar grwa tshang btsugs pa'i zhal bkod mdzad nas sde pa rgya 'grul la song / 'brug gi lo'i lo gsar de gar mdzad/ dus gtor mnga' gsol dang / bstan gsol thams cad sngar srol las rgyas par mdzad de/ tshes gsum la sgar btegs/ nas/ 'gu tsha gang la bzhugs/34

de nas sku khams cung zhig ma bde yang bka' lung ci yang ma gsan 'di skor de dus gsol dpon phun tshogs kyis bris pa 'di lta ste dus gsum rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse gcig bsdus pa'i/ 'phags pa'i mtshan gsol ltar bcas 'gro ba'i mgon/ bsod nams rnam par rgyal ba dbang po'i sde/ zhabs pad la 'dud thugs rje'i lcags kyus bzung / khro mo ( 16rkya5) lo yi hor zla dang po yi/ yar ngo'i dus kyi rgyal ba bdag po'i nyin/ srid gsum 'gro ba'i yon gam/sa bla na med/ thub bstan nam mkha'i rgyan cig rgyal ba'i sku/bdud rigs dus me'i lag pas sgrig pa'i tshogs/ cung zad bsnyung zhes nye ba'i 'khor la gsungs/ rgya mtsho'i tshes la ches cher bzung tshul bstam// de nas bzung ste bstan bzhugs 'phrod bsten dang / sku rim gsol 'dems me shor ra mda' bzhin/ 'bad rtsol brtson 'grus le lor ma song byas/tshes dgu'i tho rangs thugs dang bka' lung 'gyur/ da ni sman dang rim gro ma byed par/ nga yi tshig 'di nyams su longs shig gsungs/ tshogs pa spyi dang bye brag so so la/ gang la gang 'tshams bka' chems zhib tu gsungs/'khor tshogs rtse gcig gdung shugs smre sngags kyis/ sku rim bstan bzhugs gsol ba drag tu btab/ zhal bzhesda ma mdzad lkeṭa ki'i tshes pa la/ dag pa'i zhing du gshegs pa'i thugs thag bstocad/ bla ma lharwa bcas kun gyi lung bsta’na pa'i/ rgyal tshab dam pa burda ka ra la/ 'di dang 'di ltar ma dzad 'phrin skyong zhes gsu ngas/ gsu nga gi phyi ma bka' chems yi ger bkod/gsang ba'i zhal chems nang 'khor rnams la gsudas/ tshes bcu'i nyi ma shar ba dang dus mnyam du/ 'phags ma 'od zer can ma zhal gzigs shing /phyag mchod gsol 'debs smon ldamaci lha snrogs mdzad/ sku tshe mdzad 'phrin rdzogs pa lta bur gsungs/ de yi nub morji mnalta lam byung ba'i tshul/ bkra 35

shis phan bde'i shing ra nang du phebs/ bstan ma khang nas 'dra man gsum byung ste/ sngon chad dgon rnams nged rnams gang drag byas/ da ni phyag phyir 'os zhes zer byung yang / de dag pho mo gang yin ma nges pas/ mnyam du khrid pa'i zhal bzhes ma mdzad gsungs/ sku gsum lhun grub rje btsun bla ma de/ bden gnyis zung 'jug ji lta ji rnyed gzigs / don gnyis mthar phyin sku ri'i mdzad 'phrin rdzogs/ bde chen dag pa'i zhing du gshegs par gyur zhes sogs gsal ba bzhin shing 'brug(1604) lo kong po che shog gi kha mchu'i mdun mar phebs pa'i lam thog tu cung zad snyun tshul gyis mkhar ltag ces par sku gshegs/ 'phags pa lha sku phreng bzhi pa/ 'phags pa lha sku phreng bzhi pa/ 'phags pa chos kyi rgyal po ni rab byung bcu pa'i shing sbrul ( 1605) lo/ long po stod pa zhes par yab tshe thar don grub dang yum mkha' 'gro'i mtshan rtags du ma ldan nga/ rgyal mo zhes pa'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ yab rje nyid ni skye bo phal pa'i tshul bzhes kyang don dam sprul pa'i skye bu zhig yin pas/ ri dwags la mda' bskyon par brag zang thal du phug pa'i shul nas chu 'babs pa dang / brag snyesmu phyag zhabs kyi rjes gsal bar bzhag pa sogs ngo mtshar ldan pa zhig yod pa grags/mchog gi sprul sku rin po che gang 'di ni sku chung ngu'i dus gsung byon mkhyen tsam nas sku skye sngon ma'i skor gsung gi yod pas dkar phug bla ma ngag dbang 'jam dpal bzang pos mtshan rdo rje 'phags mchog tu gsol/mchod chang 'dren pa la nga chang 'thung ba'i bla ma min/ ja bskol gsungs 36

par rang tshang la ja bskol ba'i thab chas med zhus pas/ bskol snod rdo khog gyis gsungs nas rdo la phyag mdzub kyi kong kong bzos pa gnyis gnang ba gcig ma yum gyi dad rten du bzung zhing / gcig la gser gsol nas deng po chos khri thang du bzhugs/de nas dgung lo bzhir son pa ste sa sprel lor bkris chos lung du gdan drangs/ de skabs phan bde nas gdan 'dren zhus kyang / snga gong rten 'brel cung zad 'phyugs pas gdan 'dren ma thub/ chab mdo nas slob dpon rgyal tshab rin po ches gsol ja dang na bza' phul ba dang / ‘‘pad dkar 'dzin pa rdo rje'i sku rnyed pa’’zhes sogs sku tshe brtan bzhugs kyang 'bul bar mdzad/ de nas lcags khyi (161rkya)lor sde pa dbang grags kyi gdan 'dren zhus nas dbus su phebs/ mal gro rin chen gling du bsu ba ser sbreng rgyas par mdzad nas gdan 'dren zhus pas kun gyis mthong ba'i me tog gi char babs/ 'brog ri bo dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling nas bsu ba ser sbreng rgyas par ma dzad nas gdan drangs/ rgyal ba tsong kha pa'i bzhugs khri'i thog tu bzhugs/ de dus lo shas bar chad kyi rnam pas dga' ldan grub chu de chung chung rang las med pa phyag nas mdzad pas grub chu sngar las kyang che bar babs pa thams cad shin tu dad par gyur/ —de nas 'bras spungs nas bsu ba gser sbrengs rgyas par mdzad nas gdan drangs/ rgyal dbang yon tan rgya mtshor dbu'i gtsug phud phul zhing /‘‘'phags pa thams cad la sa rnam par rgyal ba chos kyi rgyal po'i sde’’(rnam thar phyogs sgrig las‘‘rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sde’’zhes gsal ba yig nor yin par snyam ste bcos kyang dpyad par 'tshal)zhes pa'i mtshan gsol bskyangs pa dang mtshan spel brtan bzhugs gsol 'debs kyang mdzad/ de dus phan bde nas 37

gdan 'dren pa byung yang / kong phyogs su skabs der 'khrugs zing langs te dus pade med gshis/ bkris chos lung du khyug tsam byon te khams phyogs su phebs/ chab mdo dgon du gdan 'dren par slob dpon rgyal tshab rin po che chos khri bar du byon/ rgyal shod dang nag shod/ lho stod mi da/ spo bo sogs kyi khul nas bla ma dang mi dpon/ ser skya du ma mjal khar bcar mkhan 'du tshogs shin tu chen po byung /de rjes spo bo dang / lcags rwar dpal 'bar/ rgyal shod/ nag shod khul du phebs par gdul bya'i 'phrin las rgyas par byung ste slar yang chab mdo byams pa gling du phebs rjes slob dpon rgyal tshab rin po che'i drung du dge tshul gyi sdom pa 'bul bzhes bskyangs pa dang / 'khor lo bde mchog snyan brgyud kyi yab bka' yum bka' sogs sku gong ma'i dbang lu nga man ngag yongs su rdzogs pa slob dpon gang de'i drung nas gsan bzhes bskyangs/de nas be ri rgyal pos gdan 'dren zhus don bzhi/na rje yab sras gnyis dang /chosacarje ngag dbang / rta tshag rje drung sogs phebs shing / so sor 'bul chen dpag tu med pa phul ba dang dbang lung sogs bka' chos gang la gang 'dod du gnang / de nas chab mdor phyir phebs rjes slob dpon rgyal tshab rin po che zhing du gshegs / (〈bod rgya tshig mdzod chen mo/〉las‘‘1rdzo6 0lcags sprel lo/dbon drung gshegs nas 'phags pa lha chos kyi rgyal po chab mdo'i khrir phebs’’zhes gsal ba 'di skabs yin tshe gang 'di'i dgung grang sa bcu drug tu son lo yin)9redu khang du zangs gser las grub pa'i byam/sa chen gyi sku brnyan gas ra bzhengs brkyangs pa sogs dgongs rdzogs rgya che bsgrubs rjes yab sras lhan 38

cig 'jang dang be ri'i rtsod gzhi'i 'dum mādzad par tsha kha rdzong bar du byon nas kha mchu zhi 'jags yong ba mdzad/ de skabs rdo chung chung zhig la phyag g.yas pa'i mthe bong gi rjes shin tu gsal bar bzhags gnang ba de nyid gsol dpon phun tshogs kyis rnyed nas gser gsol te kho/ nga rang ma 'das bar 'bral med dad rten du nyar zhing / 'da' khar dkar chag dang bcas bzhugs sgar gyi rtsis sprod ṇings su bzhagachos rje ngag dbang sgar pa (sku 'khor ) de snga 'jang khul du byon par gdul bya'i 'phrin las chen po byung zhing / char+pā mdor phyir phebs kyi 'bul chen bsam gyis mi khyab pa phul bas gang spyi'i stobag 'byor che tsam byung stabs 'phags pa lha mchog dbus gtsang du byon rgyu'i bka' gros kyis chos che ngag dbang dang dbon po 'phags pa chos grags chab mdor bzhugs nas shing glang (162 5) lo 'phags pa lha sku 'khor lho phyogs su byon zhing / slob dpon de mo sprul sku'ang de sngon 'jang khul du byon nas gdul bya'i 'phrin las rgyas po byung bas/ khong gis kyang 'bul chen btegs/ de sngon phan bde nas kong phyogs su gdan 'dren yang yang zhus kyang phebs ma thub/ de skabs zhar du phebs/ de nas nyang po rgya mdar phebs skabs phan bde nas kong por gdan 'dren zhu ba'i snyan zhu dang / na bza'/ chos chas/chibs rta bcas 'bul mi 'byor zhing / chibs pa des phyis rdo steng rmig rjes yang yang bzhag skad/de nas 'brog ri bo dga' ldan du phebs shing / de skabs nam mkha' nas 'ja' sprin dra ba ltar sbrel ba sogs ngo mtshar gyi ltas du ma byung bar dge 'dun pa rnams kyang thugs dad skyes/ de skabs 'phags pa lha gang der rje tsong kha pa 'ja' sprin gyi dbus nas mjal gzigs par grags/ de nas 39

'bras spungs su rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho dang mjal 'phrad kyis rten 'brel legs tshogs chen po byung / de nas bkra shis lhun po nas paṇa chen rin po che gdan drangs gnang bar byon/ de rjes lha ldan du lhan phebs kyis ra sa gtsugs lag khang du jo bo shākya mu ne'i spyan sngar paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis mkhan po dang / rgyud pa ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis las slob/ pha bong khas gsang ston/ sgo mang sangs rgyas bkris kyis dus bgo ba mdzad de gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa dge ba'i bshes banyen bcu tshogs kyi dbus su bsnyen rdzogs bzhes/ de skabs jo bo shākya mu ner dar gos sogs dang mkhan slob rnam par rda drel dang mdzo g.yag gser dngul sogs kyi 'bul chen mang du bstar ba dang gzhan yang dbus gtsang gi bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad la 'bul ba/ dbus gtsang gi dgon sde che chung tshang mar mang bskol/ lha sa ba rnams la sgo 'gyed/smon lam chen mor dge 'dun rnams la ja 'gyed nyag re bstsal/ lo der smon lam chen mo'i tshogs dbus su rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po dang / paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan/ 'phags pa lha gang nyid bcas lhan phebs kyis nyin re bzhin smon lam rlabs po che 'debs pa'i skal bzang chos kyi dga' ston gyis skye bo kun tshim par mdzad/ de skabs gang des paṇa chen rin po che'i drung nas rdo rje phreng ba dang / sgrub thabs rgya mtsho/ mi tra brgya rtsa/ bka' gdams theg le bcu drug sogs kyi dbang dang rjes gnang bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsan bzhes bskyangs/ de dus ju nang rgyal po sogs sog po'i rgyal po rnams kyise kyang 'bul ba bsam gyis mi khyab phul/ de nas kong po nas gdan 'dren zhus pas/ me stag (1626) lo dbus nas chibs kha bsgyur zhing / long po bkra shis chos lung du phebs/40

skya ser gyi tshogs shin tu che ba byung bar dbang chos gang la gang 'dod du gnang / brag gsum zho khar phebs/ zho kha slob dpon dang thugs nye zhing gus zhabs shin tu che bar mdzad/ de nas bkra shis phan bder phebs/de skor skya ser 'du tshogs shin tu che bar 'dus pa la nyin de rang nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang / grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang sogs gnang / de dus yab rje'i sprul pa'i sku'i skra phud phul/ mtshanaphasangs rgyas ye shes’’zhes gnang / de nas de mo blo gsal gling du gdan drangs/ dgon du phebs nas byams chen gyi zhig gsos zin khar rab gnas rgyas par gnang /gzim khang du nged (phan bde chos rje shākya lha dbang) nyung 'dus la snyan brgyud yum gyi bka' dbang dang gcod dbang gnang / 'di skabs sku mtshams mdzad rgyur snyad nas gsang thabs su sku 'khor nyung bsdus shig rgya lar gzab gter bzhes par phebs shing / so gsum zhes par ston pa'i sku shin tu gsal ba zhig gi gnas sgo 'bye bar mdzad/ de nas gter gnas dngos gzhir phebs nyer shang mtshal yang shin tu mang po babs/ spang gshongs shig tu sku 'khor mang che ba rnams bzhag nas de mo la pa'i grwa ngag dbang don grub gcig pu phyag phyir khrid nas ri sbrul nag thur du rgyugs pa lta bu zhig gi ri sked du phebs skabs phyag phyi ngag don yang bzhag nas gang nyid sku rkyang phebs te shwa 'od byung shul gyi sa dmar gzar po zhig tu sku'i chos gos kyang sa la 'drud bzhin par byon pa ngag dbang don grub nas rgyang nas mthong bas sku 'gram du rgyug yong grabs byas par phyag brda gnang ste ma yong gsungs pa'i phyag brda gnang ste byon/ de nas tshur phebs te gsung don gter yig shog dril zheng la sor bzhi dang kyus su mtho re yod pa brgya dang 'phel gdung sogs blangs chog 'dug pas dngos gzhi de ltar yod dam snyam nas brkos 41

par sbal lcong sogs swog chags kyis khengs 'dug pa sa/ zhed snang skyes te bros/ bka' rgya ma byas par de ltar bzhas/ na mi 'ong bsam nas slar log 'ong ba yin zhes gsungs/ de rjes chab mdo'i gzim khang du bzhugs skabs gcig la gang nas gang yong med pa'i grwa sa/zugs shig gis thod pa zhig nang shog dril 'ga' zhig blugs pa zhig khyer yong nas 'di ga3ga gis khyer yong gi 'dug pas khyed kyi min nam zhes zhus te phul rjes grwa gzugs de gar song med par gyur skad/ de rjes de mo sprul zur gter yig de'i mjal kha thog mar gnang yod pas/ sngar slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis lo chen ka ba dpal rtsegs la gnang zhes grags pa'i‘‘gu ru'i thugs sgrub’’skor gyi chos bka' de yin skad/de nas thang grwa byang chub gling du phebs shing / dgon pa de bar lam ser khyim sar gyur yod kyang de skabs gang gi thugs rjes gtsang dgon du byed pa'i dam bcas te grwa tshang btsugs nas bca' yig kyang bstsal/ de nas rim bzhin kong khul dang / 'gru la dgocha// lcags rwa sogs su phebs rjes chos khri thang du phebs par chos rje ngag gis bang so yang chab mdo nas chos khri thang du phebs nas chos khri'i gzim khang gsar rgyag mdzad/de rjes de mo sprul sku lha dbang phyogs 'a sa rnam rgyal zhing du phrebs khar thugs dam gsal 'debs su spo bor phebs rjes slar yang chab mdor phebs bzhugs skabs be ri don yod snang zhig dbon po yid 'gyur te bstan pa'i dgrar langs kyis chab mdo ba sogs chos sde mang por rgol bar brtsam pa na mngon spyod las kyi rtags mtshan cha nga du byung skad grags/ a re bo/ shi rgyal po drag dpung dang bcas mdo khams phyogs su bskyod 'byor skabs khul de'i bla dpon tshang ma bros gab la thug pa'i skabs der rje (radir mkha' 'gro'i lung 42

bstan du‘‘rgyal po dpung tshogs mdo khams phyogs su bskyod skabs phyogs 'di'i bla dpon tshang mas 'dir sne len byas na bston par phan’’lugs byung bar grags shing / gang ltar rje nyid smar khams kyi khra mdor phebs te go shi rgyal po dang mjal 'dzoms kyis gang dge'i gsung gleng legs par byung zhing /rgyal po de nyid kyis kyang dad shugs chen pos rje 'di'i zhabs spyi bor blangs/be ri don yod 'khor bcas go shi rgyal po'i lag tu 'byor/ de nas go shi rgyal po chab mdor bskyod cing / bar khams kyi bla dpon tshang mas 'phags pa lha'i bka' lung nyan dgos pa'i skor sogs rgyal po'i bka' bkod go shi bla mas rdo bcal khar dpon g.yog tshang ma bsdus nas bsgyur/rje nyid phyir phebs skabs sa sgang du bzhugs zhag 'ga' shas bzhugs thog nang chen blo gros rgyal po mjal bar phebs par bka' chos dang mchod yon thugs nang gcig pa'i gang ci'i bka' mol mang du mdzad/ de nas chab— mdor phebs nas rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom nos pa dang /dbang bskur/ chos 'chad/ bka' rtsom sogs gdul bya'i 'phrin las mang du skyong bzhin parari dus 'da' ba'i ngang / skabs shig chab mdo spyi par khyed rang tshos gso—sbyong dang tshogs bsngor dbon drung sku skye gdan 'dren gyis gsungs te slob dpon zhi ba bzang po mchogo bdag nyid chen po byang sems shes rab bzang po'i khrir (chab mngo/'i khrir) bzhugs su bcug nas legs 'bul yang mtshan tsam mdzad/ tāde nas cher ma 'gyangs par 'phags pa lha gang nyid sku mkhris kha lud lta bu'i bsnyun ba'i tshul bzhes kyis dgung grangs so dgur bzhes pa/ rab byung ba cu gcig pa'i chu lug (1642)lor zhing du gshegs shing / skabs/ der sa g.yo/ ba sob/sa ngo mtshar gyi lta sa kyang mang du byung / dgongs rdzogs 43

skor la dbon drung sprul sku (zhi ba bzang po) dbus gtsang phyogs su phebs/paṇa chen rin po che'i bka' slob bzhin sku gdung zhugs 'bul gyis dbu bum ril gyi nang dang thugs ljags sogs byon pa rnams tshe dpag gi nang du bzhugs su gsol/gang 'di'i zhal slob mang du byung ba gong gsal gang 'di'i mdzad rim gyi nang nas shugs las rtogs par nus kyang / thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal slob gtso bo rtogs ldan shes rab phun tshogs dang / brag g.yab dka' bcu grags pa rgya mtsho sogs yin/ 'phags pa lha sku phreng lnga pa/'phags pa lha sku phreng lnga pa rgyal ba rgya mtsho ni/ rdza rgyud gnas chen go pho khyung phyug dang‘‘'dabs chags 'du’’zhes bya ba'i grong du yab sgom sde nang chen gyi gtam phog rag shi'i rigs o rgyan bstan 'dzin zhes sngags 'chang zhig dang / yum gu ru mtsho zhes pa'i sras su rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing spre ( 1644) lo gro bzhin zla ba'i tshes brgyad kyi snga char sku bltams shing /gang 'di lhums su bzhugs pa nas yum gyi sku lus r+ṣa/sa yig drug gi sgra sgrog pa lta bu'i snang tshul 'char ba sogs ngo mtshar can du ma zhig byung bas sprul sku yin pa'i gras/sa che bar byung stabs chab mdo da gon nas chos rje ngag dbang 'phri na las dpal bzang ngo dang / 'phags pa zhi ba bzang po gnyis nas sku gong ma'i gsol dpon sangs rgyas la sku gong ma'i sku'i nyer spyad 'ga' shas dang bcas mngags gtong gnang bar ngos 'dzin shin tu gas la ba mang po gnang yod pa dang / de rjes paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyal sogs su thugs 44

dam slob ston zhus par yang 'khrul med yin lugs phebs pa ma zad/ paṇa chen rin po che nas mtshan spel gyi brtan bzhub/sa sho lo ka khya/ga kyang gnang de 'phral chab dgon nas dpon 'gur lu'i khyim du zhabs phyir sdod mi mngags rdzong byas/me khyi (1646)lor chab dgon du gdan drangs te re zhig gling smad gzim khang 'og mar bzhugs/ zhi ba bzang po thog mar mjal 'phrad skabs thugs dgyes nyams chen po gnang ba dang / sku gong ma'i sku 'khor gsung rab zer ba ming nas gsal 'bod kyi ngos 'dzin yang gnang / de nas mi ring bar gzim khang chen mor gdan drangs (gang de'i sku'i skyed byed dgung grangs zhe bzhi par gshegs )lcags yos (1651) lo'i hor zla 5nang bar khams dpon mkha' 'gror mjal kha dang phyag byin bstsal/ de nas dbus su bzhugs sgar btegs shing / dga' ldan rna ma par rgyal ba'i gling sogs su mchod sprin gzab rgyas bstar/ bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po rag kha shan khar phebs bsur phebs/ thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho las rab byung sdom bzhes gnang bas mtshan‘‘blobazang 'phags pa bsod nams lhun grub dge legs dpal bzang po’’zhes gsol/ de skabs se 'bras sogs su mang 'gyed rgyas par bstsal nas gtsang phyogs su chibs bsgyur bskya ngas te paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyal las gsang bde 'jigs gsum dang / mgon/ chos sogs kyi dbang dang rjes gnang / dben sa pa'i gsung 'bum sogs chos/ lung mang du sa/san/ de nas slar yang lha sar phebs nas rgyal dbang rin po che'i zhal sngasna nas kyang bka' chos du ma gsan rjes byang lam brgyud chab mdor phebs te mchog sprul gang nyid chab mdo dgon du grwa sko ra gnang ba'i 45

rten 'brel legs/ tshogs kyi sgo 'phar phye zhing / de nas mi ring bar de moci sprul sku de nyid phyi lo rgyal dbang lnga ge chen po'i zhabs/ phyir rgya nag tu phebs dgos kyis zhag shas chab mdor bzhugs phebs la phebs rdzong sogs mdzad/chu sbrul (1652)lo rgyal dbang lnga pa rgya nag nas bod du phyer phebs kyi phebs mjal zhu ba'i dpon slob dang rnam sras can mngags gtong bskyangs phyir log 'byor rjes rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che gser dngul bkra ma (spel ma ) gsar bzhengs legs grub mdzad/ bar khams dpon mkha' 'gros gdam/ zhu nan che zhus dom/ go 'jo nas ma tshams gzhung khul zla shas phebs bzhugs kyis bka' chos kyi re batshoskong bar mdzad/sa khyi (165〈) dgung grangs bco lnga par dgon pa'i dus bzang mchod pa ser sbrengs sogs su phebs shing / sku mtshams dang thugs brel dmigs bsal med phyine dus bzang gi chos spyod gnang sgo khag dge 'dun dmangs dang lhan cig nyams bzhes chags med mdzad/ 'di'i skabs rmo mda'i dgon rmang gding bar dpon cislob ched gtong gis mi ring bar legs par grub/ dus skabs 'di'i yas mas su de mo ba dang chab mdo dgon mi mthun pa byung bas dpon slob kyang smar khams brgyud dbus su phebs dgos byung ba so gas kyi sbir che tsam byung yod kyang / mchog/ sprul rin po che bstan la thugs bcangs kyis mdzad pa zab mos 'phral yun phan rnga/ra mdzad/ spyi sger gyi zhabs rim du chos skyong rnams la rgyun bskang gtong mi grwa bcu re 'phar 'dzugs bskyangs pas dus phyis kyang de'i srol tshugs /dgung grangs nyer gcig par dbus su phebs nas rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos mkhan po gnang ste bsnyen rdzogs bzhes/ rgyal dbang lnga pa'i drung nas chos bka' yang mang du gsan rjes nag shod brgyud chab mdor phebs/46

sku gong ma'i dgon tsha ba spom mda' gangs dkar bde chen zhig gsos mdzad pa grub nas rab gnas su phebs/dgung grangs nyer bzhir bzhes pa me lug (1667) lo slar yang dbus phebs kyis se 'bras dga' gsum sogs chos sde chen po so so dang smon lam chen mo bcas la mchod sprin rgyas par bstar zhing / rgyal dbang rin po cher 'bul tshan btegs/ de nas chab mdor phyir phebs rjes dpon mkha' 'gro nas bsam 'grub gzhung du dgon pa gsar btab kyis smon lam tshogs dbur spyan drangs/lcags khyi lor dgung grangs nyer bdun lo gsar dang smon lam gnyis ka der mdzad/ chab mdo sku zhabs grwa tshang du de sngon dge 'dun bzhi bcu skor las med kyang de skabs brgya lhag tsam bar 'phar zhing / dge tshul slong sha stag la rgyud sde'i phyag bzhes rnam dag thog sgrig lam sogs bstan pa'i mig rgyan du 'pher nges 9radoms par mdzad/ rnge phu lhun grub yang rtser thugs dam dben gnas kyi gzhi bting zhing / der dge slong rnams la'ang ma tsho ba'i mthun rkyen bar mar sbyor bar mdzad/ de nas mi ring bar dpon mkha' 'gror gzhung sa nas yid ches ma byas par da lan hong tha'i ji ched 'byor dang 'brel mchog sprul gang nyid kyang mtshams 'dzin sogs gang ci'i thad gzigs par phebs dgos pa'i skor bka' shog kyang phebs pas /'bom nyag gzhung khul hong tha'i ji'i sgar du phebs pa dang / dpon mkha' 'gro blo dogs zos pas dpung dang bcas bros shing / hong tha'i ji'i dmag gis rjes bsnyegs btang ste 'dzoms gshis zhes par phan tshun 'thab lag 'phrod la khad du mchog spru'4 gang nyid nas dpon slob nyung shas bcas de gar phebs te byams pas brlan pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsis phan tshun gyi zhe sdang drag 47

po'i me dpung zhi bar mdzad/ hong tha'i ji nas gang gi mdzad par yi rangs shing bsngags brjod dang 'brel legs skyes rgya cher phul/ de nas chab mdor phebs/ bla brang du chos srid kyi gnang sgo spel yul yang pa zhig sgrub par dgongs pa gtad de lcags (me ) 'brug nas dgung grangs so gsum lo gnyis kyi nang bde blag tu legs grub mdzad/ de nas dbus chiphebs bskyang rgyu'i dgos cha dang gdul bya rjes 'dzin gyi slad du 'dan chos 'khor sogs su chibs bskyod kyis khul der bka' chos dbang lung sogs ji snyed bstsal/sa lugs (1679)dgung grangs so drug bzhes lo dbus ljongs khul du chibs bsgyur bskyangs te rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po las paṇa chen shākya shrī'i sdom rgyun gyi bsnyen rdzogs bskyar bsgrub gnang / de skabs kyang rgyal dbang lnga pa'i drung nas chos bka' mang du gsan pa dang / rgyal mkhan zur ngag dbang bstan 'dzin gyi drung nas bka' dbang gi rigs shin tu ma nga po gsan/phyir phebs skabs kong po brgyud phebs lam 'khel yul skya ser du mar chos sbyin rgya che bstsal/shing byi (16rdo4) dgung grangs zhe gci lo slar yang rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che gser dngul bkra ma sngar gyi de las khyad du 'phags pa pod brgya dang gcig gi thog skyes rabs bka' thang rnams gsar bzhengs gnang ba gegs med du grub/ shing glang nas bzung grwa tshang du yig drug bum sgrub zla rer dung gnyis la nye bar 'gro ba gsog rgyu'i gsol yon gzab rgyas kyi srol 'dzugs bskyangs pa dus phyis bar tshugs/rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me yos (16ṭ+wāṃ7) dgung grangs zhe bzhir bzhes lo sku tshe tshe sgrub pa dang dge slong bzhi grwa btsugs pa de rjes brgyad grwa'i 48
