bar 'phel rgyas gtong gnang mdzad/ chab mdo tshogs chen gyi 'du khang chen mo ka ba dgu bcur rgya bskyed mdzad pa dang / sgo 'byor shar nub kyi g.yab tu rdo gcal/ shing rtsa'i ldebs ris bcas pa gsar bskrun mdzad/dus 'di skor la rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po zhing du gshegs zin nas gsang rgya'i skabs yin rung / 'phags chen lnga pa 'di'i rnal lam du rgyal dbang nyid spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam par mjal tshul gsungs pa ma zad dbus su byon rgyu'i dgongs bzhes gnang bar zhabs 'bring sogs nas rgyal dbang mchog sku smin tshul gyis sku mtshams sdam ste bzhugs yod pas mjal kha sogs dgongs bzhes don thog yong dka' tshul zhu mkhan byung yod kyang /gang des ci nas kyang byon dgos kyi bka' ngo ma ldog par lcags lug (1691) dgung grangs zhe brgyad bzhes lo'i hor zla 6par bzhugs sgar btegs nas hor zla 9nang lha ldan du phebs shing / zhabs brtan lha khang gsar bzhengs kyi legs 'bul sogs 'bul gnang thog dbus gtsang chos sde khag la mang 'gyed mchod sprin gzab rgyas bstsal/de nas chab mdor phebs te ston pa'i 'khrungs rabs kyi gra thang chen mo gsar bzhengs dang / 'du khang chen mo'i tshogs gdan gsar bzo/tshoms chen ka ba nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i rgya khyon du sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku brnyan ldebs ris bcas legs skrun mdzad/ dus 'di'i sngon tsam du grwa tshang la tshe dpag med sgrub rgyal lugs kyi cho ga dang / 'di'i skabs sman bla'i cho kha bcas gsar 'dzugs bskyangs/ sa stag (16khardo) dgung grangs nga lngar bzhes lo rgyal dbang drug pa tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho mjal ba dang sprags hor zla lnga pa'i nang chab mdo nas bzhugs sgar btegs te hor zla dgu pa'i nang lha ldan du phebs shing 'bras 49

spungs tshogs dbus su rgyal dbang mchog sprul rin po cher gser gyi 'khor lo dang chos dung sogs kyis sne drangs 'bul chen btegs/ rten dang 'dus sder mchod sprin rgya che bstar/ de bzhin dbus gtsang dgon khag la'ang mang 'gyed bstsal/ de nas phyir phebs rjes yar thang mchod rten chen mor zheg gsos dang dbu rtser gser zangs kyi nyi zla bsgron pa gnang / lha khang gi thub chen sku rgyab khri drug dang / mchod rdzas rnying pa bzo 'chos dang /gsar bzo bsdoms brgya skor tsam bzo skrun/ 'dus spyir ja 'khor drug brgya dang bcu skor sbyor 'jags bcas gnang /de nas gzhung bstan lar rgyar rkyen 'tshubs kyi rnam pa shar skabs ba thur tha'i ji wang dpon blon nas gang der thugs dad mthong chen po gnang gi yod pas mtshams zhu'i thog nas bka' slob nan zhus dang gdarna zhu mdzad par gang 'di sku na smin phebs kyis mi lcogs pa'i tshul gyis phyogs der ma phebs kyang‘‘gzhung bstan gya nyams kyi skabs 'dir rgyal po chen po dpon blon nas rang 'dod kyi 'khri ba med par bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin gyi zhabs 'degs lhag bsam dpang bstod mdzad dgos’’tshul sogs gsung bkod gnang smin gnang bas dpon blon rnams 'phral yun kun tu yi rangs par gyur/'di skabs bstan 'gyur zhig bzhengs rtsis gnang yang ma dpe sogs spus gtsang gra sgrig ma byung bas gser 'ba' zhig gi bka' 'gyur bzhengs pa gnang zhing / de'i rgyu 'gro phogs yon gzab rgyas bstsal te 'phral grub byung nas rab gnas kyi dga' ston yang rgya cher mdzad/ sa byi ( 170rdo) dgung grangs re lngar bzhes lo nam chi thi ji ched du phebs par thugs 'dod bskyangs/ de'i dbyar thog lho nas ngag sprul rin 50

po che 'phral phebs kyi gdan zhu gnang 'don/ hor zla 7tshes 2nyin phebs te yab sras zhal 'dzoms byung / 'di skabs sku na bgres tshul che zhing snyun gzhi yang bzhes phar/ de lo'i zla 10nas steng skyon gyi rnam pa'i snyun gzhi lci bar bzhes pas/ dpon slob dang / ngag sprul rnam gnyis nas zhabs brtan sku rim dang sku'i sri zhu rbesam las 'dos pa zhus/rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu sbrul (1712) dgung grangs bdun cur bzhes lo'i zla 1rkyatshes 2rkyanyis brtsegs kyi phyi mar zhing du gshegs(〈rgya bod tshig mdzod chen mor〉chu 'brug ces gsal yang / 'dir 'phags pa lha sku phreng lnga pa'i dbon dang sku phreng drug pas chos bka' 'ga' zhig gsan myong ba/btsun pa blo bzang dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i〈zhal snga chos 'byung phan bde chos rjes mdzad pa'i 'phro mthud〉ces pa bris rnying gzhir bzung du bkod)zhag bdun phrag lnga'i ring sku gdung mnyam bzhag gi tshul bzhugs nas phyi nang mchog dman gser skya du mas ma/jal ba sos/sa dge ba'i bag chags gso bar mdzad/ de nas lo gsum nang tshun du sku gdung bzhugs yul gyi mchod stong chen mo thob/ brtsegs ldan pa legs par ngagrub/ rje 'di nyid sku chung ngu'i skabs yig klog pa'i slob dpon sogs dbu 'don bla ma'i gnas su gyur cing / phyis gang de'i sras kyi thu bor gyur pa slob dpon zhi ba lha sku phreng gsum pa 'phags pa zhi ba bzang po yin la/gzhan yang brag g.yab dka' bcutshogrags pa rgya mtsho'i skye sprul du grags shing /byams mdun gyi dgon phyag 'debs po sprul sku ngag dbang bsod namaso lhun grub/ de min ngag dbang bstan 'dzin lhun grub sogs zhal slob phul byung mang du byung 'dug 51

'phags pa lha sku phreng drug pa/'phags pa lha sku phreng drug pa 'phags pa 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgya mtsho ni 'phags pa lha gong ma 'khrungs phyogs dang mtshungs pa'i chab mdo rdza rgyud gnas chen go bo phug gi lha zhol spu thog ces par yab lha rje dbang tshe nor bu(tshe dbang nor bu yin nam snyam yang dpyad par tshal) dang yum tshe ring skyid kyi sras su rab byung bcu gnyis pa (1714)shing rta lo'i hor zla 2pa'i nyer bdun nyin 'khrungs/ skabs der mtshan mo khyim du zla 'od shin tu gsal ba lta bu'i snang ba dang / 'ja' zug pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas rnams chab mdo bla gnyer gyi snyan du lhongs par dbon zung rtogs 'jug tu gtong gnang mdzad cing / skye srid de ni byin chags shing brjid bag ldan pa zhig yod tshul chos rje'i snyan du gsol/ 'on kyang brtan brling gi khyad du dgongs nas dbus phyogs su zhu sbyor mdzad pa dang khog 'grig gshis hor zla brgyad pa'i dga' ba gsum ldan gyi 'grub sbyor thog 'dus pa rgya mtshor mang 'gyed rgyas par gnang thog snga phyi'i lo rgyus dang mchog sprul rin po che nges rnyed mtha' chod skor dbus su(rgyal dbang rim/ po cher) zhu dgos zhes phran (blo bzang dbang phyug) la bka' gnang zhing / de'i dus rol mo dar 'phyar sogs kyi dga' ston kyang rgya cher bstar/ de skabs nas slar yang la mo tshangs pa'i lung gis kyang grub 'dug par chos rjes gzigs te thugs nges spro shin tu che bar gyur/de nas rim gyis lha bab kyi dus tshes phyi mar chibs bsur chos rjes dbus chibs hrag dbu 'dzoms thang du nam langs tsam du phebs par byang 52

shar nas sprin dkar po rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs lta bu'i dbus nas glang po che'i mche ba lta bu che chung gtso 'khor gyi rnam pa brgyad lho nub dgon pa'i thad phyogs su snang ba chos rjes nas kyang ngo mtshar ba'i lhas yin tshul gsungs/ dge 'dun 'dus pa'i ser sbrengs kyi bsu bkod rgyas pa dang bcas bla brang chen mor gdan drangs/ tshoms chen du dga' ston mchod sprin yang rgya cher bstar/ mi ring bar paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang ye shes mchog nas ‘‘'phags pa ye shes bstan pa'i mgon po’’zhes pa'i mtshan dang / mtshan spel gyi brtan bzhugs gsol 'debs rgyas par bstsal/ phyi lo'i dbyar thog tu rgya nag gong ma chen pos tā zhin gnyis kyi gdong gser yig dang lung las kyi che bkur yang mdzad/ rim gyis chos rje ngag dbang nas sku yon 'phral mkho'i rigs dang / gling smad slob dpon lha dbang dpal 'byor sogs nas zhabs phyi bcar mar zhus/dgung lo dgu pa chu yos (172 2) lor dbus ljongs bstan pa'i 'byung khungs su phebs nas mchod 'bul mang 'gyed sogs rgya cher btabs shing / rgyal dbang rin po che blo bzang bskal bzang rgya mtsho la satsun phud phul/ mtshan‘‘'phags pa 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgya mtsho zhes bstsal/bkris lhun por byon te paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes dpal bzang po'i drung nas tshig snga ma dge bsnyen dang dge tshul gyi bslab pa rdzogs par buzhes/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang dang rjes gnang kha shas gsan/ de rjes rgyal ba rin po che'i drung nas bka' gdam lha bzhi sogs rjes gnang gi rigs du ma dang /lha sa khrom gzigs khang du rgyud pa mkhan rin po che ngag dbang mchog ldan gyi drung nas bde gsang 'jigs gsum dang / rnam thar brgya rtsa sogs dbang lung mang bar gsan/ 53

de nas rje gong ma'i gdan sa bkris chos lung dang / lho dgon rnams la zhabs kyi bcag ste chab mdor phebs/ chos rje ngag dbang la dbyar gnas khang nas thebs dngul srang lnga brgya sngon nas gnang 'dug par gzhi bslang pa'i shing sbrul lor kun dga' ra ba chen mo bzo bkod phun sum tshogs pa ldeb bris tshon rtsi bcas legs par grub pa'i nang rten du dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi sku thog tshad ma gser zangs las grub pa rten dang rten par bcas dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i ji srid bskal pa'i bar gyi longs spyod dang / dad ldan bso da nams kyi zhing du gsar bskrun rnams la rab gnas dang bcas pa rgyas par gnang /dgung lo bcu gnyis chab mdor dus bzang chos 'chad dang / gling bskor mchod 'bul bka' bsgo gnyer gtad sogs bka' drin bskyangs pa'i dge mtshan gyi sgo 'phar yangs par phyes/ de lo nas mdzod gos bzang bsgrig gi bstan pa'i bdag po'i bo/sa sku chen mo thog tshad drug pa cho 'phrul dus bzang skabs 'gro ba mang po'i bsod nams kyi zhing du 'grems rgyur bzhengs par rab gnas sogs rgyas par gnang / rab 'byams pa blo bzang don grub kyi mtshan zhabs zhus pa'i sdus ra dang phar phyin skor gyi rigs tshul la'ang thugs sbyong nan tan du gnang / phyag mdzod dbon gzung 'bum dgongs 'khrol gnang bas tshab sku zhang dge slong blo bzang brtson 'grus bsko gzhag mdzad/ —dgung lo bcu bzhi pa'i thog chos rje ngag dbang zhing phebs kyi dgongs rdzogs gdung sbyangs su lcags rar gdan zhus bzhin phebs//sa bya lo gsar rgyal dbang rin po che bskal bzang rgya mtsho sga thags su chibs bskyod pa'i phebs bsu dang sge len 'bul tshan dgyes par zhus/ de 54

lo'i sa ga zla b.re rgyud smad mkhan rin po che gong sa'i sku yon zhabs 'degs su sga thags su phebs dgos zla gcig lhag tsam phebs bshol zhus pa'i bde 'jigs kyi skor sogs bka' chos gang rdzogs thang lhod med pur sa/san/de lo'i dbyar thog tu yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po byams pa'i zhal snga nas gdan 'dren zhus par mi dbang pho lha tha'i ji'i sku tshab zhabs 'degs bcas zla dgu pa'i dkar tshes su phebs pa nyer lnga nas lam rim chen mo'i bshad lung dbu brtsams pa phyi lo zla lnga pa'i tshes bcu skor bar thugs/ brel dmigs bsal zhag kha shas ma gtogs mdo sngags las brtsams pa'i nyi ma re chos thun phal cher gnyis sam re re ma chags par mdzad/chu glang lo byams chen lha khang bzhengs par dbu brtsams/ hor zla drug pa nas byams chen gtso bo zhal mtho dgu pa sku khog hang rgya grub cing 'khor lha rnams ma jug tshag zhal bkod gnang ste dbus su chibs kha bsgyur/nag shod nas rwa sgrong du phebs te mchod 'bul smon lam dang / thig le bcu drug gi sgrub ma chod bdag 'jug sogs zhag gsum ring thugs rtsol che bar mdzad de rim gyis dga' ldan du mchod 'bu'/ gtos che bar gnang / de nas rim phebs kyis po ta la gser khri'i mdun sar mi dbang chen po dang mjal 'phrad dgyes tshor che bar mdzad cing / lha ldan smon grong du bzhugs 'jags kyis jo shag rnam gnyis sogs la mchod 'bul dang / ser 'bras sogs la mang 'gyed/ de nas bkris lhun por paṇa chen rin po che 'bul chen dang dgon par mang 'gyed glegs khral mngon mdzes chos tsam min pare blo dang ldan pa rnams kyis ches bsngags par 'os pa'i gnas su mdzad/paṇa chen rin po che'i drung nas rmer yang bka' chos rjes gnang gi rigs mang po dang / nyid kyi gsung 'bum gyi lung gi dbu rmedzugs tsam zhig gnang ba 55

gsan/ de nas lha ldan du phebs nas dus 'khor slob dpon yon tan dar rgyas kyi drung nas zur dka'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbang mang bar gsan/sgar gzhis phyir bzlog ste dpon slob nyi shu skor bzhugs sar gzhung sa nas rgyun gyi gsol phogs nar mar gnang / ma 'gyangs bar se ra theg chen gling bla brang rnying par bzhugs 'jags thog byes mkhas snyan grwa tshang gi chos grwar phebs par mi dbang nas legs skyes 'bul bar sras da lan ba dur phebab// phar phyin gyi thugs gnyer 'phro skyong brtson par mdzad cing /thugs rab kyi bab la mkhas pa mgu ba'i snyan grags kyang rgyas par gyur/ston mjug nas nyi lding slob dpon rin po che 'jam dpal rgya mtsho smon grong du phebs pa sa lugs dmar po skor gsum dang rnam sras sogs kyi chos 'khor zla gcig tsam dang / de mjug mi dbang gis sbyin bdag mdzad de mkhas grub rin po che nas gsang 'dus kyi khrid rgyas pa zla gcig gnang ba gsan/ lnga mchod sngon tsam nas 'bras spungs blo gsal gling gi chos rwar phebs par 'dzin grwa mang zhing nub mo shin tu phyi ba'i thugs ngal sogs khyad du bsad nas zur bskol skabs thob kyi thugs gnyer la brtson pa ra mdzad/ 'di skabs dga' ldan pho brang du bla ma 'jam dbyangs gdan drangs pa'i drung nas dpal mgon sogs chos skyong skor mang po zla 'khor rgyal sras sku zhabs dang lhan cig gsan/ de kha'i zla ba bcu gnyis par phur mjal skabs nas se rar phebs/phur bu lcog bla ma'i drung du zhag shas phebs nas slar yang smon grong du smon lam gyi skabs dang bstun te khri rin po che rgyal mtshan seng ge'i drung nas rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang chen gsan par brtsams/ dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling nyag rong grwa tshang du phebs nas zla chos 'grim par mdzad cing / mjug tu dbu ma'i rtsa'i zhag dbu 'dzugs tsam yang gnang / grwa tshang gong gi chos 56

rar yang bka' chos dang dam bca' mdzad/ de nas zhog don yod mkhas grub rin po che'i drung du phebs te lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum sogs gsan zhing / dka' ga nad kyi dogs gcod rnams gnang nas zla gcig thog phyir tshophebs/ de nas se rar bzhugs thog smad dang sngags pa grwa tshang gi chos rar yang phebs shing / mi dbang nas rdzong rgyab gzim gur du gdan 'dren zhus te dpon blon tshang mar bka' dbang gnang zhing / bka' 'gyur rin po che spar bu dang / dngul dang gos chen thag snam sogs sku rdzong rgya che bstar ba de yang rgyal dbang rin po che phebs rgyu'i thugs brel stabs kyis snga 'gros su btab/ de mtshams nas phur bu lcog tu zhag shas bzhugs par byams pa blo bzang don grub grongs pa'i dge rtsa dgongs rdzogs gnang /zla ba brgyad pa'i dkar phyogs su rgyal dbang rin po che'i phebs bsur 'brom thod gling khar phebs nas mjal bar dgyes pa'i bka' 'phros rgyas par mdzad/ phyi nyin lha ldan du phebs bsu byings 'dre dang / de nyin nas bzung khyam bkra mthil dang / rim gyis gzim chung khams gsum zil gnon sogs su nyin bdun dga' ston du ma'i skabs su chen po rnams kyis dbus bkur bzos che bar mdzad cing rim gyis po ta lar phebs pa'i dga' ston kyang de mtshungs mdzad/ —de nas mtshams bar lta bur byams pa'i sku zhabs las thig le bcu drug gi dbang gsan zhing / phur bu lcog tu phebs par bla ma'i sku drung nas zhabs brtan rgyas pa dang phebs rdzong yang 'bul bzhes bskyangs/ cang skya zhabs drung nas zhus pa'i rgyal dbang rin po che nas 'jigs byed kyi dbang dang /bka' gdam glegs bam gyi lung gnang ba yang gsan/ rgya dbang rin po che mchog nas kyang phebs rdzong rgya cher gnang ba dang bcas zla 10nas lha ldan 57

nas dga' ldan du phebs/ bla ma byams pa'i sku zhabs phepres skyel du phebs pa dang lhan cig mchod 'bul smon lam rgyas par gnang /de na sa rime gyis chab mdor phebs nas 'brug lo'i lo gsar dag9ra ston mdzad/ 'di lo'i dbyar thog nas rjedzibadag nyid chen po'i rnam thar thang chen grwa mtshungs bcu dgu bzhengs/ pa'i dbu brtsams (lha bzo bco lnga skor gyis lo lnga'i khongs su legs par grub cing / de khongs su rdo rje phreng ba'i dkyil thang sogs sku thang che chung brgya phrag tu nye ba batshengs par mdzad )ston mjug lcang skya'i sku zhabs phyir phebs la gzhi le+o/ bsnyen bkur rgyas par mdzad cing / phan tshun chos 'brel gsan res kyi thugs gus shin tu che bar mdzad/ gsar lo'i mtsham sa khongs su phran (blo bzang dbang phyug)la'ang zhal snga'i bde chog dang / khrid drug sogs khyod nas gang thob da gos tshul phebs pa bzhin 'bul bzhes bskyangs/ 'di lo ston ring bzang gos kyi sku rgyu 'ba' zhig las tshe dpag gi gos sku chen mo thog tshad phyed bzhir longs pa legs par grub/ me lug lo gsar nas lhun rtser phebs/ thugs dam nyams bzhes bsnyen sgrub rigs mthun bzhi'i brtson pa rgyun chags zla ba bdun pa 'i bar dang / de skabs ka rong char 'bod la khyug tsam phebs dgos byung / sngon ma lha ldan du mchod yon (mi dbang ) ngos kyi zhu 'phros byung ba bzhin bstan 'gyur rin po che'i phyi mo 'pher ba'i zhud dag legs par mdzad/ 'dzi skabs sku tshab dang bcas phebs pa shog bu snga lo grub pa dang 'phros sgrub rgyu'i zhal bkod gnang // zla ba gsum pa nas gdan sa chab mdor phe bas nas lho ngoms rdza lci'i bris mang sum brgyar nye bas da kha'i tshes bco lngar 'bri 'go brtsams pa'i sher phyogs kyi mdo sde rnams gser dag bris dang / bstan 'gyur rnams gser dngul bkra chen gyis po ti brgya phrag phyed 58

pazhir nye ba 'phros bcas bsgrub bkod gnang bas phyed lnga legs par grub/'di ga'i rgyu yon phogs tsam du ma zad snga phyi'i dkon mchog mchod pa'i rigs dang sku 'dra dang gsung rab kyi na bza' yan rgyu 'gros la mi gtsigs r+shang /mig snga'i mdzes chos lhur mi mdzang/ pa/ dkon cog dang las 'bras kho na la dpang gtad pa'i mdzad pa gzhan gyi blor mi chud pa kho na mdzad/ rim gyis bka' bstan rnams kyi dbu glegs sogs rgyan spros rnams rim sgrub thog phyi lo nas bka' 'gyur rin po che rdzogs par bzhengs pa'i thugs rtsis bzhes te/bstan 'gro yongs kyi phan bde spel ba'i thugs bskyed kyi 'jug pa zad mi shes bdag nyid du gdan pa chen por bzhugs/ thugs sras ni dbon drung zhi ba lha'i sku phreng bzhi pa dang / chos rje ngag dbang gi sku phreng drug pa sogs mang du yod/rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa phag (spyo lo 1719)lo gong mas bod du gangs ti sir phyin tshad len par mngags pa'i dpo na dmag rnams la chab mdo nas sa tshugs kyi zhabs zhu'i byed sgo gang legs zhus pa dang / gong ma'i zhabs brtan dang bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel ba'i bya ba rlabs po che bsgrub par brten gong mas er ti ni no mon han gyi mtshan gnas dang tham ka/gser yig bcas rtsal zhing gser yig zhal bshus gsham sa/sal/ ‘‘gnam gyi shed mong gis da lta yongs kyi bdag po hwang de'i bka'/nged nyi 'og bstan srid spyi'i bdag po yin gshos/ bstan 'gro spyi la nges par phan pa'i lugs bzang gis 'gro 'dug byed pa de la yid brtse zhing /mngom/ 'dod kyi ming dang lasakas mngags te gzengs bstod sogs gong 'phel du gtong bar 'dod/ 'phags pa lha'i sku skye bstam/ pa'i rgya mtsho khyed/chab mdo'i sa char ming can gyi bla ma yin pa dang / sangs rgyab/ kyi bstan 59

par brtson pa'i bshad sgrub kyi lugs bzang 'bad nas yun ring song ba mtha' yi sa char yod kyang 'di nas brtse bas bskyangs pa zhig e yong bsam pas/ nged kyi gangs ti sir sa tshad len par btang ba'i mi sna tsho la u lag shud si sogs mthun rkyen tshul ldan byas 'dug pa shin tu legs shing / da lta khyod kyi chos ming dang / bdag thob kyi sa char dgon ba/ ga sogs yi ger bris nas bskyel sar yong ste cho lo sogs bka' drin bskyangs e yong zhes nges pa'i sems kyi sgo nas zhus pa'i stabs kyi ched gtad kyis bskyangs pa'i khyed kyi 'dug gnas dgon par dge ldan byams pa gling zhes pa'i ming dang / khyod rang la zhwa ser bstan pa chos cher gsal bar mdzad pa'i er ti ni no mon han zhes bkur ba'i cho lo dang 'ja' sa thams ka byin yod/ khyed rang gi lha sde mi sde nges par bdag tu bzung ba la su gang gis kyang bsnyad gtser 'phrod bcom rtsod gleng dmod pa sogs chog rgyu mim/ zhes lhag par brtse bas bskyangs pa yin cing / nged 'gro ba rnams la phan pa dang bstan pa rgyas pa'i bsam pa dang bstun nas bslab sdom legs par srung zhing skye 'gro rnams chos lugs kyis 'dren cing sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spyi dang / khyad par zhwa sere gyi bstan pa rgyas pa la ma yeng par lhag par du brtson pa dang / 'dus sde rnams la sgrig lam kun spyod tshul bzhin du skyong lugs sogs ma yeng par 'bad pa gal che/ bde skyid lo nga brgyad/ zla 2tshes 29la zhes bstsal/'phags si lha sku phreng drug pa 'phags pa 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgya mtshor gong ma bde skyid (khang shis ) khri/ bzhu0/sa lo 5rdopa'i zla 2 (spyi lo 171khas phag)par gnang ba'i tham kho/ 'i kha ris gsham gsal/60

la/miX cho rnyirna — — bca 'i /tho/mi rnya༈ 7〉/ rte/ / ri hūṃbla ri /lha( de/// 6 / / hūṃ twe/— /tram̐/ / ) ri rngo ( tsha hūṃ 4ca 4 rte ṇi / rngo ra kho /stesne rtertso/ rdo /rdo snipre ༷ci ltarngo ṇa ḍa pe/ci ri'ipha ci— ri snaduca/ ’ shā smo ༷ —/ ri co tsho‘/ tsu ri kha 4 — rna dzā watswa / 1 zlos// chirīsnye ji ni cipyo ṇazhe de rjes gong ma chan lung nas stsal ba'i gser yig zhal bshus su ‘‘gam/ma bskos gong ma rgyal po hwang de'i bka'/ chab mdo'i 'phags pa lha bstan pa'i rgya mtsho ho thog thu la phab pa/ bdag gnam 'og thams cad la mnga' dbang bsgyur ba'i bdag po yin pas 'gro ba mtha' dag bde skyid kyis 'tsho ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba/ sems rtse gcig gis bstan srid la zhabs 'degs su legs par spyod nus pa yod na phyi nang mi dbye bar ci nas kyang de'i sems drang por gsal bar byed cing / ngo che bar gzengs bstod par byed/ 'phags pa lha ho thog thu khyod sa thag ring po nas byams brtse'i bslab pa la gus pas nged rang gis ri bo gangs ti si sa la ma 'jal bar mngags pa'i mi sna rnams la 'u lag dang gro chas sgrigs nas dad gus yid kyis ma thun tshul byas rjes su khyod kyi chab 'og rnams su gang gis kyang mi gtse bar bya ba'i ched du bka' shog tham ka dang / dgon pa la mtshan gnang dgos zhes zhus pa la brten nas ched du byams brtses gzigs shing da gon pa la mtshan btags pa dang tham ka bka' shog gnang ba yin/ de nas bkrin dad pa skyes te phacha/ tshun bya byed la bgrod pa'i mi drag blon po 61

dmag dpung rnams la zhabame 'degs kyi rigs gang legs tshul dang mthun pa byas te da lta yang nged kyi bkrin bsam te yul thag ring nas mi sna btang zhing mtshams zhu byas pa dang / yang skabs sbyar mi sna btang chog pa dgos zhes gus pas zhu ba ni bdag gis shin tu bsngags pa'i 'os su byas pa yin/khyod kyis zhus pa'i don tshul bzhin du dgongs zhing sa mtha'i zhing chen gyi blon po rnams la yang bka' phab yod/ spyir mi sna btang lugs lo zla nges bzung byas na lam thag ring bas khyod kyi mi sna bgrod pa la dka' ba dang / slad mar gal te dus las nges par thogs pa byung tshe bla ma khyod kyang sems mi bde bar 'dug de'i phyir bdag gis byams brtses gzigs shing khyod kyi mi sna btang lugs lo dus nges bzung can ma byas par lo gnyis gsum mam yang na lo bzhi lnga tsam khyod rang stabs gang 'grigs la mi sna btang chog mi sna btang ba'i tshe sngon tsam nas zhing chen gyi blon po rnams la brda sbyar bar gyis/khyod rang gi mi sna gang gi sa mthar yong ba'i dus su yang mi sna 'di'i lugs bzhin du byas nas pho brang chen po 'dir slebs par gus 'dus/ 'di ltar na bla ma khyod kyi gus pa'i bsam pa rdzogs shing khyod cho la yang phan bde che/'di ga'ang sems thams cad bde skyid la 'god pa'i slad du zhwa ser gyi bstan pa dar rgyas su spel bar mchis/ bla ma khyod kyang nged kyi bkrin la bsam nas zhwa ser gyi bstan pa'i chos lugs la brtson zhing / chab 'og rnams legs par bskyangs nas rang lugs bde 'jags su ci nus par spyod/ lar rgya'i don la sems rtse gcig gis sngar ltar zhabs 'degs kyis dus rtag tu bkrin chen pos 'tsho ba'i thabs la 'bad pa gal che/ ched du phab pa yin/ chan lung gnam lo bcu drug zla 7tshes 2la’’zhes phebs pa nas bzung nā kwang khri bzhugs 20bar lo gsum bzhi'i mtshams su pe cin du mi sna mkhan nang 62

btang dang gtong bzhin yang de ska bas sa khad ring gshis dka' tshegs che bar brten slar yang gzigs bskyangs kyis lo lnga re'i mtshams su yong 'thus phebs pa dang / gnam bskos gong ma han hung khri bzhugs gnyis pa'i skabs 'tshams zhu mi sna mkhan nang rim btang ga—dong 'bul rten dngos ngo nang mdzod/ sku rten li ma/ dngul srang bco lnga'i maṇ+ḍal/ gser srang 12gyi yol go/ phrug bub 2rkya spos bam 2rkya0 re bcas 'bul lam la phyir gser yig gnang rten gnang cha bcas la kha btags nang mdzod 7chos 'don nang mdzod 7 dngul srang 2rkyayi mdong mo/ mdzod gos yug chen 12kyis gtsos pa'i gos yug 4〈skor gang srol dang / yang gong ma gnam skyong khri bzhugs lo 22pa 'i dus su mtshams zhu gong bzhin 'char can thog zhabs brtan gyi 'bul ba 'phar ma kha btags nang mdzod/dngul srang nyi shu rtsa lnga'i maṇ+ḍal/ dngul gyi bkris rtags brgyad/ phrug bub 2rkyatham pa bcas phul bar bka' lan gser yig gnang rten dang /zhabs brtan gyi slog gnang cha bcas la kha btags nang mdzod 7 mdzod chung 7 dngul srang sum cu'i mdong mo/ g.yang ṭi sngo skya'i bum pa cha/ gu sha gser mdog gi bzhes spyad/ gos chen mthing kha'i khug ma cha/ ser po'i khug ma cha/ dmar po'i khug ma cha/ gos phrug dmar ser legs pa yug 2sogs bstsal 'dugapho lha bsod nams stobs rgyal gyis phul ba'i gtan tshigs kyi 'bru don rags rim/‘‘gnam bskos 'jam dbyangs gong ma bdag po chen po'i lung gis yangs pa'i nor 'dzin gyi khyon la chos dang srid kyi khrims lung btsan pos mngon par dbang bsgyur ba'i cod paṇa gyi rtse mo dud mi shes shing / ris bral 63

rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che bla nas blar 'degs pa dang / mtha' klas pa'i lus can rnams la phan bde sbyin pa'i bsod nams chen po'i dpung stobs las la sbyor ba'i skal ba mchog gi dge mtshan dar la drag pa dpal mi yi dbang po phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba jun dbang du 'bod pa'i gtam ’’ gnam 'og tu spyod cing / nam mkha'i nor bu'i snang bas gsal ba'i lus can gyi khams yod do cog mtha' dag la springs pa bod chen po'i rgyal khams su zhwa ser cod paṇa 'chang ba'i dgon sde ji snyed pa'i phyi mo'am gzhi rten lta bu ni rje bdag nyid chen po'i thugs sras bstan pa'i dar chen drug gi nang tshan byang sems bdag nyid chen po shes rab bzang pos chags btab pa'i dpal ldan chab mdo byams pa gling zhes yongs su grags pa 'di nyid da lta'i bar mi lo bzhi brgya nye bar bshad sgrub bya ba las kyi 'khor lo nyams gud med pa'i 'phel rgyas kho nas bstan pa'i mardzas rgyan du gyur pa ni/kun mkhyen lnga pa chen pos ‘byams pa'i bstan si dbus 'gyur 'chang ba'i yul/ shar min de srid khrims lda na 'dus pa'i gling / zhwa ser 'dzin pa'i snang ba rab rgyas shing / mdo khams mun sel sgron mer 'bar gyur cig’zhes bstsal ba bzhin dang / khyad par tā la'i bla ma badz+ra dha ra kun mkhyen phyag na pad+mo bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sde/ jing gir gan gyi yul nas mdo khams phyogs su zhabs pad bskyod skabs gdan rabs bcu gsum pa'i seng ge'i khrer zhabs sen bkod de bstan pa'i 'dzin spel bsam gyis mi khyab par gnang / gdan rabs bcu bzhi pa nas 'phags pa lha mchog gi sprul sku bsod nams rnam par rgyal ba dbang po'i sde phebs pa nas bzung sku phreng rim pa bzhen 'jigs med gdong lngas btegs pa'i chos kyi gdan khrir 'khor lo gsum dang 'brel ba'i chos srid kyi 'phrin las bstan di rin po che gsal byed 64

du skyong bar mdzad pa yin la/ de yang khams gsum 'gro ba'i bla ma paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen gzigs blo bzang ye shes dpal bzang pos‘bskal bzang dang po'i sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jigs/ isha bo dhi ar+ya de ba'i zhabs/'gro ba'i mgon po rdo rje rgyal po sogs/ ngo mtshar skyes rabs ldan pa gsol ba 'debs’zhes stsal ba ltar/ 'dren mchog 'khor ba 'jigs dang isha bo dhi sogs dngos su zin pa rnams dang / gong sa lnga pa chen pos ‘rgyal kun 'gro la rjes su rab brtse ba/ bheriphags chen dam pa'i skyes rabs phreng ba can/lhar bcas skye rgu'i gnyen du sprul pa'i gar/ bsgyur mdzad rje btsun bla mar gso/la ba 'debs’ zhes sogs stsal ba ltar las/ sku phreng thog ma ba 'phags pa lha nyid/ grub pa'i dbang phyug ku cor sangs rgyas dpal gyi sras su 'khrungs/ mdo sngags gzhung lugs spye dang / rje nyid kyi bstan pa la sbyangs shing grub pa'i go 'phangs mthon por gshegs pas grub mtha' ris su ma chad pa'i mnga' bdag kun gyi gtsugs rgyan du gyur/ mi dang mi ma yin sogs 'gro ba mtha' yas pa 'i don mdzad/ bkris chos gling nyi zla thang sogs bshad sgrub kyi dgon sde che chung bco brgyad/ yer pa lha ri snying po/long po ri bo chos 'phel sogs sgrub sde bcu gcig byams chen dang gtsug lag khang mang bar bzhengs pa sogs bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po che mdzad/sku phreng gnyis pa 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi ring 'jang bod 'khrugs chen zlum zhing / sgyu 'phrul gyi bkod pas rgyal po 'khor bcas shin tu dad pas ti'i shrī bkur zhing / chen po'i lung las phul/ sku phreng gsum pa 'phags mchog mthong ba don ldan bcas kyi sku ring la mdo khams bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen po mdzad pa dga' ldan chos 'byung boḍūr+ya ser po sogs su ba/sal bzhin yin/snga phyi 'di dag gi sku ring / de mo gong ma/ rgyal tshab dkon mchog 'byung 65

gnas/ lha dbang phyogs las rnam rgyal/ ba so rje drung lha dbang chos kyi rgyal mtshan sku snga phyi/ rje drung sngags ram dge 'dun bkra shis/ bka' bcu grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje ngag dbang dpon slob zhi ba bzang po sogs mkhas shing grub pa'i bla chen zhal slob kyi rim pa shin tu mang bas/nub phyogs kong nyang gi yul ljongs nas shar phyogs 'jang rgyal po'i pho brang bar la zhal snga nas yab sras zhes snyan grags kyi gos dkar thub bstan 'dzin ma'i rgyan du gyur/ sku phreng bzhi pa 'phags pa chos kyi rgyal po grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po bzhugs pas/ go shrī bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal pos bstan dgra be ri sogs nag phyogs med du bcom pa'i grogs mdzad cing / rgyal pos thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang sogs gsan nas rigs kyi cod par+ṇa du bkur zhing lung las kyi gzengs bstod shin tu che ba phul/ sku phreng lnga pas 'phags mchog rgyal ba rgya mtsho chab mdo'i gdan khrir yun ring du 'tsho bzhes kyi gdan sa'i 'dzin spel dar rgyas dang / dbus ljongs bstan pa de 'dzin gyi bsnyen bkur sogs rnam dkar gyi mdzad rlabs bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan du gyur pa kun gyis gsal bzhin dang / da lta sprul pa'i sku 'phags pa 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgya mtsho 'di nyid kyang dgung lo lnga pa nas byang sems bdag nyid chen po'i chos kyi gdan khrir zhabs sen bkod cing / mi ring bar gnam bskos 'jam dbyangs gong ma hong te'i chen po nas zhwa ser bstan pa ches cher gsal bar mdzad pa er ti ni no mon han gyi lung las gser yig dang / gdan sa chen pos mtshon pa'i nges par bdag bzung rigs la sus kyang 'da' bar mi byed pa'i lung bzang po bcas bdag rkyen bla lhag tu bstsal zhing / bstan pa rin po che spyi dang / bye brag gi 'phrin las rjes su skyong ba'i thugs bskyed snying stobs kyi go cha cher bzhes te dbus 'gyur gdam/ 66

sa chen po rnams su gsan sbyangs dang / bstan pa'i bdag po rgyasnyel ba yab sras/ mkhas grub chen po don yod rdo rje/ khyab bdag bla ma ngag dbang byams pa'i zhal snga nas sogs rigs kyi bdag por bzhes shing / gdan sa nyid du'ang rnam dkar gyi mdzad patshorlabs che zhing / rgyal ba yab sras kyi zhabs 'degs dang / bstan 'gro'i phan bde lhur bzhes kyi dgongs gtad gzhan dang mi 'dra bar 'tsho zhing gzhes nga/ 'di ste/ 'di nas kyang dngos mjal skabs bcas la dam pa'i chos kyi bka' drin nod cing rnam pa thams cad du sri zhu gus 'dud nan tan du bgyis pa bcas bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde'i rtsa lag tu 'gyur ram snyam pa rang 'dod med pa'i lhag bsam kho nas yin pa khyod tshang mas nges pa gal che/ khyad par chab mdo bla dgon nas dgre/'a ldan bstan srid kyi ched du rtsod dus kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba bstan 'dzin go shrī rgyal po khams phyogs su chibs kha bsgyur skabs dang / phyis su 'jang bod mtshams rgya gya gser mdog sogs su dkar srid kyi zi sbir gzhil bar rgyal po hong tha'i ji phebs skabs sogs snga phyi zhi drag gi zhabs 'gyur gzhan dang ma 'dra ba ma zad/ gong zhabs rgyal ba'i dbang po mdo smad nas chibs bsgyur snga phyir gnang skabs zhabs 'degs legs spel gzhan dang ma 'dra ba dang / snga phyir gong ma'i dpung chen rta rmig gi rdul gyis mkha' lam 'gog pa tshan po che'i rgyu 'grul bstar chags pa bcas la sne len zhabs 'gyur sogs sku tshab dpon po mtha' dag gi spyan lam du 'bab nges kyi legs char gyur pa sogs gang ci nas bdag rkyen gyi skabs thob tu son pa bcas des na da sgos kyang mchog sprul 'di nyid kyi gong ma na rim gyi rgyun bzhin chos bstam/ rnam dkar gyi 'phrin las phyogs med du skyong ba dang zhal 'dzin mdzad pa'i lha sde/ mi sde/ btang 'gro zhag sdod mdor na gong gsal gyi don tshan 67

la kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i dbang po lnga pa chen pos bstan 'dzin chos rgyal yab sras/ gzhan yang mchod yon gong ma na rim dang / bkra shis ba dur tha'i ji so0/sa rgyal po dbon mi yi bdag po lha bzang khang dang / 'di ga nas song ba'i tham ka le tshan/ don gcod du mngags pa'i nga tshab so so'i mtshams khra yig rigs dang 'brel ba da lta phan gnas bzhin ci yin rnams bskal pa'i bar du 'jags gnas bsgyur bkod med pa 'i gtan tshigs dang 'ja' sa byin par/ mchog dman sus kyang rtsod slong bsnyad 'tshol g.yo 'phrul btsos po rjen bsgyur gyi rigs su/ thad nas byas mi chog pa'i gtam gyi sgra dbyangs chen po nye bar bsgrags pa yin pas go bar gyis de yang mdo las/gang ma/ rgyal po chos spyod pa/ der ni 'jig rten dar bar 'gyur/ dge sbyong bram ze rnyed ldan zhing / dam pa rnams kyang mtho bar 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin chos ldan gyi khrims kyis lugs gnyis kyi gzhung bsrang ba'i sgo nas 'jig rten bde legs kyi lam bzang po dar zhing / bkur 'os dam nga/ bsod nams kyi zhing rnams dbu 'phang mtho bar 'gyur ba sogs bstan 'gro'i don chen kho nar bsam nas ma pham rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir shar min de srid du snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs nyams pa med pa'i gtan tshigs gtam du byas pa 'di bzhin spel ba yin pas/ shes ldan rnams kyis rang rang gi bsod nams kyi sgo skal phyin ci ma log pa sgrub pa'i ched du spang blangs kyi tshu' las cung zad kyang g.yo/ ba med par nyams su bstar ba gyis shigagal srid gong don las 'gal ba'i bsam sbyor tshul bzhin ma yin pa'i log par spyong/ pa shar na rgyal khrims btsan 'jis/sa kyi chad las kyis mnar bar 'gyur ba shes par gyis la mchog dman skye 'gro mtha' dag sis spang blangs tshul bzhin du byos shig zhes gnam lo'i rgyal po thi/nga mo glang lo (rab byung bcu 68

gnyis pa'i )hor gyi zla ba'i tshes dge bar khams gsum gyi dregs ldan ma lus pa'i 'od 'bar nor bu'i cod paṇa gyes 'dar bzhin du 'dud pa'i gnas gcig pu phun tshogs sde bzhi'i sgo 'pha ra gcig char du phye ba phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang chen po dga' ldan khang gsar nas bris’’zhes 'khod/'phags pa lha sku phreng drug pa gang 'di'i sku dus nas rgya nag tu gong ma ra 'tshams zhu'i sba yer 'busnyesmu mi mngags srol thog ma byung 'dug dgung grangs zhe gcig tu bzhes par rab byung bcu gsum pa'i shing khyi ( 1754)lo zhing du gshegs/'phags pa lha sku phreng bdun pa/'phags pa lha sku phreng bdun pa/ 'phags pa 'jigs med bstan pa'i dgon po ni rab byung bcu gsum pa'i shing phag (1755) lo mdo smad spo 'bor sgang li thang thub chen byams pa gling gi 'o/la du yab a brtan mgon po dang / yum rgyal mchog bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i yum gyi sku mched sde pa a 'bum gyi sras mo sgrol ma 'phel gnyis kyi sras su sku bltams shing / paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyi thugs dam dgongs don bzhin dgung grangs lnga tsam bzhes skabs zhi bzang dge legs rgyal mtshan mchog nas ngos 'dzin gyi thugs 'gan bzhes nas chab mdo byams pa gling gi gdan gsar mnga' gsol/ gang de 'khrungs ma/sa ngos 'dzin ma mdzad kyi gong ste me byi ( 1756)69

lo rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtshos bstsal ba'i gtan tshigs kyi 'bru don rags rim du‘‘rgong ma'i lung gis nub phyogs mchog tu dge ba'i zhing gi rgyal dbang sa steng gi rgyal bstan yongs kyi bdag po thams cad mkhyen pa badz+ra dha ra tā la'i bla mar 'bod pa'i gtam stod ma/nga' ris skor gsum bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ smad mdo khams sgang drug gi sa'i char 'khod pa'i rgya po rgyal phran/ bla ma chos rje/ sna chen po la gtogs pa'i blon po mdun na 'don༈/ da bang blon/ 'phrin blon/ khrom gyi ru 'dzin/ chen por 'os pa'i ‘ras tshan bcu gsum sogs 'phrin las rnam ba'i'i sna la dbang ba/rdzong sdod/ gzhis sdod/ yang sgos/ bod ljo/ngas stod smad kyi char gtogs kong nyang / rngod/ rgya sta ra/ sho mdo/ lho rdzong / zur mang /khyung po dkar nang ser gsum/ nag shod/ nang checha// rag shul/ rdo shul/ yul shu‘smu/ 'brong pa/ dase/ rgyas/ gser kha stod smad bar sa/sum/ lha thog sto da mi da/ go 'jo/ sde dge/ brag g.yab/ nyag gshis/ 'ba' li / shar dar rtse mdo/ rgyal thang / 'jol / 'jang yu'// mdzo sgang / gsang rdzong / tsha ba sgang stod smad bar gsum/ spo bo ka nam/ dpa' shod/ ri bo che so gas kyi slob dpon las byed gnyer las 'dzin/ zhi drag gi sne mor rma ngags slebs spyir btang dmigs bsal/rgan bcu mi dmangs sogs mdor na gre/nam ka ba med pa'i 'og rol du spyod cing / nam rma kha'i nor bu'i snang bas gsal ba'i lus can gyi khams yo/da do cog mtha' dag la springs pa/ gangs can gyi ljongs sprudir bstan pa snga phyer dar ba'i nang nas rgyal mtshan gyi tog ltar ma ngon si ra 'phags pa 'jam rmagon mi'i zol cam/ kha/ 'i ru ci gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong takyi pa chen ngo/'i ring lugs zhwa se ra gyi tsod paṇa snachang ba'o bstan pa'i rin po che ma do khamaṭashrī kyi 70

ljongs su 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i gzhi rten du gyur pa chab mdo byams pa gling zhes yongs su grags pa 'di nyid rje bdag nyid chen po'i dngos slob bstan pa'i dar chen drug gi nang tshan byang semyo/sa shes rab bzang pos phyag btab pa nas bzung / zhang khung pa cho sa dbang grags pa sogs mkhas shing grub pa'i gdan rabs rim par byon pa las/ gdan rabs bcu gsum pa phyag na pad+mo bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sdes bstan pa 'dzin spel bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad/ gdan rabs bcu bzhi par 'phags pa lha mchog gi sprul sku bsod nams rnam par rgyal ba dbang po'i sde nas bzung sprul sku rim byon rnams kyis bla dgon bstan srid gcig pa'i 'dzin skyong spel gsum mdzad pa dang 'phags pa lha rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i bar byon zin thams cad kyang 'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad pa bla na ma mchis pas/ rgyal bstan spyi dang / bye brag ri bo dge ldan pa'i bstan srid zung du 'jug pa'i mthun 'gyur mdzad 'phrin rma med pa dang / lhag tu sprul pa'i sku 'phags pa 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgya mtsho dgung lo lnga nas byang sems bdag nyid chen po'i chos kyi khrir 'khod cing /gnam bskos 'jam dbyangs gong ma'i lung las kyis kyang mngon par mtho ba dang / paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs chen po blo bzang ye shes dpal bzang po dang ngos la'ang zab chos kyi 'brel ba zab mos thugs rgyud gtam par mdzad de/ gdan sa 'di nyid le lag dang bcas par yang rnam dkar gyi mdzad pa rlabs che zhing bstan 'gro'i phan bde lhur bzhes kyi dgongs gtad gzhan dang mi 'dra bar mchis kyang gdul bya bsod nams kyi skal ba dman pa'i gegs dbang gis glo bur du gzugs sku chos dbyings su bsdu ba'i mdzad mtha' bstan kyang / sems dpa' chen po rnams gzhan don phun tshogs kyi ro la rjes su chags pa'i thugs bskyed dam bca' nam yang 71

'gog pa med pa'i phyir mchog gi sprul sku'i zlos gar gsar du bsgyur bar gdon mi za ba bcas 'phags pa lha sku phreng rim par bdag 'dzin mdzad pa'i lha sde mi sde/ btang 'gro bzhag sdod/ khrims lung khral rigs sogs lugs zung gi 'phrin las la log par 'khu ba'i bsam sbyor byed mi chog pa tsam du ma zad/ zhal ring bkur bste lhur len pa'i gus 'dud mngon bstod yong ba dang / nang tshan dmigs su bsal bar grwa tshang lnga'i mchod gzhis su gtogs pa dang / mi gtogs pa'i lha sde mi sde/ lho rgyud chos khri/ yu la bzhi/ ngo 'du/ lcags rwa dgon gsum/ shog gsum/ lha rtse/ rngod dgon khag gnyis/ kong po bkra shis chos gling / ri bo gru 'dzin/ bkra shis dpal ra/ dum po che/ bkra shis 'bras spungs/ ku cor/ spo bo chu mdo/ sum rdzong / rdo rje rdzong / mda' zhing / ra ngag thang dgon/mig dgon/ khyung po rme ru/ dkyil mkhar/ bsam grub dgon/ tsha 'phong dgon/ grang 'phel/ sbyin 'bar dgon/ stag gzigs mdzo lung / rdzong rtsa dgon/ be ri shog gsum/ hab brgya grwa tshang tho gru gu pa/tsha ba mthu cha/ 'bo tshan dgon ma lag ldem gshis sde dgon ma lag tsha ba dngul mda'i mchod dud/ hor stod smad/ rdza stod dgon tshan/ ri ne dgon/ rdza ngom la rob mar yul bcas kyi lha sde mi sde rnams su gyur pa'i bye brag sa mtshams skor/ rdza stod 'be gru mo brag 'gag phyin/ 'od gyang ke sgo gcig 'dzin rdo kha dge la tshun/ stag gshis/ stes thog g.yug gshis stod smad/ rngam skyig gnyis/ sha ru nang / wa rnga rtseb lam/nis khe o rong yan tshun/ smar khams cur yul/ mgar ke la/ ngag slong phu mda'/ la btsal khe ru dang la bzhi tshun/ cor chung mdo yan dang /ka ra la tshun/ tho gru gu phu mda'/ rngam gdong nyag gshis yan dang tshun 72

chod nga thog 'bur mo'i rtse nas thad drangs/ lho nub phyogs 'bur mo nyag yan dang / byang phyogs brag ri rtsa yan/ 'ga' yi ne tso sgal yan/dkar g.yas g.yon gsum mdo nas mgron phyi'i lung pa dang dkar sdom bar gyi ri monatshoja sngo yu nas thad drangs pa'i sdom smad rdzong thang yan/ rgya bya nang yan/ ras ni 'ol phad yan/ mar yul/ g.yam la/ tshwa thang / skyo thu mgo dbag nag brag thang so/ 'bo seng la/ mdzo mo dkar leb/zher rjes thang yan/ rtam la kha/ lcags sgang yan/ rob 'bo spar rdzong gsum/ ye rong phu mda' tshun chod/ gam dang dug lung / gnam che chung / lcags kha dang dge la tshun/ la stod a 'jab 'phrang mgo gzhog re la/ stag shod/ mkhar 'bal mdo g.yug la phyin/ mtsho rog gsum mdo/ngom gis la/ mda' rag dkar rdi phug gsum la kha/ rma tsha thi/ rdis 'gu mdo phyin/ ngom sto da tham ga'i rdo dga'/ se ra nyag chog ra srog chu kha phyin/ re ne nang / stag ge nang / brag dmar bya nyal ma/ me tog ser ru/ rdzog gshis yan/ da7/ra shod mdo khams mchod rten mthong grol phyin gyi shug pa tsha kha/ tshal brag la/ rta 'dzer spun gsum/ yor mda'/tsha ma skor bcas/ tsha ba mthun rgyang 'jal sa yan kle 'gya 'ges brag sngon phyin/ gu shi mda' tshun/ ye re lung / rdi ra la phyin/ gla mda' rdo 'bum dang sa ser ngos tshun/ ldem gshis khra shod phyin/ gla spu kha/ wa shod ro re kha yan/ rngu chu phan/ rgya mkhar brag log 'bog ra nang stod smad phyin/ stag gzig gzi phra mdo phyin/ 'ol mda' yan/ gong dmar rgal tshun/ brag dmar g.yang 'phrad phyin/ sas ma'i rdza 'gag nag rdzong 'gag yan chod/ rab mdo rta mgrin gyi sa zhing khang / me ru shog gsum gyi dmu la/ la gnyis yan/ ram la phan gyong sngon gyang mkhar yan/ kha 73

lung sho sna tshun dang bcas pa'i rtsa mtshams chu mtshams rtswa chu shing gsum gyi bdag thob dkor sa dge khongs/ ban lam dge rgyun/ 'bab yong /khrims lung lar rgya/ mtshal lcags dngul ba/ sogs bdag 'dzin mdzad rigs dang gzhan sde gte rgya nas 'bab yong gi rigs/ rtswa shing ri klung gi brngon rgya bkag khrims/ phyogs kyi tshong pa gar song gi ja 'go sga zam gyi khral yang / mdzod pa sogs las byed kyi bsko 'ja' phyi nang kha mchu'i chod 'dom/dmag bu khral/ dud 'khyar gzhan gyi mgo btags lo bcu song nas gzhan gyi rtsod med/ dgu gzhung gnyis nas yar mar gyi zam khral sprod len/chab mdo'i mnga' khul gyi mdo mgron rnams nas khral rigs chab mdor gang 'khri las/ 'ba' li dgu gzhung sogs la khral sprod mi dgos pa/ mdo mgron dang mnyam song sgar 'brang gis ja 'go sprod rgyun bcas mdor na gong gsal gyi don tshan la/ gnam bskos 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po'i bka'i lung gis gzengs bstod lung las 'ja' sa rtsal 'dug pa dang /kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i dbang po lnga pa chen po dang / 'di ga nas song ba'i she bam dang tham ga le tshan go shrī bstan 'dzin chos rgyal sras brgyud na rim/ sa spyod sde srid rim 'khod bcas nas gtan tshigs she bam sogs rim spel bcas gtan khra yig rigs dang 'brel ba da lta phan gnas bzhin ci yin thog nas lcags ra sde dgon dang / ngo 'du/ chos khri/ rngod dgon khag gnyis/ spo bo dgon khag bco bcas pa'i skor da lam dmigs bsal bcad mtshams kyi 'dum khra zur gsal don bzhin dang / de phyin rnams ji srid rgyal bstan rin po che ji gnas kyi bar de srid du gnas 'jags bsgyur bkod med pa'i rgyab gnon 'ja' sa she bam chen po'i bcad mtshams bgyis pa yin pas/ khyod gong 'khod mtha' dag gis lhag pa'i bsam pa rnamyo4 par 74 —

dag pas kun nas blangs te rnyed pa dang bkur bsti/ / ri mor bgyed pa sogs lugs zung gi sgo nas phan grogs mthun 'gyur gyi rim pa dang bas lhur len pa gal che/ ji ltar bsgo ba tshul bzhin du sgrub pa rnams la gnas skabs dang / mthar thug kun tu dge ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi skyabs 'jug rnam pa kun tu yid la 'grogs pa byed cing / gal te bsgo ba rnar gzon te gong don las 'gal g.yo g.yo'i rigs spyod pa shar na rdo rje'i srung ma mthu dang ldan pa rnams kyis 'phrin las drag po'i rol pas tshar du gcod pa'i 'jigs pa la bag zon dang ldan pa'i sgo nas blang dor mtha' dag 'gal med du spyod pa gyis/zhes go bar bya ba'i yi ge 'dzin byed ces pa me byi (rab byung bcu gsum pa)dbo zla'i 'bras tshes dge bar phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang lugs brgya'i mdun sa gru 'dzin 'phags pa'i gzhal mad khang chen po nas bris ’’zhes bstsal 'dug (de'i phyi lo rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtsho zhing du gshegs )dgung grangs bdun du bzhes pa lcags sbru' (1761) lo dbus phyogs lha ldan du chibs sgyur bskyangs te paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyi drung du dbu'i gtsug phud phul nas mtshan‘‘ye shes 'jigs med dpal ldan bstan pa'i mgon po’’zhes gsol/ slar gdan sa chab mdor phyir phebs kyis chos spyod dang yig klog sogs gsan sbyong gnang /dgu grangs bcu bzhir bzhes pa/ sa byi(176ra) lo bsdus grwa che chung la thugs sbyangs mdzad/ dgung grangs bcu mdun du bzhes pa lcags yos (1771) lo dbus phyogs lha ldan du chibs bskyod kyis ser byes grwa tshang du cho sa zhugs rmadzad nas lo lnga'i ring ngabu phar sogasatshomatshan nyid gsan sbyong mthar phyin gneng / pyaṇache.ā+oṃrichu po ce'i drung nas bsnyen rdzogs 75

bzhes/ dgung grangs nyer gcig bzhes pa shing lug lo chab myo/do dgon du phyir phebs mdzad khar rgyal dbang sku phreng brgyad pa 'jam dpal rgya mtsho mchog dang de mo mchod yon nas gzengs bstod rgya cher mdzad/ de nas gdan sa chab mdor zhabs sor 'khod/ de nas mi ring bar mang‘re 'bangs la byamasatshoskyong dgos pa'i bsdam 9redo mas dang / 'dul grwa spyi'i 'dul khrims das/ ther mdzad/dgung grangs nyer gnyis su bzhes pa me sprel(1776)'o/ bla brang gi pho brang rnying pa bshigs nas gsar skrun gyi dbu 'dzugs bskyangs shing / lo gnyis kyi khongs su theg chen pho brang thog rtsegs lnga ldan/ ka ba drug brgya'i sa khongs rgya khyon bzo bkod phun sum tshogs pa ga sa ra bzhengs mdzad/ nang gi rten gtso gser zangs kyi byams chen mtho so bdun pa dang / zhi lcags rnam gnyis nas stod dpag med dang rje tsong kha pa mtho so lnga pa re sogs gsar bzhengs shing / dgung grangs nyer lnga bzhes pa sa phag lo rten dang brten pa'i tshon rtsi ldebs ris dang bcas legs grub byung / de'i snga lo ste sa/ khyi lo kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che rgya phyogs su/ chibs zhal bsgyur skabs 'phags pa lha mchog 'bri chu bar phebs nas/ dbang chos gsan bzhes dang phebs skyel phebs rdzong sogs gzab rgyas mdzad/ phar phyir phebs lam 'khel yul gyi ser skya du ma chos 'brel yang mang du mdzad nas chab dgon du zhabs sor 'khod/ ('di nas dgung grangaru/ nyer dgu chu yo/sa bar gyi mdzad lam gsung rnam sogs kyi dpyad gzhi ma rnyed pas stong char lus)dgung grangs gsum/ cur bzhes pa shing 'brug si/ gam/ma lo gsar du bzhad pa'i tshes dang po'i snga cha nas rgyal ba'i bstan srung ma gcig dud si sa sol ba ma dang dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo thugs dam dgyes bskangs kyis 76

tshes gtor gsung chos/ dang / mchog sprul rnam gnyis dang phyag mdzod che mo/steng shod kyi gnyer che chung gsol gzims mgron gnyer sogs kyi mjal dar 'bul bzhes lo gsar gyi nyin snga phyi'i bzhugs gral dgyes ston/ tshogs langs// gar rol sogs sngar srol rgyun bzang gzab rgyas bskyangs/hor zla 1tshes 15cho 'phrul chen mo'i dus bzang nyin dge 'dun gyi sde chen por mang 'gyed gzab pa dang / srod 'khor skabs bco lnga mchod pa'i mchod sprin rgya mtshor 'phags chen mchog sprul rin po che yab sras dang /phyag mdzod che mo blo bzang rdo rje/ rgya ra sprul pa'i sku sogs mchod gzigs su phebs thog sku zhabs rnam grol grwa tshang tshogs yongs nas mchod 'bul gsung chog tshogs pa'i tshogs dbur zhabs sor bkod de bstan (ragro ma lus sman pa'i thugs bskyed bsngo ba rgya che rtsal nyin ltar yongs 'dzin chos rje ngag dbang gi drung nas ljags lung rnams gsan/ bco lnga mchod pa ang rim/ bsgrigs pa'i bzang rigs rnams la legs dar bstsal/ yongs 'dzin ngag dbang mchog sprul gyi drung nas lha mo'i smor dang ngag dbang mchog nyid kyis gsar rtsom mdzad pa'i shor mo brtag thabs bcas kyi ljags lung gsan/zla 2tshes 1nas nyin bdun gyi bar grwa tshang gi gsung bzang gyer dbyangs gsar bslab tshang mas lha mo rnams gnyis kyi bskang gso gzab rgyas tshogs par 'phags chen mchog sprul rin po che yab sras tshogs dbur phebs/rmo mda' chos 'kher rtser chos rje shes rab mtshungs med dang / g.yo mda' dkon du chos rje dka' bcu pa bsam gtan grags pa/ lhun rtse bla mar tshwa chu grags pa rgyal mtshan/ de'u gsum ri khrod kyi bla mar hor 'brug bzod pa rgya mtsho bcas bsko bzhag mdzad/ yongs 'jin chos rje ngag dbang sprul pa'i sku drung nas dpal ldan lha mo'i be'u bum ljags lung gsan/77

tshogs khro chen mo gsar bzhengs kyi zhal byang bka' rtsom gnang / 'phags chen mchog nas rdor slob mdzad pa'i grwa tshang bsnyen song bcas nas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi las bzhi'i sbyin bsreg phyag len bka' drin bskyangs/yongs 'dzin dam pa chos rje ngag dbang sprul pa'i sku nas zhi ba'i sbyin bsreg mdzad rgyu'i bka' phebs/ hor zla 2tshes 12nyin 'phags chen yab sras dge 'dun pa'i kun dga' rwa ba chen mor byon te slob dpon lnga dang / sgrub mchod chen po brgyad kyi mchod dpon/ dbu mdzad/ dge zhal/ 'dus mang dang bcas ston 'khor tshang ma nas spyan 'dren khrus gsol mchod dbyangs sogs snga ra rgyun ltar gyi phyag len nyams pa med pa mdzad pa dang 'phags chen mchod sprul rin po che mchog nas bka' chos ljags bsngo bde ba can gyi smo na lam dang / bstan 'bar ma sogs kyi dbu bskul mthun 'gyur gang rgyas gnang / de'i phyi tshes 14nyin snga gror za 'og las grub pa/'i gos sku rnams zhal phye bar mchod pa snyan shal rgya cher phul ba dang / mgul dkris kyi chos khri chen mor zhabs sor bkod/ mchod 'bul smon lam chos spyod gsung chog dang 'dus sde rgya mtshor gzab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ phyi dro 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug sogs kyi 'dra 'bag la phyag nas bkris pa'i me tog 'thor ba dang / gar 'cham sogs gzigs rtog la phebs/ tshes 19nyin skor lam chem/ mor mchod pa'i bye brag sna tshogs pas mdun bsus te skal bzang rnam 'dren lnga pa'i sku brnyan mthong grol chen mo shing rta'i 'phrul gyis gdan drangs/ dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho ser sbrengs du byon pa'i mgon du 'phags pa lha yab sras dang rgya ra sprul sku sogs phyag phebs/rdza srib ko mdar 'phags pa zhal bcu gre/cig pa phyas/ stong spyam/ sdong rang 78

byon du phebs pa'i gnas mchog khyad par can der sngar phyag mdzod che mo sku zhang ngag dbang rgya mtshos dge slong lnga rgyun bzhugs kyi sgrub sde btsugs kyang de rjes zhal grangs lnga re tshang min ci rigs byung 'dug pas/ 'di lo nas bzung bla ma pis pa rab 'byams pa sbyin pa dpal ldan gsar bskos la gzhan dge slong bzhi bcas ji srid bar rgyun bzhugs kyi rten la mchod 'bul sogs nyams chags med pa dang rgyun par gyi sgrig lam sogs bstan 'gro'i mig rgyan du phan nges dgos tshul sogs bka' phebs/ rin chen dang gnyis dang rang byung zangs sogs las 'phags pa lha mchog gi thugs dam nang rten grar bzhugs rgyu'i rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku brnyan ljags bkod ltar bzhengs pa blugs lam du 'gro zhing byon gtsang ngo mtshar ba phebs/ 'du grwa spyi bso nas mgon khang chen mo sngar gyi khang rgan la song gshis gog skyon shin tu che bas 'phags pa lha mchog nas mgo 'dren mdzad pa'i gsar bzhengs zhig thugs rje che ba mkhyen mkhyen zhes snyan seng zhus ngor zla 2tshes 1'phags pa lha mchog dang / yongs 'dzin ngag dbang mchog gi sprul sku/ phyag mdzod che mo sku 'khor bcas mgon khang chen mor phyag phebs snyan shal gser skyems 'phrin bahrol gzab rgyas thog stong shod phyi nang kun tu gzigs rtog gnang / chos skyong chen mo'i lung phebs bzhin dge 'dun gyi 'du khang chen mor rgyun bzhugs gnang rgyu'i dbyen zlum mchod rten gsar bzhengs kyi gzungs zhugs dril sgrub phyag len bkrin bskyangs/ dpal mgon zhal gyi dam tshig bskang gso 'tshogs pa'i gral dbur yang yang phebs/ dad ldan 'ga' zhig gi zhus ngor rgya ra mchog gi sprul sku'i 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs 'jags rtsom gnang / ji lo ltar lha ldan du rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa yab sras dang /79

rgyal tshab mchog gi sprul sku/ khri chen no min han/ rgya dpon a ban gnyis/bka' blon khag sogs bod kyi bla dpon mi dpon so sor mtshams zhu 'bul srol bzhin 'di skabs kyang sku tshab ched btang gdong khung so sor gsung shog 'bul gnang mdzad/ mdo sgar dpon phyirasko'ong gdong rgyal dbang rin po che mchog dang /khri chen no min han sogs nas gsung shog rten rgya gnang ba dang bcas mjal phyag byung bar dkar spro sogs bstsal/ g.yo mda' dgon pas tshogs khro gsar bzhengs kyi zhal byang zhus pa ltar ljags rtsom dang zhal 'debs khro dkar chab rgya lnga bcu sogs gnang cha mdzad/ gdugs dkar mdos chen dang / chos skyong chen po'i gtor mdos zhag bdun phrag re 'tshogs rgyu'i bka' bkod mdzad/ sku zhabs rnam grol grwa tshang tshogs mang nas lo ltar bzhin sa ga zla bar yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bca gsam pa'i rdul tshon gyi ༄ ༄dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i dbang chog tshogs rgyun ltar 'phags pa lha mchog nyid tshogs dbur nyin phal cher phebs pa'i dbang chog bzhes/ chos rje ngag dbang mchog gi sprul sku sman chab 'phrod bzhes legs par byung ste gdan sar phebs pa dang zhal 'dzoms gsung mchid yun ring gnang / yongs 'dzin chos rje ngag dbang mchog sprul sku drung nas rje bdag nyid chen po tsong kha pa'i gsung 'bum phal cher gyi 'jags lung gsan grub pa dang / chos rje sprul sku rang nas mdzad pa'i dmigs brtse ma'i bum gter lhan thabs bla ma sman khang pa'i dmigs brtse ma'i 'khor lo'i las tshogs kyi lhan thabs bcas gsan nas mdzod btags rtser son/ dngul dkar gyi maṇ+ḍal/ mdzod gos yug chen/ ba zang ja 'khor drug gnyis bcas kyi dngonu/ 'bul btogs/80

zla 5tshes 11la chos rje sprul pa'i sku'i drung du dus sbyor sogs rtsis kyi skor 'ga' zhig dogs gcod gnang / dkar mda' mkhan po zur pa chos mdzad ngag dbang dge legs sogs mjal 'dod re ba dag gi 'dod smin rtsal/ lis tā shin mjal khar byung bas mdzod btags g.yang ṭi'i phor pa sogs dngos tshan du ma'i 'bul ba bstabs par dkar spro dang / gcan lpags sna tshogs sogs bstsal bas yid mgur gyur/ pe cin nas rgyal dbang sku phreng bdun pa skal bzang rgya mtsho mchog la phyag tham 'bul mi sgo mang hu thog thu sku 'khor mjal khar byon par ston mo dang gsungs mchid zhib par mdzad/ tshes 12nyin pe cin nas gong ma'i bka' yi gzengs bstod che bkur gyi gser yig dang / zarte'og yug chen bcu phrag lnga/ mdzod btags sum cu skor/ gzhan yang g.yang ṭi'i snod chas sogs gnang cha du ma dang bcas mkhan po grags pa ngo g.yog dang / gong ma'i sku tshab jar sbi/ mar mang du sdod mus kyi tsang phogs sogs bla brang du 'byor bar las sne sogs kyi bsu 'phags chen mchog nas ston mo dang legs skyes kyi gnang cha sogs sngar srol bzang po mdzad pas rgya bod kyi dpon g.yog 'khor bcas yid mgur gyur/de nas rgya ra mchog gi sprul skus gru gu thang dgon du sku gsung thugs rten mang po gsar bzhengs mdzad pa dag la rab gnas zhu rgyu bcas kyi ched du spyan drangs pa bzhin/ zla 6tshes 12nyin 'phags chen mchog sprul rin po che dang / yongs 'dzin dam pa zhi sprul phyag mdzod chen mo lhan rgyas bcas chab mdo nas bzhugs sgar btegs shing maṇ+ḍal thang du gru gu bla spyis thabs su mjal dar dang / dgon nas 'dus mang gis ser sbrengs dang lha khang so so'i yang thog nas bsangs dar rol —mo sogs kyi bsnyen bkur ba dang bcas 81

te gzim khang bla brang du zhabs sor 'khod par phebs ja bzhes spro mjal dar thog bka' mchid gsung mol yun ring bar mdzad/ rgya ra mchog sprul sku zhabs nas gsar bzhengs kyi thugs dam rten 'phags thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi si mi tshad lhag pa sogs sku brnyen sna tshogs brgya phrag lhas/ dang / bris sku'i gras bde mchog bla brgyud/ chos skyong sogs kyi sku thang du ma/ rgyal bka' rin po che tshar gnyis/ bstan 'gyur par ma sogs pod du ma/ rje drung gi phyag bris gnas bcu'i zhal thang bcas dang / gru gu'i 'du khang dang lha khang 'du khang bcas par bzhugs pa'i rten gsum gsar rnying mtha' dag bcas la 'phags pa lha mchog dang / yongs 'dzin zhi sprul sku zhabs/ rgya ra mchog gi sprul sku/ grwa tshang gi gsung bzang bco lnga skor/ gru gu'i bla dge bgres grwa bcas lhan cig tu 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi lha yi rnal 'byor zab mo dang ldan pas dam tshigs pa so sor ye shes pa dngos su bsdim pa'i rab gnas kyi cho ga sbyor dngos mjug gsum dang / 'dod khams dbang mo dang rgyal btsan sogs rgya sprul nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i srung ma rnams la gzab gsol bka' gtad 'phrin bcol dang bcas mdzad pa la rgya ra mchog gi sprul sku nas dngos 'byor gyis mchod sprin nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo 'phar yang sor dbye bas ston 'khor tshang ma gzab ston dang / rten gsum la'ang mchod pa sna tshogs snyan shal sogs blos mi phud pa lta bu'i rab ston shin tu rgya dpang mtho ba phul/ de'i phyi nyin gru gu bla grwa thugs 'dun gcig pas gsol ba btab pa bzhin 'phags chen mchog nas ser skya'i khrom tshogs brgya phrag lnga lhag 'das par 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug phyag bzhi pa'i rjes gnang dang / grub thob rgya ra mchog sprul nyid kyi sku yi 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs 'phags chen mchog gis bka' rtsom mdzad pazhi ljags lung sogs 82

dang gru gu 'dus mang la mang 'gyed dang / mchod rdzas spyi 'jogs sogs bstsal/ de nas rgya sprul nyid nas bsnyen bkur ba'i chod yon tshang ma mdzo ya la thang du bzhugs sgar mdzad/ der rgya bod kyi zas sna tshogs kyi srid zhu ci ya nga zhus pa'i thugs spro dang sku rtsed du ma gnang zhing sman chab bzhes/ de nas grub dbang rgya ra shes rab phun tshogs kyi sgrub gnas spangs phug tu lhan phebs kyis gnas gzigs mchod 'ebul thugs smon gnang / de nas 'phags pa lha mchog sku 'khor rnams gru gu dgon nas bzhugs sgar btegs par rgya sprul sku 'khor dang / gru gu dgon pa'i las sne'i chibs skyel dang bcas phyag phebs/ rgya dpon tsang phogs gnyis kyi 'tshams zhu 'byor/zla rdotshos 1nyin 'phags pa lha mchog sprul rin po che dang / yongs 'dzin dam pa zhi sprul sku zhabs lhan rgyas cheb mdo nas bzhugs/ sgar btegs te dben gnas chen po lhun grub rtse byang chub dga' tshal du phebs/ de nas rim par dpon slob zhi sprul rin po che'i drung nas kun mkhyen lnga pa chen po'i gsung 'bum nang ma gsang ba rgya can ma'i dbang lung 'ga' zhig gsan bzhes dang / mgon po gur zhal gyi dbang lung khrid thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa du ma gsan bzhes gnang / tshes 12nyin gtsang bkra shis lhun por paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po'i yang srid mchog sprul rin ngo che (bstan pa'i nyi ma ) gser khrir mnga' gsol ba'i dus tshes la chab mdo khul gyi dgon ma lag mi ser mtha' dag gis sangs dar rol mo gang legs dgos kyi bka'‘bkod bstsal/ gru gu nas rgya ra sprul sku phebs te 'phags pa lha yab sras sku 'khor bcas par nyin 'khyongs kyi bsnyen bkur gang rgyas zhus/ tsho— sto / rī ༷ tsho — — 83

zla 9tshes 12nyin 'phags chen mchog dang / yongs 'dzin zhi sprul rin po che sku 'khor ri khrod nas chibs bskyod kyis zam khar rgya dpon rnams kyis mjal dar phul te ri ma gyis chab mdo bla brang du zhabs sor 'khod/tshes 2 2gza' skar bzang ba'i nyin bstan srung chen po'i gnas sde brgyad zil gnon lcog tu 'phags pa lha ma chog gi bka' srung chen mo zhangatshopaṇa sku gsol spyan 'dren thog sgron dar gser skyems sogs phul zhing 'byung 'gyur gyi lung gsal zhu gnang mdzad/ gyer dbyangs pa rnams nag po skor gsum sogs kyi dbyangs rgyugs bzhes pa'i dbu tshugs/ bod bzhugs a ban lis tā shin phyir log chab mdor 'byor bas 'phags chen gyi mjal phyag tu bcar nas mdzod btags phrug shar legs pa drug 'go snam bub/ bzang spos ko bkra sogs phul bar dkar spro rgyas pa dang / pags regs bco lnga skor/rdor sems kyi sku 'dod li byon gtsang bcas kyi gnang cha dang / bod phebs sgo mang ho thog thu mjal khar byung bar dkar spro gnang cha sogs thugs mgu bar bstsal/de nas zam gdong sprul sku dang / sku zhabs rnam grol grwa tshang du gsar zhugs pa bcas nyi shu skor la dge tshul gyi bslab sdoms gnang / zam gdong spru' skur mtshan 'phags bstan pa'i nyi ma zhes bstsal/ sku zhabs rnam grol grwa tshang du ma ṇi bum sgrub zla 'khor nyin mtshan thun chad med 'tshogs rgyu'i skor la zhal bkod bka' slob zhib rgyas mdzad/zla 10tshes 12nas yongs 'dzin bla ma dam pa zhi sprul gyi sku srung nas snga ma'i chos lung gsan 'phros rnams dang dud sol lha mo'i rjes gnang dang be'u bum sogs kyi ljags lung du ma gsan/zla 11tshes 1nyin lha mo rnam gnyis kyi dus gtor sngar rgyun ltar dang /84

rgyal dbang yab sras kyi bka' yig rten bcas sku mdun du 'bul 'os rnams phul bar dkar spro dang gsu nga mol zhib cha mdzad/ tshes 2nyin ldan chos 'khor nas chos rje ngag dbang mchog gi sprul sku chab mdor phebs/ phyag mdzod chen cho/sadang / gnyer che chung / gsol mgron/ grwa tshang gi las sne sogs nas phebs bsu dang / 'dus sde rnams nas ser sbrengs dang bcas chab mdo bla brang theg chenatshochos kyi pho brang du zhabs sor 'khod/ 'phas/sa chen mchog sprul rin po che yab sras rnam gsum nyi 'od ngo mtshar bkod par dgyes 'dzum lhan cig 'dzoms pa'i spyan sngar bla brang nas dkar spro gzab 'bul thog thugs yid gcig 'dres kyi gsung mchid zhib lhug yun ring gnang /'phags chen mchog nas yongs 'dzin dam pa ngag dbang mchog gi sku zhabs nas ljags lung gsan pa'i legs 'bul du mdzod btags dang /gos me tog brgyad pa yug gis gtsos dgu tshan/ ja 'khor drug cu bcas 'bul gnang mdzad pa dang / yongs 'dzin ngag dbang mchog nas kyang bzang gos yug chen dgu tshan sogs 'degs 'bul mdzad/ tshes 9nas phyag rdor gyi ljags bsten bdun phrag bzhi lhag thugarngage dam gong 'phel du bskyangs/zla 12tshes 29nyin chos 'khor ma lus 'dus pa'i srung ma tshang ma'i ging chen thugs dam dgyes bskangs kyi rdo rje'i gar 'cham rnams la gzigs zhib gnang / shing sbrul gnam lo gsar pa'i tshes 1snga char gsung chog pa rnams kyi zhabs 'degaṭasdo dang bcas 'phags chen mchog nas 'jam dpal shin rje gshed kyi rnam 'byor dang ldan bzhin du phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mthun rdzas ma 85

tshang ba med par tshar du dngar zhing ma gcig dpal ldan lha mo dud sol ma dang dmag zor rgyal mo 'khor bcas thugs dam dgyes bskangs kyi tshes gtor rten 'bul sogs kyi zhal 'don dang / yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis dang phyag mdzod chen mo/ rtse shod gnyer chen sogs nas mjal dar 'bul bzhes sngar srol ltar mdzad/ tshoms chen srid gsum rnam rgyal du bla grwa'i nang mgron rnams 'tshogs par dgyes ston chen mo'i gtsug rgyan du 'phags chen dam pa yab sras phebs par bla brang gnyer tshang chen mo nas dgyes ston bsnyen bkur gzab rgyas bstar 'bul zhus/ tsang phogs sogs rgyatshodaponarnams la lo gsar ston mo bstsal/chab mdo spyi chen gyi bstan srung pho brang mgon khang chen mo de nyid sngar gdan rabs bzhi pa rje drung shes rab brtsegs kyi sku ring la rje drung nyid kyi phyag bzo mdzad de bzhengs pa'i nag po skor gsum gyi sku byin bzhugs yul de dag gog skyon che bas 'di lo gsar bzhengs dgos tshul phyag mdzod chen mor bka' khyab gnang /tshes 15nyin cho 'phrul che na mor 'dus sder mang 'gyed rgya che dang /stod kyi gtor chen sogs ngo mtshar kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin/ phung ltar bkod pa la gzigs zhib dang 'brel sku zhabs rnam grol 'dus gsung chog gi gral dbur 'phags chen rin po che zhabs sor bkod/tshes 17nyin 'phags chen sku 'khor dkor bdag klu yi dge bsnyen dkar po chos mdzes rtag tu bsti ba'i gnas rdza rgyud gtsang chab chene mo'i rgyud lcang dkar klu sding du phebs te bsang gsol klu mchod/ mtsho rdzas bstsal ba dang / de bzhin rdzong nag mtsho 'gram dang / seng rdzong klu sding mtho ris dga' tshal bcas par bsang gsol 'bul gtor sogs gsung chog gzab 86

rgyas bskyangs/ mgon khang rnying pa bshig rgyu'i las ka skya bo pho mos byas na mi legs pas sgrub mchod khag nas grwa gzhon 'os mtshams gtong dgos bka' phebs ltar btang ste las/ 'du grwa spyi bso nas grwa tshang lnga bsdu bca' byas pa'i mgon khang gsar bzhengs kyi las byed 'go pa ad 'ul bcas la phogs dang ja tshul sogs sta gon byas na zhus par ar ston tsam 'grig na phogs ja thug sogs 'phags chen nas gnang 'thus kyi bka' bzhes bstsal/zla 2tshes 15mngagon khang gsar bzhengs kyi 'go pa dang / dbu mdzad che chung / 'ul mi dmas bcas la go babs bzhin mjal dar dang / ja thug dgong dro chang ston sogs gya nams bstsal/chab mdo dgon chen gyi nub ngos bskor lam nang du sngar rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu glang lor 'phags chen sku phreng drug pa 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgya mtsho dgung grangs bcu dgur bzhes skabs gsar bzhengs kyi ljags bkod dang las grwa'i dbu 'dzugs bskyangs pa'i byams khang chen mor rten brten pa 'di nyid kyi sku brnyan rin po che cung gog skyon byung yod par lo 'dir mdzod pa blo bzang rdo rjes gzhi nas gsar bzhengs kyi mthun rkyen sbyar rgyu'i skor 'thad min bkanya slob zhus par legs tshul phebs don bzhin rten rnying pa'i rab gnas spo ba arga'i cho ga mdzad/ yongs 'dzin zhi bzang sprul sku rin po che drung nas gso sbyong dang / thugs rje chen po'i ljags lung gsan/zla 4tshes 7nyin 'phags pa lha sku 'khor chab dgon nas chibs bskyod kyis dben gnas lhun grub rtser phebs/ de gar sde dge dpal spungs bla brang nas g.yar zhus grub brgya'i zhal thang kla gzigs zhib thog lha bris rnams la grub brgya'i zhal thang gsar bzhengs kyi ljags bkod mdzad/ byams chen gsar bzhengs kyi gzungs zhugs 'jigs byed kyi 'phrul 'khor chen mo'i zhi 87

rgyas dbang gsum gyi (sprukhor lo bri bsgrub phyag len gnang / tshes 29nyin lhun rtse ri khrod nas gu ru klu lding du gsol tsha dang bcas chab mdo bla brang du zhabs sor 'khod/ li'u am ban mjal phyab/ tu bcar te mjal dar nang mdzod dang / rgya khug rgya gri spus legs/ spos phreng so/gas phul bar sku mdun du gsol ja bzhes 'bras gnang thog li ma'i tshe dpag med dang /gcan pas/sa sogs kyi gnang cha bstsal yang am ban nas sku 'dra de nyid dad pa'i rten du zhu gcan pags rnam sogs gnang cha rnams mi zhu/ khong rang la rnam kun skyabs 'jug thugs la ma brjed pa gnang rogs/ da res bka' bsgo srung mdud cig thugs rje che ba zhu/ slar khong rang pho brang du 'byor nas rgya yul gyi dngos po thugs bzhed yod pa 'dug na gsung gnang yod pa rjes 'bul zhus chog ces sogs zhus te dad gus bla med zhus/ de nas mchog sprul rnam gnyis nas byams khang du gzungs 'bul gyi phyag len mdzad/'phags chen nyid kyi phyag bzo mgon po phyag phrus/ gsar bzhengs dang 'brel srog shing gzugs sngags/ srog 'khor sogs kyi phyag bris gnang zhing rab gnas kyang mdzad/ de nas rma gon khang chen mo'i phyi nang steng shod rgya phigathug dar sogs legs grub byung bas mchog sprul rnam gsum dang / rgya ra sprul sku/ sku zhabs rnam grol grwa tshang gi tshogs yongs bcas nas rab gan sa 〈 bkra shis snye ma 〉yi sgo nas gsung chos/ dang / gzab ston bskyangs/'phags yul gyi a tsar+ya ar+sha si n+ti bya ba la gos chen gyi gon pa dang dkar spro gnang cha bstsal/ ra ba stod klong rdol bla ma ngag dbang blo bzang nas chab mdo mgon khang gsar bzhengs grub pa'i legs skyes rten rgya 'bul 'byor byung /zla 7tshes 2dbon a khu skal ldan rgya mtshos mgon khang du gdan drangs 88

pa ltar phebs shing / yongs steng dgon pa'i gser zangs las grub pa'i byams chen rgyug mtho bco lnga gsar bzhengs zin par rab gnas dang / a khu skal ldan dang mgar dbu sogs la legs dar bstsal/ de nas ra sku 'bum du phebs bzhed kyis chab dgon nas bzhugs sgar btegs shing /sku 'bum gyi spyan sngar nyin ltar mchod sprin dang / gos sna tshogs kyi ka paṇa/steng du rgyalasna mtshan gser zangs kyi tog bcas gsar 'dzugs dang / sbyin 'jags kyang bstsal/ de nas chab mdor phyir phebs rtsis zla rdotshes 2nyim/ gzhung sa'i sba yer mkhan por gsol ston gnang cha bstsal/ 'di skabs tsam nas yongs 'dzin zhi sprul gyi drung nas rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i gsung 'bum〈gsang ba rgya can ma〉zhes pa'i dbang lung gsan 'go tshugs/ sku zhabs grwa tshang gi ngag 'don〈drug cu srid gsum rnam rgyal〉zhes pa ljags rtsom bka' drin bskyangs/ thugs dam nang rten du rnal 'byor ma'i sku brnyan byon gtsang gaspur bzhengs grub par byin rten gzungs sngags sogs sta gon mdzad/ tshas 25nyin gzungs 'bul rab gnas mdzad/ zla 10tshes 10yongs 'dzin zhi sprul gyi drung nas rnam sras sogs kyi dbang lung sna tshogs gsan/ mar thang khul sdod rgya mi 'ga' res nas ra mo che sogs dgon gyi nye khul du ri bong dang nya sogs la gnod 'tshe byas par mgron pad+ma tsang phogs sogs kyi gam du mngags gtong bka' slob gnang bas rgya dponamornams nas kyang je ltar bka' bzhin spyi bor dwang du blangs pas srog chags du ma srog sbyin thog zla 11tshes 12nyin nas tshe sgrub kyi ljags bsnyen du bzhugs te zla 12tshes 22nyin sku mtshams grol nas dgu chen gyi tshogs dbur phebs/me rta gnam lo gsar tshas skabs lha mo rnam gnyis kyi tshes gtor 'bul srol dang dgyes ston sogs sngar rgyun ltarā dang / gnyer phun tshogs skal 89

bzang nas bram ze'i thod pa mtshan ldan zhig 'bul lam zhus par thugs dgyes legs dar bstsal sngon du zla 12tshes 27dben gnas lhun rtse byang chub dga' tshal du phebs/me lug zla 1tshes 2nas 'phags chen mchog dang gzim dpon blo bzang don yod bcas thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i ljags bsnyen dbu tshugs/chab mdo mdzod par nad rims la dogs 'dzems kyi bca' khrim—sa gang dam dgos/ rgyu'i bka' shog bstsal/ phyag mdzod chen mos nad rims bzlog thabs rim 'gro ji 'gab gsung zhu 'byor bar phyag mo zhib gzigs kyis bka' lan gnang / mar thang sogs su bro nad kyis gdungs shing bza' btung dang bral ba nyams thag brgya skor yong/ pa gsan ma thag bla brang gnyer tshang nas de dag la chab khal nyer lnga'i rtsam pa bster sprod dgos pa'i bka' shog bstsal/ skabs der chab mdor nad rims nyen che bas gling gseb kyi kye kye rdor pa dang / kun rigs pa'i sgrub mchod 'phral grol dgos pa byung zhing / grwa tshang yang nad rims thar ma'i grwa nas bskang gsol pa dang /sgrol chog pa/ mtshams rgyun pa bcas dgon du bzhugs pa las mang ma re khya/ga rang yul ngo/ sor phebs pa e 'gab tses mdzod pa dang gnyer phun tshogs skal bzang nas zhu yig phul 'byor la de don bzhin legs tshul bka' lan gnang / zla 4tshes 4nyin chab mdo nas li'u am ban gyi zhu yig dang /bstan rgyas gling gi gsol dpon 'phags pa bstan 'dzin gyi zhu yig/ klong rdol bla ma rin po che'i gsung brtag bka' lan bcas 'byor bar khungs so sor bka' lan gnang / bde mchog ljags bsnyen sogs ljags bsnyen snga phyi sbyin sreg kha skongs dang bcas pa legs grub bskyangs/zla 6tshes 5nyin zhi sprul rin po cher bla ma yab sras dang rgya sprul rin po 90

che bcas thad dkar nor rgyas lding du zhal 'dzom/sa myo/dzad rgyu'i bka' yig bstsal don lhun rtse ri khrod nas chibs bsgyur gyis tsha rting trem du thang dkar klu sding du phebs nas zhi sprul rin po che dang phyag mdzod chen mo sogs nas mjal dar dang 'brel zhal 'dzoms gsung mchid bskyangs / thang dkar klu sding du dbyar mthong spro gseng godagyes ston grub pa dang / lha bris rnams nas grub brgya'i zhal thang legs bris grub par sku yon dang legs dar gnang cha sogs kyis yid mgu bar mdzad/ tshes 22nyin chab mdo bla brang du zhabs sor 'khod/ lha su'i‘‘tsang yes’’dang chab mdo'i‘‘tsang yes’’gnyis mjal khar bcar bar 'dod mthun bstsal/phyag mdzod chen mo blo bzang rdo rje nas byams khang chen mor rgyal ba mi pham mgon po'i snang brnyan gsar bzhengs la gser btul ma srang bdun bcu slor bsgron pa sogs byon gtsang legs par grub par zla 7tshes 5nyin 'phags chen sku phreng bdun pa ye shes 'jigs med dpal ldan bstan pa'i mgon po gang nyid dang zhi sprul 'phags pa dge legs rgyal mtshan/ chos rje ngag dbang 'phrin las rab rgyas dpal bzang po/ grub thob rgya ra sprul pa'i skus dbus sku zhabs rnam grol grwa tshang 'dus tshogs bcas nas rab gnas 〈dge legs rgya mtsho'i char 'bebs〉sbyar dngos mjug gsum cha tshang mdzad par phyag mdzod chen mos rab ston rgya che bstar 'bul zhus/ — de nas tsha ba dang spom mda' khul chibs bskyod kyis spom mda' sde dgon nas chibs bsu dang 'dus sde'i ser sbrengs dang bcas 'du khang du gdan drangs shing /spom mda' dgon pas gsol ba btab don bzhin der 'dus ser skya khrom tshogs la bka' dbang dang gsung chos bskyangs pa dang / dgon par mang 'gyed/ sbyor 'jags sogs bstsal/ de nas chibs bskyod mdzo sgang sde pa 91

dang them thog dgon pa'i bla spyi las sne bcas nas chibs bsu dang ser sbrengs kyis spyan drangs der yang khrom tshogs la bka' dbang dang 'dus sder ja sogs gnang cha spam mtho bstsal/ thar pa don gnyer can mang por bsnyen rdzogs dge slong gi sdom bzhes mdzad/ de nas chibs bskyod kyi thugs chags dgon par phebs skabs mdzad lam gong bzhin bskyangs thog de gar dgon pa'i maṇ+ḍal brtan bzhugs 'busnyel bzhes mdzad/ de nas sa la dgon dang ljang phu dgon/ si phu dgon bcas par phebs shing / dgon so sor mang ja sku 'gyed dang / gsung chos/ bka' dbang sogs mdzad pa rgya cher bzhes/ de nas tsha stod ldem dga' ldan rtag brtan gling gi ser skya du ma'i phebs bsu dang bcas te gdan drangs te bsnyen bkur gzab rgyas zhus/ dga' ldan rtag brta na gling gi rten gsum la rab gnas bka' drin bskyangs te rab ston dang brtan bzhugs 'bul bzhes mdzad/ rta mgrin gyi gtor bzlog dang / ser skya khrom tshogs la thugs rje chen mo'i dbang chen dang 'grel ba'i gsung chos bka' drin bstsal/ 'dus sder ma nga 'gyed dang / spyi 'jogs sogs bstsal te zla rdotshes 1khanyin dga' ldan rtag brtan gling nas chibs skyel dang bcas phebs thon gyis spom mda' dgon du phebs/ de gar rgya la dbang bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i ljags rtsom thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi bskung gnas cho ga'i ljags lung gnang / dad ldan 'ga'i re 'dod ltar gang nyid kyi zhabs brtan gsol 'debs ljags rtsom mdzad pa'i ljags lung yang bstsal/ de nas spom dgon bla spyi dbu chos sogs kyi chibs skyel dang bcas bzhugs sgar btegs te chu grags su phebs skabs de ga'i nye 'khor du yod pa'i mda' dpon sogs kyis mjal phyag zhus/de nas rim phebs kyis seng rdzong lcang gling du yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis kyang 92

phebs pa dang / skyo zam khar rgya dpon tsang phogs gnyis kyi ngo tshab gnyer pa thang si ched rmangags kyis phebs bsu dang bcas chab mdo bla brang theg chen pho brang du zhabs sor 'khod/dgung grangs so gsum du bzhes pa me lug gnam lo gsar tshes su sngar srol mdzad sgo dgyes ston khag nyams med gzab rgyas bskyangs/ hor zla 2nang gong ma'i sku tshab am ban nas 'pha gas chen yab sras latshorgya nag gi dngos spyad sna tshogs pa rten du phul nas mjal bcar la bka' mchid dang /dkar spro/ gnang cha yid tshim bstsal/ gzhung sa'i mdo sgar dpon rtse drung gdong rgyal dbang mchog dang / bka' blon khas/ lha sdod am ban sogs kyi phyag bris 'bul 'byor byung zhing / mdo sgar rtse drung dang dkar spro dang bka' mchid zhib lhugs bstsal/mang gnyer rnying pa shing kha pad+ma dang 'phags pa bstan pa/ sta srung bcas nas mang gnyer gyi rtsis sprod 'phros lhag gi dngos po rnams kyis 'bul ba dang /— mang 'argyad/ spyi 'jog sbyor 'jags sogs phul zhing / de'ang grwa gling gi dge 'dun bzhugs so cog gdan drangs pa'i dbus su chos kyi khri 'phangs mthon por 'phags chen mchog dang / yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis/rje dbon sprul sku/ rgya ra sprul sku/ gzhan yang grwa gling gi slob dpon rnam pa/phyag mdzod chen mo/ gnyer chen gnyer chung / gsol gzim/ mgron drung sogs bla dpon so so'i sku'i rim gro ba che chung bcas rang rang go bas kyi khri stan la 'khod pa'i dbus su 'phags chen gyis dbus bla ma yab sras rnams la mdzod btags re dngaka dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal dar snas brgyan pa re/ sku rten dang gsu nga rten/ thugs rten bcas cha tshang re/ sku'i nyer spyad skor/na bza' cha tshang gos yug gi gtsos pa'i tshan grangs/ dngul/ ja/ 'bru 93

dkar sogs go rim ltar phul thog yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po gling smad slob dpon rab 'byams smra ba blo bzang lha dbang nas lung rig rnam par dag pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi bshad pa mkhas pa yig 'phrog par zhus par zhal bzhes bka' lan bla na med pa spyi bor bstsal ba dang / 'dus mang du mang ja sbyor sbrel lnga yi thog sku 'gyed dge 'dun rer ja sbag re/ spyi 'jog tu sku zhabs grwa tshang dang / rgyud sde brgyad bcas so sor dngul rdo tshad re bcas phul bar 'phags chen yab sras nas gong gsal mang gnyer zur pa gsum so sor mgul dar dang gsung mdud thugs smon bstsal/'di skabs tsam la ri bo che bla brang khag gnyis thugs snang ma gshin pas lha ldan du byon tshul gsan pas thugs bskyed bzang pos sar 'dum yong phyir byams tsha rnam sras dbang rgyal ngo g.yog bka' shog dang bcas dbus phyogs su ched gtong bskyangs/ pe cin du gong mar mtshams zhu 'bul mi mgron phun tshogs rus gcod pa dpon g.yog rnams la dkar spro dang bka' slob gnang skyes bstsal/ lha ldan nas li'u am ban pe cin du phyir log skabs mjal phyag tu bcar bar ston mo dang gsung mchid zhib tu mdzad pa dang /de rjes kyang li'u am ban thengs 'ga' shas bcar bar dkar spro rgyas pa dang /zhal thang / 'phags chen gang gi phyag phreng / dam rdzas byin rlabs/gcan lpags sna tshogs bcas kyi gnang cha bstsal bar sku am ban nas dad gus chen pos dngos 'gul rgya che btegs thog gnang cha'i pags rigs rnams kyang phyir phul zhing / ‘‘slad pe cin du bka' shog rgyun par gnang skyong dang / thugs bzhed kyi dngos po 'bul 'os sogs nges 'bul zhus chog pa dang rnam pa kun tu thugs rjes gzigs pa mkhyen mkhyen’’zhes zhus/hor zla 7tshes 22nyin 'phags chen mchog dang / yong 'dzin zhi sprul/94

rje dbon sprul sku/ rgya ra sprul sku/ phyag mdzod chen mo sogs las 'dzin pa rnams dang bcas pa gu ru thang dkar nor rgyas klu sding du dbyar mthong spro gseng du byon zhing / bzhes spro dang gsol chas kyi skor rnams bla brang gnyer tshang nas nyin brgyad dang / zhi sprul phyag gnyer phun tshogs skal bzang nas nyin bzhi/ rje dbon sprul sku dang rgya ra sprul sku nas nyin gnyis re bcas kyi bsnyen bkur zhus shing / spro gseng ring yang nyin re'i zhal 'don gsung chog khag snga dro chag med bskyangs pa dang / tsha rting skabs bsangs gsol gang rgyas/ nyin dgung gsol tshigs grub rjes lugs gnyis kyi rol rtsed sna tshogs par gzigs zhib/ skabs re sman chab kyi 'phrod bzhes sogs ske bskyangs/ hor zla rdotshes 10nyin bde mchog dang rnal 'byor ma'i dbang chog bstsal nas 'phags chen mchog lhun rtse ri khrod du phebs/ de min zhi sprul mchog dang phyag mdzod chen mo sogs chab dgon du byon/ 'phags chen mchog nas lhun rtse ri khrod kyi bla brang gzim chung dbu rtser 'dzugs rgyu'i gser zangs kyi gan ji ra dang / rgyal mtshan cha/ rten thug bcas la gzungs 'jug dang bla rdo srog 'khor dril sgrub 'bul gsum gyi phyag len legs par bskyangs nas tshes 15nyin gnas bdag jo bo chos 'phel zhes pa'i ri rtser nyi 'od 'phro ba'i dus dge bar bstun te dben gnas lhun grub yang rtse'i bla brang gzim chung byang chub dga' tshal gyi yang steng du bde gshegs rgyal ba rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan gyi mtshan ma bkra ba'i gan dzi ra dang / mi mthun phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan cha/ ma gcig 'dod khams dbang phyug ma rnam gnyis kyi rten thug bcas legs par 'dzugs pa gnang thog 'phags chen mchog dbu spuzhugs kyis grwa tshang rtsogi gsung chog pa bcu phrag bcas nas 95

rab gnas bkra shis snye ma'i gsung chog sbyor dngos rjes tshang bskyangs/tshes 19nyin 'phags chen mchog dben ri nas chibs bskyod kyis thang dkar nor rgyas klu sding du gsol tsha dang de nas chab dgon bla brang du phebs/hor zla 9tshes 1nyin nas bzung yongs 'dzin 'i/ sprul gyi drung nas sgrub thabs brgya rtsa sogs kyi bka' dbang gsan 'go tshugs/ de sngon dbon mgron bsod nams nor bu nas rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che gsar bzhengs byed 'go btsugs kyang mi ring bar khong rang 'das grongs su gyur pas 'phro lus yod pa de dag phyag mdzod chen mo nas 'gan bzhes/ kyis bris dpon byams tsha rnam sras dbang rgyal bzhag nas las 'phro bskyangs pa/'di skabs legs grub byung bas phyag mdzod chen mos gsol ba btab don bzhin 'phags chen mchog dang / 'i/ sprul/ rje dbon sprul sku/ grwa tshang gi 'dus mang bcas gdam/ 'dzoms kyis rab gnas 〈bkra shis snye ma〉dang zhi rgyas kyi sreg blugs bcas zhib rgyas bskyangs/ —tshes 22nyin brag g.yab mchog sprul rin po che blo bzang dpal ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan chab mdor phebs par chos khri thang du bla brang gzhung rkyang nas thab bsu zhus pa'i sar zhi sprul rin po che dang / rje dbon sprul sku/grwa tshang gi slob dpon khag bla brang sogs spyi sger gyi las sne khag bcas nas phebs bsur bcar/ bla brang gi gzim chung nyi 'od 'khyil bar 'phags chen mchog dang mjal 'dzoms kyis mjal dar 'bul bzhes thog dkar spro dang gsung mol zhib lhugs mdzad rjes brag g.yab mchog sprul bzhugs yul zhi sprul gyi gzim shag tu phebs bzhugs mdzad/ de skabs brag g.yab mchog sprul nas 'phags chen mchog dang gsol ba btab pa bzhin paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyis mdzad pa'i mgon po zhal gyi mchod chog las rim 96

tshogs mchod gser skyems dang bcas pa'i ljags lung gnang / chab mdo grwa gling slob dpon dbu chos sogs nas gsol ba btab don bzhin brag g.yab mchog sprul rin po che 'dus mang la〈lam rim bsdus don〉dang lam gtso'i ljags lung gnang / hor zla 1rkyatshes 2nyin 'phags chen mchog nas brag g.yab sprul skur dkar spro rgyas pa dang / rgya dngul srang bcu las grub pa'i maṇ+ḍal dar tshan gyis brgyan pa/ sku gsung thugs rten/ dngul rdo tshad/ jus dmar gyis gtsos pa'i dgu tshan/ gos sku sha mas gtsos pa'i dgu tshan/ gos rdor gsang dmar pos gtsos pa'i dgu tshan/ dbu paṇa rna ring spus legs/gos sku sha ma ser po'i sku ber rgyan ldan/ 'go rnam ljang khra'i chibs phebs la tung skud kyi dzar lo can nang ldan/ rgun 'brum ltang / 'bras dkar ltang /chibs rta chibs rol shed bzang na gzhon gnyis bcas 'bul gnang mdzad pa dang / de 'brel bla mchan dang / phyag mdzod/ gsol mgron sogs la'ang 'os mtshungs kyi gnang cha bstsal/ de nas 'phags chen rin po che nas bskul ma myo/dzad don ltar brag g.yab mchog sprul rin po che dbu bzhugs kyis chab dgon gyi gsung bzang ba bcu skor bcas nas byams khang yid dga' chos 'dzin du bzhugs pa'i rten gsum gyis gtsos rten dang brten pa bcas la rab sa/nas〈bkra shis snye ma'i〉gsung mchog sbyor dngos mjug gsum tshang ba legs par mdzad/ gong zla 1rkyanang chos rje ngag dbang mchog sprul rin po che 'dan chos 'khor nas hor dpon khag gnyis kyis gdan 'dren byung tshul sogs kyi bka' yig 'byor bar bka' lan bstsal/ de sngon rgya nag tu mtshams zhur song ba'i r+ṣa/gron phun tshogs nas lam bgrod bde zhing / gong ma'i mjal kha 97
