sogs legs lam byung tshul gyi zhu yig phul 'byor byung / de skabs yongs 'dzin zhi sprul gyi drung nas g.yu thog snying thig gi dbang lung sogs gsan pa dang / de rjes bde mchog dang 'jigs byed kyi sngags bsdus rjes gnang /rgyal mchog lnga pa chen pos mdzad pa'i bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi sgrub thabs dbang mchog skor gyi bka' dbang dang ljags lung / rgyud bzhi'i sman gzhung gi ljags lung / zhi sprul rin po che nyid nas mdzad pa'i rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi srung 'khor sogs rim bzhin gsan rjes yongs 'dzin zhi sprul rin po cher sku yon rten 'brel mtshon byed mjal dar nang mdzod dang /dngul dkar gyi maṇ+ḍal/ sku 'gag spus legs sogs 'bul gnang mdzad/tshes 14nas tshes sgrub kyi bsnyen mtshams bzhugs te zla 12tshes 7nyin sku mtshams grol nas gnyer che chung sogs la mjal kha gnang / tshes 12nyin nas dud sol ma dang dmag zor ma'i thugs dam dgyes bskang gi tshogs dbur phebs pa dang gsung tshogs grol rjes bka' rtsom 'di 'dra zhig mdzad pa ste ‘‘mi mthun rgud ma lus drung 'byin pa'i/ rta ljang dbang po'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin ma'i khyon/ gsal dang lhan cig srid gsum dbang byed ma'i/zhal dkyil mthong ba'i ngo mtshar brjod par dka'’’zhes phyag sor gyi 'du byed mdzad/sa sprel gnam lo gsar tshes kyi mdzad chen khag sngar lam gzab rgyas bskyangs/ gnas bcu'i zhal thang gi dpe gang legs shig lho 'dzi tho dgon dang / dpal spungs bla brang / ri bo che dgon/ dpa' shod dgon/'dan chos 'khor bcas nas g.yar po mdzad bzhes kyis ljags bkod dang 'brel lta bris mkhas pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal nas tshes 14gza' skar bzang nyin las 'go btsugs/ tshes 15cho 'phrul chen mo'i srod 'khor gtor chen 98

mchod par gzigs zhib dang / gsung mchog gzab rgyas bskyangs/ grwa tshang gi dge gnyer dang / dngul gnyer/ tshogs chen gyi mang gnyer/ tshe 'bar gnyer pa/ ser gnyer ba/ byang khang gnyer pa sogs gsar bsko mdzad/ lha ldan nas bka' zur skal bzang bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal gshegs pa'i skyabs zhu 'byor bar byang chog bsngo smon mdzad/ zla 2nang a khu bskal ldan rgya mtsho sku khams ma bde bar sku rim zhu sgo'i thebs dngul rdo tshad gcig dang / sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung sogs byin rten rtsa chen gnang yang khams ma mtsho bas gzim dpon don yod bstan 'dzin 'gyur med sogs la a khu'i 'das 'jug dge sgrub byed sgo'i skor bka' phebs ltar dge rtsa gang rgyas gnad smin bskyangs/ yongs 'dzin zhi sprul mchog dang / rje dbon sprul sku/ rgya ra sprul sku sogs dang mgyogs bsngo dang / lha khang mtha' dag la mchod 'bul gang gzab bskyangs/ tshes 12nyin smon lam dus bzang gi gral dbur byon nas gsung chos ljags bsngo sogs dang / tshes 14nyin gos sku zhal phye/ tshes 15nyin byams pa skor lam du gdan 'dren sogs phyag srol nyams med bskyangs/chos skyong gi lung ltar spyi chen mgon khang chen mor dud gsol lha mo'i sman sku gsar bzhengs mdzad rgyu'i srog 'khor 'bri sgrub dang gzungs zhugs sogs kyi phyag len gnang 'go tshugs/ lha bris 'phags pa sogs nas gnas bcu'i zhal thang gi tshon gtong 'go tshugs par ston mo gzab rgyas gnang / phyag mdzod chen mos mkha' 'gro'i sun bzlog gi brtan bzhugs zhabs brtan gyi dngos 'bul mdzod btags rtser son dang / dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal/ sku gsung thugs rten/ na bza'— cha tshang / sku'i nyer spyad/gser srang lnga/ dngul dkar bre chen/ bzang gos yug chen btegs 99

'bul zhus pa dgyes bzhes mdzad/ jo bo rje dpa' ldan a ti sha'i sku brnyan thugs dam nang rten du bzhugs rgyu zhig phyag bzo gnang 'go btsugs/sa zla'i yar ngor sku zhabs rnam grol grwa tshang tshogs yongs nas 'jigs byed lha gsum gyi rdul tshon dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i dbang mchog gyer dbyangs kyi phyag len mtha' dag khri chen rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang mchog ldan gyi ljags bkod dpal ldan smad rgyud grwa tshang nas ji ltar mdzad pa dang dbyer med pa'i dbang mchog nyin bdun phrag lhag bzhes pa'i phyag rgyun yod pa bzhin 'phags chen mchog de'i tshogs dbur byon te bdag 'jug sogs mnyam bzhes mdzad/ kun gsal gyi dpal mo gos dang bral ba'i rang mdog rjen par bstan par 'phags chen mchog nas tsha zer gyi gdung ba mi bzod pa'i sems can nyam thag rnams la thugs brtse ba'i snying rje chen pos char 'bod ched a 'phrag chu mig tu chibs bsgyur bskyangs te bzhugs zhag bcu skor tsam bzhugs nas char phebs kyi cho ga gang gzab mdzad pa dang /de nas bka' srung dge bsnyen byang chub grags pa gnas yul gyi sa 'dzin rtse mor phebs te rgyags brngan gser skyems dang 'brel bum gter sba 'jugabaka' bsgo gnyer gtad thugs smon sogs mdzad/ de'i nub mo nas bzung chu 'dzin bstugs por 'khrigs shing char kyi rgyun tshugs te zhing pa dang /'bu srin tsha gdung gis mnar ma rnams dbugs dbyung bar mdzad ces grags/ de nas thang dkar nor rgyas sding du sman chab 'phrod bzhes gnang rjes chab mdo bla brang du zhabs sor bkod/ dus mtshams 'di skabs tsam la lha ldan nas bstan rgyas gling gi lde chu shar tsha bu 'phags pa bstan 'dzin nas gor bodatsho'akhrugs slong byed tshul gyi zhu yig phul 'byor byung ba dang / chab mdor yod pa'i tsang yes dmag mi 100

bcas lha ldan phyogs su 'gro dgos skor pe cin nas dral tse 'byor skad/lo der phyag mdzod chen mos rgyu tshogs yo byad mtha' dag sbyar te bka' 'gyur mthing shog bzang po la rin chen gser bzhun dang / rdo bcud brtul ba las gsar bris mdzad 'go tshugs yod pa dang / skabs der btsa' ri rong chen gyi gnas skor nas yong ba'i mi zhig la rdo rje tsher ma'i rims nad('brum nad)byung ba las mched pa'i nyer 'tshe byung bar brten zla shas ring bka' 'gyur 'bri rgyu bshol dgos byung yang / 'di skabs phyag mdzod chen mos phags chen mchog la bka' 'gyur bris grwa mu mthud tshugs tshe lam stong 'gal rkyen ji yong skor thugs dam zhus par gegs med legs tshul bka' phebs bzhin lam 'gro yang dag pa byung yod skad/ yang 'di skabs rgya nag nas mgrom/ phun tshogs phyir 'khor gyis gong ma'i bka' yig dang gnang cha bcas khyer 'ongs yod pas mgron pad+ma sogs bkra shis sgang du bsu mar gtong gnang mdzad thog gzim chung 'chi med dga' tshul nang 'phags chen mchog nas gong ma'i bka' yig dang gnang cha rnams bdag gis bzhes shing / mgron phun tshogs ngo g.yog dang rgya dpon sogs nas mjal phyag zhus par bka' spro dang legs dar gnang cha rgya che bstsal/zla 5tshes 15nyin nas tshe sgrub kyi ljags bsnyen zhag bdun phrag gsum bzhugs/ bal po'i steng du gong ma'i sku tshab thing tu dang rgya dmas/ lnga brgya skor 'gro dgos kyi dral tse 'byor bas sa tshigs 'ul lag sogs bskul gtong byed phyogs skor phyag mdzod chen mos 'phags chen mchog 'char gzhi phul bar bka' lan zhib cha bstsal/ tshes 20nyin nyi khrod nas nor rgyas sding du gsol tshwa dang bcas chab mdor phebs/ rgya dpon thing tu dang / krang nā lo'o yes sogs rgya dpon rim 'byor dang / rgyal rong dmag mi sogs 101

mjal phyag bcar bar dkar spro dang / gnang cha go bab bzhin bstsal/gzhung sa'i bstan srid kyi zhabs rim du drug cu lcags mkhar gyi gtor bzlog nyin bdun gnad smin 'tshogs par nyin ltar 'phags chen mchog tshogs dbur phebs nas thugs smon gnad smin bskyangs/mu ta shin/ ti ta shin/ rgyal rong pa'i dmag dpon sogs mjal khar byung bar dkar spro sogs yid 'phrod bka' drin bskyangs/ a skyo rab 'byams pa blo bzang smon lam lcags rwa'i mkhan po dang / spru thog dbu chung lcags rwa'i mdzod par thon dgos kyi bka' khyab gnang / rgya dpon khyi da lo ye/ man ju'i dpon/ rgyal rong dpon sogs mjal khar byung bar yid 'phrod kyi dkar spro sogs bstsal/zla 10tshes 21nyin nas sku mtshams bzhugs sa'i ljags bsnyen mdzad/'di zla'i tshes 21la 'phags pa lha sku phreng lnga pa 'phags pa rgyal ba rgya mtsho zhing gzhan du gshegs pa'i dus chen dang / tshes 22la drung byang sems bdag nyid chen po shes rab bzang po gzhan don du gshegs pa'i tshul bstan pa'i dus chen dang / tshes 25la rje bla ma tsong kha ba chen po sku mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan pa'i dus chen ste nyer gcig nyer gsum nyer lnga de dag gi nyin rten gsum mtha' dag la mchod pa gang mang snyan shal sogs 'bul ba dang srod 'khor du gling me'i mchod rol dgos tshul bka' phebs shing gsung mchog gzab rgyas gnang / 'di skor tsha ba snyed nas sprul sku lder bzod mkhas dbang rab brtan dang / a 'phel gnyis 'byor bar 'phags chen nyid kyi thugs dam nang rten gral bzhugs rgyu'i paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs chen po rje btsun blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes kyi sku rten dang /dam can chos kyi rgyal po'i sku brnyan gsar bzhengs dgos pa'i bka' phebs/102

zla 11tshes 11nyin sku mtshams las bzhengs/ phyag mdzod chen po nas rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che legs par grub par rab gnas kyi cho ga zhabs bskul zhus don bzhin/ tshes 12—14nyin snga phyir 'phags pa lha mchog dang / dpon slob zhi sprul sku zhabs/ chos rje ngag dbang mchog gi sprul sku /rje dbon bla ma'i mchog sprul/ rgya ra sprul pa'i sku bcas kyis gtso mdzad sku zhabs rnam grol grwa tshang mkhas mang rig 'dzin 'dus sde chen po nas rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga〈bkra shis snye ma〉rnam par dag pa nyams bzhes dang phyag nas kyi me tog 'thor/ phyag mdzod che mo nyid yon bdag tu bsko ba'i thog rten gsum ji byung lo rgyus ji ltar bzhengs pa'i tshul/ de ltar bzhengs pa'i phan yon dang mchod pa phul ba phyag skor sogs kyi bsnyen bkur ba'i bsod rnams tshad med pa thob tshul gsung bshad zhib pa bka' drin bskyangs/ phyag mdzod che mo nas sku zhabs rnam grol grwa tshang 'dus mang gi mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i rnal 'byor nyams bzhes mdzad pa'i gral dbur chos kyi khri 'phang mthon por bshams pa la 'phags pa lha mchog dang yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis/rje blon bla ma dang / rgya ra sprul sku bcas gdan drangs/ 'phags chen la dngul dkar gyi maṇ+ḍal che ba tshom bu dang dar sna spras pa dang sku rten mgon po tshe dpag med kyi gser sku/ gsung rten gong du phyag gnas mdzad rgyu'i rgyal bka' rin po che gser dngul bkra chen gyis bzhengs pa dbu gdongs kyi zhal phebs hor gos rnying ma khyad thon can/ pod so sor dbu dbu mchan la 'brel mtshungs kyi dbu lha zangs gser gyi tshig rgyan g.yu phra can/ glegs shing mtshal gzhi ma grang gser gyi ri mo can mdun ngos kyi gdong yas mas la gser zangs kyi ji spar yod pa/ chos thag bu zhabs mtshungs par stong skud dmar po slas ma can/ chos chab zangs gser gyi rdo rje'i ri mo can pod gra 103

mtshungs brgya dang bcu/ pod rer rgyu tshogs dngul srang brgya lhag song nges rnams dang / thugs rten bka' gdams mchod sdong li ma na bza' can/dngul dkar las grub pa'i nyer chas cha tshang / dbu paṇa rna ring sogs na bza' bzhes pher cha 'grig mdzod gos kyi snyel 'bol dang / bzhugs gdan/ rin chen dang po srang bco lnga / dngul bre chen bcu skor/ bzang gos yug res gtsos pa'i dgu tshan bzang nges dgu/ bzang ja 'khor drug/ shan gzhungs 'khor drug mar ltang / trī 'bru dkar ltang /khrab rmog dkar ras yug ring so gas dang / yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis so sor maṇ+ḍal sku gsung thugs rten sogs dngos 'bul rgya che bstar ba bcas dang / rje dbon bla ma sprul sku nas maṇ+ḍal gyi gsung bshad zhus pa'i gsol ba btab bar 'phags chen nyid nas zhabs pad bskasnyer brgyar brtan pa'i zhal bzhes bla na med pa dgyes bzhin spyi bor bstsal / de nas phyag mdzod chen mos rgya sprul grwa slob bcas la dngos 'bul dang / grwa tshang 'dus sde drung 'awo/ ra bcas la bsod btags re dang ja bag gnyis sogs kyi bsnyen bkur/de nas 'phags chen lha yab sras sogs nas phyag mdzod che mo blo bzang rdo rjer legs skyes/ kyi dngos po rgya cher bstsal zhing / ba/zhan yang grwa gling nang sogs las sne che phra rnams nas legs 'bul zhus/ gsungastarab kyi bris dpon rab 'byams pa byams tsha rnam sras dbang rgyal sogs la'ang gong 'khod thams cad nas mgul dar bstsal/ tshes 17nyin rgya nag nas byon pa'i dza sag tā bla ma bla brang du mjal phyag byung ba nyi 'od ngo mtshar 'khyi'/ bar 'phags chen ya ba sras rnamaṭa5 zhal 'dzoms par mjal phyag zhus pa'i thog dkar spro bzang po dang bka' mchid bstsal/ 'di nyin nas sku mtshams bsdams pas zla ba gcig ring ljags bsnyen bskyangs/ phyag mdzod che mor ma gcig dud gsol 104

lha mo'i chibs sga khyad thon gsar skrun dgos tshul bka' bstsal ba ltar phyag mdzod che mo nas rnam sras dbang rgyal las dpon du bskos pas bzo grwa bsdus/nyer drug snga dror gnyer zur pa rnal 'byor gnas po tshe ring 'phel/ blo bzang nyi ma/ 'phags pa dbang phyug bcas nas grwa gnyer gyi gtong sgo rtsis sprod legs par grub pa'i dngos rdzas 'phros lhag gang yod kyis sku zhabs rnam grol grwa tshang tshogs yongs gnas bcu phyag mchod gsungs pa'i gral dbur 'a phags chen yab sras gdan drangs par mdzod btags dang / dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal tshom bu dar tshon gyis spras pa sku gsung thugs rten dang / sku'i nyer spyad la sogs dngos 'bul dang mchog sprul rnam gnyis dang chos skyong sogs la 'os mtshungs kyi dngos 'bul/ tshogs sar sku 'gyed rgyas pa bcas dang /bod khams chos bzhin du skyong ba'i ma gcig bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi 'cham gos gos bcad ldan spus gtsang las bzos pa nang ldan stod phebs bcas khyed 'phags dang / dgu chen skabs grwa tshang du phogs 'phar nas chab zho gnyis re bcas phul bar 'phags chen gtsos bla dpon so sos legs dar gnang skyes rgya che ba bka' drin bskyengs/sa bya lo'i sa/nam lo gsar pa'i tshes gcig nyin ma gcig re ma ti 'khor dang bcas pa mnyes pa'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mthun rdzas ma tshang ba med pa tshar du dngar te 'phages pa lha mchog gis gtso mdzad sku zhabs grwa tshang gi gsung bzang bgres grwa bcu skoratshobacas nas tho rangs dpal ldan lha mo rnam gnyis thugs dam dgyes par r+shabaskangs pa'i tshes gtor rten rdzas ma tshang ba med pa dang dpal ldan dmag zor ma'i chibs dre'u'i sga cha cha tshang yod thog 'di lo dpal ldan dudagasol lha mo'i chibs bong gwa dam/ra thod sga cha tshang khyad mtshar gsar bzo ljags bkod mjod pa sogs rten 'bur rgyas pa mnga' 105

gsol shis brjod bcas phyag len bstar/ sku mdun du mgon chos dang /lha mo rnam gnyis/ de mo dkor bdag bcas kyi bskangs ba sogs gzab rgyas nyin lnga'i bar gnang ba'i gsung ram pa dag la sku 'gyed rgyas pa bstsal/rgya dpon tsang yes phog dpon sogs la lo gsar ston mo gnang / rgya dpon phyir byon rim 'byor nas mjal phyag zhus par bzhes spro gnang cha bka' phebs sogs kyis yid tshim par mdzad/ dus bzang che mo'i gos sku zhal phye skabs chos khri khang du phyag phebs mchod 'bul chos spyod bka' chos ljags bsngo gang rgyas bka' drin bskyangs/ bco lnga'i gser sbrengs skabs dka' bcu byams pa blo gros la gnyer gtad 'phrin bcol bsngo smon byed dgos bka' phebs pa ltar bsgrubs/ — sgrol dkar tshe sbyin yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs gsar du ljags rtsom mdzad/ gling stod grwa tshang gi 'dod bstun nub gling slob zur ngag dbang blo bzang gling stod slob dpon du bskos bla phog dang bka' slob zhib don bstsal/ zla 2tshes 1nyin lha mo gnyis kyi gsol ka dang / bstan gsol sngar rgyun ltar dang / dpon lha lhun grub be ri rdzong stod bskos stsal la bka' slob zhib rgyas gnang / hor zla 4tshes 12nyin dus gtor dang / char 'beb kyi gsung mchog bskyangs/ lha ldan du rgyal ba'e dbang po mchog dang / rgyal tshab mchog sprul sogs bla dpon dang mi dpon rnam par zhu rgya phyag rten bcas 'bul mi ched gtong bskyangs/ pā ta shin mgyogs myur 'byor nyer yod pas 'phags pa lha mchog zhag shas klu sding du bzhugs nas mi ring bar pā ta shin 'byorabar mjal 'phrad thog gnang cha yid tshim bstsal/phugs pa rab dga' lha ldan du mtshams zhur gtong gnang mdzad pa phyir 'byor dang / bkras lhun sba yer mkhan po spo bo sman lung sprul sku dang /106

tsha ba rdzong sdod grags pa ngo g.yog tsha ba tshong dpon sogs mjal phyag tu bcar bar dkor spro gsung mchid dang gnang cha sna tshogs bstsal/ hor zla 5tshes 17nyin nas rta mgrin gyi ljags bsnyen dbu tshugs pa'i sku mtshams bsdam/ cang jun mjal 'phrad la mgron pad+ma btang bar thugs dgyes pa byung song zhus/ bod bzhugs shu am ban dang mu am ban lhan rgyas gdong gong ma chen por chab mdo bla brang nas sba yer 'bul chog pa'i zhu yig phul/mgron pad+ma nas gsol tshigs sogs kyi bsnyen bkur gangs rgyas zhus/ chab mdo nas grwa tshang spyi pa'i dge bskul bcas kyi las sne 'ga' re'i 'os tho 'byor bar ang dang po rnams la phyag dam bstsal ba dang / grwa tshang du gsar zhugs rnams la bla ma rnam gnyis gang bde nas dge tshul gnang dgos lugs dang /yong sdud dpon so sor mi ser la byams skyong gang che dgos tshul gyi bka' phebs/ grwa tshang dngul gnyer gzim dpon blo bzang don yod dang / sprul zla 'phags pa bkra shis/ shing kha pad+ma'i tsha bo 'phags pa 'od zer bcas nas 'phags chen mchog grwa tshang 'du khang du spyan drangs te dngul srang brgya thams pa dang bzang dgos yug chen gyis gtsos tshan grangs kha shas sogs kyi dngos 'bul rgya cher btegs pa dang 'dus tshogs su deb gsal dngul rtsa skyed 'grigs thog dge 'dun rer sku 'gyed ja sbag re dang / lo ltar sa zla'i gtong thebs dngul srang brgya thams pa sbyor 'jags/ yongs 'dzin bla ma gnyis dang / rje dbon sprul sku/ phyag mdzod chen mo/ chos skyong bcas la'ang dngos 'bul bstar bar gong gsal 'bul yul so so nas kyang dngul gnyer gzim dpon blo don dang / shing kha pad+ma'i tsha bo sogs la dgyes pa'i bka' mchid dang / mgul dar bzang ba re bstsal/ hor zla 12tshes 2༈na bsangs mchod sogs nyams med sngar 'khyud ltar phyag len 107

mdzad phyi dro nas sku mtshams bsdams pa'i bsnyen pa tshugs/ skyo mda'i mdos chen la snyan shal sogs sngar srol gyi gnang rgyun gang yod bstsal/ nyi ldog gi lcags mkhar 'tshogs par ling ga bkugs gre/zhugs sogs sngar srol ltar mdzad/ tshes lngar sku mtshams nas bzhengs bla brang gi las sne rnams la phyag dbang gnang / tshes ṭ+wāṃ—9la tshangs pa'i ging chen sku lnga dgyes mchod kyi gar 'chams sogs la gzigs mor phebs/ tshes 1rkyal dbang mchog sngar rgyun ltar bzhes/ spyogs gdongs sprul pa'i sku dang dpon bdud 'dul sogs nas rin po che sa le shām dang rta nor sogs kyi phyag rten bzang mang dang bcas te mjal phyag zhus par ston mo rgyas pa'i thog bka' mchid zhib lhugs bskyangs/dgung grangs so drug bzhes pa lcags khyi la/ nam lo gsar du tshes par lha mo rnam gnyis la bskangs 'phrin/ tshes gtor/ rten 'bul/ mnga' gsol sogs gang rgyas dang / dgung gsar gyi rten 'brel mdzad sgo'i thog mjal dar 'bul bzhes sogs sngar srol gzab rgyas bskyangs/ rgya tsang yes phogs dpon sogs la lo gsar skal ba sngar lam ltar bstsal/ mjal phyag pa du ma'i re 'dod smin par mdzad/ tshes 5snga dror skyogs gdong sprul sku 'phags pa bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dang / gzhu mkhan sprul sku sogs thar 'dod skal ldan du mar dge chul dang dge slong giri bslab sdom bstsal/ lha ldan nas ba so rje drung rim/ po ches phyas/ bris dang / sku thang gsar bzhengs rnams kyi tshon du bsre rgyu'i dam rdzas sogs gan nga 'byor la bka' lan 'phral 'bul gnang / sde dge sras dbus phyogs gnas mjal phebs te phyir byon par bka' yig dang bcas ko cho sde pa bso da nams mgon po ched gtong gnang ba phyir log mjal bcar la bka' mchid bstsal/ grwa gnyer dang 108

byams gnyer/ lhun rtse ri khrod kyi khang gnyer bcas bsko bzhag gnang /rgya 'cham par gsol ras mdzad/ thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang chen bka' drin bskyang rgyu'i phyag dpe gzigs rtogs gnang / sku zhabs grwa tshang dang 'dus spyi nas gsol btab bzhin 'phags chen mchog nas bla sprul der yod rnams dang / grwa gling gi slob dpon khri pa dang gdan zur/ ar skya ho thog thu'i phyag mdzod/ 'dus sde sogs nyis stong la nye ba'i skal ldan rnams la nyin snga mar sta gon dang bcas 'phags pa 'jigs rten dbang phyug rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang chen dngos gzhi cha tshang bka' drin ba stsal bar chos rje sprul pa'i sku nas nang mdzod dngul dkar gyi maṇ+ḍal dar tshon sna lnga'i 'dogs can/ bzang gos yug chen/ rje dbon sprul pa'i sku nas mdzod btags dang dngul dkar gyi maṇ+ḍal/ dngos tshan/ rgya sprul phyag mdzod sogs nas gong mtshungs/ slob dpon rnams nas mdzod btags re dang gos kha/ ja 'khor gsum re sku zhabs grwa tshang bla ma 'dus spyi nas nang mdzod rtser son dang dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal tshom bu dar tshon gyi spras pa/ dngul rdo tshad gsum/bzang gos yug gi gtsos pa'i dgu tshan/ ja 'khor drug nyi shu/ nas khal 1༷0sogs gang 'byor gyi dngos 'bul btegs/ ri khrod lhun rtse'i gzhis gnyer a nu bu dgongs 'phrol gyi tshab ras mda' lhun grub bskos par sprod dpang du gzims dpon blo bzang don yod ched gtong gnang / grwa slob dka' bcu grags pa rgya mtsho dgongs 'phrol mdzad pa'i tshab lcang ra slob zur dbag sho rab 'byams pa blo bzang rgyal mtshan gsar bsko mdzad/zla 2tshes 1nyin byams khang yid dga' chos 'dzin gyi dkon gnyer sku gsar bar rtsis sprod pa mgron pad+ma ched gtong mdzad/ tshes 2nyin dus gtor sngar lam ltar dang / gnas thang drung pa dang / gte ljings bla ma 109

gsar bsko mdzad/ chab mdo'i tsang yes krong ṭ+wā rin dang / ho tsang yes gnyis mjal phyag tu byung bar dkar spro dang / sku 'dra sogs gnang ster bstsal bas yid tshim gyur/ bod bzhugs am ban lhan rgyas brgyud gong ma chen por sba yer 'bul chog pa'i bka' shog 'byor ba bzhin thog ti bla ma ngag dbang dar rgyas dang / gu ru a chog gnyis pe cin du 'gro dgos pa'i brda sbyar/ ser gnyer zur pa blo bzang dar rgyas dang / blo ldan nyi ma gnyis kyi gtong sgo dang rtsis sprod 'grub 'phros kyis dge 'dun mang ma dbyar gnas khang du 'tshogs pa'i gral dbur 'phags chen yab sras rin po che lhan rgyas spyan drangs/ gnas bcu phyag mchod dang 'brel pa'i zhabs rten gyi dngos 'bul btegs shing dngul dkar gyi maṇ+ḍal tshom bu dar snas brgyan pa/ sku gsung thugs rten/ na bza' cha tshang / sku yi nyer spyad skor/ dngul rdo tshad gnyis/ bzang gos yug gis gtsos pa'i dgu tshan/ ja 'khor drug bcu gsum/ dkar ras yug bcas dang / yongs 'dzin bla ma rnam gnyis sogs la 'os mtshungs kyi dngos 'bul dang bca sa te yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen slob dpon rab 'byams pa blo bzang lha dbang nas maṇ+ḍal gyi gsol 'debs yang dag pa zhus par 'phags chen rin po che nas zhal gyis bzhes/ de nas rten gsum gyi spyan sngar brgya mchod dang 'dus sder mang ja gsum/ sku 'gyed dge 'dun rer ja bag re/ spyi 'jog bzang gos phra spel gyi ka paṇa spus legs cha bcas phul bar 'phags chen mchog nas gong gsal ser gnyer zur pa gnyis la legs skyes mgul dar bstsal/tshes 12phyi dro smon lam chen mo'i tshogs dbur 'phags chen yab sras zhabs sor 'khod de zhal 'don gsung chog dang / 'dus sder bka' chos sogs sngar 'khyud phyag len bzang po nyams med bskyangs/ phyi nyin gos sku 110

zhal phye bar mchod pa snyan shal gang bzang mdzad de chos khri khang du phebadī/chos spyod gsung chog bka' chos bsngo smon zhib rgyas bskyangs/ tshes 15nyin mchod pa'i bye brag sna tshog sa pas mdun bsus te rgyal ba ma pham mgon po'i sku brnyan rin po che mthong grol chen mo shing rta'i 'phrul gyis bskor lam chen mor gdan drangs pa'i ser sbrengs chen mo'i dbu 'dzin du 'phags chen yab sras rin po che rnams phebs gzhung sa'i mkhan nang dang / de'i sne shan sbyar sgo che sogs la mjal kha bka' mchid bzhes spro rgyas pa bstsal/ byams khang yid dga' chos 'dzin gyi mchod gnyer ngag dbang bstan 'dzin dang /'jigs med dpal ldan/ a bkra bcas kyis mchod pa dang rtsis sprod legs grub byung ba'i 'phros nas byams chen gyi spyan sngar sku zhabs grwa tshang gi 'dus mang tshogs pa'i dbur 'phags chen yab sras gdan drangs te maṇ+ḍal sku gsungs thugs rten dang / gos yug dgu tshan/ dngul srang brgya/mdzod btags dang bcas pa'i dngos 'bul btegs pa dang / sku brnyan rnams la snyan shal/ steng mchod 'bar rgyun 'dzugs kyi sbyor 'jags/'dus sder mang ja sku 'gyed bcas kyi bsnyen bkur zhus par 'phags chen mchog nas legs par bstsal/sku zhabs rnam grol grwa tshang nas grwa rgyun pa bco brgyad dang / gsang 'dus pa dang yi dam pa so so nas brgyad re/ bde mchog pa dang 'khor chen pa/ lcang ra pa/ kye kye rdo rje pa/ kun rig pa/ dus 'khor ba bcas kyi grwa tshang so so nas drug re bcas dbus su grwa sar phebs dgos pa'i bka' khyab bstsal/ gong mar 'bul rgyu'i tshe dpag med kyi sku brnyan la gzungs 'jug bri bsgrub 'bul gsum dang rab gnas bcas kyi phyag len zhib rgyas mdzad/zla 2tshes 1nyin bkras lhun gyi sba yer mkhan po dang / jar go cher 111

gsol ston dang / chab bla'i sba yer mkhan po 'gro mkhan la gnang cha/bka' slob bstsal// tshes 5nyin sba yer mkhan po thon par rgyags brngan lha bsangs gang rgyas mdzad pa dang ser byes dge bshes lha rgyal sprul sku nas gsol btab bzhin dge bsnyen nas dge tshul bar gyi bslab sdom dang mtshan‘‘'phags pa bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan’smozhes bstsal ba dang / gser zangs kyi thub pa'i sku brnyan byon gtsang zhig dang / srab ther ngur ba'i chos gos shig/shing tog ltung / ja 'khoru drug sogs kyi gnang cha dang / ston mo rgyas par bstsal/ 'di skabs tsam nas yongs 'dzin ni sprul gyi drung nas〈ra spod〉skor gyi ljags lung cha tshang gsan bzhes bskyangs rgyu'i dbu tshugs par 'phags chen mchog dang / yongs 'dzin chos rje ngag dbang sprul sku/ rje dbon dkon rdor sprul sku/ grwa tshang gi slob dpon gdan zur bcas kyis kyang nyin ltar lhan du gsan/ mda' dpon dpa' rtsal ba'i zhabs phyi lha/ ldan du phyir log rnams dang / dpal spungs bla brang gi 'tshams zhu ba/khyung po nas/ ru'i 'tshams zhu ba sogs nas mjal phyag re zhus la 'dod mthune don smin bstsal/ tshes 10nyin〈ra spod〉kyi ljags lung gsan bzhes grub nas〈dpal spod〉kyi ljags lung gsan rgyu dbu tshugs/ grwa tshang gi grwa gzhon rnams la rgya gling dang / rkang gling / dung chen sogs bslab dgos pa'i bka' khyab mdzad/ rnying bla rdo rje dbang chen la rgyal 'gongs kyi ar gtad dang / sri gnon dgos pa'i bka' bstsal/ sde dge sras po 'jigs med phyogs las rnam rgyal gshegs pa'i bsngo rten dang / bla ba dge legs rgya mtsho gshegs pa'i bsngo rten bcas 'bul 'byor la thugs smon dang 'byor len gnang cha bcas bstsal/ chab khul tshong dpon rnams kyis nor rgyas klu sding du spro skyid gtong gi yo da pas/ phyag mdzod chen mo dang / gzim dpon blo 112

bzang rdon yod gdan drangs par phebs 'thus kyi dgongs zhur gnang ba bstsal/ tshozla 5tshes 1— 2nyin bar dus gtor sogs char can khar/ dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo'i bskang mdos dbu tshugs da gos pa'i bka' bstsal yongs 'dzin zhi sprul gyi drung nas 'jigs byed lha zhe dgu'i skor sogs kyi dbang sta gon dang bcas pa cha tshang deng / ra lugs kyi 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum dang dgra nag lha bcu gsum bcas kyi dbang chen rnams rim bzhin gsan rjes slar yang gshin rje gshed dmar lha bcu gsum gyi dbang chen yang gsan grub pas yongs 'dzin rin po cher rten 'brel dngosasmo'abul du mjal dar nang mdzod dang sku gsung thugs rten/ rgya dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal dar snas brgyan pa/ mdzod gos yug chen gyis gtsos tshan grangs dgu tshan gsum/gho dngul rta rmig ma gsum/ 'bras dkar ltang sogs 'bul gnang mdzad/tshes 17nyin bsam sde tshe dbang brtan dbus su grwa rgyun 'gro mkhan rnams kyi 'go 'dzin du 'gro dgos pa'i bka/'a khyab bstsal/ 'di tsam la‘‘'chi med gzhon nu'i rtse 'jo'i zlos gar gyi/ sna tshogs nyams 'gyur ston 'di e ma mtshar’’zhes pa'i tshigs bcad cig kyang ljags rtsom gnang / rje dbon sprul skus gsol btab bzhin dben sa pa yab sras kyi bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi ljags lung cidang / mgon po snying zhugs kyi rjes gnang sogs bstsal bar dngoso 'bul rgya che bstar bzhes bskyangs/ bal po'i sne shan pa byes thas dang / ho tsang yes/ bal po'i mi drag pa sogs mjal khar bcar bar sne lan gsung mchid 'os 'tsham gneng /zla 6tshes 7nyin/ dbus bskyod grwa rgyun pa rnams dang 'go 'dzin byed po tshe dbang rab brtan bcas thon phyag tu bcar bar gnang ster dang bka' 11 3

slob zhib rgyas gnang / tshes rdonyin ri khrod rde'u gsum mgor dbyar mthong thugs spror 'phags chen ma/ chog dang / yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis/ rje dbon sprul sku/ phyag mdzod chen mo sogs sku 'khor chibs kha bsgyur zhing /ri khrod rde'u gsum du phebs 'phral der bzhugs chos rje bzod pa rgyal mtshan gyis bzhes 'bras sogs kyi bsnyen bkur zhabs tog zhus/ dbyar mthong spro chen skabs kyang snga dro rnams su thugs dam nyams bzhes dang / tshes gtor sogs rgyun ldan gyi mdzad rim rnams chag med mdzad pa dang / nyin ltar tsha rting tsam nas bza' bca' dang btung ba'i bye brag ji snyed par rol bar mdzad/ phyi dro rnams su dam sa'i tshul dang mi 'gal ba'i thog nas rol rtsed ci rigs pa rnams la dgyes bzhin gzigs/ dbyar mthong spro skyid chen mo grub rjes/ zhi sprul rin po che re zhig rde'u gsum ri khrod du bzhugs pa dang /'phags chen mchog dang / yongs 'dzin ngag dbang sprul sku/ rje dbon sprul sku/ rgya ra sprul sku/ phyag mdzod chen mo bcas chab mdo bla brang du zhabs sor bkod/ de'i phyi nyin gzhung sa'i dbu gdugs mkhan po mjal khar bcar bar dkar spro dang gsung mchid mdzad/ grwa tshang gi dge zhal la chos khrims gang dam dgos pa'i bka' khyab dang / hor tsang yes dang /phogs son mjal bcar la dkar spro gsungs mchid bstsal/ zla 6tshes 9nyin 'phags chen sku 'khor nor rgyas klu sding du chab zhugs su phebs skabs gu ru a nu tshang gi khyim du gdan zhus dang 'brel gsol ston bsnyen bkur dang chibs rta nor bu g.yang 'dzin zhes la sogs kyi dngos 'bul btegs/chab zhugs su nyin shas bzhugs ring chab dgon/ nas phyag mdzod chen mo ched phebs kyis 'phags chen mchog la zhabs brtan gsol 'debs dang 'brel dngos 'bul rgya che bstar/ de nas 'phags chen mchog chab mdo bla brang du 114

phyir phebs skabs rgya ra sprul sku'i 'khrungs gzhis dbos mdo a 'tshams tshang du gdan drangs pa ltar phebs par dngos/ 'bul gang rgyas dang bcas zhabs tog zhus/ de nas chab mdo dgon du phebs rjes lha ldan nas am ban gnyis kyis rgyal ba rin potshoche'i sku mched rje drung gnyis pe cin du byon dgos zhus don ltar khong gnyis sku 'khor chab mdor phebs par 'phags chen gyi mjal phyag la bka' mchid dang gsol ston gzab rgyas thog gnang skyes chibs shed bzang re/ gsol zhib dang / gsol mar/ gsol dkrum/dngul srang lnga brgya bcas bstsal/ tshes 29nyin dus gtor sngar rgyun dang /yong sdud pa rnams la mi ser thog brdab gsig gang chung dgos pa'i bka' khyab zhib cha gnang /zla ranang g.ya' tā zhin mjal phyag tu bcar bar dkar spro rgyas pa dang /tshe dpag med chab li byon gtsang / pags rigs sogs kyi gnang cha bstsal/sku zhabs grwa tshang du gsar zhugs pa bcu gnyis la dge tshul gyi bslab sdom bstsal/ grwa tshang dang spyi pa'i dge zhal bsko bzhag gnang / tshes rdonyin sku zhabs rnam grol grwa tshang gi lo ltar char can gyi maṇi ril sgrub dbu tshugs par slob dpon dbu chos/ dung gnyer/ mchod chab bcas la bka' slob zhib cha mdzad/ shu am ban dang / spo am ban gnyis nyin snga phyir mjal khar bcar bar dkar spro gang rgyas dang gnang skyes bstsal/ lha ldan po ta la nas rgyal dbang chen pos snga phyir bka' shog dang sku mched rje drung rnam gnyis gru 'dzin pho brang du myur phebs yong ba'i 'dod don gsol 'debs tshogs 'don tshugs rgyu bcas kyi skor bstsal ba'i bka' yig gi zhu lan 'bul gnang mdzad/ lnga mchod kyi nyin snga phyi gsum so sor mchod khang khag la mchod pa rnam lnga dang / rnyan shal bzang mang dang / srod 'khor rnams su gling me 115

mchod rol sngar 'khyud dang / gsung chog gzab rgyal bskyangs/ mar bcu'i dbang chog sngar lam ltar bzhes/ grwa gling gi dbu chos sogs la rgyal dbang chen po'i ljags rtsom sku mched rje drung rnam gnyis myur phebs kyi 'dod gsol tshogs 'don du ma 'gyangs par tshogs dgos dang chos khrims che phra mtha' dag do gang dam dgos tshul bka' bstsal/ bsam sde tshe dbang rab brtan grwa rgyun 'go 'dzin la dbus su btang ba phyir 'byor la dkar spro gsung phebs mdzad/ khri chen pa tā man pak+ṣi'i cha/gron gnyer rnams dang / rgya dpon pā ta shin sku 'khor bcas par dkar spro gsung mchid/ gnang ster rgya che rtsal bas yid tshim du gyur cing / pā ta shin gdong gong mar mtshams zhu'i kha btags 'bul rgyu yang bskur/ der pā ta shin nas byams khang yid dga' chos 'dzin du ka paṇa zhig gong ma chen por zhus na gnang 'ong sogs zer te sems mgu mgu byas/ khri chen pa tā man pak+ṣi'i ring bsur mgron phun tshogs byams mdun du btang / tshes 12nyin khri chen pa tā man pa k+ṣi'i chibs bsur zhi sprul rin po che sku 'khor g.yel mdar phebs grwa slob sogs grwa nang gi las sne che kha/ 'du grwa sogs kyi phebs bsu dang / skya thung thang du thab bsu/ 'dus mang nas ser sbrengs gi mdun bsus te gser sgo 'gag tu 'phags chen mchog nas spos snes phebs bsus mdzad de srid zhi'i rab gsal du bzhugs yul dang / nyi 'od ngo mtshar 'khyil par zhal 'dzoms kyis mjal dar bzhes spro rgyas pa'i thog thugs yid 'o chu gcig 'dres kyi gsung mol zhib dal gnang / gzhung gi sne shan pa rtse drung sbyin pa chos mdzad la'ang dkar spro gnang cha yid mgu bstsal/ khri chen pa tā man pak+ṣi'i nas 'phags chen mchog la mdzod btags rtser son dang / bzang gos yug chen mang ba/ g.yang ṭi dang ma na ho/ dkar yol sogs kyi snod dpyad ngo 116

mtshar can du ma phul ba dang / yongs 'dzin mchog sprul rnam gnyis la'ang dngos rdzas sna tshogs phul/ tshes 14nyin tshoms chen srid gsum rnam rgyal du bzhugs khri mthon por brtsegs pa la khri chen pa tā man pak+ṣi'i gdan drangs te bzhugs su gsol/ g.yas phyogs kyi gral la rim pa bzhin 'phags chen mchog sprul rin po che dang / dpon slob zhi sprul sku zhabs/ chos rje ngag dbang sprul pa'i sku sogs/ g.yon gyi phyogs la phyag mdzod byams pa stobs ldan sogs bzhugs par bla brang nang gzhung nas gsol ston rgyas pa'i thog mdzod btags dang / dngul dkar gyi maṇ+ḍal tshom bur dar tshon sna lngas brgyan pa/ sku gsung thugs rten/ bzang bo/sa yug chen gyi gtsos pa'i dgu tshan bzang ba lnga/ dngul srang brgya dang lnga bcu/ ja 'khor drug nyer lnga bcas dang / yongs 'dzin bla ma rnam gnyis nas kyang dngos 'bul spam mthor btegs/ der yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gling smad slob dpon rab 'byams pa blo bzang lha dbang dang / dka' bcu byams pa blo gros zung nas chos kyi bgro gleng thugs spro ba phul zhing / gar rol ba rnams nas thugs dgyes pa'i bsnyen/ bkur zhus pa dang / grwa gling gi dge 'dun 'dus mang nas khri chen pa tā man pak+ṣi'i rin po cher mjal dar phul zhing phyag dbang byin rlabs zhus/ khri chen mchog nas tshoms chen dang byams khang sogs su phyag nas me tog mthor bar mdzad de bla brang rtser phebs shing / 'phags chen mchog dang gshin po'i gsung mol zhib rgyas mdzad pa dang / de nas 'phags chen mchog nas phyag tu bzang spos dri btul bzung zhing gser sgo 'gram bar phebs skyel dang / yongs 'dzin mchog sprul rnam gnyis dang /grwa gling gi slob dpon las sne che kheg 'du grwa sogs nas nang ma/'i thab skyel pa chos khri thang du chibs skyel dang / phyaka mdzod chen mo nas gu ru bar zhabs 117

'degs su phebs pa bcas khri chen yongs 'dzin rin po che pa tā man pak+ṣi sku 'khor chab mdo nas bzhugs sgar btegs/sde pa ri zur pa dang thung si gu ru sogs la dkar spro dang gnang ster bstsal/ tshes 15nyin lha bsangs dang / bstan gsol dus gtor ma chag pa dang / cang jun ngo 'khor mjal phyag tu phebs par dkar spro rgyas pa dang / tshe dpag med kyi sku byon gtsang mtho lnga pa/ 'go snam gos ldeng /phrug bzang ba shar gnyis/ gcan lpags sna tshang rta the/da bzang bcas phul gnang bar cang jun yid mgur gyur/ nag shod nas 'phags pa'i bka' srung zhang paṇa chen po'i sku brten pa rnam rgyal mjal phyag la byung bar dkar spro dang / thugs dgyes pa'i gsung mol zhib rgyas bstsal/zla 9tshes 2nyin nyi 'od ngo mtshar 'khyil bar chos skyong chen po sku phebs par zhal 'dzoms mjal dar 'bul bzhes bsnol ba dang dngos 'bul thogagasang lung gsung 'os rnams zhib lhug bstsal/ chos rje bla ma sku brten pa nas 'phags chen mchog la mjal rten mdzod btags dang / pho rta g.yang can spu rtags can spun gsum/ dngul srang lnga bcu/ mar 'degs rgya lnga bcu sogs kyi dngos 'bul btegs par sku mdun du gsol ston bka' mchid zhib rgyas gnang / tshes 4nyin gza' skar 'phrod sbyor legs pa dang bstun yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis nas 'phags chen rin po cher tshe mchog dang 'brel ba'i zhabs brtan gyi dngos 'bul mdzod btags dang / dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal tshom bu dar tshon can sku gsung thugs rten/ na bza' skor/ sku yi nyer spyad cha tshang / dngul srang brgya tham pa/ bzang gos yug gis gtsos pa'i dgu tshan bzhi/ ja 'khor drug nyer lnga / dkar ras yug ring dang bcas zhi sprul sku zhabs nas maṇ+ḍal gyi gsung bshad zhib cing rgyas pa'i gsol 118

ba nan cher btab par 'phags chen mchog nas zhabs pad brtan rgyu'i zhal bzhes kyang gsungs shing / rten 'brel gyi dge mtshan rmad du byung ba mngon du gyur/ tshogs dang bcas par dkar spro dang sku 'gyed kyang gya nom par phul/ grwa gling khag gi dgu chen gyi 'cham dang / gtor skyongs/ rten 'bul/ mnga' gsol/ dkar spro bcas la 'phags chen yab sras mchod yon lhan rgyas phebs te gzigs mo thugs gtad zab pa bcas sngar lam bzang po ltar bstsal tshes 2rkyanyin phu'u am ban nas mdzod btags dang tshe dpag med kyi sku 'dra/ gos yug kha shas bcas phyag rten 'bul rgyu khyer te bcar bar dkar spro dang gcan lpags sna tshang / bka' mchid bcas bstsal bas yid tshim gyur/lcags phag gnam lo gsar pa'i yar ngo'i tshes 1nyin snga cha nas sku mdun du dpal ldan 'dod khams bdag mo zung gi bskangs 'phrin tshes gtor/ rten 'bul mnga' gsol sogs sngar 'khyud mdzad/ yongs 'dzin bla ma rnam gnyis dang / rjeridabon sprul sku sku mched/ gnyer che chung sogs bla brang nang gi las sne che chung thams cad nas 'phags chen mchog la mjal dar 'bul ba sogs sngar srol bzang po ltar mdzad/ rgya dpon tsang phogs gnyis la lo gsar ston mo sngar srol ltar bstsal/ treng yes dang rgya mi zung 'go bcas nas rgya zas dngos gtsang khyad mtshar bzang mang 'bul lam zhus par legs dar bstsal/ mar thang phogs dpon dang ru yes nas rgya lugs kyi/bza' bca' khyad mtshar ma du 'bul lam zhus par mgron phun tshogs ched btang gdong mdzod btags gnang cha bstsal/ bka' blon rdo ring gi zhabs phyi 'byor bar dkar spro gnang / rgya mi rnams kyis 'brug dang seng ge/ ko gru sogs kyi rgya 'chams ngo mtshar ba du ma'i rol rtsed sna tshogs 119

byas par gzigs rtogs dang gnang cha bstsal/ mang ja gnyer pa dang /tshe 'bar gnyer pa/ grwa tshang dge gnyer bcas bsko bzhag gnang /tshes 15cho 'phrul smon lam dus chen nyin 'dus pa'i sde chen sor mang 'gyed rgyas pa dang mchod khang khag la mchod pa snyan shal mang du phul/ srod kyi tshe gtor chen gtsor gyur gyi ngo mtshar mchod sprin sna tshogs pa tshar du dngar ba sgrig gshom la 'phags chen yab sras mchod yon(skabs 'dir yon bdag ni phyag mdzod chen mor zer ba)sku 'khor tshang ma phebs te gzigs zhib dang sku zhabs rnam grol grwa tshang 'dus mang nas mchod 'bul gyi gsung chog mdzad pa'i gral dbur zhabs sor bkod de zhal 'don bsngo smon thugs bskyed rgyas par mdzad/ li thang nas wa shul dge bshes blo bzang snyan grags kyi sku skye 'phags chen nyid kyi sku tshar gyur si de nyi dbus su grwa sar byon ma khan mjal phyag zhus par chibs bsu thab bsu sogs kyi bsnyen bkur dang sku mdun du bzhes spro gsung phebs zhib rgyas gnang ba dang / de'i phyi nyin phyag rten bzang po dang bcas slar yang sku mdun du byung bar dkar spro rgyas pa'i thog bka' bslab rgyun ring gnang zhing / snyan grags sprul sku sku 'khor bcas par ston mo gang rgyas kyi thog kha btags nang mdzod dang / thub dbang gi gser zangs sku byon legs/ mdzod gos ser po 'brug 'khor ma'i rgyan sbyar la ṭam ka dmar po'i mtha' 'ja' can nang phrug dmar gyi byas pa/dzab kyi mchod zhal shing tog gis gang ba/ mdzod gos ser po'i stod thung nang wa pags kyi byas pa/ dngul srang brgya tham pa/ chibs pho chen shed bzang kha gzhon spus legs/ bod sga gser dkrol ma bo/nga smed ko bzar rgyab yob nang rten bcas cha 'dzoms sogs kyi gnang ster dang 'phral yun kun tu dge ba'i bka' slob zhib cing rgyas pa bstsal/120

zla 2tshes 5nyin gzhung sa'i rtse drung smon lam rgya mtsho dang zhol drung sde pa gnyis rgya nag tu sba ye mkhan po'i don gcod du bskyod pa phyir 'ong bas mjal phyag zhus par bzhes spro bka' phebs bstsal/ chab mdo'i sba yer bar bka' shog bskur/ tshes 15nyin chos rje ngag dbang sprul pa'i sku'i thugs dam rten de mo dkor bdag dam can bcas kyi zhal 'bag la bla rdo srog 'khor sogs ye shes pa rang gnas su 'khor zhes pa'i 'khor lo bri sgrub dang rab gnas mnga' gsol/ shis brjod gang rgyas gnang / tshes 12chab mdo dus bzang gi smon lam chen mor slob dpon khri gdan zur mchod dpon brgyad dbu chos khrims 'dus mang bcas nas chos spyod smon lam spyan 'dren 'khrus gsol so gas gsung pa'i gral dbur 'phags chen zhabs sor bkod/de'i phyi nyin za 'og spus ldan las grub pa'i gos sku rin po che rnams zhal phye ba'i spyan sngar mchod pa rnam lnga brgya phrag du ma tshar du dngar ba bshams/'dus sde rnams nas chos spyod smon lam dang / spyan 'dren 'khrus gsol sogs gnang ba'i tshe 'phags chen yab sras rin po che lhan rgyas mgul dkris kyi chos khri chen mor phebs nas bka' chos ljags bsngo gang zab sngar rgyun ltar gnang / tshes 15nyin mchod rdzas kyi bye brag sna tshogs pa du mas bdun bsus te rgyal ba ma pham pa'i sku brnyan rin po che shing rta 'khor lo'i thog skor lam chen por gdan drangs pa'i ser sbrengs chen mo'i mgon du 'phags chen yab sras rnams phyag phebs/ dgon gyi phyogs bzhir bstan srung dam can rgya mtshor mchod 'bul gnyer gtad bka' sgo 'phrin bcol ljags bsngo smon shis sogs sngar gyi phyag srol bzadze+epo tremi nyams par mdzad/ bka' srung chen po'i dgyes mchod gsar 'dzugs skabs kyi zhal 'bag gsar bzhengs grub par 'phags chen yab sras rin po che nas gzigs rtogs gnang bar 121

thugs dgyes pa'i lha bzo bar legs skyes bstsal/ gyang mda' dka' bcu byams pa tshul khrims gling stod slob dpon du gsar bskos ston mo gla phogs gnang cha bka' bslab bcas zhib rgyas gnang / dka' bcu byams pa blo gros nas 'phags chen mchog la rten 'brel gyi dngos rdzas kha shas bcas phul te zhing lha rten 'dzugs dang 'brel ba'i lo legs cho ga ljags rtsom gyi zhabs bskul zhus par gza' skar legs pa'i rten 'brel khyad kyis de 'phral du bka' rtsom gyi dbu 'dzugs bskyangs/ tshes 29nyin char can gyi dgu gtor sogs kyi mdzad rim sngar lam nyams med mdzad pa dang / de nyin dpa' shod nas bang mi 'byor gdong dpa' shod rje drung rin po che zla 2tshes 5nyin dpa' shod nas phebs thon gnang rgyu dang / tshes 1rkyanyin chab mdor 'byor ba phebs nges kyi phyag bris bstsal 'byor byung / byams khang gnyer pa nas gtor 'bul skabs rgyun 'don 'don rgyu'i lha mo gnyis kyi gsol ka zhig gsar du ljags rtsom gnang rogs zhus don bzhin ljags rtsom mdzad/ lha ldan nas hu yes phyir 'byor mjal khar bcar skabs dkar spro dang gnang cha bstsal/ hu yes nas bal bod kyi gnas tshul skor zhib cha zhus/ grags pa slar yang rgya nag mkhan por thon dgos kyi bka' phebs/ e pa lha bzo pa rnams la ston mo gang rgyas bstsal/ kun gsal nyi 'od du rje drung rin po che bzhugs yul gra sgrig gnang / tshes 〈'char can gyi brgyad gtor chen mor 'phags chen mchog tshogs dbur phebs/ phyag mdzod chen mo rje drung rin po che'i phebs bsur gla mdar byon dgos gsungs/ tshes 11gza' tshes dge bar gzhon nu dpa' shod nas ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi sprul pa'i sku rin po che rje drung ye shes blo bzang brtan pa'i mgon po dpal bzang po sku 'khor rnams chab mdo dge ldan byams pa gling du phebs pa na/ dpon slob 122

zhi sprul rin po che dang / chos rje ngag dbang sprul sku/ rje dbon sprul sku/rgya ra sprul sku/ grwa gling gi bla ma slob dpon/ gnyer che chung / gsol mgron drung / dbu chos khrims 'du grwa bcas rta pa nyis brgyar nye ba chos khri thang du bla brang nang gzhung nas thab bsu zhus pa'i sar chibs bsur byon zhing mjal phyag zhus te rim gyis phebs par grwa gling gi 'dun 'dus pa'i sde chen po rnams gur gum gzhon nu'i skyed tshal phreng bar spel ba lta bu'i ser sbrengs gi bkod pa tshar du dngar bas mdun bsus nas bla brang theg chen chos kyi pho brang chen por phyag phebs/ nyi 'od ngo mtshar 'khyil bar 'phags chen rin po che dang / ba so rje drung sprul pa'i sku rin po che ye shes blo bzang bstan pa'i mgon po dpal bzang po yab sras mtsha na dpe'i 'dzum zhal lhan cig rgyas par bkra shis pa'i re kha mngon par bkra ba'i nang mdzod rtser son gyi mjal dar 'bul bzhes gnang ba bsnol mar mdzad de rang rang gi chos kyi khri 'phang mthon por zhabs sor 'khod par bzhes spro gsol ba rgyas pa'i thog thugs yid gcig 'dres mdza' gcug mnyes shing gshin pa'i bka' 'phros zhib dal yun ring bar gnang ste rje drung rin po che'i bzhugs yul kun gsal nyi 'od du mdzad/ de'i phyi nyin nas bzung rje drung mchog sprul rin po che nas 'phags chen rin po cher zhabs bskul mdzad pa ltar 'phags chen mchog nas rje drung sprul sku rin po che dang / lcag rwa sprul sku ngag dbang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gnyis kyi gtsos sku 'khor bcas sum cu skor la zhal snga bka' brgyud kyi pha chos grub dbang mi tra dz+wa ki'i thugs bcud mi tra 'khrid drug tu grags pa'i gzhung pod kyi ljags lung gi dbu tshugs/ tshes 12nyin rje drung mchog gi sprul sku nas 'phags chen mchog la mdzod btags rtser son dang / dngul dkar gyi maṇ+ḍal tshom bur dar sna lngas brgyan pa/ sku gsung thugs rten/ na 123

bza' cha tshang / mdzod gos kyi bzhugs gdan snyel 'bol/ sku yi nyer spyad rigs/ rin chen gnyis pa srang nyis brgya/ bar mdzod bam gnyis/phyi mdzod bam brgyad/ mdzod gos bzang nges tshos sna tshoganu/ yug bcu/'go snam tshal kha gyon 'deng gsum/ phrug rgyu bzang tshos sna tshogs shar bcu /rdor dril bzang ba cha/ dung dka/ra legs pa/ rgya sbub spus gtsang cha/gsol ldir bzo bkod khyad mtshar can/ chibs pho chen shed bzang kha gzhon/ rta sga gser dkrol ma sga 'khor cha tshang legs pa/ ko sman rgya snam bzhi / a ma/ ltang / chi phi kha ltang / 'bru dkar ltang / ras dkar dri bral yug ring bcas kyi dngos 'bul rgya spam mtho nges su btegs par mdzad/'di nyin ljags lung mu bzhin bstsal/ tshes 14nyin 'phags chen yab sras kyis rje drung mchog sprul rin po che sku drung nas sras rgyud lugs kyi lo gyon ma dmar nag ser gsum gyi dbang lung dang / lcang skya rin po che ye shes bstan pa'i sgron mes mdzad pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gzab gnad can/ nyams mgur bka' rgya ma/ bde mchog lus dkyil dang 'brel ba'i lho sgo cho ga/klu yi cho ga rgyas pa/ bde mchog dkar po'i cho ga dang 'brel ba'i tshe sgrub dang bla mar zhabs brtan 'bul tshul sogs kyi ljags lung gsan par phyag mdzod chen mo dang / grwa slob gdan zur/ sku 'khor gso la gzims mgron drung bcas kyang der ljags lung gi bka' drin thob/ de nas nyi 'od ngo mtshar 'khyil par 'phags chen mchog dang / rje drung mchog gi sprul sku rin po che/ yongs 'dzin mchog sprul rnam gnyis/ rag ra sprul sku/ rje dbon bla ma'i sprul sku/ rgya ra grub chen sprul sku sogs kyis dbus bla dpon mi dpon rnams gdan 'dzoms pa'i bzhus/sa gral chen por bla brang nang gzhung nas bza' bca' btung ba'i bye brag ji snyed pa mngon par bshams pa'i gsol 124

ston gyi 'byor pa bsam brjod las 'das pa phul ba'i thog yongs kyi dge ba'i bshe4gnyen grwa slob khri thog pa dbag sho rab 'byams blo bzang rgyal mtshan dang / dka' bcu byams pa blo gros zung nas chos kyi bgro gleng gang legs dang kun tu dga' ba'i gar rol ngo mtshar bas bsnyen bkur zhus par gnang skyes legs dar rgya che bstsal/ 'di skabs tsam la nyin ltar khrid drug gi ljags lung mu bzhin dang / bco lnga'i dus gtor kyang ma chag pa mdzad/tshes 16nyin 'phags chen mchog nas rje drung sprul pa'i skur mi tra khrid drug gi nang tshan tshe dpag med dang / 'jam dbyangs/ phyag rdor bcas kyi rje gnang dang / khri dror spyan ras gzigs rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang chen cha tshang ba bstsal/ rje drung mchog sprul rin po cher sku zhabs rnam grol grwa tshang bla ma 'dus spyi nas sger mjal phyag dbang zhus/ dpon slob zhi sprul rin po che'i drung nas rje drung sprul pa'i skus bde mchog ngam rjong / bsnyen brgyud lugs kyi dbang lung sogs chos bka' mang po dang / chos rje sprul pa'i sku'i drung nas lho brag bka' 'bum nang gi dbang lung du ma gsan/ chab mdo 'du grwa spyi chen nas rje drung mchog sprul rin po cher mjal rten dngos 'bul gang 'byor thog 'dus mang nas mjal dar phul zhing phyag dbang zhus pa dang bka' chos kyi zhabs bskul zhus par byang chab lam sgron gyi ljags lung gnang gedang / 'dus pa'i sder mang 'gyed rgya che bstsal/ slar yang 'phags chen mchog nas rje drung rin po cher khrid drug nang gi spyan ras gzigs dang /sgrol ma/ dzam bha la/ rta mgrin bcas kyi rjes gnang dang / sku sger la bde mchog gi bdag bskyed dbang mchog bcu cha'i sbyin sreg bcas kyi lung gnang ba bcas de ltar thugarme bzhed kyi dbang lung rnams gsan grub nas tshes 1ṭ+wāṃnyin snga dror nyi 'od ngo mtshar 'khyil par rje drung rin po che sku 'khor 125

bcas par bla brang nang gzhung nas gsol ston rgya che'i thog 'phags chen mchog nas mdzod btags khyad mtshar che ba/ dngul dkar gyi maṇ+ḍal tshom bu dar tshon gyis mdzes par byas pa/ sku gsung thugs rten/ na bza' bzhes rung cha tshang / dngul ngo bo srang bzhi brgya dang / gos yug gi gtsos pa'i tshan grangs/ ja sogs dngul rdo tshad lnga yi rgyu rtsa phul ba dang / zhi sprul dang chos rje ngag dbang pa/ rje dbon bla ma'i sprul sku/ rgya sprul/ phyag mdzod sogs nas dngos 'bul gang rgyas kyi bsnyen bkur/ phyi dro rje drung rin po che sku 'khor rnams chab mdo'i mchod khang mtha' dag la phebs nas mchod pa dang snyan shal gzab rgyas phul thog mchod mjal gsung chog thugs bskyed smon lam nan tan mdzad/ tshes 19nyin snga char 'phags chen yab sras rin po che rnams zhal 'dzoms thog 'phral yun kun tu dge ba'i bka' 'phros zhib rgyas dang mdzod btags bzang po 'bul bzhes gnang ba bsnol mar mdzad/ yongs 'dzin mchog sprul rnam gnyis dang / rje dbon spul sku/rgya sprul phyag mdzod chen mo/ grwa gling gi slob dpon/ gnyer che chung /gsol gzim/ mgron drung / 'du grwa sogs rta pa nyis brgyar nye bas chos khri thang du phebs skyel zhus pa dang bcas te chibs bskyod/ yongs 'dzin sprul sku rnam gnyis dang 'du grwa sogs mang ma de nas phyir phebs/ phyag mdzod chen po gu ru bar dang / mgron pad+ma rngan mda' bar phebs bskyel btang / rje drung rin po che nas bka' srung zhang paṇa chen por lung gsal 'ga' re zhu rgyu gnang ba sku gsol phebs thog zhus pa'i lung phebs rnams phebs rje su 'bul rgyu zhus/ dgung grangs so mdun du bzhes pa gong ma lha skyong khri bzhugs lo 56rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags phag lo gong ma dgung lo brgyad cur phebs pa'i zhabs brtan du lha khang gsar bzhengs 126

mdzad pa sogs la brten gong mas zhwa ser bstan pa chos cher gsal bar mdzad pa'i er ti ni no mon han du bsngags pa'i dngul tham dang lha khang la‘‘tshe gsol gling’’zhes pa'i sgo paṇa bod sog dang man ju rgya bcas kyi yig rigs bzhi ldan dang dral tse brgyud man ju'i yi ger phab pa'i bka' yig tu‘‘spa'o nas zhu ba/ 'phags pa lha ho thog thu nas gong ma dgung lo brgyad cur phebs dus zhabs bstan du lha khang gsar bzhengs byas 'dug par ming dang sngon du 'phags pa lha ho thog thur gong ma sku gong mas gnang ba'i rag gi tham ga dngul du brjes na 'os che 'dug zer bar/ 'phags pa lha ho thog thu 'di chos kyi yon tan la mkhas pa chen po yin 'dug pa dang / lo kha shas nas yar phyir 'gro mi la 'u lag gra sgrig sogs byed sgo tshang ma le thogs —med pa'i lugs mthun btang 'dug par brten de don thugs rjes 'phar gzigs kyis sngon du rtsal ba'i rag gi tham ga de dngul gyi tham kar bsgyur nas gnang ba dang / lha khang gsar rgyag byas par tshe gsol gling zhes pa'i yi ge gsol ras gnang yod/ de'i ched du bka' phebs pa yinakya’zhes 'khod pa rtsal 'dugayang de'i snga lo lha skyong khri bzhugs nga lnga lo pe cin du mi sna ched gtong gis brgyad cu'i zhabs brtan la 'bul ba kha btags nang mdzod/ sku 'dra li ma 9dngul srang 20yod pa'i maṇ+ḍal/ spos bam 100phrug sna tshogs bub 20bcas phul bar bka' —lan gser yig gnang rten nang mdzod7/ chos 'don nang mdzod 7dngul srang sum cu'i mdong mo/ nang gi mdzod gos sna tshogs yug kha mdzod chung sna chegs yug 2bcas dang gnang cha rgya nag gi bzang spos bam 2 sku rten g.yab ṭi las grub pa'i tshe dpag med kyi sku brnyan tsan dan dmar po'i bzhugs khang shel sgo can/ sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun gyi shog thang gra mtshungs/ thugs rten shog thang gi byang chub mchod 127

rten dpangs su thog brtsegs gnyis ldan/ g.yang ṭi'i ru'i ye/ rgya khug cha gsum/ kha btags nang mdzod 7 gos yug 12bcas bstsal 'dug pa sogs kyi gong ma'i gzigs bskyangs thob/gong ma lha skyong khri bzhugs drug lo pe cin nas jar go che dpon g.yog gdong bla brang theg chen pho brang la‘‘tshe gsol gling’’zhes pa'i mtshan byang phyag bstar ma bka' paṇa dang gser yig gnang cha sogs bstsal ba rnams zla 2tshes 15nyin chab mdor 'byor skabs mgron pad+ma dang / phyag mdzod chen mo gnyis bsu ma ring thung la gtong gnang thog gser sgo chen mo'i 'gram du 'phags chen mchog nas spos snes bsu ba mdzad de nyi 'od ngo mtshar 'khyil ba'i gdan khri mthon po'i steng drangs nas bdag gir bzhes/ gong ma'i sku tshab jar sgo che dpon g.yog dang / chab mdor yong mus kyi tsang yes phogs dpon ngo g.yog bcas par dkar spro dang legs dar bstsal/ de skabs 'phags chen mchog nas phyag bris 'di 'dra zhig bris gnang yod pa ste ‘‘'jam dpal dbyangs ngos bdag po chen po yis/ phyag sor 'du byed las thon khyad mtshar gyi/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rtags kyi brtar/ tshe gsol gling zhes 'khod pa'i bka' paṇa gyi/ gser yig legs skyes phun sum tshogs pa'ang bstsal’’zhes so/ yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis dang / rje dpon bla ma'i sku sprul/ rgya ra sprul sku/ phyag mdzod chen mo/ gnyer chen/rtse gnyer/ gsol gzim/ mgron drung / grwa gling khag gi bla ma slob tsodapon/dze 'du grwa/ phyogs nye ring gi bla bsko dang rdzong sdod sogs che phra bltos bcas mtha' dag nas 'phags chen mchog la legs 'bul bstar/de nas pe cin nas 'ongs ba'i jar go che dpon g.yog rnams la dar dkar dang / gos yug sogs kyi gnang cha bstsal ba dang / gong ma chen por 128

rigs byed lha mo'i li sku sogs kyi rten dang bcas pa'i zhu yig dang / bod sdod am ban la'ang tshe dpag med kyi li sku sogs dang zhu yig bcas bstsal/de rjes gza' skar bzang bstun la bla brang theg chen chos kyi pho brang gi tshoms chen srid gsum rnam rgyal gyi sgo steng du‘‘tshe gsol gling’’zhes pa'i bka' paṇa bkal/ de'i tshe gong ma'i mngags zhugs pa tsang ye phogs dpon sogs rgya dpon che chung rnams dang rgya dmag bcas nas kyang 'phags chen mchog la gus pa chen pos bstod cing bsngags par byed pa sogs gang gi snyan pa'i grags pa dkar po de bas mngon par 'phags par gyur/dus skabs 'di skor tsam la lha sa nas rta zam thog khri chen pak+ṣi sku gshegs pa'i gnas tshul dang bcas thugs dam gsal 'debs su thub dbang gi gser sku byon legs/ gos rgyan bzhi sngo nag yug chen sogs 'byor bar 'phags chen mchog nas thugs smon gzab mo gnang / yongs 'dzin chos rje ngag dbang gi drung nas dbu ma 'jug pa dang mngon pa mdzod la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid kyi phyag dpe ji nyed pa zhig gsan bzhes bskyangs/ e pa lha bzo ba rnams kyis sman sku gsar bzhengs byas pa byon gtsang legs grub byung bar legs dar bstsal/rgyal dbang rin po che mchog gi sku'i mched zla rje drung rab 'byams pa blo bzang rdo rje rgya nag tu gshegs par rgyal dbang mchog nas 'phags chen du bsngo rten mdzod dar dang / bzang gos sna tshogs bstsal 'byor la bsngo smon dang 'byor lan bstsal/ gzhung gi mkhan nang sngon du rgya nag la song ba rnams zla 6tshes 1nyin chab mdor 'byor skabs phyag mdzod chen mo phebs bsur mngags gtong mdzad/ rgya nag nas sba yer mkhan po thog ti ba dka' bcu ngag dbang dar rgyas sogs 'byor gdong gong mas 'phags chen 129

mchog la bstsal ba'i gser yig dang / sangs rgyas rab mdun gyi zhal thang sogs 'bul 'byor byung ba rnams nyi 'od ngo mtshar 'khyil bar bdag gir bzhes/ yul bzhugs rgya dpon tsang yes phogs dang / mkhan po dpon g.yog tshang mar dkar spro gnang /zla 7nang dpa' shod dza sag bla ma'i zhu yig phul 'byor du dpa' shod rje drung sprul sku zi ling nas bod phyogs chibs sgyur gnang gi yod lugs sogs kyi gnas tshul 'khod yod pa da nga / zla 〈tshes shar du thang dkar klu sding du chab zhugs grub rjes bla brang du phebs nas bka' srung zhang paṇa gyi dus gtor chen mo gsar du tshugs skabs su mkho ba'i 'cham gos rnams bzo rgyu'i dbu tshugs/tshes 6nyin rdza jo bo sprul sku sogs nas gsol ba btab don rdza jo bo sprul sku dang / kong po ri khrod bla ma sku 'khor/ dka' bcu byams pa blo gros bcas par tshe dpag med kyi rjes gnang bstsal/ 'cham gsar bslab pa rnams 'cham rgyugs bzhes te sbyong brdar legs po byung yod pas 'cham dpon dbu mdzad dpal 'byor rgyal mtshan dang dge 'dun grags pa gnyis la legs dar bstsal pa dang 'cham gsar bslab rnams la'ang mgul dar dang ja sbag re gnang /zla rdozla mjug tu dpa' shod dza bla nas rje drung sprul sku 'bri chu kha nas yar phebs kyi yod lugs kyi zhu yig phul 'byor byung / bal po kha shas dang /rdo ring sras/ g.yu thog sras/ bstan gling dza sag bla ma/ mda' dpon lcang lo can pa sogs rgya nag tu phebatshomakhen rnams chab mdor phebs 'byor gyis mjal khar bcar bar dka' spro gsung mchid dang zur gsos gnang cha rmospam mtho bstsal/ bstan gling bla brang nas b.lanebod kyi gnas tshularteskor geb phra'i zhu yig kyangartephul 'byor byung ba dang / 'di skabs lha sdod am ban nas 130

chab yod tsang yes gtsos rgya dmag tshang ma lha sa ngos yar yong dgos kyi yi ge yang btang 'byor byung yod pas/ mi ser mkhos chung la brten dmag dang sa tshigs sogs gcig las gcig dka'i zhabs phyi 'grub re bral ba'i bde sdug zhu cha yang phul 'byor byung / bstan srung rnams kyi pho brang che chung khag la 'phrin bcol dang nyin ltar skangs gso tshogs pa'i tshogs dbur zhabs sor bkod/ gar dpon dge legs dpal 'byor dang blo bzang dngos grub gnyis su grwa gzhon bcu skor la gar gsar bslab dgos pa'i bka' khyab gnang / sku zhabs grwa tshang gi tshogs yongs nas bstan srid spyi'i sku rim du lcags mkhar chen mo zhes pa nyin bdun tshugs pa'i gtor bzlog gi gtso skyongs mdzad/ li thang nas wa shul dbon po yongs grags dang blo gros yon tan dpon g.yog ser skya nas dngos 'bul rgya che btegs par gsol ston gzab rgyas dang bka' mchid zhib cha gnang / de bzhin rag nyag sprul sku rnam gnyis nas phyag rten dngu bcas mjal bar phebs pa la'ang dkar spro dang gsung mchid zhib lhugs mdzad/ 〈tri yangs mu tri〉sogs kyi ljags lung gsan grub nas 〈rtsa she'i rnam bshad rig pa'i rgya mtsho〉zhes pa'i ljags lung gsan rgyu'i dbu tshugs/ gong gsal yongs grags rgya mtsho spun mched lha sar jo mjal sogs su bskyod par mgron phun tshogs phebs skyel du mngag gtong gnang /zla 9nang cang cun chen mo ngo mkhor mjal khar bcar bar yang dkar spro dang pags rigs/ sku 'dra sogs kyi gnang cha bstsal/ rlis tsang yes sogs rgya dpon 'ga' shas mjal khar byung bar yang dkar spro sogs yid mgu bstsal/ de sngon mi tra khrid drug gi sman 'dam sku gsar bzhengs grub pa rnams lhun rtse ri khrod du gdan 'dren dgos pa'i bka' khyab mdzad/ bar 131

bar du gong gsal ljags lung khag gsan grub nas gas 'dus rtsa rgyud dang de'i bsdus don sa bcad chen mo sogs kyi ljags lung gsan 'go tshugs/rgyal rong gi dmag dpon treng yes dang / de min rgya dpon tog sngon can/rgyal rong lu'u nā lo'o yes/ 'ba' sde pa bsod nams chos 'phel ngo 'khor sogs mjal phyag tu bcar bar dkar spro dang gnang cha gsang mchid yid 'phrod bstsal/ zla 9tshes 14nyin gru gu dgon nas rgya ra grub chen gyi sprul sku skal bzang chos grags zhing du gshegs skor bang mi'i gdong gnas tshul phul 'byor byung bar mgron pad+ma de'i dgongs rdzogs sgrub po'i 'go 'dzin du bka' khyab thog rje dbon bla ma mchog dang / grwa gling gi slob dpon gang bzhugs rnams gru gu dgon du dgongs rdzogs zhu bar phebs dgos kyi bka' bstsal/ tshes 15nyin rag nyag sprul skus gsol ba btab don tshigs snga ma dge tshul gyi sdom pa bstsal te mtshan‘‘'phags mchog 'phrin las lhun grub’’ces dang / gser zangs kyi thub pa'i sku brnyan/ mdzod btags bcas bstsal/ 'di skabs tsang tu mar thang du 'byor bas mgron gnyer brgyud mdzod btags dang gos chen yug gsum 'bul 'byor la phyir lan gnang cha bstsal/ hor zla 9tshes 19nyin sku zhabs rnam grol grwa tshang 'tshogs yongs dang lhun rtse ri khrod kyi dge slong rnams bcas nas lo ltar zla 'khor nyin mtshan rgyun mthud kyi ma ṇi bum sgrub tshogs rgyu'i srol 'dzugs bskyangs/hor zla 10tshes shar du yongs 'dzin chos rje ngag dbang sprul sku'i drung nas gong gsal ljags lung khag gsan grub nas rje tsong kha pas mdzad pa'i gsang 'dus kyi〈dbang don de nyid rab gsal〉sogs kyi ljags lung gsan 'go tshugs/ bka' srung zhang paṇa gyi dgyes mchod gsar tshugs skabs chos skyong chen mo sku 'khor sogs kyi sku 'cham go rim dang 'cham stangs sogs grwa 132

tshang gi dbu mdzad dpal 'byor rgyal mtshan dang / gu ru bla ma dge 'dun grags pa gnyis la ljags bkod gnang / gong ma'i dmag dpung rnams chab mdo nas thon/ zla 10tshes 19nyin sku zhabs grwa tshang ma ṇi bum sgrub grol ba'i tshags dbur byon te khrom dbang dang dgyes ston mdzad/ lha ldan nas bstan rgyas gyis rgya gar gyi rma bya zhig bskur gtong gnang ba de nyid sa ma 'phrod par tshe 'phos par bsngo smon bskyangs /rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags phag hor zla 11tshes 12nyin bka' srung zhang paṇa(gtsug na dpal dge yang zer)gyis dgyes mchod gar 'cham gsar du btsugs pa'i mdzad chen thog 'phags chen mchog dang / yongs 'dzin zhi sprul 'phags pa dge legs rgyal mtshan/ yongs 'dzin chos rje ngag dbang 'phrin las rab rgyas/ rje dbon kun rdor bla ma blo bzang 'jigs med phyogs las rnam rgyal sogs rang rang go babs kyi khri steng bzhugs nas rten 'brel mdzad chen gzab rgyas bskyangs pa dang / phyag mdzod chen mo blo bzang rdo rje dang / gnyer che chung / kasol gzim/mgron drung / slob dpon khri gdan zur sogs nas legs skyes dngos 'byor bsam gyis misakhyab pa 'degs 'bul zhus/ tshes 17nyin 'brug pa zhabs drung chos mgon sprul sku 'khor bcas phebs par gsol ston dang gsung mchid zhib rgyas/ de'i phyi nyin rgya mi dmag dpon bzhi dang phogs dpon bcas mjal khar bcar bar dkar spro gnang / zla 12tshes 6nas tshe sgrub kyi ljags bsnyen sku mtshams tshugs/ tshes 27nyin bkras lhun phyag mdzod drung pa blo bzang sbyin pa dang grwa tshang chen po bzhi'i chos rje slob dpon zur bzhi bla ma rnams /rgya nag tu phebs mkhan chab mdor phebs 'byor la mgron pad+ma gsol ja'i mtshams zhur gtong gnang rjes khong rnams 'phags

chen gyi mjal phyag tu bcar bar dkar spro dang gnang cha/ gsung mchid lhugs por gnang ba dang / tshes 20nyin bkras lhun phyag mdzod drung pa ho thog thu blo bzang sbyin pa sku 'khor rnams la sku mdun du gsol tshigs rgya che gshom pa gnang zhing / gsung mol yun ring bskyangs/ dgung grangs so brgyad du bzhes pa chu byi gnam lo gsar tshes la dpal ldan lha mo rnam gnyis la gtor 'bul mnga' gsol sogs sngar srol mdzad sgo khag gzab rgyas bskyangs pa dang / bkras lhun drung pa ho thog thu sku 'khor rnams la phebs rdzongs mdzod btags dang / dngul rdo tshad lnga/ chibs drel spus legs sga gdan rang 'grigs bdun/ gsol chas sne 'dzoms bcas kyi gnang cha dang / tshes 2nyin khong rnams phebs thon skabs phyag mdzod chen mo dang / mgron gnyer bcas phebs skyel du gtong gnang mdzad/ tshes 2nyin char can srung ma spyan 'dren rgyu gsol lung zhu sogs kyi mdzad rim khag dang / do thal tsang phogs sogs rgya dpon rnams la lo gsar gyi bskal ba gnang / tshes 10nyin phyag mdzod chen mor sngon du rgya mi'i lag nas byung ba'i 'u la'i bdal gla rnams mi ser gyi lag tu sprod dgos pa'i bka' khyab gnang / tshes 17nyin mgron pad+ma gzugs khams lci bab skyabs zhu phul bar lha mo'i mgon khang gi 'dus tshogs la mang ja dang 'brel zhabs rim dang / 'phel gdung sogs kyi byin rlabs bstsal/ de rjes mgron pad+ma dang mgron blo bzang nyi ma gnyis khams ma 'tsho ba'i bsngo rten 'bul 'byor la bsngo smon dang rgyang 'pho sogs gnang / phu si nā ran mjal phyag tu bcar bar dkar spro dang gnang cha/ dge sde'i dmag dpon tsang yes mjal bcar la yang gnang cha bstsal/ ngag dbang phun tshogs zhes par khyung po dkyil mkhar rdzong sdod dang / nub gling slob zur dka' bcu 134

'phags pa chos rgyal tsha ba ldem dgon gyi bla 'dzin du bsko gtong gnang /sngone du mgron pad+ma 'das po'i nad las 'phrod pa lta bus gzim dpon blo bzang don yod kyang khoms ma bde bas zhi sprul rin po che dang / 'phags chen gang nyid nas rim 'gro thugs smon gang rgyas gnang ba dang / 'di skabs rims nad khyab par nad pa dang nad kyi bgo gzhi yod pa rnams ri khar btang ba dang / gnyer phun tshogs skal bzang la nad rims 'gog thabs kyi bca' khrims do gang dam dgos pa'i bka' khyab gnang / 'di skabs yongs 'dzin chos rje ngag dbang sprul sku'i drung nas sna tshogs yum gyi rjes gnang dang / yo ngas 'dzin zhi sprul rin po che'i drung nas rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang sogs gsan/ zla 2tshes 14nyin cha ra can ltar gos sku noms la mchod pa dang snyan shal 'bul rgyur mgron gnyer mngag gtong dang / tshes 15nyin ser sbrengs chen mor byams pa'i sku brnyan gdan zhus la snyan shal 'bul bar thugs smon dang bcas mgron phun tshogs ched gtong gnang / 'di nyin gzim dpon blo bzang don yod khams ma 'tsho ba gsan phral yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis sogs bla khag la ma gyogs bsngo 'bul gnang thog rgyang 'pho bsngo smon gang gzab gnang / gzim dpon 'das po'i dge rtsar dgongs gtad kyis mkha' spyod sgrub mchod sogs rjes 'jug bsngo smon gang rgyas gnang / tshes 24nyin dbon rab dbyangs khams ma 'tsho ba'i brasngo 'bul la rgyang 'pho dang byang chog bstsal/ gnod sbyin k+ṣi tra pā la'i sgo nas rgya 'dre'i mnan pa dang gtor bzlog sogs nad rimasazhi phyir gyi zhabs rim rgya che ga nang / bstan rgyas gling gi dza sagre/ bla ma pe cin du sgon dgos kyis chab mdor 'byor bar mjal kha dang dkar spro/ gsol ston dbai 'brel bka' mchid zhib lhugs 135

gnang / sku mched dbon rab dbyangs dang nye gnas gzim dpon blo don gnyis kyi dge rtsar dgongs gtad kyis sgrub mchod dang byang chog bsngo smon gang gzab rgya che bskyangs/ 'di lo 'phags chen gyi sku phywar yang 'tshub ngo yod lugs bka' srung gi lung du gsal yod pas zhabs brtan sku rim rgya che gnang /zla 2tshes 5nyin nas tshe sgrub kyi sku mtshams bzhugs/ tshes 1rkyaskor nas bzung dgon chen gyi shar ngos skor lam gyi 'og sa yi gnad du rgyal 'gongs dang rgya 'dre mnan pa'i mchod rten bzhengs rgyu'i gzhi bting ba dang de'i gzungs 'bul sogs kyi phyag len 'phyugs med dgos skor gyi zhal bkod mdzad/ rizla 4tshes 10nyin gzim dpon blo don 'das po'i spun mched 'phags mchog skal bzang gzim dpon dang rtse gnyer gyi las gnas gnyis 'dzin dgos lugs dang / sngar gyi rtse gnyer a tu phun tshogs 'das po'i tsha bo rnam rgyal phun tshogs rtse gnyer gyi sbrel zlar gsar bskos gnang thog dkar spro dang bka' bslab zhib cha gnang / zla 5tshes shar du gu ru a nu'i bu o rgyan rab brtan la gnyer chen gyi go sa dang / ru thung phun tshogs la bsher dpang / gu ru a chog la gnyer chung bcas bsko bstsal dang 'brel mjal khar bcar bar so so'i las don gzhung sems lhag bsam rnam dag dgos pa'i bka' khyab zhib tu bstsal/ gnyer chen o rgyan rab brtan nas gsol ston dang dngos 'bul rgya che btegs/ zla 5tshes 2nyin gru gu thang dgon nas rgya ra mchog sprul rin po che'i gser gdung gsar bzhengs zin pa'i rab gnas su gdan zhus ltar chibs bsgyur bskyangs te tshes 5 —7nyin rab gnas kyi gsung chog dang sbyin bsregs sogs bskyangs bar gru gu dgon gyi spyi 136

sger ltos bcas nas rab ston legs 'bul rgya che bstar/ gru gu 'dus spyis gsol ba btab don bzhin thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang chen sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang ba bstsal rjes lhun rtse ri khrod du phyir phebs/ gnas bcu'i zhal thang chen mo gsar bzhengs la gong gsham dang lag dril/ thang tog zhal phebs dang bcas pa legs grub zin pa rnams dang / sgrub sde'i thugs dam gyi rten shing bse las grub pa'i grub chen mi tra'i thugs dam lha drugabaka' srung brag lha mgon po bcas gsar bzhengs la zhal gser sogs legs grub rnams bcas la rab gnas legs par bstsal/ gnyer chen o rgyan rab brtan gyi spun zhu mtshan nas de sngon li thang gi bka' 'gyur mtshal par ma grangs tshang blu bzhengs kyi khyim du bzhugs par yang rab gnas su gdan zhus ltar phebs/ gu ru sde spyi'i gsol btab bzhin zhing khar khrus gsol yang bskyangs/zla 7nang de sngon rgya nag gong mar mtshams 'bul du mngags gtong gnang ba'i mkhan po grags pa rgya mtsho phyir log gdong gong mas 'phags chen du che bkur gzengs bstod gnang ba'i gser yig dang / dngul gyi tham gza 'og bzang nges yug chen bcu phrag lnga sogs kyi gnang cha dang bcas 'byor nyer yod pa rnams bdag gir bzhes phyir 'phags chen mchog lhun rtse ri khrod nas chab mgon du chibs bsgyur bskyangs thog gong ma'i sku tshab dang rgya nag mkhan po grags pa rgya mtsho bcas kyis drangs pa'i gser yig dang tham kha sogs la bsu ba ring thung dang / rgya bod kyi mi sna khag la ston mo sogs sngar lam ltar gnang / gong gsal mkhan po grags rgyal las don lhag bsam gang legs byung ba'i bdag rkyen du 'phags chen mchog gi mgron gnyer du bskos/ slar yang 'phags chen sku 'khor lhun rtse ri khrod du chibs bsgyur 137

bskyangs/ de nas bcad rgya lngags bsnyen zla 'khor du bzhugs/ sku mched yongs grags rgya mtsho lha ldan nas phyir 'byor la mjal kha dang dkar spro gsung mchid zhib rgyas bstsal/ zla 12nang 'phags chen sku 'khor chab dgon du phebs/ bka' srung zhang paṇa gyi dgyes mchod gar 'cham snga lo ltar mdzad/'di'i skabs tsam la dka' bcu byams pa blo gros nas phyag mdzod chen mor snyan seng du‘‘chab dgon gyi dge slong mang ma lo ltar dmigs rtse ma dang nag po skor gsum gyi las rung bsnyen par 'gro nges kyi mtshams grwa zhig yod na bstan 'gro spyi dang bye brag sku mtshams bzhugs pa po rnams kyi 'di phyi'i don chen 'grub pa dang las rab 'byams gang mdzad dgos byung yang gnad du 'gro nges yong 'dug pas de don mgo 'dren thugs rjes gzigs pa mkhyen mkhyen’’zhes zhus par phyag mdzod chen mo nas gra 'grigs pa yong zhes gsungs pa dang / chos rje ngag dbang sprul skur 'phag chen mchog la snyan sgron zhu 'gab che'am mi che zhes zhus par de don zhus na shin tu legs lugs gsungs/de bzhin zhi sprul rin po cher zhus pa ma zad/ mdzod btags dri med dang rin chen dang po zho gang / dngul srang gang yod pa'i kho'e tse bcas phyag rten du sbyar nas 'phags chen gyi sku mdun du mtshams grwa tshugs rgyu'i skor gong ltar zhus don la de 'phral gang cir legs lam che bas mgo 'dren yong 'e/sa bka' bstsal/ de rjes 'phags chen mchog dang phyag mdzod chen mo mchod yon thugs bstun bka' gros thog phyag mdzod chen mo nas mtshams grwa ba rnams kyi mchod pa dang gsol chas sogs gang song dang po lo gcig ring gnyer tshang chen mo nas btang ste de nas zhib rtsis kyis rgyu rtsa mi chung ba sbyor 'jags byed gsungs pa ltar/ dngul rdo tshad bcu bzhi dang / ru thung dbon 'gya tshang stong pa'i khang pa dang sa zhing chu 'gro sa bon chab khal bco lnga skor 'gro ba rka 38

bcas spyi chen gyi mang gnyer du rtsis sprad pa'i skyed bun 'bru 'bab dang bcas pa rnams mtshams pa'i mthun rkyen du bstsal rgyu'i thugs thag bcad gnang ba dang / de bstun lo ltar dge slong bcu re zla ba bdun ring sku mtshams su bzhugs nas dmigs brtse ma'i las rung dang / nag po skor gsum gyi las rung sbyin sreg dang bcas bsnyen pa gnad du 'gro nges dgos skor gyi bca' yig zhib cha dang bcas pa'i bka' bslab kyang bstsal ba dang / mtshams kyi tshe 'don rgyu'i zhal 'don rnams kyi dbang lung khrid rigs ma thob pa yod rigs yongs 'dzin chos rje ngag dbang mchog gi drung nas zhus zhes bka' bstsal ba bzhin yongs 'dzin mchog nas bstsal/ de ltar mtshams bsnyen 'dzugs pa'i mdzad bzang gis mtshams su bzhugasda pa po rnams kyang dbang lung khrid bcas thob cing phyag len rnam dag byung thog gsol chas dang /dpe cha/ gdan chas/ thab chas/ bzhugs yul khang pa dang bcas pa'i mthun rkyen mkho dgu 'dzoms nges byung ba dang / lo ltar hor zla 7tshes 2tsam nas phyi lo'i hor zla 2tshes 4trem gyi bar dge slong mtshams bzhugs kyi srol bzang tshugs/dgung grangs so dgur bzhes pa chu glang gnam lo gsar tshes su ma gcig dpal ldan lha mo rnam gnyis kyi tshes gtor bskangs 'phrin mnga' gsol rten 'bul gang rgyas dang grwa tshang gi tshogs dbur zhabs sor bkod/byusngar lam ltar yongs 'dzin mchog sprul rin po che rnam gnyis dang rje dbon sprul sku/ rgya ra sprul sku/ phyag mdzod chen mo/ gnyer che chung / gsol mgron sogs kyi mjal dar 'bul bzhes sogs dang bla dpon dang mi dpon las sne rnams tshoms chen srid gsum rnam rgyal du bzhugs gral chen por gdan 'dzoms pa'i gral dbur 'phags chen rgyal ba'i dbang po yab sras — 139

rin po che rnams zhabs sor mngon par bkod pa'i mdzad chen snga 'khyud nyams med bskyangs/ bco lnga cho 'phrul dus chen nyin rten gsum la mchod 'bul snyan shal dang / lus pa'i sder mang 'gyed rgya che/ srod 'khor skabs gtor chen gyi mchod sprin mtshar du dngar bar gzigs rtogs mdzad gzhung sa nas gong ma chen por bal bod kyi 'khrug lang thag chod pa'i legs skyes kyi sba yer 'bul bar ser byes tre bo rab 'byams rgyud smad byang rtse mkhan po blo bzang bkra shis can sngon btang pe cin nas phyir log chab mdor byon par 'phags chen rin po che'i sku drung du mjal khar phebs te nang mdzod rtser son dang / gong ma'i bzhes dkar ngo ma/ sku 'gags khyad thon/ dngul rdo tshad ri ba sogs ma ha tsi na'i zong ngo mtshar ba sna tshogs pa'i dngos 'bul phul bar ston mo gang rgyas gnang thog mkhan po blo bzang bkra shis ni 'phags chen dam pa nyid sngon grwa sar bzhugs skabs chos grwar mnyam phebs kyi thugs nang shin tu dag pas gang ci'i gsung mol zhib rgyas dang / khong nyin shas bzhugs ring gsol tshigs lhan rgyas yang yang bzhes pa dang /mdo sngags kyi dka' gnad las brtsams pa'i gsung mchid zhib dal gnang /byang rtse mkhan po blo bkra'i zhus ngor 'phags chen rin po che nas dgongs bstun gyi rjes gnang dang bka' lung kha shas bstsal/ chab mdo 'du gra spyi la'ang 'phags chen rin po che nas byang rtse mkhan po 'di mdo sngags kyi sku yon shin tu che zhing gdan sa chen po'i bdag po yin gshis 'dus spyi nas kyang chos bka' gang 'gab zhus na legs tshul bka' bstsal pa ltar 'du grwa spyi nas bka' chos gang 'thad pa zhig gnang bar zhus don byang rtse mkhan rin po che nas 'dus mang la lam gtso rnam gsum gyi bshad lung 'byams klas pa bka' drin bskyangs/ der dngos 'bul rdo tshad tshan grangs sogs 'bul lam zhus/140

de nas byang rtse mkhan po lha ldan du byon nyer 'phags chen rin po che nas gsol ston rgya che dang / phebs rdzong ja dngul/ lcags chas sna tshogs/thugasaneb zhed kyi gsol dkar stegs dngul tshag ma/ bzed zhal spyi blugs/dngul lter/ phyag tham gsar bskos/ zhal thang kha shas sogs thugs dgyes nges bstsal/ gsol dpon a skong blo bzang dpal ldan khams ma 'tsho ba dang / de rjes gnyer gu ru a nu bu o rgyan rab brtan lnga lam du song ba snga phyi'i byang zhus kyi dngos 'bul rgya cher btegs par 'phags chen dam pa yab sras rin po che sku zhabs grwa tshang gi tshogs pa'i gral dbur phebs te 'das po de dag gi sdig sgrib sbyong mi byang chog bsngo smon yang dag pa bkrin bskyangs/lha ldan nas he gung gi nu bo o 'ba' phyir phebs dang mnyam du dbus tsang gi mi drag dpon rigs 'ga' re yang pe cin du byon dgos pa'i rgya bod kyi dpon rigs de dag sku mdun du mjal khar bcar bar dkar spro dang gsung mchid zhib pa dang / sku 'dra sna tshogs/ lpags rigs/ zur gsos sogs thugs rangs pa bstsal/ slar yang bstan srid la rgya'i rkyen sel du dgongs pa gtad pa'i rgyal bka' rin po che sogs kyi zhabs rim sgrub rgyur chab mdo dgon ma lag gi chos sde che chung mthar chags la khyon ja 'khor drug brgya dang bcu drug dngos pongasna tshogs dngul phab rdo tshad bcu gsum skor gtong bar mdzad/ de nas ri khrod du phyag phebs te thugs dam gzab mo'i bsnyen mtshams la bzhugs/ bal po goraṣa sde dpung dang bcas rtseg med du thal bar brlags pa'i dpa' bo chen po he gung zhes yongs su grags pa de lha ldan nas pe cin du phyir log byed mkhan gu rur slebs pa na/ ri khrod lhun rtse nas 'phags chen rin po che yang gu rur phyag phebs te dmag dpon chen po he gung dang mjal 'dzoms kyis bal bod kyi chings 'grigs lugs 141

dang bal bod 'khrug long byung tshun rgya bod kyi 'grul bzhud shin tu mang bar byung yang chab mdo bas sa tshigs sogs gang phyir legs lam ci che byung lugs sogs kyi gsung mol nang gshin mang po mdzad pa dang / gos chen sogs rgya yul gyi dngos dpyad sna tshog sa dngos 'bul spam mtho btegs/ 'phags chen mchog nas he gung la sku 'dra dang lpags rigs sogs kyi gnang cha rgya che'i rdzong ba bstsal/ de nas 'phags chen mchog chab mdor phyir phebs/ dus skabs de tsam la dka' bcu byams tshad bla ming byams pa blo gros nas chab mdo dgon chen gyi 'dus sder lo ltar 'phags chen yab sras thugs gang lcogs su 〈byang chub lam rim〉gyi gsung chos bkrin skyabs 'jug yod pa'i snyan seng zhus par de don yong 'gro zhes pa'i bka' bzhes thob pa ma zad/ gsung chos skabs kyi mthun rkyen du dad 'byor khag la slong mo bgyis na e 'gab zhus par yang gnang ba bstsal gshis dka' bcu byams pa blo gros nas lhag bsam rnam dag gi sgo nas dad 'byor yon bdag rnams la slong mo zhus pa'i zhal 'debs zam rdo bcu gnyis dang srang nyer lnga tsam byung ba rnams 'phags chen gyi drung du rtsis zhu phul ba'i 'byor 'dzin tham sbyar dad sbyin so sor khams dwangs phul/ gong gsal gyi dngul rnams ser tshogs gnyer par sbyor 'jags mdzad nas lo re'i skyed bun gyi thog nas lo ltar gsung chos gnang skabs mthun rkyen dgos mkho spyod rgyu dang / lo de gsung chos gnang gra 'grigs na gong dngul nas spyod rgyu'i bka' khyab bstsal/rgya dpon krung thang bal bod 'khrugs rtsod skor gyi don gcod du yong nas las don mtha' dag legs grub kyis pe cing du phyir log skabs zla 2tshes 17nyin chab mdor 'byor bas 'phags chen sku 'khor ko chor phebs bsur phebs pa dang / rgya dpon krung thang dang 'phags chen mchog mjal dar sne 142

sprod mdzad rjes gla mdar bzhugs zhag gnang / der krung thang nas 'phags chen rin po che'i bzhugs khri krung thang rang gi gdan gyi gong du mthon por brtsegs pa la 'phagaso chen mchog bzhugs su gsol zhing‘‘khyed ni bstan pa'i dbag po chen po yin yang thag ring por ngos bsu bar phebs pa dang /khyed kyi zhabs 'degs pa rnams kyis kyang gang dgos kyi sgrig cha yag po byas 'dug pas bsam pa shin tu dga' po byung’’zhes sogs zhus nas yid mgu byas/ de nas 'phags chen mchog chab mgon du sngon phebs rjes de'i phyi nyin dgong dro krung thang yang chab dgon du 'byor nas bla brang theg chen pho brang du 'phags chen mchog dang slar yang mjal 'phrad zhus te mjal dar rtse sprod gnang thog dkar spro gzab rgyas bshams/ dngul gyi za ma tog nang bzhugs pa'i jo bo smri ti dzha na'i phyag rtsa ngo ma'i thub dbang gi sku brnyan gcig bstsal zhing / gsung mol zhib rgyas yun ring bskyangs/ de nas krung thang mar thang sgar nang du zhag gsum sdod ring gzan shing dang / rta chag sogs kyi dgos mkho gang gzab chab bla nas btang ba dang / rdzongs su zhal thang dang / lpags rigs/ dre'u nyi shu bcas bstsal/ krung thang nas dngul srang sum brgya tham pa dang / snam sir po spus legs nam 'dengs brgyad/'go snam ser po bub brgyad/ gzhan yang rgya yul gyi dngos dpyad ngo mtshar can du ma bcas phul/ de na sa krung thang ngo 'khor marartsothang nas sgar btegs pa la slar yang 'phags chen yab sras g.yed mda' bar thab skyel du phebs shing / der krung thang dang mjal dar rtse sprod gnang rjes 'phags chen mchog gi sku 'khor chab dgon du sbyir phebs/ krung thang gi phebs skyel du lha ldan nas byon pa phag mo lhas sding pas phyag rten dang bcas 'phags chen gyi mjal phyag tu bcar bar dkar spro gzab rgyas thog gsung mchid zhib lhod 14 3

bskyangs/ de'i phyi nyin lha sding pa'i 'dod mos zhus don bzhin 'phags chen mchog nas tshe dbang bstsal ba dang / gsol ston phebs rdzongs 'dod khengs bstsal/ de rjes krung thang gi blon po ka lan ta 'byor bas mjal phyag tu bcar bar dkar spro dang / gnang cha lpags rigs/ sku 'dra sogs yid mthun bstsal/de nas 'phags chen sku 'khor dben gnas lhun grub rtser phebs/hor zla 6tshes 2nyin rngo la brgal nas ri khrod rde'u gsum mgor bzhugs sgar gnang thog 'phags chen rin po che dang / yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis/rje dbon dkon rdor sprul sku/ phyag mdzod chen mo/ gnyer che chung /gsol gzim/ mgron drung sogs sku 'khor tshang ma dbyar mthong thugs spro bskyangs shing / de'ang bla brang nang gzhung nas nyin brgyad kyi ring rgya bod kyi zas sna ci rigs kyi bsnyen bkur zhabs tog zhus pa dang / de mtshams su yongs 'dzin mchog sprul rnam gnyis kyi phyag gnyer nas bsnyen bkur nyin bzhi re/ de rjes rjes dbon sprul sku nas bsnyen bkur nyin gnyis dang /gsol dpon byams pa rgya mtsho dang byams pa 'od zer gnyis nas nyin gcig bcas kyi bsnyen bkur zhus/ gzhan yang rde'u gsum ri khrod pa spyi pa dang //chibs dpon a bu rgyas/ bsam mdo sde pa/ spu thog dbon khag so so bcas nas kyang tshogs ston dngos 'bul sogs kyi zhabs tog bsgrubs/ spro bsangs grol rjes 'phags chen mchog dang rje dbon sprul sku/ phyag mdzod chen mo bcas lhun rtse ri khrod du phebs pa dang / yongs 'dzin zhi sprul rin po che rde'u gsum ri khrod rang du bzhugs/ yongs 'dzin chos rje ngag dbang sprul sku chab mdor phebs/dus skabs de'i skor tsam la chab mdo dgon gyi nor ma (ru ba) khag 144

rku—cig lha thog pa 'ga' zhig nas 'phrog pas don rkyen g.yul 'brug 'byung la nye ba na 'phagasachen mchog nas rtsod pa zhi phyir bka' shog snga phyir bstsal thogazhi mol byed par gnyer phun tshogs skal bzang dang / rnam rgyal phun tshogs sogs ngo g.yog ched gtong dang 'brel gang myur 'khon 'gras zhi 'jags dgos pa'i bka' slob zab nan bskyangs/ bstan gling lde chung 'phags pa bstan 'dzin chab mdor 'khor zhag tu 'byor ba dang / dza sag bla zur pe cin nas lha ldan du phyir log chab mdor 'byor ba gnyis nas mjal phyag tu bcar bar khungs so sor dkar spro gsung mchid zhib rgyas bstsal/ sku zhabs rnam grol grwa tshang nas lo ltar zla ba rer ma ṇi ril sgrub nyin rgyun mtshan rgyun 'tshogs rgyu sogs la bka' slob bstsal/ de nas 'phags chen sku 'khor chab dgon gdan sar phebs te gong gsal gyi ril sgrub grol nyin tshoms chen du chos khri chen por zhabs sor bkod de sgrub rten gyi ril bu bzhugs pa'i bum pas der 'dus ser skya khrom dmangs la rten dbang bstsal/rgyun par zla re'i dus gtor sogs char can gyi gsung chog khag gong 'phel mdzad/ de lo'i dbyar thog dbus su byon rgyu yin lug sa bka' phebs pa ma zad byes lam du mkho ba'i gzims gur dang / bzhugs gdan/ na bza'/chibs pa chibs rol gyi yo chas/ phebs byams sogs gsar bzo khyad thon spus gtsang dgos pa'i bka' khyab kyang gnang /dgung grangs bzhi bcur bzhes pa shing stag gnam lo gsar du tshes pa'i tshes gcig nyin gsung zhabs 'degs pa dag dang lhan cig 'phags chen mchog nas tshes gtor dang bskangs 'a phrin mnga' gsol rten 'bul gang rgyas phyag len mdzad cing / zhogs snga nas yongs 'dzin mchog sprul rnam gnyis dang / rje dbon sprul sku sku mched sogs dang bla brang gi las 'dzin che 145
