r+shaphra sogs nas sngar srol bzang po ltar mjal dar 'bul lam zhus/ri de nas sku zhabs grwa tshang gi gsung tshogs gral dbur zhabs sor bkod/ 'phags chem/ mchog sprul yab sras zhabs zung bkod pa'i mdun sar gsung rab kun la nang byams chud pa'i dge bshes kyis chos kyi bgro gleng gi spyan zhu phul/tshes 15nyin rten gsum dag la mchod pa snyan shal/ 'dus sder mang 'gyed/ srod 'khor mtshams mchod gzigs gsung chog sogs bskyangs/de nas lhun rtse ri khrod byang chab dga' tshal du zhabs sor bkod/ khang gnyer nas mda' lhun grub yun ring song bas dgongs pa zhus 'phrol tshab a sgrub bu dbang phyug gsar bsko mdzad nas ri khrod bla brang gi rten gsum dang /mchod chas sogs rtsis/ sprod zhib cha byas pa dang / khang gnyer rnying pa lhun grub nas khang gnyer gyi bgyid sgo mtha' dag 'thus tshang byung ba ma zad 'bru sogs 'phar cha che tsam byung bas mgul dar dang / bzang gos kyi gyon pa bcas bstsal ba dang / khang gnyer gsar pa dbang phyug la khang gnyer gyi byed sgo phra rag lha bsam rnam dag dgos pa'i bka' slob zhib rgyas bstsal/'brel rten gsum dang nyer mkho rgyun bzhag dgos rigs rnams phyag deb tu zhib bkod mdzad/ 'di skabs tsam nas yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis sku khams cung mi bde ba'i gnas tshul gsan pas zla 2tshes 15nyin ri khrod nas phyir phebs kyis sman bcos rim gro zhabs tog sogs legs par mdzad pas yongs 'dzin gnyis ka cung dwangs sgyed byung yod kyang tshes 25tsam nas 'phags chen gang nyid ban kan gyi snyun bzhes kyis sku khams cung mi bde bas yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis kyis thugs dam rtags pa mdzad pa'i 'bas brtan sku rim du chab mdo 'dus tshogs dang mnga' 'og gi chos sde ris su ma chad pa dag dang / chab mdo dgon khongs kyi dgon r+sāsde che chung mtha' dag la mang ja 1 snyekhyi

'phar 'gyed sogs dngos 'bul gya nom pa mdzad/ lhag par yongs 'dzin bla ma rnam gnyis nas kyang sku'i rim gro dang zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan pa'i smon lam bden chig smre sngags dang bcas gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab cing / gsol sman skor zhi sprul rin po che nas 'gan bzhes kyis sman dpyad mkhas pa 'gyur med bstan 'dzin dang / skal bzang gzhan phan bcas nas gang gzab zhus rung / zla 4tshes 〈tsam nas sku'i snyun gzhi cung lci tshul bstan pas de bas sku rim sman bcos zhabs tog lhad med zhus kyang zla 5tshes 20skor nas je lcir phebs pas/ dbus gtsang du ra che dang gtsug lag khang / po ta la/ gdan sa che khag sogs kyi rten gsum la mchod sprin dang /skyes chen khag la zhabs brtan sku rim sogs phul/ de nas zhi sprul rin po cher mnal lam du‘‘rtse'i gzim chung rnam rgyal khang bzang du bzhugs khrir 'phags pa lha bzhugs pa nas slar gzhan zhig tu phebs pa rgyang tsam song ba dang byis pa chung ngu skra kham zing ba zhig tshur phebs te rnam rgyal khang bzang gi khri khar bzhugs/ der dpon slob zhi sprul gyis byis pa 'di su 'dra yin gsungs par/ gzhan ser skya ngo shes pa dang mi shes pa 'ga' 'dug pa de dag gis 'di 'phags pa lha'i yang srid yin zer ba byung bas rmi lam mi legs pa 'dug’’ces gsungs/ gzhan yang lo der snga phyir khul der sa g.yos che chung lan mang dang skabs 'gar srod dang tho rengs su nam mkha' nas mar me 'phro ba lta bu'i gza' skar rgyu ba sog sa ltas ngan gyi rtags du ma byung skad/dgung grangs bzhi bcur bzhes pa rab byung bcu gsum pa'i shing stag hor zla 6tshes 10nyin gyi phyi dro nyi ma bzhi cha gcig tsam lus pa'i tshe na sku rlung 'phar ldang che ba'i tshul bzhes kyis gzugs sku chos dbyings su thims tshul bstan pa'o/147

de nas yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis dang rje dbon sprul sku/ phyag mdzod chen mo sogs mya ngan gyi 'khur bzod glags med pa byung zhing / ci bya gtod bral du gyur kyang bzod bsran gyis 'phags chen mchog gi sku gdung rin po cher lha gos kyi stod g.yogs smad g.yogs/ rigs lnga/ dar dpyangs sogs gsol te longs sku'i chas su mdun du sna lnga mchod sprin tshar du dngar ba bsgrigs shing / dbus kyi jo shakya rnam gnyis dang gdan sa che mo bzhi la sogs par stong mchod dang / mang ja/ 'don skul rgya che dang / khyad par rgyal dbang rin po ches gtsos skyes chen dam pa rnams la skyabs rten dngos 'bul rgya cher mdzad/ phyag mdzod chen po blo bzang rdo rje nas mi ring bar 'phags chen mchog gi gser gdung mthong grol chen po byon gtsang gsar du bzhengs skabs gser dngul zangs sogs rgyu tshogs gang 'gro khur len sogs rnam dkar dngos 'byor gyi zhabs 'degs rma med pa dad gdungs chen pos zhu rtsis kyi gsol ba btab/ gzhan yang sku 'khor mnga' 'bangs dang dgon sde khag gi mkhan slob bla sprul khag gis kyang mchode 'bul dang dngos 'byor gyi 'bul ba rgya cher phul/ de nas sku gdungu rin po che zhugs sbyang zhus rjes/ phur khang zhal phye bas sku rus rnams la sku gzugs dang / yig 'bru phyag mtshan gyi rnam pa gsal bar bzhugs 'dug pa rnams gtsang sbra dang bcas te rin po che'i snod du bzhugs su gsol ba la dri bzang dang sbag pa'i 'o chab bum chu dang bcas pas 'khru ba sogs dam pa'i phyag len ltar bzhugs su gsol/ de nas sku rus cha tshang ba ma 'thor bar rin po che sna tshogs pa dang / sman sna spos sna sogs dang bsres te zhib mor brtul ba 'jim pa bzang po dang sbags te slar yang srid mchog sprul rin po sku tshe zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan pa'i rten 'brel du dgongs pa'i mgon po 148

tshe mtha' yas pa dang / lhung bshags sangs rgyas so lnga sogs sangs rgyas byang sems sna tshogs pa'i sku grangs shin tu mang pa'i spar btab pa las gser gyi mchod sdong chen po'i nang rten du zhugs rgyu rnams la tshon gtong sogs gang legs zhus shing / phyag mdzod chen po blo bzang rdo rje mchog gis 'phags chen 'di nyid kyi gser gdung ni 'phags chen sku phreng lnga pa'i gser gdung chen mo bas kyang spus ma zhan pa legs skrun zhus yod pa bcas so/'phags pa lha sku phreng brgyad pa/'phags pa lha sku phreng brgyad pa/ blo bzang 'jigs med dpal ldan bstan pa'i nyi ma ni/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i shing yos 1795lor li thang du 'khrungs/ me 'brug zla shrītshes1la/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng brgyad pa 'jal dpal rgya mtsho dang srid skyong rta tshag no mon han bod bzhugs sung am ban/ he am ban bcas lhan 'dzoms kyis pho brang po ta la'i 'phags pa lo ke shwa ri'i spyan sngar gong ma'i 'dra thang mdun gser bum brtag nas thon pa bzhin gong mar gser snyan sgron par bod bzhugs sung am ban brgyud gong mas gser yig dang / kha btags che ba gcig tshe dpag med kyi sku rten/tshe mdo'i glegs bam/ byang chub mchod rten/ rdo dril/ g.yang ṭi'i ru yi/byu ru'i phreng bar in+d+ra nī la sogs kyis brgyan pa/ rgya khug cha gsum/mdzod gos yug bzhi bcas bstsal ba'i gzigs bzos thob/ dgung lo bzhi gsum rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i me lug (1shrī47)lor gshegs/'phags pa lha sku phreng dgu pa/'phags pa lha sku phreng dgu pa/ 'phags pa mkhas grub ngag dbang blo 149

bzang 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan ni/ rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i sa bya (1〈49)lor li thang khul du 'khrungs/ —chu bya'i zla 6tshes 12 tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gcig pa mkhas grub rgya mtsho mchog la snyan zhus dang 'brel srid skyong rwa sgreng ngag dbang ye shes tshul khrims mchog dang bod bzhugs am ban lhan rgyas nas lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi jo bo shwakya mu ne'i spyan snga dang / po ta lar gong ma'i 'dra thang mdun gser bum ngakrugs te thon pas gong mar gser snyan sgron 'brel gong lo'i zla 9tshes 22la gdan sar 'khod/ gong ma zhan hong gis bod bzhugs jimam ban brgyud bka' yig dang gnang rten kha btags che ba gcig gser zangs kyi tshe dpag med/ tshe mdo'i gleg bam/ dngul gyi rnam rgyal mchod rten g.yu byur gyi khra rgyan can/ gzhan yang rdo dril dang / g.yang ṭi'i ru'i ye/ byu ru'i phyag phreng mu tig gi grangs rta can/ gos chen gyi khug ma che ba gcig chung ba bzhi mdzod gos yug bzhi bcas bstsal/rab byung bco lnga pa'i me yos(1rdo67)hor zla 2tshes 2nyin tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gnyis pa'i mtshan thog nasaṃ bstsal ba'i bka' rgya'i zhal bshus su‘‘nyag sked dmag don skabs de ga bla brang khongs gtogs dang bcas nas spyi khyab bka' blon gyi ngag bkod dang blangs kyis dmag phogs yod 'don dang / skyel 'dren yul dmag bskul gtong sogasku gang cir khar bsam thogamadzod pa nas kyang phogs khang las khur la lhag bsam mi dman pa 'thus tshang byung bar brten sngon du bod bzhugs blon chen la wang shu zhib 'khod phul te gnam gyi lha yi thugs rje bskul bas bka' drin 'phar ma'i gzigs bzos bdag rkyen rtsal thub zhus 'brel bzhin nye 'char gong ma bdag po chen po'i wang shu rir 'byor bka' mchan phyir phebs dgongs don/ de ga 'phags 150

pa lha ho thog thur ji yon chan zhi'i cho lo dang / byams brtse'i dpal ldan dngos gyur zhes pa'i paṇa yig las byed mdzod pa dar han gyi cho lo brgyud 'dzisadang / 'phags pa lha ho thog thu sku phreng gong ma'i tsha bo skal bzang la rim pa bzhi pa'i tog dang rma bya'i sgro mdongs brgyab 'thus bcas gsol ras bstsal thob skor de gar gnang rgyu'i sbrag yig dang sbrags 'dir gnang 'byor byung ba gos sang ser po'i ngos su rgya man sog bod kyi yi ge bzhi 'byar dam 'khod kyi paṇa ngo ma dang / am ban gyi sprag yig skog ldan bcas zur du phul yod pa de gar 'byor bstun sprul pa'i sku nyi dang / mdzod pa 'phags pa bstan 'dzin sku tsha skal bzang bcas nas gong ma chen po'i bka' drin la gus phyag dang 'brel ba'i slar yang gnam gyi lhar thugs rje che zhu'i sku rten kha btags sogs 'bul gnang mdzad 'os sngar lam la zhib 'jug gis gnang lugs thugs 'jags 'tshal’’zhestobastsal yodartepa dang de 'brel am ban gyi sbrag yig kyang btang 'byor byung 'dugarab byung bco lnga pa'i sa glang (1ṭ+wāṃr9) hor zla 6tshes 21nyin gong ma'i bka' mngags phu ru thung gi go gnas 'dzin pa bod sdod blon chen hrin am ban nas gong ma'i bka' yig zhadze+egeshus dang 'brel bkod rgya btang don‘‘zhib na nged blon chen nas kwang zhus khri bzhugs bcu gnyis pa/ rab byung bco lnga pa'i me khyi zla 11tshes 1ṭ+wāṃnyin sa mtshams nas phyag 'tshal thog gser snyan sgron domādu/ brag chab phan tshun rtsod 'khrug gi lo bcu bzhi bar lab rtsod byung skor bka' yig dgongs don la brtsi 'jog gis las don zhus thog 'khrug gcod zin pas kho pa ho— thogathu dang / don rtsa 'di skor las don byed mi dpon rigs che chung la dbyer+ṣa'abyed bab bltas kyi gzigs bzos gnang lugs zhu rgyu'i dral tse 3phul sdor da lam kwang zhus khri bzhugs bco lnga pas 151

zla 2tshes 20nyin bka' mchan phyir phebs su bka' zur du yod gzigs/bka' don brtsi 'jog yong ba gyis zhes byung ba ltar/ gong ma'i bka' yig tu ‘hrin tha'e nas gser snyan sgron don brag g.yab dang chab mdo phan tshun rtsod 'khrug bgyis skor bka' yig dgongs don la brtsi 'jog gis las don zhus thog 'khrug gcod zin pas kho pa ho thog thu dang 'di skor shed shugs 'bul mi dpon rigs che chung la gzigs bzos gnang lugs yod pa zhes dral tse phul gsal kwang zhus khri bzhugs bzhi pa'i lo nang brag g.yab nas dpung dmag btang ste chab mdo'i sa gnas mtha' skor thog mi bsad 'phrog bcom bgyis te phan tshun gyi mi mang rnams rtsod gzhi lo mang byung ba da cha hrin tha'e nas zhib dpyod dpon rigs bsko bzhag gi bkod khyab tsha nan thog go gsed bkod pa zhib nan song zhing / brag g.yab ba nas 'phrog khyer bgyis pa'i dngos po rnams phyir slog dang 'brel ba'i bskyin bsgrigs byed dus mtshon zhu bshags bgyis thog slar yang hrin tha'e nas chab mdo bar rgya srang chig stong tham pa gsol ras sprad de kho pa gnyis kyi ho thog thu nas don rtsa 'khrun chod zin pa'i snyan zhu phul 'byor sogs las don byed sgo rnams 'thus tshang byung gshis/ 'di skor shed shugs 'bul mi si khron du gre li kra'u gyi go sa 'phral bsko byed rgyu'i lha ri phogs dpon ci'i drin 'un la rim pa bzhi pa'i go sa gsol ras sprad pa dang / chab mdo 'phags pa lha dang / mdzod pa nor bu tshe dbang bcas nas lar rgya bzang po zhib rtogs kyis pham khur thog mi mang la chun 'doms bgyis stabs gzhan ma'i don rtsa 'phar thon ma byung ba ma zad/ de khul sa gnas su dpung che cher byung kyang khral ni sngar rgyun zhabs 'degs hur bskyed zhus te 'thus shor med pa 'di dag gang legs byung ba bcas jis dbyon hran si chab mdo 'phags pa lha hozuthog thu er te ningag 152

dbang blo bzang 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan la man hru'u yig tshang han min la bkod khyab thog paṇa yig zhis 'char bris kyi gsol ras su sprad de rtsis len zhus phyin gzengs bstod du phan pa yong ched dang / phyogs mtshungs chab mdo mdzod pa dar han nor bu tshe dbang la dza sag gi go ming 'phar ma gsol ras song ba dang / mdzod pa'i las 'khur gsar 'dzin skal bzang yon tan nas phan tshun gnyis la bar 'dum byed sgo 'thus legs byung bar tā bla ma'i go ming gsol ras song zhing / spa tsong krang 'un yon la las thog tu phyan tsong gi go sa gsol ras song ba dang / yig 'bri drung yig le'u rgyun dang / krung yon gyin bcas la rdzung ji'u phin gyi go sa sbyor khang nas bsko bzhag bgyis phyin phan pa yong ched bcas de byings 'char 'bul zhus gsal ltar las don bgyis 'thus la khyod rang ya mon nas nges pa'i bka' don la brtsi 'jog yong ba gyis’zhes spyi phebs byung ba bcas de'i ched bka' yig zhal bshus thog rgya bod shan sbyar gyi bkod rgya 'di bzhin btang ba khyed rang dza sag bla ma nas de 'phral bka' don la brtsi 'jog gis nges dgos la/ de don 'gal med yong ba gyis/ kwang zhus khri bzhugs bco lnga pa/sa glang zla 6tshes 21lang’’zhes gsal/ dgung grangs nga gnyis bzhes pa rab byung bco lnga pa'i lcags byi (19rkyarkya)lo gshegs/ — 'phags pa lha skye phreng bcu pa/ 'phags pa lha sku phreng bcu pa/— blo bzang thub bstan mi pham tshul khrims rgyale mtshan ni/ rab byungakebaco lngo pa'i lcags glang (1901) lor/153

smar khams rdo 'bum sgang du yab ye shes chos 'phel dang / yum tshul khrims sgrol dkar gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gesum pa dang / bod bzhugs sung am ban skabs jo bo shākya mu ne'i spyan sngar gser bum brtag dpyad nas thon te chab mdo'i khrir bkod/ dgung grangs bcu gcig rab byung bco lnga pa'i chu byi ( 1912) lor kra'o er phung gi rjes 'jug phin thung lin nas chab mdo bla dgon phyi nang snod bcud mer bsregs rtsa brlags btang bas chags gnas bral te nyen g.yol dang chabs cig lha sar chos lugs slob gnyer du phebs nas gsan bsam slob gnyer gnang ba dang / tā la'i bla ma bcu gsum pas/ ‘‘blo bzang thub bstan mi pham tshul khrims rgyal mtshan’’zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/ snga rjes su rgya ra 'jigs med chos kyi dbang phyug yongs 'dzin du bsten nas smin grol gyi gdam pa mang po zhus/dgung grangs bcu bdun rab byung bco lnga pa'i sa rta (191ṭ+wāṃ) lor dgon gnas nyams gso'i don du tā la'i bla ma bcu gsum par snyan zhu phusnyesmu don slob gnyer mjug skyong mtshan btags len rgyu dang bsnyen rdzogs sgrub rgyur dgon pa gzhi rkang nyams gso tshar bstun slar yang gdan sar zhabs bcar zhu rgyu'i dgongs khrol zhus smin gyis rab byung bco lnga pa'i sa lug dgung grangs bco brgyad bzhes skabs chab mdor phyir phebs kyis dgon gnas gsar bzhengs kyi rtsa 'dzin gtan tshigs sa lug she bam gtan 'bebs sogs kyi las don gnang mur/ rab byung bco lnga pa'i lcags spre dgung grangs bcu dgu'i bzhes lor rigs ma bsten bzhes la brten tā la'i bla ma bcu gsum pas phyin chad dge ldan gyi bstan 'dzin bla sprul che khag nas bstan rtsa so thar gyi bca' khrims ras su bor ba'i bag med 'chol spyod mi yong ba'i 154

phyis lar 'chun 'doms ched 'phags pa lha'i ho thog thu'i go gnas dbyungs te gser yig las tham mdo spyi bka' bla nas dam bsnan dang 'brel chab bla nas dpon g.yog bdun gyi gsol phogs phul te dben pa'i ri khrod cig tu bshags sdom gyi bcad rgyar sdod dgos pa sogs kyi bkod rgya tsha nan phebs 'brel 'phags pa lha'i chos srid kyi las tshab zhi ba lha sku phreng drug pa bstan 'dzin 'phrin las bsko gzhag gis 'phags pa lha bcu pa de nyid mar thang grong khul bzhugs khang zhan po zhig tu zur bzhugs gnang dgos pa byung yod/'on kyang sde dgon mi ser bcas pas 'phags pa lhar ho thog thu'i sgo gnas yod pa'i skabs ltar brtsi bkur dad gus zhus pa dang / 'phags pa lha gang nyid nas kyang sngar gyi go gnas dbyungs kyang chab mdo'i dgon 'bangs thugs blos ma btang bar dgon pa nyams gso'i las don la mu mthud thugs 'khur bzhes shing / dpa' shod ra sprul gdan drangs te 'dus grwar dge tshul slong gi sdom pa 'bog 'jug pa dang / dbang lung zhu 'jug pa/ kar mda' khri sprul gdan drangs te rgyud sde'i dbang dang / bka' bstan gyi lung rgyun spel thabs mdzad/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags rta ( 1920)dgung grangs nye dgu bzhes lor mtshan nyid grwa tshang bskyar tshugs kyi thebs rtsar bla brang gi gzhung 'dzin sa rtswa gzhis ka dang / bla brang gi sku rten dang gtong deb bcas sbyor 'jags bstsal ba dang / bla dpon khag la chos gzhis sbyor 'bul dgos pa'i skul slong / dpe cha slob khrid gnang mkhan nyin lung rdza sprul 'jam dpal rol pa'i blo gros la mngag bcol gzhogs 'degs thog 'phags pa lha gang nyid nas mtshan grwa'i mtshan 'dzin mkhan po'i thugs 'gan bzhes shing / brtsi bzhag sogs mkhan po'i byed sgo lag bstar dngos bskyangs mkhan kun rigs grwa tshang khongs rgan tshe ring don grub 155

bskos/ rigs pa'i sgo 'byed bsdus grwa che chung dang / blo brtag grub don sa gsum bcas kyi rtsod grwa dam 'dzin gyis shing slong dam bca' dang de min mtshan sbyong dam bca'i skabs 'dzin grwa so sor ngo phebs kyi rtags gsal gtong rogs gnang ba sogs 'chad nyan gong 'phel yong thabs do 'khur chen po gnang / sngon 'gro 'bum bzhi dang / dmigs brtse ma/ 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i las rung bcas gtong mkhan gyi mtshams grwa dang /'jigs byed bdud lagarnam rgyal gyi bsnyen chen gyi mtshams grwa gsar du btsugs/ snga ma'i go gnas kyi las tham do dam song yang gang nyid nas rjed du the'u gsar skrun gnang nas mi ser nyams dman rnams la khral yang dang bun yang bka' 'dzin gnang ba sogs don dngos thog go gnas yod skabs dang khyad med kyi dgon 'bangs yongs la phan yod kyi phyag las rab dang rim pa gnang bas tshang mas dang len brtsi bkur zhu/ mchog dman bar ma tshe 'das skabs snyan seng zhus 'phral 'bul ngo che chung la mi gzigs par phung po'i 'gram du phebs nas 'pho ba gsal 'debs kyi cho ga dang thugs smon zab smin bskyang ba dang / dad 'bul sogs dngos rdzas gang byung rnams skabs 'phral yar mchod mar sbyin las bdag tu mi bzung zhing / zhar long rgan 'khogs nad mnar 'tsho rten bral ba nyams thag rnams dang / gra rkyang rten med dbul khongs rnams la lhag par brtse zhing zas gos sogs gnang sbyin gso skyong mdzad/lo ltar chab dgon dgun chos tshugs skabs grwa tshang khag so sor ma chod pa rnam lnga stong phrag re dang / tshogs bzhugs dge 'dun par nyin 'khyongs bsnyen bkur gzab rgyas dang / sku 'gyed bcas gnang nyin grwa tshang so sor phebs te mchod pa grangs tshang yod med dang / spus gtsang byung yod med 156

sogs gzigs zhib gnang thog tshogs pa'i gral mjug tu bzhugs nas gsol ja bzhes thug sogs dge 'dun pas bzhes spro ba yag po byung yod med kyang thugs zhib gnang rjes mchod bsnyen thugs la babs nges yag po byung med pa dgongs tshe phyi nyin gtong sgo zhu mi'i las byed su yin la bka' bkyon drag po gnang ba ma zad/ skabs 'gar gang nyid sku ngo mas phyag 'jug kyang tsha nan gnang gi yod pa/ dad ldan khag nas gzim shag rang du bzhugs rogs gnang zhes sku rten nam/ mchod rdzas sogs phul ba rnams grwa tshang gang nyam zhan de dang der spyi 'jog gam/nga ba las gang gi bzhugs shag tu bdag nyar mi gnang ba/ degasngon me shor gyi bla brang gzim khang le lag zhig ral du lus bsdad kyang‘‘mi ser la brdab mnar mi byed’’ces gsungs te nyams bzo ma gamang bar bzhag gnang ba sogs mdor na gang de'i sadzad spyod la mdo spyis gtsos gzhung gi sku drag dang / rdzong khag gi bla dpon mi drag ser skya su dang su yin na yang mang che bas 'phags pa lha'i mdzad spyod ni grub thob kyi mdzad pa bstan pa zhig red ces dad gus brtsi 'jog byed pa zhig byung bas sde dgon 'go gco bcas pa'i gcig gyur gyi ngos 'dzin du 'phags pa lha sku phreng bcu pa 'dis rigs ma bsten bzhes sogs thog mar mdzad spyod mi mdzes pa zhig byung yang / dgon pa bskyar gso dang / mtshams grwa mtshan grwa bcas gsar 'dzugs/ mi ser la byams brtse'i thugs 'khur gnang stangs rmo sogs mdzad pa je bzang song zhing / da phan 'phags pa lha sku phreng dang po nas bcu pa bar bla slob rmās dad dam tshig gi 'brel ba dam zab yod pa ma zad gong ma khri rabs rim pas 'phags pa lha skuphreng rnams la chab mdo dgon sde mnga' ris 'dzin skyong dbang bskur ba'i cho lo las tham/ gser yig bcas rim rtsal gzhir bzung tā la'i bla ma sku phreng rim pa dang srid skyong rim 157

can nas kyang 'phags pa lha sku phreng rim pa'i mtshan lung lar rgya'i 'dzin dbang lha mi sde bcas rtsod med gtan 'jags gtan tshigs kyis chod yod pa bzhin/ da lta'i sku phreng bcu pa'i go ming gnas dbyung btang ba 'di slar gso ma byung phyin sku phreng rjes ma rnams la'ang chu ngan lam zhugs lta bu'i phugs kyi gnod skyon yong gzhir snyam ste chu bya(1rdzo22)lo sde dgon spyi mgrin nas tā la'i bla ma bcu gsum par 'phags pa lha gang 'di'i go ming bskyar gso yong ba'i re 'dun snyan zhu dang sbrags spyi 'thus rtse bla brang gi mgron gnyer don rgyal lha sar mngags gtong byas/skabs der bka' thag ma chod gong tā la'i bla ma mchog dgongs pa rdzogs rung srid skyong rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes nas gnang ba'i srid tham 'go mchan du‘‘'phags pa lha'i mtshan lung go gnas sngar lugs bskyar gso chog 'thus dang / chos phyogs rab byung sdom pa 'bog chog sogs bla tshab dkon rdor sprul sku nas 'khur bzhes dgos’’zhes phebs don ltar rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing khyi(1924) dgung grangs 22bzhes lo hor zla 9tshes 22nyin 'phags pa lha bcu pa'i mtshan gnas bskyar gso'i khri gsol gyi mdzad sgo bskyangs shing / klu sding sa nas chab dgon du phebs byams sogs chibs phreng mdzad chen gyis phebs par skabs de'i mdo spyi bkras mthong pas mkhan rim sogs las bya yongs rdzogs chibs bsur mngags gtong thog mdo spyi ngo mas mdzad sgo tshugs yul gyi mgon khang sgo 'phyor nayophebs bsu zhus pa dang / mdzad sī'i bzhugs khri sogs chab blas sngon tshud nas gra sgrig zhus shing / thog mar 'phags pa lhas tā la'i bla ma bcu gsum pa'i sku brnyan la sku phyag dang bcas maṇ+ḍal rten gsum dang mjal dar nang mdzod 'bul gnang mdzad/ de nas bzhugs khrir 'khod 158

bstun chab bla nas gsol ja bzhes 'bras dang dkar spro bstar mtshams de sngon bka' blas dam bsnan byas pa'i dam phrug spyan zhus thog dam rgya bkrol nas nang mdzod kyis lcib sde mdo spyis 'phags pa lhar phul grub bstun thog rol snyan gsan dang bcas spyi mdzod rin chen don grub nas spos snas gdan drangs shing / mdo spyi ngo las dang bcas lhan phebs kyis chab bla'i tshoms chen nang 'phags pa lha'i bzhugs khri zhal lho gzigs kyi g.yas su mdo spyi'i bzhugs khri dang / de gsham mkhan rim sogs mdo las rnams kyi bzhugs gdan/ g.yon du zhi lcags dkon phyag sogs chab mdo bla dgon las byed kyi khri gdan so sor bzhugs gral 'khod nyid bla brang nang gzhung nas sngar gyi khri gsol las don ltar dgyes ston chen mo gzab rgyas bskyangs shing / dang po gzhung sa'i khri 'bul dang / brag bla'i sku tshab ched gnyer nas khri 'bul bstar zin mtshams bla khag gi khri 'bul yig lam deb don bzhin bstar rjes mdzad sgo grub nas rtse gzim shag tu phebs te gsol ja bzhes 'bras 'degs 'bul dang / mdo spyi nas maṇ+ḍal rten gsum dang 'brel sku sger khri 'bul bstar ba dang / de mtshams mdo las tshang mas maṇ+ḍal rten dod dang rten 'bul phul ba sogs grub bstun thog rol snyan gsan dang bcas gnyer ches spos sne dang bla dgon las byed nas mdo spyi phebs bskyel zhus/spyi mdzod rin chen don grub las 'khur dgongs zhus kyis spyi mdzod kyi las tham gong 'bul zhus te chos srid gnyis ka'i thugs 'gan 'phags pa lha bcu pas bzhes nas dgon pa'i 'dul khrims bca' sdom gyis mchon dgon 'bangs 'tsho skyong gi las don khag tshags su tshud pa gnang ba dang / lhag par du sngar phan chab dgon mer bsregs kyis phyi nang snod bcud bshad sgrub dang bcas pa nyams chag song ba sa rta nas bskyar gso byas kyang sngar bzhin 159

'thus tshang de tsam byung med pa'i gnas tshul 'og cho ga phyag len sogs mdo sngags gang cir rje rin po che'i bzhed srol dri ma med pa bstan rgyun sngar mus rkang tshugs pa zhig yong ba'i ched du pha bong kha rin po che chab mdor gdan zhur las byed lha sar ched gtong dang 'brel mdo smad khul gyi dgon sde mtha' dag la bka' chos zhu bar yong dgos pa'i skul slong gi bkod yig bkram pa dang / mdo sngags kyi zab chos zhu 'os 'char gzhi dang bla ma sku 'khor bzhugs rgyun gyi gsol chas bzhugs sgrig chibs dre'u gi chag gzan sogs gang cir bla ma'i mnyes pa bsgrub pa'i sri zhu phu dud zhu 'os gang na ci mchis 'char gzhi gtan 'bebs dang 'brel zhabs zhu ba bla dgon las byed ched bskos gnang ba sogs gra sgrigo 'thus tshang gnang /de rjes rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing phag (1925) lo hor zla 9tshes 22lha bab dus chen nyin pha bong kha rin po che chab mdor zhabs sor 'khod skabs phebs bsu ser sbrengs sogs bkur bste sri zhu bla med zhus/ pha bong kha rin po ches bka' chos gsung skabs〈lang kar gshegs pa〉mdo'i sha'i nyes dmigs gsungs te dge 'dun pas rnam gsum ma dag pa'i bsngos sha longs spyod mi rung tshul bka' slob gnang don 'phags pa lhas de don mjug gnon gnang nas slad rtse shod bla khag tshang mas sngar mus sgo bshas mi chog pa'i bka' bcad mtha' 'doms gan bzhes gnang tshun sha dkar nag khrom nas nyo spyod las bla dgon nas sgo bshas bya rgyu mtshams gcod thub pa byung / de skabs rang khongs chab mdo'i ma bu dgon gyi bla sprul dang / dge bshes grwa dmangs/ gzhan yang sho star lho gsum/ dang / dpa' brag smar mdzo gsang gsum sogs mdo smad rdzong khag dang / yun nan yan gyi bla sprul dge bshes sogs dad ldan ser skya mang po 'dus/ gong tshes nas phyi lo me byi zla 160

9tshes 2 2bar lo 'khor gcig ring pha bong khas mdo sngags zab rgyas smin grol gdams pa'i chos 'khor chen mo tshugs pas mdo khams bstan 'gro'i gsos su smin pa mdzad/de sngon lcags rta lor mtshan nyid grwa tshang btsugs te bsdus gra nas phar phyin bar tshugs kyang / gzhung chen bka' pod gzhan dag gzhi nas tshugs rgyur song dpe khrid dge bshes mkhas grub gnyis ldan zhig gdan 'dren zhu 'os skor 'phags pa lhas pha bong kha rin po che dang bka' mol zhib gnang mthar pha bong kha'i zhal slob mdo sngags gnyis mkhas ser byes dge bshes tsha ba byams pa mtha' yas rang phan thogs che ba dgongs pa rtse mthun bzhin 'phags pa lhas dge bshes de nyid mngags gtong yong thabs pha bong khar bka' mngags nan tan zhus thog 'phags pa lha gang nyid sngar grwa sar gsan bzhes skabs thugs rgyus yod don bstan rgyun la dgongs bzhes kyis chab dgon du cis kyang phebs dgos pa'i zhu yig dang sbrags mtshan grwa'i las sne tshe ring bkris ngo g.yog gdan zhur ched gtong gnang / de rjes pha bong kha rin po che phebs byams dang bcas lha sar phebs bskyel zhus/ de skabs paṇa chen er te ni sku phreng dgu pa mchog nang sa nas bod la chibs zhal bsgyur te skye rgur phebs par pha bong kha rin po che yang der phebs nas mjal 'phrad gnang / paṇa chen rin po ches 'phags pa lha'i mdun mjal 'phrad gnang dgos pa'i bka' yig phebs kyang rgyu rkyen 'ga' zhig gi rkyen pas de skabs 'phags pa lha phebs rgyu'i rngo ma thogs shing / 'tshams zhu'i snyan zhu 'bul ba bcas phul/ de rjes mi ring bar paṇa chen rin po che skye rgur sku gshegs pa'i gnas tshul 'byor par chab dgon nas dgongs rdzogs mchod sprin bsta ra/161

me byi(1926)hor zla 10pa'i zla mjug tu khyung po khul gyi sde dgon nas gdan zhu nan cher brten 'phags pa lha khyung po spe rur phebs bzhugs yod mur/ khul de'i dgon khag nas gdapa zhus snyan zhu phul bas pha bong kha rin po che khyung skye rgu nas khyung mer phebs par slar yang 'phags chen dang mjal 'phrad gnang skabs gsol ja zhu mi yang bkag ste khong rnam pa gnyis sku rkyang gis mtshan mo yun ring zhig gsung mol gnang ba'i nang don ni sus kyang ma rtogs/ khul de'i skya ser la bka' dbang sogs 'dod chos gnang grub bstun pha bong kha rin po che chibs zhal bsgyur/ 'phags pa lha sde dgon gyi zhu mos ltar de'i phyi lo ste me glang sos thog bar khul der bzhugs nas ser skya'i re 'dun bskangs/ de nas chab mdor phyir phebs gnang rjes sku khams cung bskun tshul bstan pas zhabs rim dang / brtan bzhugs gsol ba thengs mang btab kyang dwangs bskyed ma byung bar mthar rab byung bcu drug pa'i me glang ( 1rdzo27) lo'i zla 9tshes 2ṭ+wāṃdagung lo 26thog zhing gzhan du gshegs/de'i sngon klu sding gling kha'i nang gi shing ba sis rnams la dbyar kha nang bzhin me tog khra chil chil bzhad pa ni 'phags pa lha sku gshegs pa'i mtshan myo ra mngon zhes rjes su gleng / yang srid myur byon gsol 'debs dang sbrags mnga' khongs dgon sder 'das brda bkod rgya bkram/ sku gdung dgon du gdan 'dren zhus te zla 9pa'i zla mjug nas bcu pa'i zla dkyil bar bla khag dang las byed/ dgon yul spyi sger tshang mas nyin mtshan bar mtshams ma chad par gdung mchod dang gdung 'bul bstar zhing / gling me spor ba dang / rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod byed pa/ dge 'dun la mang 'byed gtong ba sogs thugs dgongs rdzogs thabs rnam dkar 162

dge tshogs kyi rim pa gang na ji 'os bsgrubs mthar/ rgyud sde'i dgongs don bsregs chog dang 'brel bar sku gdung zhugs 'bul zhus te phur khang zhal phye skabs/ rdzo lho sprul sku dkon mchog 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i gsol 'debs su‘‘sprul gzhi sngon bstan seng ge sgra la sogs/ rang byung ring bsrel bstan 'gro'i dpal du bzhag rgyal ba 'phags pa lha la gsol ba 'debs’’zhes bstan pa ltar thugs ljags spyan gsum seng ge sgra'i sku'i rnam pa can gong bur bzhugs pa dang / yung 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel phon che byon pa gdung rten mchod sde nang bzhugs su gsol ba dang / rtse'i rten sgam nang dam bcas byas pa/ bla dgon las byed ser skya dad mos can rnams la dad rten du sprad pa sogs byas/ chab mdor gdung rten mchod sdong bzhengs grub pa dang lha sar dgongs rdzogs mchod 'bul gtong dmigs bla brang rtse shod nas rkang len thog bla khag dang las byed dgon 'bangs dang bcas pas mchod sprin zhal 'debs 'bul srol yig lam ltar bsdu len byas te rtse shod gnyis nas gnyer che gcig dang / rtse gnyer gcig cho 'khrul smon lam dang bstun lha sar ched thon gyis gtsug lag khang smon lam tshogs chen dang /gzhan yang gdan sa chen po bzhi dang rgyud grwa stod smad sogs su mchod 'bul bsten bkur/ sku 'gyed/ sbyor 'jags/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pa mchog gis dbus sprul sku che khag la dgongs rdzogs sbyang rten 'bul ba sogs sngar lam ltar grub mtshams slar yang srid sprul sku'i skor thugs dam zhus te phyir log gis yang srid brtsad gcod zhus/'phags pa lha bcu pa de nyid kyi brtsams chos kyang 'go log nyin lung rdza sprul 'jam dpal rol pa'i blo gros dang / bsam mdo sde pa tshang gi mtshams bla dgon po srung sogs nas bskul ma zhus pa'i sger srung 〈zhang paṇa gyi brkang 163

'phrin/〉dang 〈byang chub lam gyi rim par nyams su len tshul gyi gdams pa〉〈snga gas lam gyi nyams rtogs 'char tshul do ha rdo rje'i glu dbyangs〉 〈lha chos dang mi chos kyi bslab bya〉sogs gsung rtsom thor bu 'ga' ༅/sa yod/gong gsal dge bshes rin po che byams pa mtha' yas mchog 'phags pa lha 'tsho bzhugs skabs chab mdor zhabs so ra ma 'khod kyang khong gis gdan zhus bka' yig dang pha bong kha'i bka'aci mngags bcas la brten rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa yos lor chab mdor phebs nas rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa glang lo'i zla 10tshes 12nyin dgongs pa ma rdzogs bar lo bcu'i ring chab mdor gtan chags su bzhugs nas gdan sa chen po nang bzhin gyi sgrig lam kun spyod/ bka' pod lnga'i rtsod gra/ rigs chung gra skor/ phar phyin gtong lugs/ dge bshes kyi mtshan btags gtong rgyu/ mdo sngags kyi gsung chos rjes su mtshan btags btang zin rnams nas gsang 'dus 'grel pa bzhi sbrags kyi dam bca' tshugs rgyu'i rmang grezhi 'ding bar mdzad/ rgyud sde'i bka' dbang so gas sgo gang thad nas dge ldan ring lugs kyi bstan rgyun dri ma med pa rkang tshugs pa zhig gnang ba ma zad/ gong du dargon pa'i 'du sgo mchod rgyun skor bkod yod pa ltar 'phags pa lha bcu pa 'das rjes rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa stag lor chab dgon spyi bso las zur 'ariga' shas nas dgon pa'i 'du sgo thad bla brang las byed nas lta rtog bya gi med lugs gzhung la snyan zhu phul nas mdo spyi dza sag sbrel pos bla dgon zlos zhib phan tshun zhu ba zhu lan gyis te rtsod gleng yun ring byas pa 'khrun thas/ ma chod pas mdo spyi gnang byung skabs rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags sbrul lor mdo las rim bzhi sku mda' snye mdo dang / mdo spyi'i phyag mdzod nyi ma phun tshogs gnyis nas klong 'bebs zhus smin bzhin bla dgon sel med dam gtsang gnyis sman 164

'jags bde'i bar 'dum gnang ba'i 'dum nag snol 'jog byas yod cing /de snga 'phags lha dgu pa'i skabs bla dgon rtsod thug dam sel gyi ngan 'bras byung bar brten dge bshes rin po ches bka' cho sa skabs bla ma dang dgon pa'i bar rtsod gleng dam sel mu mthud shar tshe bla dgon mi ser dang bcas par bkra mi shis pa yong lugs bka' slob ya nga yang gnang bas tshang ma sems khug nas dam tshig nyams gso'i ched dge bshes rin po che'i zhabs nas bla dgon las byed ga dmangs mang tshogs yongs kyis spyan ras gzigs kyi bka' dbang zhus te slad char bla dgon bar dam sel 'byung gzhi'i rnyog ma gting slong su thad nas mi byed rgyu'i dam bca' mtha' gtsang phul pa bcas bla dgon mthun sgril dam gtsang lhad med bkra shis lugs legs byung yod/'phags pa lha sku phreng bcu gcig/ pa/'phags pa lha sku phreng bcu gcig pa blo bzang bstan 'dzin dge legs rnam rgyal(mtshan 'di gdan sar chos zhugs skabs tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi par zhus bstsal zhabs brtan gsol 'debs kyi mtshan bkra ltar yin)li thang dgon chen dang nye ba mtsho gsum pa'i khongs a mdo grong sna lu tshang ngam/chu bskor tshang zhes par yab blo bzang ngag dbang dngu yum rig 'dzin sgrol ma gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa yos(1929) hor zla 12tshes 8nyin bltams/ sku phreng bcu pa'i yang sring ngos 'dzin dang gdan zhu'i skor/ 165

'phags pa lha sku phreng bcu pa'i yang srid rtsad gcod zhu phyogs thad skabs de'i chab dgon gyi chos srid 'khur 'dzin dkon rdor dang / spyi mdzod tshul khrims grags pa gnyis kyi bkod mngags gzhir bzung chab dgon gyi rtse shol las byed gnyer rtse gnyis nas pha bong kha rin po cher thugs dam sa bon phul ba'i bka' lan phyir phebs su‘‘dbang phyogs tsi na'i yul dang khad nye li thang ngam/ de'i g.yas g.yon gyi yul ljongs yangs shing grong tsho che tsam zhig la yab/ tshe/ blo/ mthar/ skyabs gang rung gi ming zur yod pa zhig dang yum / sgrol/ dbyangs/ 'bum/ mtsho gang rung gi ming zur yod pa/ 'byor pa mi dman pa zhig tu bltams zin’’zhes gsal phebs kyang thugs dam der lo khams ma gsal bas srid skyong rwa sgreng rin po che dang /phur lcog rin po cher thugs dam zhus par rwa sgrong rin po che‘‘dgung mal sa stag dang sa yos gang rung yin ngo shar’’zhes dang / phur lcog rin po che sa yos yin ngo shar’’zhes dang zhabs rim khag mang zhig phebs pa de dag bsgrub na‘‘yid la ri mo bris pa gang / nam mkha'i gter bzhin mi mngon kyang /dus su bab tshe don rnams kun/ ma 'dres za 'og ris bzhin gsal/zhes pa ltar rim gsal 'ong’’zhes phebs pa bcas gong gsal bla sprul rnam pa'i thugs dam dgongs don ltar na 'khrungs yul smad phyogs li thang yas mas su yin pa ngos 'dzin gyis skabs der de sngon min go srid gzhung gis tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i dgongs rdzogs mchod 'bul du mngags pa'i hong mung sung gis btsugs pa'i don gcod khru'u nas yang srid rtsad gcod zhu bar 'gro mkhan rnams la lam yig kyang blangs thog chos srid 'khur 'dzin dgon rdor sprul sku dang / spyi mdzod/ gnyer rtse gnyis/ rtse shol bla dgon bcas mol bsdur gyis zhang paṇa sku rten pa dang yi dam grwa tshang 166

khongs kyi bla ma don tshe('di 'jigs byed bsnyen tshad rtags thon nus ldan yin par bshad)las byed khongs nas chab bla rtse'i drung yig rgyal mtshan (sku gong ma'i zhabs 'bring yin pa) bcas gsum bdam ste yang srid rtsad gcod zhu mir ched bskos thog gtso bo pha bong kha'i thugs dam gyi dgongs don ltar li thang phyogs su ched bskyod kyis khul de'i gang sar rtsad gcod khungs 'drong zhus nas rtags mtshan lo khams sogs khams dwangs sgro bskur med pa'i tho 'god dang 'brel sku gong ma'i phyag bzhes ṭa dril dang / phyag phreng /shangs phyis sogs sku'i nyer spyad ngo ma dang 'dra bcas chung srid la ngos 'dzin du 'jug dgos lugs dang / yab yum gyi ming gra sogs thugs dam dang mthun zhing gong ma'i nyer spyad ngo ma ngos zin na skabs sbyar zhang paṇa sku phebs zhus te bla lha thun mong gcig gyur gyi gzhi rtsa'i yid ches nges rnyed byung mtshams ngos 'dzin thag gcod ma byas par gsang rgya'i sgo nas chab mdor phyir log dgos rgyu sogs kyi bkod mngags dang 'ibre'/ byed sgo'i lag 'khyer dang bcas khong tsho dpon g.yog bdun la rgya bod sa mtshams bar rta khal dang /rta thab lag g.yog gzan shing / zhag sar sdod sgrig bcas dgos pa'i mdo spyi gnang byung pa'i lam yig dang bcas rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags 'brug (1940) lo'i ston mjug chab mdo nas thon te byams mdun dang rmar khams brgyud mthar li thang dgon chen gyi nye 'dabs tshes ma grong du 'byor zhing / der zhag 'ga' ring ngal gso byas rjes khul de'i gnas tshul zhib rtogs dang 'brel yul sde'i 'go gtso 'ga' shas la 'brel gtug byas par de skabs li thang dgon chen gyi mkhan po las thog sgo zab bla brang gi yum rgyas sprul sku dang / mkhan zur sgo zab sprul sku gnyis nas dgon yul tshang ma dbang 'og bsgyur lugs bshad don ltar khongs rnam gnyis la sku rten 'ga' 167

shas dang / lpags rigs/ snam phrug sogs 'bul rten dang bcas mjal kha zhus thog 'phags pa lha sku phreng bcu pa'i yang srid rtsad gcod zhu sgo'i las kar rogs ram gnang rogs zhus par sgo zab mkhan zur nas zhal bzhes dang 'brel khong tshor dgos pa'i ngo sprod phyag bris shig kyang gnang bas khong tshos li thang khul gang sar dus bgos khag bgos kyis phyi tshul bsod snyom pa'i rnam pa'i thog nas rkang thang du nyul te khye'u mtshan bzang yod lugs go thos byung rigs kyi pha ma'i ming sogs tho 'god kyis slar li thang du 'dzoms kyang thugs dam bka' lung dang sgo kun nas mthun pa zhig btsal rnyed ma thub pas sgo zab sprul skur thugs dam zhus par da cha lo 'jug 'khel bas snga 'phros srung ma'i 'phrin bcol nan bgyis kyis lo gsar pa tshes 'phral brtag dpyad byas na bzang lugs phebs shing / de don ngang sgug byas te de'i phyi lo lcags sbrul gsar tshes skabs sgo zab sprul skur slar yang thugs dam zhus par‘‘'ja' khog dang mtsho gsum khul khye'u yos lo pa mtshan bzang gnyis yod lugs pha mas phran latsho mo rgyag rogs zer byung bas de gnyis mgon chung nang srung ma'i spyan sngar 'phrin bcol dang 'brel zan ril phul nas gang thon de la brtag dpyad byas na’’zhes gsung don bzhin zan ril phul bar mtsho gsum khongs sna lu tshang gi bu de zan ril thon gshis/ de nas zhag shas mtshams sgo zab rin po che dud tshang zhig gi ma rgan shi ba'i 'pho ba gsal 'debs su gdan zhus ltar phebs skabs khong tsho lhan bcar gyis brtag dpyad byas par grong tsho'i chags tshul dang / yab yum gyi mtshan zur/ khye'u'i dgung rtags sogs pha bong kha'i thugs dam dang mthun pa zhig byung 'dug pas de nas gza' skar bzang nyin zhig tu sgo zab rin po che dbu bzhugs kyis khong tsho thun mong thog khye'u de gdan drangs nas 'phags pa lha sku gong ma'i sku'i nyer spyad ngo ma ngo 'dra ngos 168

'dzin gnang du bcug par go rim ma 'chol bar phyag gis 'dzin tsam re gnang yodangapa dang / de 'phral sku rten par zhang paṇa thog phebs kyis rten 'bul dang 'brel gus 'dud byas 'dug pa bcas la brten khong tshos gzhi rtsa'i thog yid ches byas kyang / da dung gzab nan byed ched li thang du bskyod thog li thang sa sgo krang shan krang la rogs ram byed rogs zhes bshad nas dar mdo shis khams zhing chen gyi krang rmis hru'u brgyud e rar chos zhugs yod mus zhi ba lha la gong gsal sna lu'i bu de yang srid yin min pha bong kha'i rin po cher dgongs bskor zhu gnang yod pa zhes skabs der lha sdod go min tang srid gzhung gi don gcod khang la glog 'phrin yo byad yod pa de brgyud lha sar glog 'phrin phul zhing / nyin nyi shu skor sgug sdod zhus kyang bka' lan ma 'byor bas slar yang dar mdo krang rmis hru'u brgyud go min tang srid gzhung gi lha sa'o don gcod khru'u'i khru'u krang zhung ching tsung la glog 'phrin btang nas pha bong kha'i rin po che gong gsal sna lu'i bu de 'phags pa lha bcu pa'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin zhu 'gab mchis min snyan seng zhu rogs zhes bshad par yang 'phrin lan ma 'byor bar brten khong tsho nang gros kyis sa khra dang yab yum gyi mtshan zur sogs tho 'god gsal po byas pa khyer te chab mdor phyir log bya rgyu'i thag bcad/ sgo zab rin po cher thugs rje che zhu rgyu'i tshul du bla mchod kyi tshogs 'khor dang 'brel brtan bzhugs dang sbrags rgyal mtshan nas zhabs brtan gsol 'debs〈pad dkar 'phreng ba〉zhes pa brtsams te phul/de lo'i zla 2tshes shar du khong tsho li thang nas thon te rmar khams gtsang shol du 'byor skabs li thang sa sgo nas 'ba' shan krang brgyud glog 'phrin phyir lan yi ge btang 'byor byung ba'i nang pha bong kha'i thugs dam bka' lan du ‘‘rgya dpon zhung khru'u krang sku ngo phebs kyis bka' mol gnang don brtag 169

dpyad byas par li thang 'dzom pa sna lu tshang gi bu 'jam dbyangs bsod nams zhes pa de nyid 'phags pa lha bcu pa'i yang srid 'khrul med yin ngo shar’’zhes gsal bas/ khong tsho 'gro go chod 'dug snyam nas blo bde bag phebs byung yod 'dug ride nas khong tsho rim bzhin chab mdor bde 'byor thub ste dkon phyag (dgon rdor sprul sku dang spyi mdzod) lhan sar gnas tshul zhib 'drong dang 'brel ba'i grong tsho'i sa khra dang / yab yum gyi mtshan zur sogs kyi tho dang tar yig bcas spyan 'bul zhus par legs gso'i bka' bzang dang kha btags gnang /de nas zhag shas mtshams se ra nas zhi ba lhas pha bong khar thugs dam sa bon phul bar phyir phebs su4rgya dpon zhung khru'u krang la bka' lan sngon phul ltar sna lu tshang gi bu 'jam dbyangs zhes pa de nyid 'phags lha'i skye sprul 'khrul med du ngo dkar bas/ zhabs brtan gnas chog dang bla mchod kyi tshogaspra sogs sgrub dgos’’zhes pha bong kha'i dam rgyas mnan pa 'byor bar brten tshang mas de bas yid ches dang dga' spro chen po byung yod/ sngar lam gser bum dkrugs 'don zhu srol yang de skabs de ltar bya rgyu'i cha rkyen med la/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pa sku na phra bas srid skyong stag brag la gnas tshul zhib 'khod kyi snyan zhu dang sbrags zhu khungs dag phyir gnas lugs snyan seng zhu bar bla ma don chen lha sar mngags gtong bya rgyur dgon phyag rtse shod bla dgon spyi mthun byung don lha sar btang zhing / zla 4pa'i tshes shar la snyan zhu'i bka' lan phyir phebs su 'phags pa lha'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin khri gsol byas 'thus zhes srid tham 'go mchan bstsal 'byor skabs dga' bsu'i mdzad sgo bstar/de nas sngar lam gzhir bzung yang srid sprul sku 'khrul bral nges rnyed 170

byung ba'i gnas tshul zhib gsal 'khod pa'i gtam snyan rtsa tshig spyi mdzod dam phab mnga' khul dgon sde yongs la spel ba dang / chab mdo'i gzim khang chen mo thegs chen pho brang gi sgo 'phyor gyi rtsig ldebs su shis brjod snyan tshig sum bid sdeb sbyor ri mo kha brang bcas mdzes mtshon gang legs kyis spras pa'i gtam snyan rtsa tshig sbyar ba bcas rgya khyab tu dril bsgrags byas pa dang / chos srid gnyis kyi 'gan 'khur dgon phyag gis gtsos rtse shod bla khag dgon 'bangs kyi 'go 'dzin tshang 'dzom thog yang srid sprul sku gdan 'dren byed lugs gros mol bgyis mthar rtse shod gnyis nas las byed re bca' bsdus thog thon nas thabs shes gang drag gis ji myur gdan zhu thub pa bya rgyu dang /'bri chu'i tshur kha rang sa zin mtshams gnas tshul 'byor bstun phebs bsu ring thung sogs je rgyas su gtong rgyu/ snga 'phros shod nas gnyer chen 'khrigs med tshe ring dang / rtse nas yang srid rtsad gcod du sngon song rgyus mnga'i babs kyis mgron gnyer rgyal mtshan gnyis ngo g.yog bcu bcas gtong rgyu'i gtan 'khel byas don ltar gnyer che dang rgyal mtshan gnyis mdo spyi gnang byung pa'i mdun thon phyag zhu bcar skabs mdo spyis li thang rgya phyogs song gshis 'brel gtugs mang po ma byas par mngon chung zab nan gyis sprul sku gegs med gdan sar 'khod thabs hur brtson dgos rgyu dang / zhu sgo 'thus tshang byung na khyod tshor byas rjes 'dor med gzigs bzos genang 'thus phebs/ de nas rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags sbrul lo'i zla 1rkyapa'i nang mdo spyi'i lam yig dang bcas gnyer chen 'jigs tshe mgron gnyer rgyal mtshan ngo 'khor chab mdo nas rdog thon gyis smar brag sa tshugs rim bgrod 'bri chu brgal te 'ba' thang brgyud li thang du bde 'byor thub pa byung zhing / zhag 171

shas mtshams sgo zab rin po che'i sku mdun du bcar nas sprul sku gtan 'khel zin pas ji myur gdan zhu thub pa'i rogs ram gnang rogs zhus par thog drug skyabs mgon deng sang dgon nang bzhugs yod pas khong dang li thang dgon gzhung spyi bso bcas la brjod rgyu gal che/ de min li thang sa sgo rgya dpon dang / 'khrungs yul mtsho gsum khang tshan bcas la'ang 'brel gtugs yag po dgos lugs nang tshags kyi bka' slob zhib phra gnang don bzhin maṇ+ḍal sku gsung thu0/sa rten dang / 'bul tshan phran bu bcas ba/nyer chen dang rgyal mtshan li thang skyabs mgon sar bcar te sprul sku gdan zhur skyabs/ 'jug gnang rogs zhes zhus par khong gis dgon yul sa sgo so gas gang thad nas stabs bde'i gre/dan zhu khag lugs rnam gyur mkhregs bzung las med pas khul der gnas tshul zhib brtsad skabs li thang skyabs mgon ni pha bong kha'i slob ma yin la lam rim 'chad spel byed mkhan thugs sems bzang po yod lugs gzhan nas bshad gshis/ gnyer che dang nang mol byas te rgyal mtshan gcig pu chos lugs dang mthun pa'i gus 'bas kyis slar yang li thang skyabs mgon sar sku bcar zhus par gdan thog bzhag nas gsol ja gnang / chab dgon gyi sa/nas tshul sogs gsung mol 'dri bshad mang po byung 'brel rgyal mtshan nas 'phags pa lha'i yang srid sprul sku ngos 'dzin gyi thugs dam/ gnang mkhan pha bong kha yin lugs dang / 'phags pa lha sku bo/nga ma 'tsho bzhugs skabs pha bong khas chab mdor bka' chos lo gcig gnang lugs/ pha bong kha'i slob ma rtogs ldan 'jam dbyangs blo gros nas rnam kun lam rim khrid gnang ba dang / dge bshes byams pa mtha' yas nas chab dgon du gzhung chen bka' pod lnga'i 'chad nyan rtsod grwa 'dzin skyong gnang gi yod lugs sogs zhib zhus thog rtogs ldan rim ngo ches khong 172

gnyis yong khar khong gis brtsams pa'i lhag mthong dka' 'grel gyi ljags lung tshar gcig gnang nas‘‘'di li thang skyabs mgon la phul nas khyed kyis gung dkar bla ma ltar gyi mdzad pa gnang ma shor/ de phyogs rje rin po che'i bstan pa la gang phan dang / rtag tu dbu ma'i lta ba 5/nga dag pa zhig 'dzin skyong gnang rogs zhes zhu 'phrin snyan la thengs nges gyis’’gsungs byung zhes zhus par li thang skyabs mgon nas‘‘dpe cha sang nyin 'khyer shog dang da dung skad cha 'dri bshad byed’’ces gsungs shing / phyi nyin phyag dpe khyer nas bcar bar thugs dgyes dgyes kyis gdan thog sdod gsungs nas gsol ja dang zhal tog gnang thog rgyal mtshan rang gi gnas tshul bka' 'dri gnang ba dang sbrags ‘ 'chi ba dgu phrugs skor dang / tha snyad grub tshul khyad chos gsum sogs lam rim du ji ltar gsungs yod dam ’’zhes bka' 'dri gnang bar rgyal mtshan nas dran sos pa rnams zhus shing / de nas bzung rgyal mtshan la mnyes po sa/nang nas rogs gang thengs byed chog ces gsungs/de nas (nag shas mtshams gnyer tshe dang rgyal mtshan gnyis/ 'bod mi gtong ba gnang nas tshoms chen zhig nang skyabs mgon dang dgon pa'i spyi so las sne bcas rgyas 'dzoms 'dug par khong gnyis nas sprul sku gdan zhur dge dgon 'a/ra slad gcig par rogs ram gnang rogs zhes sogs zhib tu zhus par mtsho gsum khang tshan gyi las sne a cog chos 'byor zer ba nas‘‘de snga 'phags pa lha mang po 'di phyogs 'khrungs nas chab mdor gdan 'dren tshar rjes chab mdo ba rnga ma thung thung las mi 'dug da res las sla stabs bde mi yong / sprul sku lo na gang 'tshams ma son bar 'tsho skyong du a khu rgyal mtshan khyod rang 'dir sdod dgos/ de nas sprul sku blu gtong byed phyogs rim blta byed’’ces sogs mang po bshad par skyabs mgon nas‘‘da ring 'du tshogs 173

der mtshams 'jog rjes su yang bskyar skad cha byed’’ces gsungs nas de nyin grol/ de nas zhag shas song mtshams slar yang khong gnyis 'bod mi btang yod par li thang skyabs mgon sar las sne tsho 'tshogs yod cing /chos 'byor nas rgyal mtshan laslolnga phyi gang sar khyed rang do gal che mdog kha ba gcig 'dug pas sprul sku 'tsho skyong du sdod rgyur blo thag chod song ngam’’zhes zer bar rgyal mtshan nas‘‘sngon tshud nas bsam gzhigs byas don ltar 'phags pa lha'i skye sprul 'di tsam ma zad de sngon sku phreng gsum li thang du 'khrungs par bkra shis lugs legs kyis gdan sar zhabs sor 'khod pa las 'di 'dra'i ka kor byung ba'i lo rgyus med pa ma zad/ nga tsho'i bka' srung zhang paṇa khog phebs skabs sprul sku ji myur zhabs sor ma 'khod na sku phywar bar chad yod lugs lung phebs la brten nga tsho dpon 'khor nyung bsdus brel stabs su yong dgos byung zhing / 'on kyang khyed rnam pas da mus u tshugs gsung nan gnang don ltar na sprul skur sku gegs mi yong ba'i 'gan len thub tshe nga rang sdod mi thub rgyu gang yang med rung / 'phags pa lha ni rgya bod kyi cho lo las tham yod pa'i ho thog thu che khag yin pas da lam gyi yo nga rkyen 'di dag rgya bod bla dpon gong mar snyan seng zhu 'bul ma byas tshe nga tshos blos 'gan bzod mi thub/ gzhi rkang khyed rnam pa mkhyen pa can yin pas dgongs pa zhig bzhes dang / ‘mkhas pa rang gi yul bas kyang / yul khams gzhan na mchod pa thob/ nor bu gzhan du brin pa tsam/ rgya mtsho'i gling du ga la byin’ zhes pa ltar 'phags pa lha'i sprul sku chab mdor gdan sar phebs na chab mdo'i ma/nga' khongs sde dgon yongs kyi bdag po yin la/ mdzad pa 'phiro las rgyas po yong rgyu dang / ga‘pa srid 'di phyogs bzhugs pa'i dbang du btang na dgon 'di'i grwa pa yag po 'is tsam yong rgyu las gzhan gang yod//71

des na skyabs mgon rin po ches dbus tshang mas thugs dgongs yag po zhig bzhes rogs gnang / snga phyi gang sar gong zhus rang las gsar du zhu rgyu gang yang med’’ces bshad/de rjes sgo zab rin po che dang / skyabs mgon sar yang yang bcar/li thang sa sgo krang shan krang dang 'brel ba byas mthar rdo don snying po khong tshos sprul skur blu yon dang dgon pa spyi dang khang tshan bcas par mang 'gyed sbug 'jog (sbyor 'jags)yab gzhis dang / mtsho gsum yul mir 'gro stangs rgya che byed dgos pa dang / de ltar byung na sprul sku blur gtong rgyu zhes brjod par khong gnyis nas‘‘nga tsho da lta bca' bsdus kyis yong ba yin pas rgya che de 'dra sgrub thub dka' yang / gang la gang 'tshams shig dang / yab tshang la sa zhing sems can so gas 'phags pa lha rim pa'i yab gzhis nang bzhin bzhugs lo nges yong ba’’bya rgyu'i 'gan len byas/ skyabs mgon dang sgo zab gnyis nas thugs nus bton te tshogs chen dang khang tshan la mang 'gyed dang nyin thebs re phul thog dgon gzhung gi tshogs chen du rje yab sras kyi sku brnyan dpangs thog tshad can chab mdo nas bzhengs te rjes 'bul zhu rgyu dang /slad li chab phan tshun thugs mthun khrims gtsang gis yul bab rogs ram bya 'os gang mchis gcig phan gcig grogs dam pa don gnas bya rgyu'i yig dan snol 'jog byas/de nas rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu rta gnam lo gsar tshes la sgo zab rin po che ched phebs kyis khong tsho lhan du 'khrungs gzhis sna lu tshang du bskyod/tshes 10nyin bla mchod kyi tshogs 'khor dang 'brel sprul skur na bza' sgron 'bul zhus te khri thog gdan drangs te gsol ja bzhes 'bras dang / dkar spro maṇ+ḍal rten gsum bcas phul/ yab yum dang sku mched rnam pa bzhugs 175

gral bstar/ na bza' dang / gsol ja bzhes 'bras/ dkar spro/mjal dar bcas phul/ thog steng du cho ga dang 'brel rgyal mtshan ser po btsugs/ nyin shas dga' ston spro skyid btang / a mdo grong tsho yul mi tshos kyang bro gzhas dga' rtsed la rol/ 'khrungs gzhis kyi yon gnas dga' thog dgon dang / rta nis dgon/ sku nye khag nas kyang gsol ston phul/ tshes 12gza' skar bzang nyin 'khrungs gzhis nas btegs/tshes 15li thang dgon chen du phebs skabs 'dzom dpon dang / mtsho gsum pa sku nye rnams bcas kyi chibs bskyel dang / skyab sa mgon gyi sku tshab/dgon spyi so las sne/ li thang sa sgo bcas nas phebs bsu dang / dgon pa'i ser sbrengs dang bcas 'phags pa lha gong ma rnams kyi khang tshan te zhi ba khang tshan du phebs par dgon pas gsol ja bzhes 'bras dang / da7/ra spro btegs/ grwa dmangs kyis mjal kha zhus/ li thang skyabs mgon nas gzim shas/ tu gdan drangs/ maṇ+ḍal rten gsum phul sku 'khor tshang mar gsol ston bsham gdan 'dren pa khong tshos li thang skyabs mgon dang sgo zab rin po cher thugs rje legs 'bul du maṇ+ḍal rten gsum dang / 'bul tshan bstar/ tshur yang 'bul dngos phul/ li thang nas thon khar sbrag yig gdong chab mdor gnas tshul btang / yab yum gnyis dang sku mched don yod/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan bcas lhan phebs dang / ma gzhis rnams rjes su phebs rgyu byas/de lo'i zla gnyiru/ pa'i zla dkyil du li thang nas chibs kha bsgyur bar li thang bla dgon nas phebs bskyel zhus/ 'ba' chos sde dgon brgyud 'bri chu brgal nas rmar khams 'grul mdar chab mdo nas chab bla'i rtse mgron bsod nams tshe ring dang / gzim dpon blo tshe/ bsher dpon mthu stobs dbang 176

phyug bcas dpon g.yog bcu ring bsur 'byor gdong chab mdo bla dgon spyi sger nas mtshams zhu snyan rgya sogs phul/ de nas byams mdun du phebs shing / byams mdun chos sde chen po bshad sgrub chos 'khor gling gi slob dpon dbu dge las sne/ brag bla'i bu dgon gnyer khang lde'u 'chang ngo las bcas kyi phebs bsu dang / dge 'dun pa'i ser sbrengs dang bcas brag bla'i gzim khang chen mor phebs/ der rtse gnyer a dpal dang / bla khag gi mgron gnyer/ spyi so seng grags sogs phebs bsur 'byor/ byams mdun du zhag bdun sku ngal gsos te bzhugs ring byams mdun byams pa rang byon gyi sku gzugs yongs rdzogs la gser chab sgron 'bul dang /byams smon tshogs chen thog sna lnga'i mchod sprin brgya tshar 'ga' shas bstar/dge 'dun stong phrag brgal bar bsnyen bkur mang ja dang sku 'gyed phul/de nas wang dkar du phebs skabs chab bla'i chos srid dbu 'dzin dkon rdor dang / spyi mdzod tshul khrims/ gnyer rtse sogs dang phebs byams phebs rol/ rta dar rten mdung sogs chibs rags mdzad chen yo chas 'byor/dkon phyag gnyis nas sku phyag dang 'brel maṇ+ḍal rten gsum dang gsol chas 'bul ba bstar/ der zhag gsum bzhugs/ de nas kye ni gling gar brag bla'i thab bskyel thog bar gnyis la brag spyis(brag gling spyi so) phebs bskyel zhus/ de nas 'ba' sgang du tshugs zhag gis/ spo bder phebs par lcags sprul rin po che yab tshang dang spyi zur/ mtshan grwa'i mkhan po sogs bla spyi las sne bla khag phyag mdzod sogs phebs bsur 'byor/ mdo spyi'i sar rtse mgron gcig 'tshams dar dang chabs cig snyan seng zhu bar btang / 'phags pa lha sku 'khor rta rong jo sngon mar bzhugs/ mnga' khongs dgon 'bangs yongs khyab tu khri gsol dus tshes dang 'brel mdzad chen chibs zhabs su yong 177

dgos skor dang / khri gsol nyin tshang mas dga' spro'i rten 'brel gzab rgyas zhu dgos pa'i skor zhib phra'i byed sgo'i bkod rgya spyi mdzod dam 'byar spel/chab mdo'i dgon zhol tshang mar yang de don bkod khyab bgyes don bzhin dgon pa'i gtsug lag khang dang grwa shag khag bcas par dkar rtsi gso ba dang /thug dang rgyal mtshan gsar brje sgo dang sge khung gi sham bu gsar brje/ zhol mi dmangs mang tshogs nas gos gzab gyon zhing / bro gzhas 'khrab pa dang nye skor ri rtse khag dang / khang steng du dar lcog gsar 'dzugs theg chen pho brang dang gtsug lag khang sogs kyi yang steng du bkris gra sgrig gis brgyan pa/chibs bsu rnams kyi go bab gon chas dang / rta sga sga 'khor so gas 'thus tshang byung yod med rtsis bsher sogs gra sgrig phun sum tshogs par byas/khri gsol mdzad sgo dang / chos zhugs/grwa skor dam bzhes/de nas chu rta dgung grangs bzhir bzhes pa lo de'i zla gsum pa'i tshes 16gza' skar 'phrod sbyor dge ba'i nyin lha rong nas phebs byams thog phebs te lta ba gnam lcags thang du dbu gur rma bya chung bar chab bla'i thab bsu gra sgrig thog phebs/ der mdo las mkhan rim 'gron drung sogs chibs zhabs pa tshang ma 'dzom/ dbu gur nang mdo las rnams dang zhi lcags dkon phyag rtse shod bla dgon las byed nas mjal dar phul ba dang rnam gras tshogs 'khor dang 'brel rdzas brgyad 'bul ba sogs mdzad sgo grub rjes chibs phreng bstar ba'i dbus su 'phags pa lha phebs byams nang gdan drangs te gdan sar zhabs sor 'khod cing / gzim khang steng nas thog 178

rol dang / dge 'dun pa sum stong tsam nas ser sbrengs bstar/ bla brang theg chen pho brang gi tshoms chen nang khri gsol mdzad sgo bskyangs pa'i thogagazhung sa dang brag g.yab bla brang sogs nas sngar lam bzhin khri 'bul bstar ba sogs byas nas mdzad chen grol/de nas lha sar mi sna ched btang gis tā la'i bla ma mchog dang srid skyong bcas la 'bul rten dang sbrags khri gsol zhus snyan phul ba dang / de min rwa sgrong sogs rgyal sprul khag dang / gdan sa gsum bcas par yang gnas snyan phul/ tā la'e bla ma mchog srid skyong nas khri gsol legs 'bul gnang rten dang 'brel ba'i bka' lan dang / tā la'i bla ma mchog nas mtshan‘‘bstan 'dzin 'jigs med dge legs rnam rgyal’’zhes bcas srid skyong stag brag nas gos chen ser po'i thog 'phags pa lharayongag dbang blo bzang lung rtogs bstan pa'i gsal byed dpal bzang po’’zhes pa'i ma/tshan yig dam 'byar dang / mtshan spel zhabs bstan gsol 'debs bcas gnang / de bzhin rgyal sprul khag dang / gdan sa khag nas khri gsol legs 'bul kyi zhu yig 'byor/ chab dgon tshogs chen 'du khang gi tshogs dbur gdan drangs te chab bla'i khri ston gzab rgyas zhus/ (dkon phyag tse shod bla khag spyi nas gnyer che dang rgyal mtshan gnyis la zhu sgo legs 'grub byung ba'i byas rjes bdag rkyen du gtan tshig dang 'brel kha 'dzin gzhis ka re gnang / yab tshang la g.yo stod mda' pa tshang dang / rdza srib ha 'go gnyis kyi sa zhing rtswa sa dang / zhing srung khang pa nor phyugs dang bcas pa/ zhol du 'tsher khang dang 'dzin chas sogs gang thad nas yab gzhis gsar 'dzugs byas) de nas sprul sku rin po ches dge bshes mkhyen rab myo4 thar phyin yongs/ 'dzin du bsten nas phyag bris yig klog dang phyag dpe thugs 'dzin gnang /179

dgung grangs bdun du bzhes pa shing bya ( 1945)lo dge bshes rin po che byams pa mtha' yas kyi drung nas dge brnyen gyi bslab sdom bzhes nga/ dang / gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang chen gsan/ — dgung grangs brgyad me khyi lo sa zla'i tshes 15nyin dge bshes rin po che byams pa'i mtshan can drung nas dge tshul gyi bslab sdom bzhes zla 9tshes 22lha bab dus chen nyin chos bsnyen gtong sgo gzab gzengs kyis byams gling mtshan nyid grwa tshang du chos zhugs gnang / dge bshes thub bstan dam pa yongs 'dzin du bsten nas gzhung chen bka' pod la gsan bsam thugs gnyer rgyun 'khyongs gnang ba dang /dge bshes rin po ches (byams pa mtha' yas )lam rim bka' chos gnang dus skabs 'gar gsung chos gsan par phebs/ skabs 'gar dad ldan 'ga' zhus don chos mtshams dang bstun klu sdengs/ dang / rde'u ga/sum ra khyod du tshe dbang dang / dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i ljag/sa lung sogs bstsal// dgung kho/ bcu gnyis lcags stag (1950) lo grwa bskor dam bca' dang bcas tshogs chen du chos (rakhor las brtsams pa'i chab mdo rma tshan nyid grwa tshang du rigs chung tshogs bzhengs gnang bar dam lan thogs thug med pa bskyangs pas sku skye dam pa'i rang rtags gsal bar mtshon gyi 'dug ces ma/tshan grwa'i dpe cha ba tshang mas gleng mol byed pa byung / rtse shod bla brang nas tshogs chen dang grwa tshang / khang tshan bcas pa'i rten drung du stong mchong bstar/ dge 'dun par dam thug sku 'gyed/ tshogs chen du‘‘bya sasum grags ma’’zhes ston pa'i sku brnyan byin gtso 'khor dang / gnas bstam gyi sku thang rgya bris byon gtsang gos rgyu bzang gi 'ja' gong zhal khebs tsan dan dmar po'i sgril rtog can nyi shu gtan 'jog gnang / spyi zur rin chen don grub nas bri gsol skabs phu la ba'i gser zangs 'a/sa grub pa'i sgros rma cerari 180

gcig gi sku brnyan rtse khru gang pa mtshan grwar gtan 'jog gnang /mdo spyi rnying pa lha klu zhal dgyes dang gsar pa nga phod 9sprutshamyo/sa zhur phebs nas sngar srol ltar 'phags pa lhar gus phyag dang 'brel maṇ+ḍal rten gsum phul bar 'phags pa lha khri thog nas bzhengs tsam gyis dargyas bzhes mdzad/ de nas gong lo'i zla rdzonang de sngon 'bri chu rgyud du bzhag pa'i bod dmagre sa srung mda' dpon 'go dmag chab mdor phyir 'byor dang /bcings 'grol dmag chab mdor 'byor nye'i skabs mdo spyi nga phod ngo las gru gu dgon du nyen g.yol du phebs pa dang / go mdzod la me mches pa sogs zing 'ur che gshis/ tshang ma skrag snang 'tshab 'tshub kyi gnas tshul 'og bla brang rtse shod dang bla khag phyag mdzod gros mol gyis 'phags pa lha dgon du bzhugs rgyur nyen kha'i gnas la brten re zhig nyen g.yol du byon na legs zhes zhus rung / skabs der gang nyid sku na phra yang 'tshab 'tshub mi gnang bar bab lhing ngang bzhugs pas yongs 'dzin gyis gtsos gam bcar dang dgon gyi las sne rnams kyis kyang dgon dang kha ma bral bar bsdad/ go mdzod 'tshig shor skabs skya ser mang pos me mda' hab thob rgyag par bskyod par 'phags pa lhas dbus yongs 'dzin sogs g.yo 'gul med par bzhugs pa ma zad/ dge 'dun pa rnams la brtan lhing ngang bzhugs dgos pa las zing cha gnang mi nyan pa'i zhal tashabaslab bya'ang gnang yod/gong lo'i zla 10tshes 1khanyin te chab mdor bcings 'grol dmag 'byor sa'i nyin gsum par 'thages mdun ma'i bkod 'dams dmag spyi wang chi med chab mdo dgon par 'phags pa lha'i bzhugs shag tu phebs nas phan tshun 'tshams 'dri gnang zhing / wang si ling nas ‘‘bcings 'grol dmag chab mdor dpung bskyod byed skabs khyed nyid ('phags pa lha mchog)181

dang byams pa gling dgon pa'i grwa btsun yongs kyis bden don zab rtogs ngang bcings 'grol dmag la 'gog rgol byas med la/ khyed kyis dkrog gtam la yid ches te phyi rgyal du'ang bros byol gnang med pa de ni las sla po zhig ma yin zhing / ha cang yang dag pa zhig red’’ces zhus gnang yod pa red/ de nas nyin shas mtshams cun bco brgyad pa'i cun krang krang go hwa 'phags pa lha'i drung du phebs nas gzim sgo 'dzul ma thag‘‘de ring khyed la lta bar yong ba yin/ khyed la don dag gal chen zhig zhu rgyu yod pa de ni/ ma'o kru'u zhi dang / spyi khyab si ling kru'u tes khyed kyis bcings 'grol dmag la 'gog rgol ma gnang ba dang / phyi rgyal du bros byol la ma phebs par mnyes tshor shin tu che zhing thugs blo bde po byung’’lugs dang tar thog nas gzengs bstod gnang lugs zhus gnang yod pa red/ ci dgung grangs bcu gsum bzhes pa (1951)lo chab bla'i dgon las/ tsha ba smad thugs chags dgon du gdan zhus ltar chibs sgyur bskyang sa te nyin bdun ring 〈lam gtso'i 〉gsung chos gnang zhing / sku na phra yang sbyor dngos rjes gsum zab rgyas gnang bas der 'dul mkhas pa dang skyes bu dam pa rnams kyang ngo mtshar gyi yul du gyur ba dang / skyes bu dam pa'i rang mdangs mngon gsal du mtshon 'dug ces kun gyis bsngags pa zhus/ de skabs mdzo sgang dgon dang spom mda'/ 'then thog sogs la phebs te tshe dbang dang gsung chos gnang ba dang / spom mda' dgon dang mdzo sga/nga dgon gyi khri nyis 'dzin yin pa 'be the dgon gyi sprul sku'i yang srid ngos 'dzin gtan 'khel gnang / de nas snga ra lam gzhir bzung ring min 'phags pa lha lha ldan du gdan sar chos zhugs phebs rgyur song rtse gnyer 'gan 'khur sku mchod bsod 182

nams rgyal mtshan dang / zhabs 'bring las byed gnyer bkra rgyal ngo g.yog lha sar sngon btang gis gzhung nas rta khal lam yig dang kha 'dzin gzhis ka zhu rgyu sogs phebs sgrig zhu bar btang don rta lnga bcu skor dang khal ma sum brgya'i sbug dam bka' lam dang / 'phen po ni tshug gzhis 'phags pa lha'i chos zhugs kha 'dzin du gnang / chos zhugs gtong dmigs su bla brang rtse shod nas mdzo pho mo dang / 'bri shad grus yan mi nyung ba byang lam brgyud snga rjes su btang ba dang / bla brang rtse shod kyi dngul dngos dang / bla khag dgon 'bangs nas 'phags pa lha chos zhugs nas mtshan btags bar gyi gtong sgo'i zhal 'debs phul ba rnams do dam byed mi bsko gtong mdzad/rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu 'brug (1952)dgung lo bcu bzhi'i thog lha phebs skabs zhabs 'bring du gnyer che don grub bkris dang / mgron gnyer rgyal mtshan gnyis/ de min gsol gzim drung yig gzim 'gagaganyer chung / sne shan/ dos dpon/ bsher brtag chibs dpon/nang byan/ chog grwa bcas sku 'khor drug cu lhag tsam zhig zla 7tshes 15nyin chab mdo nas chibs kha bsgyur zhing / zhi ba lhas la gong bar phebs bskyel zhus/ de nas gzhung lam brgyud rim bzhin chibs bskyod kyis phebs lam 'khel yul dgon khag la mang 'gyed gnang ba dang / mi ser thog brdab gsig gang chung thog gsol ras dang srung byin 'dod tshim gnang / sa tshugs rim bgrod kyis mthar 'od zer rgyang du ser byes mkhan po gtsang pa thabs mkhas phebs bsur bcar zhing / grwa tshang gi gsol ja bzhes 'bras/maṇ+ḍal rten gsum/ mtshams zhu rten bcas phul te mjal 'phrad gnang /de nas dga' ldan zhol du dga' ldan dgon gyi grwa tshang dang / khang tshan gyi dbu gur thabacibasu dang / skyid chu'i byang du se 'bras kyi bla spyi'i thab bsu'i 183

sar se 'bras kyi bla sprul khag gi sku tshab dang / lha sdod chab mdo'i spyi khag dang mi ser 'go pa sogs kyis phebs bsu zhus/ der rgya dpon wang chi ma'e kyang phebs bsur phebs/ de nas lha sa grong khyer nye 'dabs su gzhung gi thab bsu'i sar drung rigs ser skyalte phebs bsu dang bcas 'tsher khang lha gdong shan khar phebs mjal mdzad sgo bskyangs/ de nas gnangs brda dang 'brel nor gling skal bzang pho brang du tā la'i bla ma'i drung du mjal phyag tu phebs shing / 'phags pa lhas tā la'i bla ma mchog la sku phyag dang 'brel mjal dar nang mdzod dang maṇ+ḍal rten gsum 'bul gnang mdzad/'phags pa lhar bzhugs khri rgyab yol dang / zhal dkar yu ring / de min zhabs 'bring rnams go rim bzhin bzhugs gral du 'khod nas gsol ja dang bzhes 'bras phebs pa sogs kyi mdzad sgo bskyangs/de rjes nyin shas song mtshams snyan seng sngon phul dang 'brel bka' shag lhan rgyas 'phags pa lha'i gzim shag tu phebs par las byed nas phebs bsu zhus/ gzim chung 'gag tu gzhung sa'i phebs gsos 'bul dngos bstar/ bka' blon khri pas mjal dar dang maṇ+ḍal rten gsum phul bar 'phags pa lhas khri thog nas bzhengs te bzhes/ gzhung gi 'bul tho dang /bka' blon sku sger so sos mjal dar dang maṇ+ḍal rten dod 'bul rten bcas phul/ bka' blon rnams khri 'bol mtho dma' med pa rer gos kha gras mtshungs thog bzhugs gral 'khod/ bla brang nas gsol ja bzhes 'bras sogs bstar/ gzhan yang mgron drung dang 'gag pa sogs nas kyang mjal kha zhus rjes gzim chung tshoms 'gag tu bzhugs gral dang gso/la ja bzhes 'bras bstar/ mdzad sgo grub bstun 'phags pa lha'i zhabs 'bring 'a sa byed rnams nang phebs bskyel zhus/ de nas chos zhugs mdzad sgo'i sta gon grub 184

mtshams lo de'i dgun kha se ra'i bzang spyod chen mo'i skabs sngar lam se ra'i tshogs chen thog khar bod kyi srid skyong bzhugs pa'i gzim khang le lag rtsis sprod gam/nga bar bzhugs te se ra tshos/sa chen dang / grwa tshang byes mi da sngags gsum khang tshan dang bcas par mchod pa dang bsnyen bkur/ spyi 'jogatshogs chen dang grwa tshang khag la tshogs phebs dang / ser byes chos rwa'i dam khri'i thog gzhung sa'i gsol ja bzhes 'bras/ tshogs chen dang grwa tshang khagabaka' blon dang drung che sogs rtse shod sku drag khag bla sprul khag bcas kyi legs 'bul bstar bzhes sogs sngar gyi mdzad lam bzhin se ra'i chos zhugs mdzad sgo legs par bskyangs/chu sbrul ( 1kha52)lo smon lam tshogs phebs dang 'brel jo bo rin po che gser chab sgron 'bul dang mchod sprin stong tshar bstar/ smon lam chen mo'i 'dus tshogs su mang ja dang sku 'gyed sogs mchod bsnyen gtong sgo legs grub rjes se rar gam bcar zhabs zhu gsol gzim sogs nyung bsdus las/ de min zhabs 'bring byings rnams chab mdor phyir slog gnang /de sngon se rar chos zhugs mdzad pa nas bzung se rar gtan bzhugs kyis rig lam che chung gi slob gnyer dam bzhes sogs legs grub zin nas rim bzhin dge bshes lha rabs pa'i mtshan rtags bzhes rgyu'i sta gon du gtan 'jog dngul gyi 'dren/ zo (ja 'dren zo lag ) brgya dang brgyad gsar bzo dang mchod bsnyen gtong dmigs ja rgyab mang po sogs chab mdo nas rim btang byas shing / thog ma'i 'char gzhi ltar na lcags byi (1960)dgung grangs nyi shu rtsa gnyis su lha rams mtshan rtags bzhes rgyu yin yang /1959lo'i zing 'khrug dus dbang gi rkyen pas lha rams mtshan bzhes gnang rgyu ma byung ba red/185

srid kyi mdzad pa rags rim/1kha59lo'i zla 4tshes 4nyin bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gi kru'u ren sku gzhon/ nang bstan mthun tshogs bod yan lag mthun tshogs kyi mtshan 'dzin tshogs gtso 'phags pa lha dge legs rnam rgyal mchog nas shin hwa gsar 'gyur khang gi gsar 'gyur 'god por bka' mol gnang skabs bod phebs bcings 'grol dmag gi las don mi snas chos dad rang mos kyi srid jus khag nan tan gyis lag bstar gnang bar bsngags brjod dang / bod gyi mtho rim log spyod ru tshogs kyis ngo log zing 'khrugs bslangs pa dang dgon sder gter bshig gtong ba'i nyams spyod la kha brdung drag po btang gnang ba red/gong zla'i tshes 8nyin bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gis bod sa gnas kyi 'gan dbang lag bstar bya rgyu'i skor u yon rgyas 'dzoms tshogs 'du skong tshogs gnang ba'i thog tu paṇa chen er te ni mchog dang krang go hwa/ 'phags pa lha dge legs rnam rgyal mchog nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med bcas kyis gsung bshad gnang ba red/gong lo'i zla 9nang bod ljongs lta skor tshogs pa'i mtshan 'dzin tshogs gtso'i mtshan thog nas nang sar gzigs skor du phebs shing / pe cin krung nan ha'e ru ma'o kro'u zhi dang / kro'u en le/ li'u hra'o chi sogs dang mjal 'phrad byung thog ma'o kru'u zhis‘‘khyed ni chab mdo'i bla chen yin pas phyir phebs rjes bod las don u yon lhan khang gi 'go khrid 'og mthun 186

sgril dang / yar thon/ gong 'phel/ dar rgyas bcas yong ched legs skyes 'bul dgos’’zhes sogs kyi bka' slob kyang gnang / (dum bu 'di 1992lo'i zla 12tshes 25nyin gyi bod ljongs nyin re'i tshags par nas drangs) gong lo'i zla 10tshes 21nyin rgyal yongs srid gros dang pe cin grong khyer srid gros kyi mnyam 'brel tshogs 'du'i thog bod kyi gnad don skor la paṇa chen er te ni mchog dang / nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med/'phags pa lha dge legs rnam rgyal bcas nas snyan gron gnang pa red/tshes 26nyin rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus tshogs kyi u yon krang gzhon pa paṇa chen er te ni chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog dang / rgyal yongs srid gros kyi kru'u zhi gzhon pa 'phags pa lha dge legs rnam rgyal sogs wang phung gi phebs rogs 'og pe cin nas phebs thon gyis sa gnas khag tu gzigs skor 'tshams 'drir phebs shing / lu'e ta dang nang sog sogs la gzigs skor legs grub kyis zla 12tshes 2nyin pe cin du phebs 'byor byung ba dang /tshes 14nyin hwa tung sogs su gzigs skor phebs shing / nan cin dang /hrang ha'e/ kong zhi/ hu'u nan/ hu'u pe/ ho nan/ si khron/ hran zhi sogs sa gnas khag la gzigs skor legs grub kyis 1960lo'i zla 1tshes 25nyin pe cin du phebs 'byor byung zhing / kro'u tsung lis paṇa chen er te ni mchog dang 'phags pa lha dge legs rnam rgyal mchog la gsol ston yang gshams pa gnang /gong lo'i zla 2tshes ṭ+wāṃnyin kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che mchog dang 'phags pa lha dge legs rnam rgyal mchog kro'u ren hran gyi phebs rogs 'og pe cin nas bod du phyir log bskyangs shing / tang dang rgyal khab kyi 'go khrid khran dbyis dang / zhi krung zhun sogs pe cin me 'khor babs tshugs su 187

phebs nas phebs skyel zhus tshes 25nyin lha sar phebs 'byor skabs krung gung bod las don u yon lhan khang gi hru'u ci krang cin wu sos/sa tang srid dmag gi 'gan 'khur mi sna gnam gru thang du phebs nas phebs bsu zhus/1960lo'i zla 11tshes 1〈—21nang bstan mthun tshogs bod yan lag mthun tshogs kyi skabs gnyis pa'i tshogs 'du skong tshogs byas shing / tshogs 'du'i thog 'phags pa lha dge legs rnam rgyal mchog nas gsung bshad gnang /1rdzo61lo'i zla 5tshes 11nyin/ 'phags pa lha mchog nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med mchog dang lhan du bkras lhun dgon par phebs nas dge 'dun pa dang bzhugs mol gnang zhing / 'phags pa lha mchog nas dge 'dun pa tshos rgyal gces khrims srung si/ chos pa zhig gnang dgos pa'i skor bal/'a slob bstsal/gong zla tshes 17nyin/ bod ljongs gzhis rtse'i mi rigs khag dang las rigs khag gi bzhugs mol tshogs 'du'i thog kun gzigs rnga/ṇa chen rin po che dang / kro'u rin hran/ nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med/ 'phags pa lha dge legs rnam rgyal bcas kyis 'bring rim dang ma/tho rim mi snas rang rang bsgyur bkod dang / mthun sgril/ gong 'phel yong ba byed dgos pa so gas kyi skor gsung bshad gnang ba dang / zla 6tshes 10nyin/ gzhis rtse sa ud kyis skong tshogs byas pa'i bzhugs mol tshogs 'du'i thog gzhis rtse sa gnas kyi 'bring rim dang mtho rim mi sna'i las don skor gyi bsam 'char dang re ba bsdu rub gnang ba red/gong lo'i zla 9tshes 26nyin nga/ṇa chen rin po che mchog dang nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med/ 'phags pa lha bcas pe cin du phebs nas de lo'i 188

rgyal ston mdzad sgor zhugs gnang ba dang / u yon krang kru'u tes mjal 'phrad dang dga' bsu'i gsol ston yang bshams gnang ba red/1962lo'i zla 7tshes 26nyin kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che dang 'phags pa lha dge legs rnam rgyal/ nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med/bkras mthong cis 'jigs med sogs pe cin nas bod du phyir phebs gnang skabs zhi krung zhun dang / li we han sogs gnam gru thang du phebs skyel zhu bar phebs pa dang / zla 8tshes 2nyin lha sar phebs nyin than kon san sogs 'bras spungs dgon bsham du phebs bsur phebs pa red/ 1965lo'i zla 9tshes 1—9nyin bar lha sar 'tshogs pa'i bod rang skyong ljongs mi dmangs 'thus tshogs kyi tshogs 'du thengs po'i thog bod rang skyong ljongs mi dmangs srid gzhung btsugs pa dang nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med mchog mi dmangs srid gzhung gi kru'u zhi dang / 'phags pa lha dge legs rnam rgyal mchog sogs kru'u zhi gzhon par 'dems thon byung yod/1966 lo'i zla 1tshes 21nyin rang skyong ljongs mi dmangs u lhan dang ljongs srid gros kyi mnyam 'brel tshogs 'du'i thog 'phags pa lha dge legs rnam rgyal mchog nas gang nyid kyis zhin cang du gzigs skor 'tshams 'dri gnang skor gyi snyan sgron gnang ba red/1972lo zla 1tshes 10nyin pe cin du blo mthun khren dbyis la mya ngan zhu ba'i tshogs 'du'i thog ma'o kru'u zhis 'phags pa lha mchog la phyag gtong ba gnang nas‘‘khyed rang 'tshar long yag po byung ste lang tsho dar la bab pa zhig chags 'dug ga'’’zhes sogs kyi gsung mol yang gnang yod pa red/19shrīrkyalo'i zla 1rkyatshes 2rkya—21nyin bar lha sar 'tshogs pa'i nang bstan mthun tshogs bod yan lag mthun tshogs kyi skabs bzhi pa'i 'thus 189

mi'i tshogs 'dur mtshan 'dzin tshogs gtsor gdan zhus ltar phebs/19〈0lo'i zla 12tshes 16—2 2 'phags pa lha mchog pe cin du 'tshogs pa'i krung go nang bstan mthun tshogs skabs bzhi pa'i tshogs 'dur phebs shing / tshogs 'du'i thog paṇa chen er te ni mchog mtshan 'dzin tshogs gtso dang / 'phags pa lha dge legs rnam rgyal mchog sogs tshogs gtso gzhon par 'dems thon byung yod/gong zla'i tshes 22nyin de snga‘‘mi bzhi shog khag’’gis ham shed byed ring mtshams 'jog byas pa'i krung go nang bstan slob grwa chen mo slar gso byas pa'i slob tshugs mdzad skor phebs/19rdzo4lo'i zla 4par rgyal yongs srid gros kyis gdan zhus ltar ne pa la rgyal ldan rgyal khab gyi gros tshogs gong ma'i tshogs gtso pe ni pa hā tu'u 'ar kha'ar ci stangs dpyal gyis sne khrid gnang ba'i gros tshogs khang gi sku tshab tshogs pa krung gor 'tshams 'dri gnang 'go tshugs te rang ljongs su mdza' mthun 'tshams 'dri gnang skabs gong zla'i tshes 10nyin gyi phyi dro u yon krang gzhon pa 'phags pa lha gang nyid nas bod ljongs mi dmangs tshogs khang du mjal 'phrad gnang thog phan tshun mdza' mthun gyi bka' mol yang gnang /da phan srid kyi mtshan gnas rim bzhes/1951lo'i zla 1nas 1956lo'i zla 12bar krung ha mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab mdo smad mnga' khul mi dmangs bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang gi mi dmangs 'thus tshogs kyi kru'u ren gzhon pa dang po'i mtshan gnas 190

bzhes/ 1956lo'i zla 5tshes 6nyin bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gi rgyun las u yon3) mtshan gnas bzhes/1956lo'i zla 12nas 1959lo'i zla 4bar chab mdo sa khul mi dmangs bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang gi mtshan 'dzin kru'u ren dang po'i mtshan gnas bzhes/1ke56lo'i zla 4nas 1959lo'i zla 2bar bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang chos lugs las —don u yon lhan khang gi kru'u ren gzhon pa'i mtshan gnas bzhes/1957lo'i zla 4nas 1959lo'i zla 2bar chab mdo sa gnas bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang —bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang chab mdo spyi khyab don gcod khru'u yi mtshan 'dzin kru'u ren u yon ang dang po'i mtshan gnas bzhes/1959lo'i zla 2nas 1965lo'i zla 〈bar bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gi kru'u ren u yon gzhon pa'i mtshan gnas bzhes/1959lo'i zla 2nas 1962lo'i zla 7bar dang / 1962lo'i zla ranas 1965lo'i zla 10bar rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang mi dmangs u yon lhan khang dang chos lugs las don u yon lhan khang gi kru'u ren gzhon pa dang kru'u ren gyi mtshan gnas bzhes/1960lo'i zla 1nas 1961lo'i zla 5bar chab mdo kron yon kung hru'u yi kron yon las tshab dang / 1961lo'i zla 5nas 1965lo'i zla 10bar kron yon gyi mtshan gnas bzhes/1kha65lo'i zla 7nas 1967lo'i zla 1bar rang skyong ljongs mi 191

tshodamangs u yon lhan khang gi kru'u zhi gzhon pa'i mtshan gnas bzhes/1979lo'i zla rdonas 19ra2lo'i zla 4bar rang skyong ljongs mi dmangs srid gzhung gi kru'u zhi gzhon pa'i mtshan gnas bzhes/19rdo2lo'i zla 4nas 19/7lo'i zla 10bar rang skyong ljongs skabs gzhi pa'i mi dmangs 'thus tshogs kyi kru'u ren gzhon pa'i mtshan gnas bzhes/ ki1977lo'i zla 10nas bzung rang skyong ljongs srid gros skabs gsum pa dang / bzhi pa/ lnga pa bcas kyi kru'u zhi gzhon pa dang 1992lo'i zla 7nas kru'u zhi'i mtshan gnas bzhes/1957lor skabs gnyis pa'i rgyal yongs srid gros kyi u yon du gsab 'dems kyis skabs gsum pa dang / bzhi pa/ lnga pa/ drug pa/ bdun pa bcas kyi rgyal yongs srid gros kyi a yon dang kru'u zhi gzhon pa'i mtshan stoganas bzhes/1992lor skabs brgyad pa'i rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus tshogs rgyun las u yon lhan khang gi u yon krang gzhon pa'i mtshan gnas bzhes te da lta rab byung bcu bdun pa'i shing khyi dgung grangs nga drug tu 'tsho zhing gzhes pa lags so/ ri192

zhi lcags dkon gsum sogs bla khag zhi ba lha sku phreng risna byon/zhi ba lha sku phreng daje skre/zhi ba lha sku phreng dang po dpal ldan mchog grub ni/ kong po brag lci la steng kha'i nyang lcib hūṃ rab byung brgyad pa'i shing khyi (1454) lo bltams shing / rgyal sras zhi ba lha'i sprul par grags pas zhi— ba lha zhes mtshan chags/rgyal ba 'phags pa lha'i zhal slob kyi gras yin pa dang / zhal snga rin po che ste 'phags pa lha'i‘‘gsang 'dus’’skor la dogs gcod mang po mdzad pa bka' 'bum du bzhugs shing / rgyal ba 'khugs pa lha‘‘bde bshegs snyan brgyud’’kyi dbang lung sogs bum pa garobyo'i tshul du gnang ba'i gdams ngag gi mdzod du gyur/ mdo khamasatsod du 'gro don 'dzags pa lhaganyis pa ltar du grags shing / 'phags pa lha 'tsho gzhed skabs rtenabazhengasaganang ba'i sku rgyu zangs phal mo che gang 'dise bskrub gnagle ba ma zad/ zhal snga rin po che gshegs rjes kyang kong po de mo la dgon gyi༄95sa chene dbu thog gser zangs 193

kyi gan ji ra dang bcas sa legs grub mdzad pa sogs mdzad pa rlabs po che bzhes te dgung grangs bdun cu rab byung dgu pa'i chu lug lo (1522)mdo khams smad du gshegs/ de nas rgyal bal (rgya gar dang bal yul )mtshams su sngags pa gzhon nu gcig tu skyes/ de nas mtha' stag tu 'khrungs pa 'di (sku phreng gnyis pa )yin zer/(gang 'di nyid kyi 'khrungs 'das skor/ nye dus chab mdo sa gnas srid gros lo rgyus rtsom 'bri tshogs chung nas bsgrigs pa'i dpyad gzhir rab byung mi gsal bar‘‘shing khyir bltams/ dgung grangs bcu chu lug lo gshegs de nas sku skye ma byung bar lo bcu dgu song’’zhes gsal yang / de ltar na 'khrungs 'das kyi dus tshod rab byung dgu pa'i shing khyi dang chu lug yin dgos rung / phan bde chos rje shākya lha dbang gis mdzad pa'i〈zhal snga bka' rgyud chos 'byung〉las/ gang 'di rgyal ba 'phags pa lha'i zhal slob kyi gras su gsal ba dang dgung mi 'grig gshis/ 'dir gong gsal chos 'byung ltar du bkod kyang dpyad par 'tshal) zhi ba lha sku phreng gnyis pa/zhi ba lha sku phreng gnyis pa dbon drung ('phags pa lha sku phreng gnyis pa 'phags pa sangs rgyas dang yab gcig yin pas dbon drung zhes zhu) sangs rgyas 'byung gnas ni kong po mtha' stag tu yab bla ma sangs rgyas don grub kyi sras su rab byung dgu pa'i chu yos (1542)lo 'khrungs shing / sku gzhon nu'i dus yab kyis rta mgrin lcags ral can gyi dbang lung dang tshe dbang gnang / phyag bris 'bri klog dang / chos spyod thugs 'dzin sogs 'bad 194

rtson de tsam gnang ma dgos par shugs kyis mkhyen nus pa sogs skyes bu dam pa zhig yin pa'i mtshan ma gsal mngon skad dang / 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyis kyang gang ci'i dbang lung man ngag yongs su rdzogs par gnang /'phags pa sangs rgyas zhing gzhan du gshegs dus chos rje ngag dbang dang /slob dpon sprul sku sogs zhal slob bu chen 'gangs che thams cad bzhugs yod kyang / gang bi rgyal tshab tu 'di nyid dbang bskur gnang zhing /mchog dman bar pa kun gyis zhal snga rin po che 'phags pa sangs rgyas dang dbyer med du mchod cing gong du bkur/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi dngul gyi gdung rten bzhengs gnang ga sogs dgongs rdzogs legs par grub gnang ba dang / lhag par du 'phags pa lha sku phreng gsum pa mthong ba don ldan gdan drangs shing / sprul sku dang yab rje gnyis kar lugs gnyis kyi zhabs tog legs par mdzad/ tsha ba spo mda' dgon phyag 'debs skabs bon po rnams kyis bkrol bar brtsams kyang gzim khang gi zhal khra nas mchong gnang bas sku la gnod pa ma byung zhing / ri klung gang sar spang ri spang 'jam yin 'dug kyang bon po 'tshol mkhan rnams kyis na bza'i grwa zur brjis kyang ma rig pa dang / tshul khrimasatshokyi dri ngad bzang po yod pas ‘‘bstan bshig de'i dri ma 'dug kyang kho rang mi 'dug’’zer nas song skad/ ('di skor 'phags pa mthong ba don ldan gyi mdzad rim nang skabs der 'dir rgyal tshab rin po che zhu bas 'brel yod gnas tshul bkod yod ) de lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul kyang bzhes par grags/ zhal gdams brtsarma chos kyang po ti long ba yod skad/ dgung grangs don brgyad du bzhes pa lcags sprel (1620)lo chab mdo byams pa gling du zhing du gshegs/ dgongasardzogs su zangs gser las byams pa'i sku 'du khang gi thos/ tshad mnyam pa bzhengs nas tshogasadabus na bzhugs su 195
