gsol/'di'i yang srid sprul sku 'jang khul du sku gong mar dad chen zhu ba'i dpon rigs shig gi sras su 'khrungs kyang dgung grangs gsum las ma bzhugs par gshegs pas sku phreng gi grangs su ma bgrangs/ ri zhi ba lha sku phreng gsum pa/zhi ba lha sku phreng gsum pa zhi ba bzang po ni rab byung bcu pa'i shing glang (1625)lo'i zla 9tshes 15nyin nyi ma shar ba dang dus mtshungs par dgon phug tu 'khrungs shing / yab ni sku gong ma dang yab tshan gcig pa nam mkha' bkris dang / yum ma gcig mtsho mo zhes pa yin/ zhi ba bzang po 'khrungs nyer yab yum gnyis kar rmi ltas bzang zhing / kun gyi mthong gsal gzim khang la 'ja' yang yang zugs pa dang / mo rtsis pa rnams kha gcig ltar lung mthun pas 'khrungs pa'i dga' ston dang bsang mchod nyin bdun sbrel byas/'khrungs nas zla ba gnyis song skabs zhal snga rin po che 'phags pa chos kyi rgyal po dbus gtsang du phebs pa'i phebs lam du kong po phan bde dgon nas na bza' dang chibs rta chibs rol dang bcas pa 'bul bar rgya mdar song zhing /de skabs zhal snga rin po che khrog la la rtsar bzhugs skabs gzigs snang dang lung bstan khyad par can byung bas/ ‘‘dgon phug gi bu chung de slob dpon rin po che'i(zhi ba lha) sprul pa yin nges 'dug gshis/ sngar dus bon po tsho dang 'dres stabs kyis bar chad ci yong mi shes shing / sku srung sogs gces sprad thon par gyis’’zhes pa'i bka' dris dang bca' bla ma rin chen bkris dang / drung rams pa 'phags pa blo bzang gnyis kar bka' mngags 196

phebs pa ltar bsgrub/ de rjes 'phags pa lha sku 'khor phan bde dgon du phebs skabs zhi ba lha'i sprul sku 'dis sku pang du byon pa sogs ya mtshan 'ga' zhig byung skad/ gsung byon mkhyen tsam nas dgung grangs bcu gsum gyi bar phan bder bzhugs shing / de lor(dgung grangs bcu gsum bzhes lo)nged rang(phan bde chos rje shākya lha dbang )gis mkhan po dang / slob dpon bka' bcu 'dzin pa 'phags pa dar rgyas gyis las slob mdzad nas bkris phan bder dngul gdung rin po che'i spyan sngar rab byung bzhes/mtshan 'phags pa‘‘zhi ba bzang po’’zhes sngar nas gsol zin pa de rang du bzhag phan bde chos rje'i drung nas bde gshegs snyan brgyud la sogs pa'i chos bka' sna tshogs bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan bzhes bskyangs/ lcam mda' dang spo bo khul sogs su byon nas gdul bya'i 'phrin las rgyas par byung zhing / sku gong ma'i chos khrir bzhugs pa sogs 'phrin las bzang pos yab sras('phags pa lha dang zhi ba lha) lhan cig tu bzhugs/ (phan bde chos rjes zhal snga bka' rgyud chos 'byung brtsams skabs zhi ba bzang po dgung grangs bcu drug yin pa) gang nyid dgung grangs bco brgyad bzhes lo ste chu rta (1642) lor chab mdo byams pa gling gi chos khrir phebs/ dgung grangs rgo ga/sum ba'e/sa pa rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me bya(1717) lor zhing gzhan du gshegs song zhi ba lha sku phreng bzhi pa/zhi ba lha sku phreng bzhi pa 'phags pa dge legs rgyal mtshan ni brag g.yab 197

mdor rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags byi (1720) lor 'khrungs/'di'i dus gong ma chen por 'tshams zhu phul chog pa zhus don don smin gyis gnam skyong khri lo nyer lnga pa sa yos lor 'tshams zhu 'bularten thog mar phul zhing / bka' lan phyir phebs 'phags pa lhar gnang ba'i gser yig zhal gsal du zhi ba lha ho thog thu la'ang gnang cha bstsal yod ces gser yig tu ho thog thu'i mtshan dang gnang rten bcas bstsal/ de nas bzung 'phags pa lhar 'tshams zhu sba yer nam phul gdong zhi ba lhas kyang lha cig phul bas gsol ras kyang bstsal/ bla ma de nyid la me byi lor gong ma'i bka' 'brel 'phags pa lha'i gdan tshab mdzad dgos bka' dang chabs cig rgyal dbang bdun pa skal bzang rgya mtsho nas tham ka gru sgor dang / gdugs/ rta dar/ rgya gling sogs gsol ras stsal/ dgung grangs brgyad cu sa lug (1799)lor sku gshegs te gong mar gser snyan phul bar kha btags nang mdzod che ba dang / dngul srang brgya tham pa bcas bod bzhugs am ban brgyud bstsal/zhi ba lha sku phreng lnga pa/zhi ba lha sku phreng lnga pa blo bzang don grub rgya mtsho brag g.yab wang dkar du rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags spre(1shrī00) lor 'khrungs/ lha ldan gtsug lag khang chen por gser bum brtag dpyad las thon pas gdan sar bkod/ dgung grangs bzhi brgyad rab byung bcu bzhi'i me lug(1ṭ+wāṃ47)lor 'phags pa lha sku phreng brgyad pa zhing gshegs kyi khri tshab thugs 'gan bzhes/ dgung grangs re bzhi rab byung de ga'i chu phag (1shrī62) lor gshegs/198

zhi ba lha sku phreng drug pa/zhi ba lha sku phreng drug pa ngag dbang 'jigs med mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin 'phrin las/ rab byung bcu bzhi'i shing byi ( 1ra64) lor brag g.yab ga zi wang dkar du 'khrungs/ shing glang lor tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gnyis pa mchog dang / bod bzhugs am ban lhan rgyas bcas la snyan zhus kyis lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang gi jo bo shākya mu ne'i spyan sngar gser bum brtag dpyad khongs nas thon te ngos 'dzin rjes khri gsol zhus/dgung grangs so brgyad rasdi byung bco lda'i lcags byi(1900)lor 'phags pa lha sku phreng dgu pa zhing phebs kyi khri tshab thugs 'gan bzhes/ gang 'di'i 'das lo zhal gsal dpyad gzhi ma son yang gsham du sku phreng bdun pa'i 'khrungs lor gzhigs na dgung grangs drug tsam bzhugs par nges/zhi ba lha sku phreng bdun pa/ zhi ba lha sku phreng bdun pa ngag dbang mkhyen rab dwags po khul yab lha dbang dang yum sgrol dkar gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bco lnga pa'i shing glang (1925)lor 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu bzhi sa stag lo lha sar chos zhugs slob gnyer dang dge bshes mtshan rtags bzhes nas dgung grangs nye gcig rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing bya (1945) lor chab mdor phyir phebs spyi mdzod kyi thugs 'gan bzhes pa dang / smon lam mchod pa dang dgyel mchod kyi gar 'cham bskyar gso/ 'phags pa lha'i gzim khang nyams gso 'go 'dzugs sogs sa/nang ba dang / chab mdor bcings 'grol btang rjes 199

mdo smad bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang gi u yon dang / rdzong bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang gi kru'u ren/ rang skyong ljongs gra ud kyi u yon/mdo smad nang bstan chos tshogs kyi kru'u ren dang / khron bod gzhung lam gsar skrun skabs sogs rgyab skyor 'or 'dren gyi thugs 'gan bzhes/ phyis rig ma bsten bzhes gnang ba dang / 1959lo dpyid dus 'phags pa lha mtshan rtags bzhes rgyu'i mdzad sgor lha sar phebs kyang zing 'khrug dus 'gyur gyi skabs 'khel zhing / gar yod 'tsho gzhes ji byas gsal po med pa bcas/lcags rwa sprul sku sku phreng rim byon/sku phreng dang po/ chos rje sangs rgyas dpal 'byor('phags pa lha bde chen rdo rje'i sku mched)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa sbrul(1629)lor 'khrungs/ dgung grangs don lnga bzhes pa chu lug lor gshegs/sku phreng gnyis pa/chos rje ngag gi dbang po rab byung bcu gcig pa shing bya(1645)lor kong yul du 'khrungs/ dgung grangs re bdun bzhes pa lcags yos lor gshegs/sku phreng gsum pa/ ngag dbang chos 'byor bzang po rab byung bcu gcig pa shing lug (1655) lor long po stod du 'khrungs/ dgung grangs bcu gnyis me rta lor gshegs/200

sna sku phreng bzhi pa/ ngag dbang 'phrin las bzang po/ rab byung bcu gcig pa me lug (1667)lor long po stod du 'khrungs/ dgung lo re gcig me lug lor gshegs/ sku phred lnga pa/ ngag dbang bstan 'dzin lhun grub rab byung bcu gcig pa lcags phag (1671) lor long po stod du 'khrungs/ gong sa lnga pa chen pos rjes su bskung zhing brtse bas bskyangs te bka' tham bstsal nas gzengs su bstod/dgung lo nga drug rab byungu bcu gnyis pa'i me lug( 1727)lor gshegs/sku phreng drug pa/ngag dbang 'phrin lasasmodapal bzang rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags khyi ( 1720) lor 'ol kha rdzing phyir 'khrungs/— ( rgyal dbang skal bzang rgya mtshos 'dan chos 'khor mkhun po rgyun rags dang / er ti ni paṇ+ḍi ta'i 'ja' sa gnang / gong mas lcags rwa ho thog thu zhes pa'i mtshan dang /tham ka gnang rten le tshan bcas bstsal/ godzom lha skyong khri bzhugs nyer brgyad thog sba yer 'tshams zhuwul bar gser yig dang ga—sol ros bstsal te/de phyin 'phags pa lha'i 'tshams zhu sba yer nam sdol dang lhan cig gong mar 'tshams zhu 'bul srol chags/ dgung grangs re lnga rab byung bcu gsum pa'i shing stag(1794)lor gshegs/sku phreng bdun pa/ ngag dbang chos kyi dbang phyug rab byung bcu gsum pa'i me 'brug ( 1796) lor chab mdo khul rob dga' 'dzoms du 'khrungs/ gser te 201

bum brtag dpyad las thon te gdan sar bkod/ dgung grangs re lnga lcags spre(1ra60)lor gshegs/sku phreng brgyad pa/ ngag dbang bstan pa'i 'byung gnas 'phrin las chos kyi rgyal mtshan rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i lcags bya (1ra61) lor chab khul rob zho 'phel du 'khrungs/ gser bum brtag dpyad dang 'brel ba'i gdan khrir bkod/gong ma'i zhabs brtan dang bstan pa sems can snyesmu phan pa'i lhag bsam 'bad bzhin lcags glang (1401)lo dgung lo zhe gcig bzhes zhes gas95/sku phreng bcu pa/'jam dpal skal bzang 'jigs med chos kyi rgyal mtshan ri bo che lcags zam kha sa chung tshang du yab rnam rgyal dang yum tshe ring dpal skyid gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing khyi( 1924) lor 'khrungs/ chab dgon mtshan grwar slob gnyer gnang mur dgung grangs bcu drug sa byi ( 1kha4rdo)lor gshegs/sku phreng bcu gcig pa/blo bzang bstan 'dzin yab lha klu tshe dbang rdo rje dang / yum thon pa bde skyid gnyis kyi sras su lcags yos (1951) lor 'khrungs/ me spre ( 1956)lor khri gsol zhus/ da lta ljongs srid gros kyi rgyun las u yon dang ljongs mi rigs chos don u yon lhan khang gi kru'u ren gzhon pa yin/dkon rtor sprul sku sku phreng rim byon/sku phreng dang po/202

mkhas grub shākya lha dbang / rab byung bcu pa'i me khyi(15rdo6)lor kong por 'khrungs/ kong po phan bde dgon gyi chos rje mdzad/ dgung grangs lnga bcu nga lnga bzhes pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i lcags 'brug (1640)lo〈zhal snga bka' brgyud chos 'byung〉'di'i mdzad pa thor 'brel yod 'phags pa lha mthong ba don ldan dang chos kyi rgyal po'i mdzad pa'i gseb tu'ang 'khod yod/ dgung grangs don cu shing lug(1655)lo gshegs/sku phreng gnyis pa/ blo bzang dbang phyug sa sbrul(1629)lor nang chen khul du 'khrungs/ (zhes gsal bas de lta na rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa sbrul (16ṭ+wāṃ9)lo yin dgos pas sku phreng dang po gshegs nas lo sum cu so gsum song ba) dgung grangs don cu bzhes pa rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa stag(175ra)lor gshegs/ sku phreng gsum pa/blo bzang phyogs las rnam rgyal rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu rta (1762)lo nang chen khul du 'khrungs/ 'phags pa lha yab sras(zhi ba lha)grwa sar gsan sbyangs bzhugs ring gong ma'i bka' don chab mdo'i las don thugs 'gan bzhes/ gzhung na tham ka sogs kyi gzengs bstod gluganang / dgung lo don bcu pa sa phag lor gshegs/sku phreng bzhi pa/blo bzang 'jam dpal bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal chab mdor rob dge zla ba steng du lcags byi(178rkya)lor 'khrungs/ chu stag zla 7tshes 25la gdan sar 'khod/ dgung lo 52pa chu 'brug lor gshegs/ de nas lo 203

shas bar yang srid ma phebs/sku phreng lnga pa/ blo bzang rnam rgyal spo bo ka gnam sde par 'khrungs/ 'phags pa lha'i sku tshab chos srid kyi 'gan 'khur lo mang gnang sa glang lor gshegs/sku phreng drug pa/ri bo che khongs yo rdzong karma dgon rgya nye mtshungs su 'khrungs/1957skor khrir bkod/ dgung lo chung ngu'i skabs ngom brgyud gtsug phud ri khrod du yig klog slob gnyer bzhugs mus nas 1959lor lha rdzong brgyud phyi rgyal du yul 'gyar phebs te da lta ru'e sir bzhugs yod/gru thang rgya ra sprul sku sku phreng rim byon/sku phreng dang po/rgya ra sangs rgyas ye shes kyi rnam sprul du grags pa grub chen shes rab phun tshogs/ khyung po rta shod du 'khrungs/ dgung grangs re drug chu sprel lo gshegs/sku phreng gnyis pa/shing khyi lo kong yul khul du 'khrungs/ dgung grangs bcu gcig shing sprel lor bshegs / (rab byung dang mtshan ma rnyed)sku phreng gsum pa/blo bzang phun tshogs rnam rgyal chab mdo rdza rgyud khul du me khyi lor 'khrungs/ dgung grangs so gcig me 'brug lor gshegs/sku phreng bzhi pa/204

blo bzang bhastan 'dzin 'phrin las brag g.yab glang rong du 'khrungs/dgung lo nga gcig hūṃgs pha—ga lor gshegs/ — pe sku phreng lnga pa/skal bzang chos grags dpal ldan shing stag lor chab mdo mda' sad du 'khrungs/ dgung lo nga brgyad lcags phag lor gshegs/sku phreng drug pa/blo bzang chos 'phel che ba mdo mar thang du chu byi lor 'khrungs/dgung lo bco lnga lcags glang lor gshegs/sku phreng bdun pa/ 'phags mchog thub bstan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang phyug chu stag lor chab mdo lhu pa nang 'khrungs/ gong ma mchod yon gyi zhabs brtan dang /bstan 'gro'i mdzad 'phrin rgyas bzhin par dgung grangs don gnyis chu glang lor lho bzhi gram dgon du gshegs/sku phreng brgyad pa/blo bzang bstan 'dzin chos kyi dbang phyug shing rta(rab byung bco lnga pa yin dgos) lor brag g.yab 'khor ra dpon tshang du 'khrungs shing / grwa sar gsan sbyangs kyis dge shes kyi mtshan rtags bzhes/ chab mdo mnga' khul du bka' chos sogs kyi mdzad 'phrin rgyas mus su me sprel(195tre)lor lho rong brgyud phyi rgyal du yul byol phebs rjes phyi rgyal du gshegs/205

de min sprul sku 'bring chung khaga'abring gras/ la gong rdzong lho sprul sku/ tsha smad dar rtse sprul sku/ rdza stod mtshan nyid sprul sku/ kar mda' khri sprul/ skyo mda' sprul sku/ rdza srib ko rgyal dge pa tshul khrims/chung gras/ skyo mda' dbon chu sprul sku/ ko rgyal dam chos sprul sku/chos mgon sprul sku/ blo bzang sprul sku/ bstan pa rgya mtsho sprul sku/ thub bstan sprul sku/ khre dgon sprul sku/ shag nor sprul sku/ tsha 'brong sprul sku/stag gzigs rdzong rtsa sprul sku/ tho gru gu bsod snying sprul sku/ chos rgyal sprul sku/ kha ba sku skye tsha smad brag nag sprul sku/ ngom stod dbon sprul/ yi dam gyen long sprul sku/ rgya nag sprul sku/ mdzo lung sprul sku/ dus 'khor sprul sku/ tho gsol sder gru sras 'phags mchog bcas dang / gzhan yang rdis dbon bla ma/ gu mgo bla ma/ gser pa bla ma bcas so/206

dri — — chab mdo bla dgon gyi lo rgyus dang sgrig gzhi chos gzhis dang gtong sgo ri — dgon lag sogs/ne chab mdo bla dgon gyi lopyirgyus rags rim/ chab mdo 'khor byams pa gling ngom/ dge ldan byams pa gling zhes grags pa phyogs kun khyab pa'i 'du sa sde chen po 'di nyid ni rdza chu dang ngom chu 'dus khul chu dbar du chags shing / 'di nyid thog mar rje tshong kha pa'i dngos slob bstan pa phyogs mthar spel ba'i dar chen drug ces pa'i ya gyal byang sems shes rab bzang pos gang nyid dgung grangs lnga bcur bzhes pa rab byung bdun pa'i shing byi (1444) lor phyag btab/ de nas rim bzhin dar rgyas byung ste/ thog mar dge 'dun brgya phrag re gnyis nas rim gyis stong phrag brgal ba byuching zhing / mkhas grub gnyes ldan gyi mkhan slob gdan rabs kyang mang du byung ba dang / dbu phar 'dul mdzod/ tshad ma bcas mdo phyogs bka' pod kyi 'chad nyan dang / sngags phyogs gsang bde 'jigs gsum gyis gtsos rgyud sde brgyad kyi sgrub sde bcas rim bzhin 207

tshugs/ gdan rabs dang po byang sems shes rab bzang po nas/ gdan rabs bcu gsum pa tā la'i bla ma sku phreng gsum pa bsod rnams rgya mtsho dang /gdan rabs bcu bzhi pa 'phags pa lha sku phreng gsum pa mthong ba don ldan/zhi sprul drug pa bstan 'dzin 'phrin las bar la khyon gdan rabs nyi shu rtsa brgyad ring bshad sgrub kyi mthun rkyen dang bcas dar zhing rgyas pa byung yod/de rjes shon thong khri lo dang po ste rab byung bco lnga pa'i sa bya(19rkya9)lor kra'o er h+phung yun nan dang shi'i khams khul gyi zhib gcod spyi khyab pa dang bod sdod am ban gcig lcogs kyis 'ba' thang brgyud chab mdor 'byor skabs 'phags pa lha sku phreng bcu pa blo bzang thab bstan mi pham tshal khrims ra pa 1bye ra pargyal mtshan sku na phra stabs lcags rwa sprul sku sku phreng brgyad pa 'asken las chos kyi rgyal mtshan nas srid 'gan khur bzhes bskyangs kyi yod cing / gang des kra'o er h+phung la phebs bsu sne len dang / gus bkur sri zhu byed 'os gang ci gzab rgyas gzengs thon gnang yod/ 'on kyang kra'o er h+phung 'go dmag nas lam bar mi mang po ske bcad pa dang / khang pa mang po mer bsregs btang ba sogs drag rtsub kyi byed spyod rim bgyis la brten mi rnams dngangs 'jigs ngang gnas dgos pa bzos/ kho pa khams khul las don yun ring byed long ma byung bar nang sar phyir 'gugs byas thog chab mdo khul gyi las don byed po phin thung lin la bskos te las don bkod mngags kyis kra'o er h+phung range nyid chab mdo nas glo bur phyir log song zhing / skabs der chab mdo bla dgon la gtor skyon ma shor tsam byung yod rung / gang ltar kra'o er h+phung gi las mjug phin thung 'go dmag gis bskyangs te chab mdo bla dgon dang mi ser thog brdab gsig do phog tshabs che bzos stabs skabs der chab mdo'i bla khag dgon 'bangs spyi nas bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi 2༷8

srid bkulalhachu rgyas su bde sdug snyan zhu phul don/ —4gangs ljongs chab srid 'phrinaltas kyi 'tsho 'dzin dpal ldan mi dbang bka'i nadze+eblon chen po dang / sa darbang bku'i gung blon lhan rgyas mchog gi zhab4pad bla na mngon mtho'i khri'i drung du/gus pa chabarnamado 'phags pa lha ho thog thu/ zhi ba lha ho thog thu/ bla brang las byed che phra/ dgon ma lag gi bla grwa/ mnga' 'bangs kyi mi ser spyi bcas nyams dman 'u9 thub mgrin gcig nas gser snyan mi gtser ka med la rnam mkhyen 'tshoms khrelami shor ba mkhyen mkhyen/ zhu snying gus 'bangs gzhung sde lho rong rdzong gi khongs gtogs chab mdo'i mnga' khul 'dir che btsan rgyal khag gzhan dang / sngar phan rgya nag rgyal po sa gnam sa dbye tshun bod chol kha gsum po rang khongs su gnas bzhin las tsha khral ri gas 'gel bkod gang yang gnang mi 'drag kyang / de rjes ching rgyal rabs kyi gong ma dang 'phags pa lha mchod yon du 'brel bas gong ma khang shis nas 'phags pa lhar mtshan 'phar/ tham ka gser yig dang / 'phegs lhas bdag tu bzung ba'i lha mi sde 'bangs la su gang gis kyang bsnyad gtser dmad pa tsam mi chog phebs 'phrel chab mdo bas lo shas mtsham4pe cin pho brang du sba yer 'bul tshan phul bar deb gsal gsol ras stsal lam sog sa bka' drin gyis 'tsho bzhin gus tshos kyang gong mtshang gi blon chen gyis dbus bod phebs khral si che phrar bka' dpyad dgongs don mi ser la bdal bla gsol ras gnang srol ltar sa gnas rta khal mi gsum gang dgos zhabs zhu lhag bsam dang bstod dang ldan pa zhus dang zhu mus dang gong ma g.yung chin khri lo gsum skabs chab mdo ni 'phagasapa lha skyes rabs brgyud mar bdag tu bzung ba'i yul yin pas yab rgyal pos 'ja'ahos bstsal bzhin bdag 'dzin chog pa gnang 209

tshar zhes spyi phebs ltar grwa tshang khag lnga gtsos rang 'og dang gzhan 'og tu 'khod pa'i dgon sde khag sogs mchod gzhis su gtogs pa rnams dang /'phags pa lha sku phreng brgyud mar bdag ṭu'adzin pa'i lha mi dgon sde tshang mas khral rigs 'char 'phar chab mdo ranga'i sgrub pa las su gang la'ang 'jal mi dgos pa sogos sngar srol bzang po de mus su gnas bzhin 'phags pa lhas dbus thugs sras/ las byed yan lag mtshan 'phar/ tham ka/ go ming sogs je mtho gnang thog skye rgu ma lus pa'i skyabs mgon bstan pa'i bdag pa'i srid zhi'i rnam 'dren rim phebs nas kyang zab chos snyan brgyud thun min gyi thugs sras khams phyogs bstan pa'i mgon du dbang bskur/gzengs bstod bka' bsher rim bstsal sogs bka' drin zab mos bskyangs dang skyong bzhin gus tshang 'phags pa lha yab sras nas kyang bsta na don lar rgya'i skyid sdug legs nyes gcig gyur gyi zhabs zhu 'os gang na ci byung gzhung 'bangs spyi 'gro'i lhag bsam mi dman pa'i zhabs zhu sgrub bzhin par phyis su bod ljongs chos kyi zhing sar bstan 'gro'i bde skyid 'a/ rngam pa'i gdug can kra'o er h+phung dang / rjes 'jug phin kon de sogs nas de sngon bod khongs dgon khag mang po mer bsregs/ skyes chen dang dge 'dun mang po bkrong /phal mo che sa mthar bskrad pa dang / de lo kra'o er h+phung / krung sogs dpon dmag 'bor che glo bur du sa gnas rim 'byor byung bar/ rta khal rtsa shing / sgrig cha sogs rig pas mi 'dum pa'i lam 'khel mi ser phal cher sdeb stong 'gro nyer gyar zhing / de rjes rang bzhin gong ma'i bka' 'brel yin tshul gyis gus 'tsho'i khral bsdu/ khrims gnon sogs dbang ris btsan bcom gyis mi ser smos ci/ 'phags pa lha yab sras dgon ma lag gi mchod gzhis dang bcas par rgya khral 'os med dang 'phrel sems can ra lug yan la 210

dngul khral brgyab ste 'bru khral rigs kyang son 'gro ji yod 'jal dgos byung ba sogs ngan dbang kho na'i khar phin kon de dpon dmag nas rtswa shing tshong 'gel byung rigs spyi dang / dgon pa'i tshogs shing bcas lam sgug bcom 'phrog grwa pa kha shas kyang brdung rdzogs dang sngar nas gong ma mchod yon gyi sku yi tshe thar srog bskyabs bgyis pa'i dgon dang / dgon gyi nye skor ri klung la gnas pa'i srog chags bsad pa/ bkag shing bcad pa sogasadabang yod khrims med byed rkyang gis dgon sde tshang ma chags re bral ba'i sdang rdzub brdabs bsigs mnar gcod dang 'brel ba'i chu byi lo 'go nas lhag par hang shed sha stag thog rjes su zam pa phan tshun/ ya la rdzong / gu ru zam pa bcas srung bkag ma zad chab mdo dgon pa 'di bzhin kho pa tsho'i lam rgyags phang drang yin zhes nam rgyun dpa' gtam byas te/ yang snying gus tshos nyam chung 'gro shes sdod mkhas bab lhing brtan gsum gyis rgya'i ci gsung bka' sgrub byas rung / da dung de las je sdug lta bus dgon pa rang la rgya mi zhugs rtsis lam gsal rung / dgon pa chos mtshams grol 'khel gyi grwa pa nyung shas las med skabs rang bzhin sdod spobs ma bzod pa'i dgon pa srung char ser skya 'ga' shas 'gugs rtsis byas kyang / phar tshur mi gcig kyang ma btang khar zla 5tshes 1ṭ+wāṃnyin phogs len yin khul gyi rgya dmag kha shas nas me mda' 'khyer te dgon par yong zhing / de nyin gu ru zam srung tshos klung sding 'phags pa lha'i chibs ra nas rta rnams 'phrog ste kho pa tsho'i za nyal dos rigs rnams chab dgon pho brang rang la bskyel dgos zhes dgon par zhugs rtsis rbad chod yod 'dug stabs chab grwa kha shas dang phogs len pa rtsod 'dzing thug ste gu ru nas phyir yong rnams kyang dgon par zhugs dwogs gdong bkag byas khul yang / yang tig de nub nam phyed tsam la rgya mis dgon pa mer bsregs 211

kyi sku gsung thugs rten re re'i yon tan rin thang gi tshad ni srid pa gsum na bgrang par mi nus pa gong du phud/ de byings rgyu rdzas dngos po'i rin thang la'ang dngul rdo tshad 'bum phrag 'ga' zhig ri nges thog pho brang dang /gtsug lagakhang / grwa khang / khrol khang yan khang pa stong phrag gnyis lhag mer bsregs/ gtor 'khyer byas pa dang / mi ngom mkhan slob khyad 'phags bcu skor/ dpon po che chung bzhi/ grwa btsun pho mo phru gu yan nyis brgya skor bcas dmar gsod btang / bla khag mi ser bcas kyi rta khal sems can bcom pa yang grangs las 'das pa sogs so so'i shor tho bsnyen ham min pa gang nges rags tsam rjes 'bul zhus chog pa ma za/ gus pa 'phags pa lha yab sras/ dar han/ las byed/ dge 'dun pa shul lus bcas sa gnas su chags re bral ba sogs gong ma mchod yon nyi zla zung 'brel gyi thugs rje'i grib bsil nas bstan dgra log can phin kon de/ lu'i/cang sogs dpon dmag rnams nas khrims men de ltar byas pa rgya bod lha mi spyi gsal la gus tshos gsal 'debs zhu ma dgos khar/ 'phros lus mi ser rnams nas sa zhing / dngos nor/ rgyud phrug sogs la chags te yul byon ma thub pa'i spyang lug mnyam gshibs su mi sdod ka med byung rigs rnams la'ang rta khal rtsa shing / 'bru khral sogs dmyal ba'i sems can gyi sdug bsngal las ches cher sdang ba'i 'jigs skrag brdabs mnar gang mi byung zhing /sngar phan bstan dgra kra'o phin gnyis nas bzung dang phan gus tshos mang nad nyung theg bral ba'i skrag ngo 'jigs zil kho na'i ngang nas rgol 'thab mi bya ka med las/ 'di phyi'i legs tshogs blangs dor mi shes pa'i nag phyogs bdud rigs rgya mi de rnams la blos blangs mgo btags lus 'bul lta zhogamanal lam du'ang ma shar ba phyi mtha' gsal zhing / da skabs mi ser shul 212

yod nas kyang srog la dmar ches ci zer dwang len mi byasaka med yong gi yod tshod lase/ krokha zhe gnyis med kyis mgo btags zhus pa med nges lha dgongs rim dwang sa yong shag bcas da skabs zhu ba'i snying por/ bstan dgra phin lu'i/ cang rjes 'jug dang bcas par nyes pa mig ltos la phan pa dang /bstan dgon sngar ltar gsar gsab/ mi bsad la stong / rgyu dngos la 'jal bshags bcas byed po rang nas ngo bkrus gdong ngag dgos pa dang /de min chab mdo'i nye mtshungs tsha ba/ dim chi/ thu'i si khag nas kyang gus tshor zhi drag mthun rkyen lta zhog dngos chas khe nyos bgyis pa sogs la brten gus tshor nyams gsos gsol ras yong ba bcas 'dir zhu rgyu byung min la ma ltos pa'i rgyal bstan spyi bye'i mgon po gzhung sa mchog nas gong ma mchod yon bka' mol dang 'brel ba'i gus tsho snga sa da 'jags nyams pa sor chud yong ba'i gong sa lha mi'i rnam 'dren chen por gser snyan sgron 'bul bcas pha mas bu bskyang lta bu'i skyabs 'jug thugs rjes gzigs pa mi chung ba ci nas mkhyen/ mkhyen/ mkhyen zhu zhes gsol ba 'debs pa lags’’zhes pa dang /yang chab blas phul ba'i snyan zhur chu byi zla 9tshes 1srid tham 'byar ma'i mgo mchan zhal bshurmos nangaphagong sa lha mi'i rnam 'dren chen por snyan zhus don 'brel bar lam rgya'i blon rigs log smon 'ga' zhig gis nyer len la brten bstan srid yong la gnod tshabs che thog chab khul du'ang las byed sngon ma rnams nas gnas dus cho 'brang gtso bzung gi rkyen las sa gnas su rgya dpon dmag 'bor che lhags 'byor gyi dbang byus 'bab rigs gang cir do phog tshabs che ji byung blo ngag thog 'di lo rgya dmag spyi mtshungs phyir log dgos rgyu'i zhib 'phros mur grwa rigs 'ga' zhig gi byed las la brten pas rgyang na nas dgon gyi rten gsum khyon che dang / rgyu dngos gser dngul sogs 'phrog 213

'khyer zin 'phros gtsug lag khang dang grwa shag sogs mer bsregs kyis gnas lugs shin tu ngan pa byung 'dug cing / chab mdo'i 'di bzhin rmad phyogs zhwa ser ring lugs 'phel rgyas kyi gzhi 'dzin med du mi rung ba zhig yin gshis gzhi rtsa'i bde 'jags mtshams rim bzhin nyams pa sor chud yong 'gro zhing / dbyin ji nas bod don skor rgya phyogs su gsung mol zhi brling mdzad dang mdzad mus/ phin gyis mtshon rgya phyogs nas da phan khrims 'gal byung rigs brda 'ded 'phros mol rim bzhin bgyis rgyur mdo smad gang ci'i 'tsho 'dzin bkod khyab byed po che khag las bya dpung dmag rim rdzong bya rgyur chab mdo'i rgya dpon dmag phyir log dgos skor dang / sku rten gser dngul dngos rigs mnyam 'khyer mi chog pa'i don gcod khag dang /sde dgon che ba'i 'go byed la bkod rgya 'thus 'doms so’’zhes sogs 'khod/me glang chab mdo grwa tshang brgyad nas thob khongs skor spang blangs zhu don mna' gan 'dra bcu'i nang‘‘rab byung bco lnga pa'i chu byi lor bod ljongs tshogs lhan bka' don grub ste rgya ngan la dgra rgyag klad 'gems ma thub rkyen log can nas dgon gnas rtsa brlag shor ba’’zhes dang / ‘‘gzhung sa'i bka' dgongs sngon chad mdo spyi sa dbang bla ma byams pa bstan dar mchog chu glang lor dgon gyi 'go yod rigs sho mdor bka' 'gugs kyis rgya gar sim lar srid blon bshad sgra chen po las bya dang / gdan 'thus bcas chibs bsgyur grub ste dbyin gzhung bar bzhugs rgya bod dbar bka' mol gnas bzhin la rdo don dgon gyi rgyu shor rgya rdo 'bum lnga slog sprod dgos mol bzhin phyir slog byung na dang / de min mthar skrad gnang 'thus la tshang mas bslab pa slob gnyer 'don tshig phyag len brjed bskyur med pa'i ri khrod nye mtshungs sogs su 'du tshogs gang yong tshul mthun dgos rgyu spyi phebs thog chab mdo sa rda 214

zla tshes larang sa tshur bzhes chab mdo'i sa gnas phebs nyid nas kyang / grwa sgrub tshang ma chagezhol mar thang du rgya khang khag tu 'tshogs bcug pa dang /lte ba'i rtsa brlag yong rkyen ngan zhing dgon gnas su dge 'dun bzhugs gnas med pa'i rkyen gyis bslab skyon je mang thog 'dus bud ci che/ mi ser dgra shul mnar rgyun ring 'khos dgan gang nas dgon gnas slar bzhengs sor chud 'byung blo rbad bral tshang ma blonga'akhums sdug sgom las smra brjod ji zhu ma mchispokyang / gong sa lha mi'i rnam 'dren chen por snyan zhus srid tham 'go mchan spyi phebs/ (gong gsal yin pa 'dra)dril bsgrags dang 'brelaba'i dgon gnas slar bzhengs/ dgos pa'i bka' khyab dang 'brel/ chab mdo'i khrims 'doms dang ar 'ul 'go byed mdo las mkhan chung bsko gzhag gis snga sor mthun rkyen du 'bru kha'i chig stong tham pa gsol bstsal byung’’zhes sogs gsal ba dang / yang chu rta chab mdo'i bla dgonanang khul mthun gan nang / ‘‘chu byir gzhung sa'i bka' dgongs rgya mir 'thab 'dzing lam du ma song bar dgon gnas rtsalke brlag 'gro rkyen der thug lugs skyabs mgon rgyal dbang bcu gsum pa mchog nas bka 'a phebs bslu med bzhin’’zhes gsal bas skabs der byung rkyen gong gsal de tshor brten nas dgon pa rtsa brlag song ba yin 'dug rī chab mdo'i ma dgon gtor ba dang dus mtshungs thang dkar steng gi 'phags pa lha yab sras kyi gzim khang le lag dang / thog thu lcags sbrul glabrang gi gzim khang / —mar thang gi grong sde mang dag bcas mer bsregs—dang /lhun grub rtse'i 'phags galha'i ri khrod bcom 'phrog gtor brlag dgon sde/dpon khag mi ser bcas kyi rgyu nor ji rnyed cig 'phrog 'khyer byas pa dang 'brel chu byi nas sa rda ba/ra lu'u cun dmag gi pa'o krang dang tshun krangu mang po 215

bsko gzhag dang khral bsdu khrims gnon gyi dbang sgyur byas stabs phyis su yang mig rgyun chags pa'i rgya gte rgya nas zhes pa'i 'bru khral lji po bkal ba red/skabs de'i rgyus can 'ga' zhig gi gsung rgyun ltar na dgon mer sreg skabs 'phags pa lhu sku phreng bcu pa dgung grangs bcu gnyis tsam las son med cing / chab mdor chags gnas bral te lha sar phebs nas se rar chos zhugs slob gnyer bzhugs ring gzhung nas gnyer mkhar gzhis ka kha 'dzin du gnang ba dang / tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa mchog nas spyan bskyangs gzigs skyong yag po gnang yod pa red/tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa hin rdu nas bod du chibs zhal bsgyur rjes lha sar bsdad pa'i lu'u cun dpon dmag phyir bskrad thog rim bzhin lha sa man chod sa gnas khag gi lu'u cun dpon dmag kyang phyir 'bud dang 'brel mdo smad sa khul gnon bzung byed ched tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pas mda' dpon khyung ram pa dang / bkras mthong pa/ phu lung pa sogs dmag dpung dang bcas bka' blon bla ma byams pa bstan dar mdo smad zhi drag spyi 'doms la bsko gtong gnang ba'i bkod 'doms 'og sa gnas khag gi rgya rigs dpon dmag phyir 'bud kyis sa cha rim bzung mthar bka' blon bla ma rang nyid lho rgyud sho mdo dang ngom 'du/ lho rong bcas su bca' sdod byas te chab mdo lte ba lhing 'jags gtong dgos pa'i bkod khyab kyis mda' dpon dang dmag dpung sngon du mngags mdzad/ chab mdo'i yab tshang blo bzang bde chen dang spo zhang mtha' yas sogs rdzong khag gi mi drag rnams mchan phebs sku srung yin lugs kyis bu gta'i tshul du kho pa'i rtsar bkag bskyil nyar 'jog byas pa dang / mkhan chung ru tsha mgon po bsod nams chab mdo'i ar las 'go byed du sngon la mngags gtong byas/ mkhan chung 216

ru tsha snga yochab mdo spyi mdzod skal bzang yon tan gyi gsol dpon byed myong bas chab mdo bla dgon gyi cha rgyus yod/ mkhan chung ru tsha nas chab mdo bla dgon gyi las byed dang grwa pa shul yod grong gseb tu 'thor sdod rnams skong 'gugs 'go 'doms kyis chab dgon gsar skrun gyi gros mol thog mi— dmangs skul slong bya rgyu sogs kyi jus gzhi bkod thog sa dbang la dga' bsu gus bkur gang che dgos pa'i bkod mngags byas/ chab mdo lte ba gzhi rtsa'i thog lhing 'jags3nga bstun bka' bla byams bstan rang nyid gzhi nas chab mdor 'byor zhing / snga phan mkhan chung ru tsha nas chab mdo'i spyi mdzod skal bzang yon tan 'das po'i rjes shul shag tshang gi ming thog nas tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa mchog dang srid skyong mdun snyan zhu 'phul te spyi mdzod 'das po'i dbang ris bdag thog gang yod chab mdo dgon du mchod rtsa nyams gsor 'byor 'ja—gas kyi spyi so'i las 'khur byed mi sgrub khag brgyad so so'i shes ldan mi re gzhung gnas rang nas bsko bzhag giris dgon ma lag gi khur len dang chab gzhung las don galacher the jus chog pa'i go gnas bdag rkyen stsal grub sogs zhus don ltar phyir phebs chu byi srid dam 'go mchan rjes 'brel dgon pa'i mchod rgyun las 'gan 'khur5mkhan spyi so zhes pa bsko gzhag byas/ sa lug (1919) lor skemakhan chung ru tsha bas 'gobyas chab mdo bla dgon las byed nas bla dgon nyams gso'i don du 'phags pa lha sku phreng bcu pa lha sa nas chab mdor phyir phebs dgos lugs re 'dun zhu yig 'phul 'brel tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa rmachog nas 'phags pa lha gnas skabs chab mdor phebs 'a thus dad ṅkagon pa nyamase gso'i bkod sgrig sogs gzhi rtsa'i las ka grub mtshams dge bshes gtong rgyu dang bsnyenangardzogs sgrub 217

par slar yang lha sar phebs dgos pa'i bka' phebs ltar de don gan 'bul zhus te dgongs 'khrol byung nas 'phags pa lha chab mdor phyir phebs/ de skabs 'phags pa lha de nyid dgung grangs bcu dgur phebs yod pa red/gong smos ltar dgon pa'i gtsug lag khang dang / grwa shag bla brang bcas 'chig ro dang gyang ro tsam gyi rjes shul las med pas rmang nas nyams gso gsar skrun byed dgos la/ grwa pa yang bgres song drug brgya yas mas las bzhugs med pa dang / gtong rtsa mchod gzhis sogs kyang rtsa ba nas rkang sgrig slar gso dgos pa bcas kyi gnas tshul 'og 'phags pa lha sku phreng bcu pa gang des dgon pa nyams gso'i skor gnang ba'i gtan tshigs su/‘‘sne mor mngags slebs spyi dang / chab 'og tu gtogs pa'i bla dpon spyi sger gyi gnyer las 'dzin/ bla dpon khag mnga' khul dgon khag shog dpon/ rgan sde dmangs bcas mtha' dag nas nges rgyur/ mdo khams 'dzin mi rgyan gcig dpal ldan chab mdo byams pa gling zhes/ rje bdag nyid chen po'i dngos slob byang sems shes rab bzang pos rab byung bdun pa'i me sbrul lor phyag btab par mdzad nas dam pa'i tshul dgu dang ldan pa'i gdan rabs du mas skyong zhing gdan rabs bcu gsum pa rgyal ba'i dbang po bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sdes chos sde 'di nyid 'dzin skyong spel gsum mdzad de dar rgyas che ba dang / rje gong ma mthong ba don ldan nasarim bzhin bdag gir mdzad pa ji skad du/ bka' gdams glegs bam las/ dang po bzhi grwa nas bzung ste/ tha ma stong phrag gsum gyi bar/ bslab pa gsum ldan shākya'i sras/ 'gro ba yongs kyi mgon du 'gyur zhes lung ba bstan pa ltar rig 'dzin dge 'dun gyi sde stong phrag gsum lhag 'phel rgyas kyi zhwa ser cod paṇa 'chang ba'i ring lugs dril ma med pa'i khyab gdal du yod pa de bzhin 218

yang / bod ljong4bde skyid kyi gshed ma log can yul gyi phung 'dre bsam sbyore gnyis gnag gis nyams nyes btang rung / gong sa lha mi'i rnam 'dren mchog gi thugs rjes log can rnams phyir bskrad grub nas bstan dgon 'di ngag nyams gso thub res kho bo bod nas phyir 'byor skabs dgon ro dang dge 'dun 'phros lus drug brgya skor rnams mig lam mthong 'phral blo yid skyo shas bcos med du rgyud la skye ba'i snying rje'i gnas su gyur 'dug pas/ rje gong ma na rim gyi bla slob thun mong ma yin pa'i dam tshig mdud rgya brtan pos 'brel ba'i gdul byi bu slob rnams kyi mchod rtsa gtong thebs phal mo che rtsa stong sngar ma grags pa'i ban hrul zhe gcig la rang lugs kyi cho ga chos spyod ma chag tsam gyi gong sa lha gcig mchog gi zhabs brtan dang / rgyal bstan chab srid dar rgyas la ched dmigs kyis 'tsho phan nyams gso ji thub kyi re 'dun che gshis/sngar grwa lam ban rgyun dang / dkor sa dge khung ji yod rnams smos med khar/snga lo mdo khams zhi drag spyi khyab sa dbang bla ma mchog nas chab bla'i las byed che phrar bka' 'dri go bsdur bskyangs pa'i spyi zhus bzhin sgrub khag gi chos gzhis sngar thob le lag ji yod kyi zhing thor khral rigs 'khri med kyi sbyor 'jags gtsang gras su mgo mchan gsol ras bstsal ba'i dgongs don de dag gzhan rtsod bsgyur bkod med pa'i ji srid bar gtan 'jags 'gal med dgos rgyu dang / bar lam rje gong ma na rim nas gnas skabs spyan bskyangs kyis ma dgon du bamābu khral zhus bstsal med pa'i khug lus su bsdad pa rdzong khag lcags rwa khyung me/ tsha ba stod smad bcas phud pa'i de byings rdza stod yar yul ma dang / gying dbriltabrag gsum/ rgya rong / 'dzi rdo ci dga' bsdus/ stag gzig pe ri shog dgu/ tho jed/ la nor stod smad/khrom grags stod smad khag gnyis/gyu ngom bstod tham brag mar thang pa 219

sogs mnga' khul tshang mas da lam gnas dus la brten sngar lam bzhin bu gnyis yod 'dud re'i bu re chos sgor 'jug pa'i thob khongs gtan 'bebs cha bgos deb 'khod ring min bya rgyu yin pas go ba log sgrub kyis bla sprul/dgon khag dpon khag mi ser sogs che phra sus kyang bka' bsher bsnyad pas mtshon ban rgyun la rtsod 'then ka kor byung tshe khrims kyos 'da' ded bya nges dang / de sngon chos mtha' ma 'khyol ba'i ser chad rtse gnyer khang du 'bul sgrub zhu la ma de bzhin yang / las byed rnams nas ji bzhin bda' 'ded ma byas pa'i khrims yang gi rkyen pas skyon che la slad phyin sngar sor nyams gso'i lugs su rtsa bzhi gang rung la 'gal ba'i ser chad spyi so las khang nas yal yol mya myu ngo srung med pa'i sngar lam zhib tshags kyis sgrub khag so so'i rgetor thebs kha snon deb 'khod dang / 'brel ba'i rgyu rkyen song gsal ma zad/ phyis su sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i ser skyon g.yor che song yod 'dug pa zhib brtag skabs kha shas nas blun po bde 'ded kyi bsam bzhin skyon zhugs thog dang por skya sar thon par khrims bsgrags bkru dag tshar rjes skya drung kho na khyad med pa'i phyi ma'i nyes lhung las 'di gang ngo tsha dgos pa med gshis 'dzems bya chung skyon du mngon pa sgrub po'i 'khos par phan gnod mi 'gyur rung / ngo tsha dran rten gyi bsdam ra 'byung khyad lo ltar ser shud res dngul sgor lnga re'i mal du 'bru dngul sne gang ri dran rten gong khongs su sgrubs dgos/rab byung bco lnga pa'i me yos tshun gyi tha spang leb 'grigs sgyur ba dang /khral khongs min pa'i spang rgod rmo 'dul dge bed yod rigs spyi sos mtshon pa'i mchod rtsa la rmo bdag bya 'thus dang / phyis su nang gzhung gis sgrub khag grwa rigs mar sgrub khral 'phar btang ba rnams kyi de sngon mar chad ji yod so sos mgo bkrus gdong dag byas rjes slad nas sngar lam bsnyad pa'i mar sgrub 220

bar khongs nas btang 'thus min cing ’’zam gdan zhes pa'i dge zhal nas ja mar/ 'bru lcags/ sha dkar nag bcas bla brang nang mar sgrubs dgos rnams khos kha4mi lcog pa mngon dod la brten slad yang cha dang / grwa sgrub khag ser mo'i rigs nas rdo shing ji yod rnams da lam 'khur len byas rjes slad nasarage 'dun pas kun dga' ra ba gsar bzhengs yin na las 'dul ba'i bcas pa dang 'gal bas de byings mchog dman sus kyang bskul 'ded bya 'thus min pa dang / 'di ga'i bkod mngags dang ma 'brel ba'i grwa rigs la las byed skye bo che phras nyes sdung med pa dgos rgyu bcas rang khul khrims gnon mkhan chung la legs sdur dang las byed rnams la 'dri brtsad zhib nan gyis chod 'doms bgyis pa yin pas de don ji srid bar tshang mas spang blang 'gal med tshul bzhin yong ba gyis/ chab mdo byams gling bshad sgrub 'phel rgyas chog grwa nas/ sa lug zla 4dkar phyogs rdzogs pa gsum pa'i tshes dge bar bris7zhes gsal bar yongs grags su‘‘sa lug she bam’’zhes brjod cing / de ni dgon pa nyams gso'i las don byed phyogs kyi rtsa 'dzin lta bu yin/dgon pa bskyar bzhengs byed phyogs ni/ sgrub khag brgyad kyi 'du khang dang grwa shag bcas so so'i grwa lam ban rgyun thob khongs kyi grwa pa dang mi ser so so nas ar las 'dzugs skrun byas pa dang / tshogs chen gyi 'du khang dang sku zhabs grwa tshang gi 'du khang dang grwa shag bcas pa bla brang gi mnga' 'og rdzong khongs mi ser la ar 'ul bskul te bskrun/ dge slong grwa tshang gi 'du khang ni bla dgon spyis a bskrun byas pa ma zad de'i mgon khang dang / a mchod grwa tshang gi tshogs khang yang bla dgon spyi nas bskrun/ mchog grwa'i 'du khang ni de snga lha khang nyis 'brel ma zer ba rtseg ro bskyar gso byas te mdo spyi bkras 221

mthong skabs bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis ar po skul te gsar skrun byas pa bcas grwa tshang khag gi 'du khang so sor tshon rtsi dang / ldebs bris la sogs rim bzhin dgon gnas cha tshang nyams gso gsar chags byung ba red/chab mdo bla brang gi gzim khang zhes/ 'phags pa lha dang / zhi lcags/ dkon rdor/ bla brang rtse shod sogs le lag cha tshang thog brtsegs lnga ldan rgya khyon chen po zhig yod pa mer bsregs rtsig ro'i rmang gzhi'i thog mi ser ar 'ul bskul te rim bzhin bskyar skrun byas pa yang nub phyogs dang /lho phyogs kyi khang pa las mtha' ma 'dus par las 'phro bsdad pa red/yang chab dgon bla spyi nas sa stag(192rdo)lor bod sa gnas srid gzhung la snyan zhu phul ba'i zhu khongs su slochu byi lo gangs ljongs tshogs 'du'i bka' dgongs rang sa gtsang dgos phebs par brten bka' don rjes sgrub zhu skabs rgya'i dpon dmag nas grwa pa brgya phrag lhag rkyen bsad dang /dgon gyi rten gtso thub chen 'dzam gling rgyan gyur dang / byams chen mthong grol chen mo sogs de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel bya dmar sel/ (ma gsar)gyi sgo nga tsam rtog gsum bzhugs pas gtsos sku rten 'bum phrag mang po dang / gsung rten rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che'i par gzhi dang /gser dngul/ mtshal snag gi bris pa sogs pod 'bum phrag brgal ba/thugs rten rgyal dbang bsod rnams rgya mtsho'i phyag sor bzhugs pa'i gser sdong chen mos gtsos stong phrag kha shas dang / pho brang chen po dge ldan byams pa gling gis gtsos gtsug lag khang bcu phrag brgal ba/ bla dpon khag gi gzim khang / tshogs chen 'du khang gi gtsos 'du khang bcu gcig slob dpon lnga'i gzim khang / dge 'dun nyis stong lhag gi grwa shag dgon spyi sger gyi mchod rdzas/ gtong rtsa 'dzin chas sogs nang dngos rnams 'khyer 222

'phros dang / khang pa shul med mer bsregs kyi dngos po la rin 'bab hang tshod dngul rgya rdo 'bum phrag sum cu tham pa lhag brgal ba meg med rtsa stong btang ba'i skabs der gzhung sa chen por snyan phul srid tham 'go mchan spyi phebs ltar grwa tshang so so'i 'du khang dang / grwa shag chu rang 'khol gyis lam sgrub dang / chu byar tshogs chen 'du khang thog brtsegs gcig gsar rgyag byas kyang shing cha phra la rul skyon gyis ka gdung chag grum dang / phyi rtsig lngar gyi myang ro me shul sa mug gis bzos pa yo 'khyom che ba sogs kyi sa brtan phugs 'kher yong re bral bas gzhung sa mchog nas slar yang gsar rgyag grub thabs’’zhes sogs zhus don srid skyong rwa sgreng nas sa yos/ (1929)lor phyir phebs srid tham 'go mchan duyotshogs chen 'du khang thad/ gsar bzhengs nyams gso ji 'os rgyu 'gro dang bcas gzhung gnas nas thugs 'gan bskyed 'thus yong 'gro bas do dam thad mdo spyis zhor 'drong dgos rgyur 'du khang bsra brtan phugs 'pher bstan byun sman thabs lhag bsam lhod med thog chab dgon bla grwa nas kyang bdag don bdag gces 'khos dpag gi zhabs 'degs lhag blo zhe bskyes byed’’ces sogs gsal ba ltar mdo spyi dza sag gnyis nas 'go btsugs te mdo smad rdzong khag yongs rdzogs ar mi leb bskul gyis ar po'i 'go 'doms mkhan che zla ba dang / rtse drung 'phags legs gnyis kyi thog dgon pa'i spyi so dang / chab bla'i brtag dpyad drung yig gcig bcas bskos nas gsar bzhengs ka gdung la shing brkos kyi mdzes rgyan dang tshon rtsi ston pa'i 'khrungs rabs sogs ldebs ris dang / steng du gan ji ra dang bcas mdo spyi g.yu thog skabs las mjug legs par grub nas zhal spro'i bsnyen bkur gzab rgyas mdzad/de ltar dgon gnas gtsug lag khang dang grwa shag khag bcas gsar 223

bzhengs grub pa dang / 'du tshogs kyang bskyar gso grub bstun grwa tshang khag gi 'du khang thog zangs gser gyi gan ji ra/ sgrub sde so so'i yi dam dang bla brgyugakyi ldebs ris tshon rtsi bcas gzhi rtsa'i thog legs grub rjes rim pas dgon gyi nang rten gsar bzhengs byas shing / zangs gser gyi rje yab sras gsum gyi sku chen thog brtsegs gnyis pas gtsos grwa tshang khag gi yi dam dang 'dod lha'i rten gtso rje btsun byams pa'i sku brnyan thog brtsegs gnyis pa sogs zangs gser dang sman 'dam las grub pa'i sku brnyan/ che ba mang po dang /de min 'thor bsdus kyi sku brnyan li ma 'gangs chen mang po/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur chen mo dang / rje yab sras gsum gyi gsung 'bum/ sgrub khag brgyad kyi cho ga chos spyod dang / mtshan grwa'i gzhung bka' pod kyi yig chu rnams kyis mtshon pa'i shing par gsar bzhengs bgyis pa grangs las 'das/rtsedz+wabla brang gi rnying lus shog nag la gser dngul gyis bris pa'i bka' 'gyur 'dzas gling rgyan gcig ces pa dang / bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur cha tshang mang po/ rje yab sras kyi bka' 'bum tshar mang pos gtsos de min chos lugs dang / lo rgyus rig gnas sogs bris ma dang par ma'i gsung rten pod stong phrag kha shas/ thugs rten 'phags pa lha yab sras sogs kyi gdung rten mchod sdong zangs gser las grub pa gzi byur/ g.yang ṭi/ ma na ho sogs rin po che'i phra rgyan can bcu phrag gzhan yang mchod rdzas tshogs chen dang grwa tshang so sor gos rgyu bzang las grub pa'i ka rgyan gdung khebs/phur ma/ dbang rdzas/ 'cham chas/ sil sbub/ rgya gling / dung chen/rkang gling sogs gser dngul zangs sogs las bzos pa'i chos chas sna tshogs/ gser kong dang / dngul kong / dngul ting / da dung sku rten bris ma tshon khra dang gser ris kyi ston pa'i 'khrungs rabs brgya pa dang 224

rtogs brjod dpag bsam khri shing / rgyud sde'i lha tshogs dang / gnas brtan gtso 'khor/ rje'i rnam thar tsong kha brgyad cu sogs kyi sku thang bzang gos rgyu gtsang gi gong gsham can/ grangs las 'das pa/ tshogs gdan dang / thab chas khro chen sogs mdor na dgon me ma shor gong gi phyi nang snod bcud 'dzin chas la do bar dka' rung / gang ltar gang ci'i thad nas cung cha tshang tsam bskyaralagaso thub pa byung yod/rtse shod bla dgon gyi sgrig gzhi/ byang sems shes rab bzang pos dgon pa phyag btab pa nas bzung 'phags pa lha sku phreng gsum pa mthong ba don ldan gyi bar dgon spyi'i 'dzin skyong mkhan rabs rim pas mdzad pa dang / 'phags pa lha mthong don ldan nas bzung gong ma'i 'ja' sa mtshan lung dang / bod kyi tā la'i bla ma'i gtan tshigs dgongs don 'phags pa lha sku phreng rim pas bla dgon gyi bstan srid gcig sdud kyis 'dzin skyong mdzad kyi yod la/ 'phags pa lha sku 'tsho bzhugs med skabs dang skur nar ma son ring thugs sras zhi ba lha dang /lcags rwa ho thog thu rnam gnyis dang / rje dbon dkon rdor sprul sku nas 'phags pa lha'i khri tshab dang skabs 'gar spyi mdzod kyi thugs 'gan 'khur bzhes gnang lam yod rung / rtsa ba'i srid kyi 'dzin skyong spyi mdzod dar ran gyi las tham bka' shog gtan tshigs lam yig sogs srid phyogs kyi las don tshang mar spyod/'phags pa lha'i chos srid gnyisakyi rtse shod las khungs gnyis te rtse las khungs kyi rgyun gtan las don 'dzin skyong byed po gtso bo rtse gnyer gsum dang /225

rtse mgron gnyis/ rtse drung gnyis/ rnam dkar do dam gcig drung tshab gnyis/ tshong las pa mi gnyer zer ba lnga yod/ las khungs kyi gzhung dam gru sgor rtse gnyer nas dam 'dzin gyis las khungs rang gi las don thog bed spyod dang / mgron dam ni mgron brgyud thad kar dgongs skor zhu yig sogs la spyod/ rtse las khungs kyi las 'gan ni/ gtso bo 'phags pa lha'i mdzub ston gzhir bzung / dgon ma lag gi bca' khrims/ sgrig lam kun spyod/ cho ga chos spyod/ mchod rgyun gtong rtsa/ dus mchod khag gi chos lugs 'gul skyod skor sogs dgon pa'i chos srid dpal 'byor gyi las don dgos rigs la 'go 'dzin do dam dang / rtse shod bla khag dang / dgon pa bcas kyi las byed bsko 'then/ dgon lag gi chos rje bsko gtong / de min chos lugs kyi byed sgo 'char 'phar rigs la brda gtong bkod 'doms bya rgyu/ don gnad gal che'i gras rtse shod/ bla khag phyag mdzod/ dgon pa'i bla spyi/ dpon khag gi gnyer pa sogs 'brel yod la brda gtong gis rtse las khungs la skong tshogs gros mol thog 'phags pa lha dang / spyi mdzod gang la zhu 'os don gnad dang bstun dgongs skor chog mchan thog nas lag len bstar rgyu sogs kyi las don sne mang yod/shod gnyer tshang las khungs su gtso bo spyi mdzod dang shod gnyer tshang nas spyi mdzod kyi mdzub ston 'og mnga' khongs mi dmangs sa nas khral 'bab bsdu len dang srid khrims gnon sdem/ kha mchu chod 'doms sogs gtso bo srid phyogs kyi las don rigs sgrub thog bla khag gi gsol phogs/ dgon par 'char 'phar/ mchod phogs 'bul gtong / rta khal sa tshigs srung rgyu/phyi phyogs kyi 'grul mgron la sne len sogs byed sgo sne mang yod/ gnyer khang las khungs kyi gtso skyong gzhung dam bru sgor 'dzin mkhan gnyer chen gsum 226

dang / gtong yong 'degs gshor dang lde'u mig 'dzin mkhan gnyer chung gsum/ 'dzing rtsod sogs kha mchu zhib 'jug rta thab lag g.yog zhor khral bskul gtong / brgya 'og mi dmangs thog rta khal bskul rgyu bcas gnyer khang dgongs mthun gyi las don byed po bsher dpang 2 brtag dpyad pa 2yod par bsher khang zhes las khungs chung chung gcig yod pa der bsher dam yang zur du yod/ gnyer khang drung yig 2 drung tshab 2 gzim khang le lag bdag gnyen byed po khang gnyer/ gto bcos rim 'gro'i rdzas sna bsdu gtong do dam lding dpon/ phyogs phan tshun la sku tshab gtong rgyu dang / spyi mdzod dang gnyer che byes thon skabs khrid rgyu che gras zhes pa mi sna nyi shu skor rtse shod kyi gad pa dang / nang byan/ mi sna 'gugs 'bod dang yig khyer pho nya gtong mkhan bcas la grwa pa bzhi bcu skor yod/ spyi mdzod kyi shag tu gsol dpon gcig dang / mdun drung gcig mdun drung gzhon pa gcig gnyer pa gcig gsol thab pa gcig bcas yod/dgon pa mer bsreg ma shor gong gnyer khang gi thad ka'i 'go khrid 'og ‘‘blos gra ba’’zhes mnga' khul dud drag gi bu phrug dbang po skyon med rig pa gsal ba bsdu rub byas pa'i bod yig 'bri klog dang / lañdza/ wartu/ sgra rig pa/ snyan sum/ sdeb sbyor/ skar rtsis sogs kyi slob grwa dang /gso ba rig pa'i slob grwa 'dzugs gnyer byas yod pa de'i slob khang dang /slob grwa'i yo byad bcas gnyer khang nas gtong dgos/ slob grwa de'i bod yig bris gzugs la chab bris zhes thun mong min pa'i yig gzugs shig yod la/ lo tho dang / nyi zla gza' 'dzin/ rgya nag glang rtsis sogs bris grwa khang nas rang mgo rang thon thub cing bris sogs shes rig bzang gras rtse shod bla khag gi drung tshab dang drung yig nas theg pa rim 'dzegs kyis gnyer che man 227

gyi las byed du bsko 'jog gi lam yod 'dug kyang / dgon pa nyams gso'i rjes slob grwa de tshugs thub med pa red/ gong gsal rtse shod gnyis nas 'phags pa lha'i chos srid kyi las khungs lte ba yin pas dgon lag khang dang / rdzong khag lnga dang brgya shog bco brgyad ces pa'i chab mdo 'phags pa lha'i mnga' 'bangs kyi las don rnams las khungs de gnyis brgyud dgos shing / zhogs pa chu tshod 1rkyapa nas phyi dro'i chu tshod 5bar rgyun gtan rang bzhin gyi las khungs tshugs dgos/ gong gsal las khungs rtse shod gnyis phud de min da dung 'phags pa lha'i yongs 'dzin rgan gzhon gnyis gsum dang chab mdo dgon gyi sung ma zhang paṇa sku rten pa/gam bcar mdun 'khor gras/ na bza' do dam pa/ na bza' sgron 'bul zhu mi gzim dpon 1 mchod pa do dam mchod dpon 1gsol ba do dam gsol dpon che chung 2 gzim 'gag 2 bla sman pa 1 mtshan zhabs dge bshes 2 mdun 'khor dkyus ma 4 chibs dpon 2 gad phyis yol sgor pa 2 phebs byams dpon 1 phebs byams pa 16bcas yod/thugs sras zhi lcags ho thog thu gnyis so sor yongs 'dzin re dang / bla brang phyag mdzod 1 mgron gnyer 1 gsol dpon 1 drung yig 1mdun dkyus gnyis re/ bla brang gnyer pa 1 gsol thab pa 1 yol sgor pa 1bcas yod/dkon rdor sprul skur yongs 'dzin 1 phyag mdzod 1 chos srid kyi 'gan bzhes skabs mgron gnyer 1 gsol dpon 1 drung yig 1 bla bral gnyer pa 1 yol sgor pa 1 spyi mdzod gzim shag la gsol dpon 1mdun drung 1 mdun 'khor 1 gnyer pa 1bcas yod pa red/dgon pa'i sgrig gzhi ni/ grwa tshang khag lnga la sgrub sde brgyad ces gsang 228

'dus sgrub sde dang / dus 'khor gyi sgrub sde gnyis la gling stod grwa tshang dang skye rdor sgrub sde dang / kun rig sgrub sde gnyis la nub gling grwa tshang / bde mchog sgrub sde dang / 'a kho ra chen gyi sgrub sde gnyis dang gling smad grwa tshang /'jigs byed sgrub sde la yi dam grwa tshang ngam/ khu byug grwa tshang yang zer/ tshe dpag sgrub sde la lcang ra grwa tshang bcas grwa tshang lnga po so sor 'go 'dzin slob dpon re yod par gling stod slob dpon dang / nub bla slob dpon/ gling smad slob dpon/ khu byug slob dpon/ lcang ra slo ba dpon bcas la bla lnga ba zer ba dang / (dgon pa'i las don che rigs 'du ra bla lnga zhes gros tshogs thog nas thag gcod srol) dgon pa'i tshogs chen la grwa tshang lnga tshogs zer zhing / dgon pa spyi ra sgrig las gnon sdem pa tshogs chen zhal ngo gnyis dang zhal 'don bskul spyi chen dbu mdzad gcig de 'og chab dam pa gnyis dang / dge g.yog brgyad/ ja khang nang pa brgyad bcas yod/tshogs chen 'du khang la spyi chen 'du khang zer zhing / spyi chen 'du khangardzisteng 'og le lag bdas gces do dam pa dkon gnyer dpog gcig yod/gong gsal sgrub khag so sor 'du khang dang grwa shag yod pa dang / sgrub khag so sor dbu mdzad re dang / dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod kyi tshogs dbu 'dzin mkhan mchod dpon re dang de 'og mchod g.yog pa re yod pa mchod g.yog pas nang gi sgrigalam gnon ldem byed/ sgrub khag so so'i lha de'i bdag mdun bum gsum dbang chog dang bcas pa'i cho ga dang / de min chos spyod kyi rim pa rnams grwa pa nas blo 'dzin skul 'ded byed mi 'dzin dpon 2re yod cing 'dzin dpon nas 'don chos rgyugs len gyi do dam byed pa dang / thog mar 'dzin dpon so sos rgyugs blangs rjes genyer rgyugs zhes las sne thon zur 'dus tshogs thog rgyugs sprodajidagos/ de yang lo gsum mtshams rgyugs 229

'phrod na legs gso'i kha btags sprod srol/ lo lnga tshun ma 'phrod na tshogs khang thog thigs sa rgyag rgyu sogs kyi chad pa gcod srol mchis/ de min chu len ja 'dren thab g.yog sogs dang / sgrub khag brgyad kyi grwa shag dang spyi khang khag gi khor yug gtsang sbra do dam byed po shag dpon zhes pa mang po yod/sgrub khag brgyad dam grwa tshang lnga'i khongs nas zur du dge slong grwa tshang zhes grwa grangs 20rkyalas sgrub pa'i zhabs brtan grub mkhan sngags grwa lta bu zhig yod cing / der dge bskos gcig dang / tshogs dbur dbyar bdag su 'khel gong gsal slob dpon lnga res mos byed pa/ dbu bskul spyi chen dbu mdzad nas byed/ de 'og dbu chung re zung / spyi rdzas gtong len byed po gnyer pa gcig bcas yod/bka' bstan gsung rab klog mkhan a mchod grwa tshang zhes grwa grangs 200skor zhig yod cing / de la 'go 'dzin dang mchod dpon dang /tshogs dpon gnyis yod pa de dag gis nang khul gyi sgrig lam gnon sdeb byed pa dang / de min dbu mdzad dang / 'dzin dpon re yod pa 'dzin dpon nas 'don chos rgyugs len gyi do dam byed/ chos spyod sogs 'don cha rnams a mchod dpon dbu bzhugs kyi gnyer rgyugs sprod dgos/rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags rta(1920)nas gsar du tshugs pa'i mtshan nyid grwa tshang zhes mtshan nyid kyi rtsod grwa zhig yod pa der bsdus grwa nas blo rtags/ sa lam/ dbu phar/ 'dul mdzod/ tshad ma rnam 'grel bcas kyi mtshan nyid sbyang rtsod byed cing / phyag dpe ba'i brtsigs gzhag dang sgrig lam gnon po mkhan po gcig dang / dge bskos gcig chab dam pa gcig dbu mdzad chen mo gcig skad gsangs pa 'ga' shas bcas yod pa skad gsangs pa de tshos dbu mdzad med skabs zhal 'don dbu 230

skul byed/ dge bshes gtong sgo'i gnyer pa gnyis bcas yod/ mtshan grwazhi dpe cha ba nas tshogs dang chos ra 'grim rgyu chag med thog rtsa ba lnga dang de'i spyi mtha' spyod kyi yig cha blo 'dzin gyis khang tshan so so'i ra skor nang khang tshan dge rgan gyi lta skul 'og mtshan mo chu tshod 2re tsam blo 'dzin skyor sbyang dgos pa/ lo ltar dbyar chos skabs chos ra'i nang mkhan po dang dge bskos lhan thog blo 'dzin byas pa'i gzhung rnams blo thog nas rgyugs 'bul zhu dgos shing / sdeb ma'i grangs drung yig nas tho bkod de grwa ji tshogs dbus su sdom rtsis khyab bsgrags kyis shog grangs 5rkya0nas 1rkyarkyarkyabar brgal bar gzengs bstod kyi kha btags dang dngul sogs kyi bya dga' dang / de 'og la kha btags/ shog grangs ma longs mkhan la skyon brjod bcas byed srol yod/gong gsal sgrub khag brgyad po so sos lo ltar dgun chos zla gsum ring rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te sa chog nas rdul tshon klu chog bar so so'i phyag len ma nyams par cho ga sbyor dngos mjug gtsang byed dgos pa dang /dge slong grwa tshang nas ston chos lta bur ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel bar gsang bde 'jigs gsum gyi dkyil chog dang / nyi ldog dang / dgu gtor/ de min spyi sger sku rim sgrub rgyu sogs rgyud pa grwa tshang gi rnam pa zhig yin/ der zhugs mkhan ni bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom ldan sha stag las dge tshul zhugs mi chog gong gsal sgrub khag brgyad po che khag gnyis nas dge slong gnyis re dang / chung khag so sos dge slong re bcas dge slong bcu res bskor gyis zla 2ring bcad mtshams byas te sngon 'gro 'bum bzhi dang / 'jigs byed kyi las rung bsnyen pa kha skong zhi sbyin dang bcas pa zin pa'i dge slong bcu re 231

res bskor gyis zla bco brgyad ring 'jigs byed dpa' gcig bdud las rnam rgyal gyi bsnyen chen bcu cha'i sbyin sreg dang bcas sbyor dngos 'jug gtsang byed dgos shing / gong gsal mtshams khag gnyis las las rung gi mtshams phogs sgrub khag so so'i mtshams genyer nas 'gan len thog bsnyen chen gyi gsol phogs dang / rten gtor/ rgyun mchod/ sreg rdzas/mar/ 'bru rigs bcas rmang gzhi'i 'gro gron tshang ma chab mdo bla brang nas dus thos/ tu gtong dges/ rgyun mchod kyi srin bal dang / spos/ de min gyi khyad rdzas rlung g.yab sogs rdzas cha rnams rtse bla brang nas gtong dgos/'phags pa lha lnga pa'am drug pas gsar btsugs byas lugs sku bcar grwa tshang zhes grwa grangs nyis brgya sum cu so gnyis(phyis su sum brgya yas mas bar phar ba dang de rtse rnam rgyal grwa tshang dang phyogs mtshungs pa yin)sgrig lam sogs gang thad dmigs bsal can gyi grwa tshang yin pa der grwa tshang slob dpon 1dang / dge bskos 2 dbu mdzad 1 dbu chung 'ga' shas/ skad gral pa 'ga' shas bcas yod/ cho ga chos spyod thad dgon pa spyi'i phyag srol dang 'dra ba yod la/ mi 'dra ba zhal snga bka' rgyud 'phags pa lha yab sras kyi bka' srol thun mong ma yin pa yang yod pa/ dper na/ bde mchog ngam rdzong snyan rgyud zer ba dang / zhal lnga'i chos spyod sogs mang po yod(grwa tshang 'di yang gtso bo sngags grwa shasadziche) lo 'khor ring zla ngo gcig la chos mtshams bzhag pa phud/ rgyun chags su 'du tshogs kyi dus mchod dang /'jigs gsang gi dkyil chog rdul tshon dang 'brel ba/ spyan ras gzigs rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ sman bla yid bzhin dbang rgyal/ tshe chog sogs sngags chog mang po yod la/ sgrig lam kun spyod dang / gtor bzo gar thiga'acham rol gyer dbyangs sogs 'thus tshang zhig yod pa red/ grwa tshang 232

'di'i grwa lam ban rgyun ni thog mar mnga' khongs mi tshang ming yod 'dud drag nas gdam gses grwa khral zhes bsdus pa las dgon pa spyi'i grwa khongs nang 'jug srol med cing / 'phags pa lha bcu pas zhol mar thang pa sogs zhugs mol su yod bkag med zhugs chog pa gnang bas phyis zhing pa dbul phongs dang / 'byor med kyi bu phrug tshang ma zhugs chog pa byung bas zhal grangs yang ches cher 'phar zhing / sngar lam ltar na 'phags pa lhas gtsos bla khag gi gsol gzim mdun 'khor grwa tshang 'di khong rang nas 'gro srol yang /gnas pa lha bcu pas dgon spyi'i sgrub khag khong nas kyang mi go 'pher ba bsko gzhag mdzad/dgon pa spyi'i grwa lam ban rgyun thad rang mos kyis grwa pa byed mkhan phud chab mdo'i khongs kyi mi ser sgrub khag brgyad kyi thob khongs su gtogs rigs nas bu gnyis yod dudo re'i bu gcig grwa khral du bskul rgyugs dgos pa 'phags pa lha bcu pa'i gtan tshigs bzhin sgrub khag so sos lo ltar ban khral 'ded pa btang nas ming tho bkod de grwa khongs su 'jog dgos pa dang / bu med pa'i thob khongs dud tshang de la rjes su bu byung na grwa pa 'jog rgyu'i gan thel 'bul dgos pa/ grwa pa 'das grongs song ba'i khyim tshang de slar yang grwa tshab 'jug dgos/ gong gsal mtshan nyid grwa tshang du phyi'i dgon lag nas slob gnyer ba'i grwa rgyun dang ma dgon rang khongs nas rang 'gul gyis zhugs mos bkag med thog sgrub khag che gras nas thab sde rang gi 'don chog blo 'dzin zin pa'i blo gsal bzhi re dang / chung khag so sos gnyis re lo ltar 'jug thog dus phyisi mtshan grwa 'di bzhin chos dang be+eng zing gnyis ka dar rgyas byung bas rang 'gul gyis zhugs mkhan je mang du song zhing / sku zhabs grwa tshang dang sgrub 233

khag brgyad khongs nang gses mtshan grwa'i khang tshan 9so sor khang tshan dge rgan re dang khang tshan gnyer pa gnyis re yod/ a mchod grwa tshang dang /dge slong grwa tshang khongs la'ang sgrub khag brgyad po nas grwa pa zhugs par gtong dgos/chab mdo bla dgon gyi las sne bsko gtong byed phyogs thad/ sa rta ( 191ra) lo phan sngar lam spyi mdzod kyis gtsos bla dgon las sne che phra 'phags pa lha rang nas bsko gzhag gnang lam yang / sa rta lo dgon pa bskyar chags rjes/ chab dgon bla spyi las sne mgrin gcig nas skabs de'i bod kyi srid skyong stag brag la snyan zhu phul te dgon 'bangs 'tsho skyong sogs lugs gnyis kyi 'gan 'khur byed po lnga lam ltar na spyi mdzod dar han rab byung shes yon can re 'jog pa dang / bla brang las sne rnams kyang dgon pa'i grwa pa sha stag nas zhu lam de ltar yang / bar lam spyi mdzod las thon nas chos tshugs ma zin kyang las don 'gan 'khur byas pa'i mig rkyen gyis spyi mdzod gnyis tsam bslab skyon byung bzhin bsdad cing / bla brang las byed mang tsam sdom med ser gzugs kyis las don byas pas dgon pa'i sgrig khrims gnon bsdom byed rgyu ltar bzhag nag chang sogs bag med kyi spyod pas bca' yig rin po che dang phyogs 'gal dang / bla brang dang dgon pa'i lar slad gang sar skya ser phyogs khyer gyis 'thus shor ci che yong gzhir brten sa yos bla dgon bar gyi 'dum gan du gsal ba ltar las sne'i khongs nas skya bo dpon 'phel byung na grwa tshang so so'i thob khongs nas bsher dpon gnyis dang /brtag dpyad pa gnyis phud/ de byings gtso bo spyi mdzod dang / gnyer che chung / gnyer drung sogs dgon pa'i grwa pa rang nas byed pa las gzhan pas zhu 'tshang mi chog pa dang / dgon spyi'i slob dpon lnga dang / spyi so rnams 234

gong sa bcu gsum pa chen pos ser 'bras spyi so ltar gyi go ming phyag rtags yod pa3mas gral gong du bsdad de dgon pa'i 'go 'doms byed srol gyi lam lugs gtan 'bebs gnang ba ltar dgos lugs zhus par bla spyi'i zhu don ltar slob dpon spyi so bcas sa gnas srid gzhung nas bsko gzhag bya rgyu chu lug (1942)lo srid tham 'go mchan dgongs don ltar 'os 'bul zhu phyogs thad sa glang (1949) lo gsang 'dus grwa tshang dang / lcang ra grwa tshang gnyis kyi spyi so tshab gsar 'os bsdus kyi 'char snyan phul ba de rang khungs so so'i sgrub khag la mol bsdur med par lkog mthun 'os phul byas lugs sogs kyi gleng lhag thog mdo spyir snyan phul byung bar brten mdo spyis las bya khang la zhib 'jug bgyis bcug pa'i 'char snyan la mdo spyi lha klu ba'i phyag rtags 'byar ma'i nang / sloslad slob dpon dang / spyi so rnams gsar bsko'i 'os bsdu byed phyogs skor chab mdo dgon gyi slob dpon lnga yod khongs nas yi dam grwa tshang gi slob dpon sngar lam brag g.yab bla brang nas bsko gtong bya lam phud/de 'phros chab dgon rang khungs grwa sgrub khag dgu'i khongs nas bsko dgos/slob dpon bzhi dang / sbyi so dgu bcas bsko gzhag 'os bsdu byed phyogs thad/ rī las sne grwa dmangs dang bcas tshang ma re dwogs chung zhing spyi mos 'dod pa rdzogs ched du da lta'i slob dpon las thog gang yod dang / spyi so las thog dkon gnyer dpon/ tshogs chen dge bskos dang / dbu mdzad bcas tshogs 'du bgyis te grwa sgrub khag dgu'i gnyer mang sogs las sne gnad yod do chod rnams mdun bkug gis spyi so bsko bsdad sgrub khag rang khungs so so nas 'os phul mi gnyis dang / gzhan sgrub khag brgyad nas phul ba'i 'os tho mi re bcas gang ltar spyi mos 'os 'dzugs mang ba'i mi gnyis re bla spyi tshang 'dzoms kyis 'dems sgrug 'os dang gnyis go ldog tu ma song ba'i snga 235

lam ltar gzhung sar mdo spyi brgyud 'char snyan phul brgyud phyir thon mtshams las khang brgyud gsar mjal 'phral zhu dgos’’ zhes dang / 'di lo sa glang nas bzung slob dpon 'phos 'das kyi tshab gsar rnams gzhung nas bsko gzhag stsal rgyur 'os 'bul zhu phyogs thad gong bzhin bla spyi tshong 'dzoms kyis grwa sgrub khag 9su rung gi khongs nas bka' 'go'i don bzhin gdan sa chen po'i bka' rams dge bshes rnams dang / chab dgon mtshan nyid grwa tshang gi dge bshes mtshan rtags bzhes zin khongs nas dgon spyi'i bstan rgyun 'dzin spel gyi mig rgyan du sman pa'i slob dpon 'os nges sha stag drag 'debs kyis phyi lo nas bzung lo ltar dbyar gnas thog gdan sa gsum gyi mdzad srol bzang po ji bzhin gso sbyong gi mdo rgyas pa chag med 'chad spel thub pa nges par dgos rgyur de rtsis sgrub khag so so'i las sno rnams gros bsdur gyis 'os tho mi gsum re bla spyi'i thog bsdu len gyis bla spyi nas kyang bka' 'go'i phebs sgo gzhir bzung bstan rgyun 'dzin spel gyi mig rgyan du sman pa slob dpon 'os nges spyi mos 'os 'dzugs mang ba slob dpon mi gnyis re drag sgrug gis ming gzhung bkod de spyi tham 'byar ma chos srid 'khur 'dzin dkon rdor sprul skur phul te dkon rdor sprul sku nas slob dpon las skal skabs babs sur bzang 'os dang gnyis tshogs chen gyi rten gtso rje rin po che dang /chab dgon mgon khang gang rung du zan rtags sgril 'bul gyi thon dang gnyis gang phebs chos srid 'khur 'dzin dkon rdor sprul sku nas bka' khyab gnang mtshams chos srid 'phur 'dzin dang / bla spyi thun mong nas mdo spyi brgyud 'char snyan 'bul brgyud kyis phyir stsal byung mtshams gsar mjal 'phral zhu dang 'brel’’ zhes dang / ‘‘spyi mdzod gsar bsko'i thad chu lug srid tham 'go mchan du/ bla brang 'khur 'dzin spyi mdzod bslab ldan zhig ma byung 236

tshe bla dgon gnyis ka'i sgrig khrims mig la gang cir gnod rkyen che nges yong gzhir brten da phyin spyi mdzod 'di bzhin bslab gtsang zhig rang dgos gal la gsar bsko'i 'os 'bul skabs bla khag dgon sde mi ser dang bcas pa'i spyi mthun thog nas grwa rigs —bslab gtsang shes 'khos gnyis ldan go 'pher 'os nges gleng med drag sgrug 'char 'bul dgos rgyu las/ sdom med ser gzugs gang byung 'os khongs gtong bde mi chog’’ces 'khod 'dugachab mdo bla dgon gyi sgrig gzhi'i mi sna rnams nas chab mdo'i sde dgon gyi gtso bdag 'phags pa lha dang / de 'og zhi lcags ho thog thu/ de 'og dkon phyag(phyag zhes pa spyi mdzod)bcas phud/ de byings bla dgon las sne rnams la dpon gral dang / mgron gral/ dkyus gral bcas rim pa gsum yod cing / dang po/ dpon gral la 'phags pa lha'i yongs 'dzin dang /sku rten chos rje/ grwa slob(grwa tshang khag gi slob dpon)dgon pa'i mkhan po slob dpon/ 'phags pa lha'i yab dang sku mched/ gnyer che/ rtse gnyer/bla khag gi phyag mdzod spyi so dang mtshan grwa'i dbu 'doms sogs/ gnyis pa/mgron gral la rtse bla'i mgron gnyer/ rtse'i gsol gzim mchod gsum/ khya/ lcags kyi yab gzhis/ ‘ bla khag gi mgron gnyer/ chab bla'i gnyer chung /grwa tshang /bag gi dbu dge/ a mchod dpon sogs/ gsum pa/ dkyus gral la rtse gsol dpon chung ba/ rtse'i drung yig rtse rnam dkar do dam/gzim 'gag zhi lcags kyi rtse gnyer dang / gsol gzim/ drung yigaspyi mdzod kyi gsol dpon dang drung yig bsher brtag gnyer khang pa'i drung yig khang gnyer/ rtse chibs dpon che gras bcas yin/gong gsal dpon gral dang mgron gralarternemasipal rta doms tog zhwa/dkyus gral rta doms —tog med/ chikhri gnad thobaradang / khri 'bul sogs 237

rim pa ltar phyed phyed kyi dma' ba yod la/ gral gnas gsum gyi gnad thob dang / gsar mjal gyi rten dang bsngo rten sogs 'khri sgrub zhu sgo yang gong bzhin rim pa ltar yin/ rtse shod bla dgon las sne gzhung bskos sam nang khul nas bskos pa gang yin rung gsar mjal zhu skabs 'phags pa lhar mgron brgyud gnangs brda snyan seng bsgron te gsar mjal zhu tshes gtan 'khel bzhin 'phags pa lha'i sku mdun du go bab kyi gdan thob steng 'khod mtshams gnyer khang nas nang byan gyis mdun ja 'degs shing / dkar spro shing tog sder kha bcas bstar rjes 'phags pa lhas kha btags dang ljags mdud dmar po bstsal te gsar mjal mdzad sgo zin rjes zhi lcags dkon phyag la'ang mjal dar 'bul khar bcar dgos pa bcas so/chos gzhis dang gtong sgo/ dgon lag sogs/chab mdo bla dgon gyi de snga'i chos gzhis mi ser ni/ rdzong khag lnga ste/(1)tsha smad rdzong / (deng skabs mdzo sgang rdzong khongs) ( 2)tsha stod rdzong /(deng skabs dpa' shod rdzong khongs) ( 2) khyung po me ru rdzong / (deng skabs steng chen rdzong khongs) (4) stag gzig rdzong / (deng skabs 'jo mda' rdzong khongs) (5)be ri rdzong bcas yin pa dang / brgya shog bco brgyad ces pa ste rdza stod dang / rdza bar/ rdza smad/ ngom stod/ ngom smad/ ngom srib/ spom rnged/ mne nyin/ mar srib/ rob/ rdza nyin/ skyo khrom/ shog bzhi/ hor ru ma/ rdza nye skor/ ngom nye skor/re ya rta zam/ la gong rta zam/ (deng skabs ri bo che rdzong khongs) bcas 238

dang / de min tho pa dang / je phu ma/ a nu ma zer ba bcas kyang yod/gong gsal rdzong khag la lo gsumasgyu re'i mtshams su rdzong dpon brje len bsko gzhag dgos pa ni gnyer khang nas gros zhib kyis 'os 'char phul bar spyi mdzod kyi phyag rtags dang 'brel bsko gtong byed pa dang / tsha smad rdzong 'og gi 'bo tshan bdun zhes pa so sor 'go 'dzin bcu dpon re dang de 'og khral rigs sgrub rgyug gi brda gtong ba re yod cing / de dag gi khongs su dar rgan zhes pa'i phyi nang khral rigs sgrub rgyug mi dgos pa'i dud drag 'be ris dang / shing rwa/ rdzong tshang / 'us tshang / gru gu tshang / tshong dpon tshang zhes pa sogs 'ga' yod/ tsha stod rdzong 'og tu ldem gong dang / ldem gshis/ 'dres/ sgrub/ rgya yul/ 'o le/ 'o ltag(wa dag)gnas rwa sogs kyi sde shog rer 'go pa re dang / rgan po re yod la/ de khongs su gnas po zhes pa'i dud drag 'ga' shas kyang yod/ khyungaspyame rdzong 'og tu spo yo dpon dang / thal rdzong dpon/ tsha shis dpon/ sgo chung dpon bcas dpon bzhi/ 'brog dud kyi 'go 'dzin 'gu rtis rdzi dpon dang mi gsar tshang gnyis/ de 'og khral rigs brda gtong ba sde‘‘brtag dpyad pa’’zhes pa 'ga' shas yod/ stag gzig rdzong 'og tu shog kha dgu la 'go dpon lo brgya tshang zer ba sogs dgu yod/brgya shog bco brgyad so sor chab dgon gnyer khang nas bdams bskos shog dpon re dang / de 'og sde shog so sor rgan po re yod/ brgya shog bco brgyad kyi khongs su ngom pa sa sgang sde pa dang / gnas mdo sde pa/ rdza stod gying thang sde pa/ rdza nyin bsam mdo sde pa/ skye sde pa/ ngom srib ko tsha yar sde pa/ btsas thang sde pa/ chu ba sde pa/ ngom stod rno brang a nu/ rnga tho a nu/ brag dmar a nu/ rgya mkhar a nu/ 'gu ro a nu/ lhu pa a nu/239

sis thog gnas po/ byang mda' gnas po/ thor bsags gnas po/gling smad gnas po/ 'go bo gnas po/ la gong gnas po/ a kas gnas po/ rug chung mi sna/ rob sga 'dzom dpon/ wa me dpon tshang sogs dud drag de dag gis sngar sa khul so so bcad bzung dbang sgyur byed pa de dag rjes su chab dgon gyi khongs su 'dus shing / de rjes 'phags pa lha'i bla brang 'og gcig gyur byung ste sger bzung sa gzhis dang / sa zhing ru ba sogs so sor sger dbang thog sa bogs dpya khral chab blar sgrub 'bul byed dgos/ de dag gi khongs nas sa sgang sde pa ni sngar bod kyi lo rgyus rgyal rabs nang byung ba'i chos blon khams pa rlangs go cha'i rgyud pa yin lugs su grags la/ sa sgang drung mkha' spyod nam mkha' rgyal mtshan zhes pa karma pa dang mnyam rgya nag tu bskyod nas gong ma'i 'ja' sa gser yig thob yod pas chab bla'i dpon rigs khag dang 'dra ba'i go gnas rgyun 'jags su gnas/chab bla'i khongs gtogs mi ser gyi nang nas zhi lcags dkon gsum sogs bla khag dang / dgon pa/ dpon khag dang las byed che khag la sger thob sa gzhis/ sngo rwa/ sa zhing / ru ba bcas mi nyung ba zhig yod pa phud/mang che ba chab bla gzhung khongs yin pas/ rdzong sgo khag dang brgya shog khag gi zhing 'brog mi ser so so nas lo ltar chab blar4rgyal po lo phral’’zhes zhing 'brog thon khungs kyi khral rigs lag 'don 'bul sgrub dgos la/ ar po'i las khral/ sa tshigs sgrub rgyug sogs rkang 'gro'i khral rigs sna tshogs sgrub rgyug byed dgos pa ma zad/ mdo spyi'i las bya khang gi ngo las 'go dmag dang rdzong dpon khag sogs 'grul bzhud la rta khal mi gsum dang / rtswa shing sogs sa gnas kyi 'khri sgrub byed sgo sne mang sgrub dgos/gong gsal rdzong sgo dang brgya shog rnams la dud grangs rob rtsis byas na/240

rdzong che ba khyung meracozhing 'brog dud grangs 200skor dang de 'og 'bring bar dud grangs 15rkyaskor/ chung ba stag gzig la dud grangs 100skor/brgya shog che gras la dud grangs 150skor dang / 'bring gras la 140skor/chung gras la 100skor tsam re bcas yod/rtse las khungs khongs kyi gzhis ka dang / nor ma(ru ba)khag gi yong 'bab rnams dang / 'phags pa lhar dad 'bul byung ba'i dngul dngos rnams rtse nas bdag gnyer do dam byed pa dang / gzhan yang 'phags pa lha'i khri gsol sogs kyi mdzad sgo'i legs 'bul rnams dang / zhing gshegs kyi gdung 'bul/ mi sna 'das grongs kyi byang rten/ chos rje khag gi thon 'bul sogs rtse las su 'bab/rtse shod kyi lo re'i 'bab khongs nas dber na/ 'phags pa lha'i chos zhugs dang / rig chung rig chen/ dge bshes mtshan rtags/ 'phar ma'i zhabs rim/ dgongs rdzogs dang gdung rten gsar bzhengs/ pho brang nyams gso'i ar las sogs kyi 'gro gron la bla dgon gyi mi ser nas zhal 'debs bsdu rub dang rtse shod bla dpon khag spyi bsdus cha gses kyis gtong dgos phud/ de dag gi gzhi rtsa'i 'gro gron rnams rtse shod bla brang nas rkang len byed dgos pa dang / de min 'phags pa lha dang spyi mdzod kyi rnam kun gsol chas zas 'dang / rtse shod las byed khongs nas dgon pa grwa tshang nas 'bru phogs len rgyu yod rigs phud/ de byings rnams kyi lo phogs dang las don mi sna byes thon gyi phogs dang zur gsos 'bru/ mar/ ja tshwa/ sga tshab kyi dngul bcas dngatsho/ zhi lcags dkon gsum sku 'khor gyi lo 'khor gsol phogs/ sgrub khag brgyad la dgun chos nyin bdun re'i mchod bsnyen/'jigs byed bsnyen chen pa'i mtshams phogs/ mgon khang gis gtsos srung tsho 241

ma lcog gi rkang gtor rgyun mchod/ bskang res pa'i phogs/ rnam grwa dang dge slong grwa tshang gi dus gtor khag gi mchod bsnyen sogs lo 'khor mchod bsnyen tshang ma(sku zhabs grwa tshang gi mchod khag gtong sgo phud)rtse shod bla brang nas gtong dgos la/ sa gnas srid gzhung la lo ltar 'don 'bru sa khral 'bru ru'i khal 2000re dang / chab dgon tshogs chen la 'bru phogs thebs rtsar 'bru ru'i khal 2000re/ mdo spyi ngo las kyi sgrig cha dang /dbyar skyid/ lo gsar sogs kyi gtong sgo rnams kyang bla brang nas gtong dgos/spyi gnyer dang / mchod khag so sor mchod rgyun sngo/nga rtsa sngar yod dgon pa mer shor bas gsar tshugs dgos gshis rgyus mnga'i grwa rgan la kha myang lces dpyad 'dri rtsad kyis dngos 'brel 'ded khungs yod pa ra 'phrod rnams nan tan zhib tshags rkang sgrig byas kyang sngar sor chud min gyis rmang gzhi zhan khar dang thog mchod rtsa gsar sbyor yang zhan pa bcas la brten chab bla dang / spyi khag gi mchod gzhis kyi 'bab khongs nas gtong dgos pa phud/gtso bo'i 'du sgo mi ser thog mchod khag 'gel bkod byed dgos kyi yod pa red/dgon pa nyams 'jig ma song gong gi gnas tshul zhib nges med la/rgyu cha'i yig cha yang ma rnyed cing sa rta bskyar chags byung ba nas bzung gi mthong thos shes tshor byung rigs la gzhigs na/ dgon pa spyir/ spyi so 9mang gnyer 9 dbyar gnyer 9bcas yod pa sgrub khag 〈dang / grwa tshang khag gi khongs nas mi rgyu cung drag gras 'dems nas ser mo ba rang bsko lam/sgrub khag brgyad po so sor/ sgrub khag che gras gsang 'dus grwa tshang la sna gnyer 4 gzhung gnyer 4 nya dge 4 phag zla gnyer pa 2mtshams 242

gnyer 2bcas mi ser khongs nas bsko/ da dung tshogs gnyer dang ja 'phar gnyer pa grwa paglu bsko yang don du mi seraglu 'khri/sgrub khag chung gras bde mchog grwa tshang la/ sne len gnyer pa 4gzhung gnyer 4 nya dge 4 phag zla gnyer pa 2 mtshams gnyer 2stong mchod gnyer pa2 lo gsar gnyer pa 2bcas lo gsum re'i mtshams brje bsko byed/ grwa tshang so sor spyi rdzas bdag gnyer byed mkhan sha bsre ba 1dang / spyi rgan 1rang khongs kyi grwa pa rgan gras bzhag srol/sgrub khag gzhan rnams kyi mchod khag yang rtsa ba'i thog gong khag gnyis dang rigs 'gre/rnam grwar grwa gnyer 4 dge gnyer 2 dngul gnyer 2 sman bla gnyer pa 4bcas mnga' khongs mi ser la bsko 'gel dang / spyi rdzas bdag gnyer dbu chos gnyer pa gsum grwa tshang rang khongs kyi grwa pa bsko srol/mtshan nyid grwa tshang la bla brang phyag mdzod 1dbu 'doms 2dbu drung zhor 'dzin 1 phyag mdzod pa 4 dge bshes gtong sgo'i mar gnyer 2bcas mtshan grwa rang khongs nas grwa pa 'dems bsko byed cing mtshan nyid gnyer pa brgyad chab mdo'i mnga' khongs mi ser la 'gel ba/dge slong grwa tshang gi bdud bzlog ces yon 'bul bdag gnyer byed po grwa tshang rang khongs nas mi gsum bsko 'gel byed/ lnga mchod gnyer pa 2mi ser la bsko 'gel byed/ a mchod grwa tshang gi dgun chos gnyer pa 4gtso bo mi ser la 'gel zhing / yon 'bul bdag gnyer pa ni grwa tshang rang khongs nas bsko lam/ phyis su gsar 'dzugs bstan 'gyur gnyer pa 4dang stong mchod gnyer pa sogs yod/ rab byung bco lnga pa'i sa lug 1919lo 'phags chen bcu pa blo bzang 243

thub bstan mi pham tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyis bstsal ba'i bka' lag tham 'byar du‘‘brgyad gnyer gsar rnying / dbyar gnas gnyer pa/ ser gnyer/ lhun rtse khang gnyer/ par gnyer/ byams gnyer/ gser gdung dkon gnyer sogs sngar phan gtong yong kha 'thab mi thub pas mnga' khul ser skya dud tshang rnams nas phyis su gnas dus dbang gis 'dod yon gang thad shin tu dkon pas mchod gnyer theg min gyis 'khos zhan mthar lhung yong mus spyi gsal sdug sbyar du gyur 'dug pa da cha spyi so khang du bsdom rgyu bka' lung legs bab bzhin gong gi mchod gnyer rigs kyi gtong rtsa gcig tu bsdoms bsgril byed rgyu ming smos tsam las don snying sa zhing dang / sems can phran bu las rgyu rtsa lag sprad bda' 'ded bya yul dben pa bcas slad phyin rnam dkar stong rtsa skyed sbyar dang / yul lung gi za chas 'bel dkon dang bstun nyams zhib kyis grwa sgrub las byed rgan rgyus tshang mas legs bsdur mtha' ring 'byung khyad 'gro song gtan 'bebs spyi mos rtags 'byar zur gsal re 'khang med pa'i sor gnas mjug gnon dgos rgyu dang / spyi mdzod dar han skal bzang yon tan de nyid kyi rjes 'jug mkhan chung ru tsha nas snyan zhus srid tham mgo mchan don bzhin me lug phan gyi 'dzin dbang gzhis khag son sbrags/ rta drel/ sems can/ bun bsdu yig khagadon rtsa dang bcas mchod rgyun sbyor 'jags thog’’ces dang / sa lug spyi mdzod skal yon gyi gzhis khag sems can mi rtsa pho mo dang bcas rtsis sprod len gyi lag 'dzin du/ sngo ra/ rdzi pa/ mi rtsa mgo btags khyon bsdoms dud grangs 60lhag tsam yod pa gsal/ lcags sbrul bla dgon nang gan nang / ‘‘me yos bla dpon snyan zhus bka' 'go dgongs don gzhung 'bab 'bul dgos khongs na4 lo re 'bru 244

ru'ikhal nyis stong tham pa re chag rtsal rnam dkar mchod rgyun thog sman pa dgos smre zhal gsal bzhin da lam bla brang gzhis lag tha mar thang sa rab son chab khal bcu dgu dang / mdze nub son chab khal sum cu tham pa dang bre bcu/ g.yo smad gzhis son chab khal bco brgyad/ g.yo stod mkha' 'gro'i ngo tshe rdzogs mtshams su sprod rgyu'i son chab khal bcu bzhi dang / bla khag spyi nas son chab khal dgu bcu tham pa bcas 'gro ba'i stong khongs sa zhing 'bring tshad bcas rjes lo 'debs rtsa nas gtan 'jagagabazhag thog spyi sor sngon yod na ba gzhis ka dang / sis gnas gzhis ka gnyis gzhung bzhes mdzad pa'i gzhis ka le lag bcas bsnan cing / kha slong du bla brang nas rtsa 'bru ru'i khal lnga stong tham pa 'bul dgos 'di lo ru'i khal chig stong lnga brgya tham pa dang / rjes lo chu rta lo ru'i khal nyis stong tham pa/ chu lug lor ru'i khal chig stong lnga brgya tham pa bcas lo gsum tshun gtsang dag byas pa dang /gong thog sa yos 'phags pa lhas gnang ba'i stong ngu dbon po'i gzhis kha bsnan’’zhes dang yang sa stag srid tham 'go mchan zhal gsal du‘‘sbug dam 'go mchan sngon stsal dgongs don spyi so gsar 'dzugs la mchod thebs mkhan chung mgon po bsod nams kyi sger gzhis rnying chod khag nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i sa khang mi gsum dang / 'bru dngos/ rta drel/ she nor sogs rgya che dang /'das gson dad can khag nas sbyor phul dngos po mchod rtsa rnying chad lag 'dus byung rigs bcas khu bsdus phyogs bsgril gtong rtsa'i skyed 'bab sogs kyis deng skabs dgun zla gsum lhag tsam sgrub mchod tshugs mus las de lhag rgyun ja tshugs thebs med rkyen rnam kun dgon nang grwa pa rgyun sdod med lugs zhu gsal dngos 'brel yin tshe 'chad nyan 'dul khrims gang cir gnod tshabs che ba de mur bzhag pas ma 'thus gshis de snga tshogs chen rgyun ja'i 245

dmigs rten bar lam khungs dor gyur pa yod tshe rtsa zhib dang / lhag par chos gzhis gsar rnying dang / 'du thems/ bogs zhing sogs la yul dus spar cha bab bstun gyi 'bab bzo dang 'brel rgyun ja rtag tshugs thub thabs dang / mchod rgyun che phra nyams pa sor 'chud yong ba'i legs cha brgya skor phyogs ji dgos mdo smad spyi 'doms nas kyang rgyab gnyer thal lus med pa dgos rgyu ’’zhes dang / ‘‘yang mkhan chung mgon bsod thad bkod rgya sngon song bzhin lha sar nges par bcar dgos las/ sngar lugs lta bu'i srin bu mir rdzus kyi zhu bde gtan nas 'thus min ma zad/ tshe 'phen rdzogs pa sger dngos mkhar dbang gang na ci yod de snga gong sa skyabs mgon chen por dad 'bul zhus zin la mchod rtsa gang 'os su stsal rgyu babs 'brel ma che yang /ji srid rgyun ja tshugs thabs spyi sgos kyi bde thabs rmad mo cher brten tshogs chen rgyun ja'i dmigs thebs kyi kha snon du gsol ras yong 'gro ba’’zhes gsal ba de dag spyi so dang / mang ja gnyer pa'i gtong rtsa'i thog yod 'dra/rab byung bcu drug pa'i me glang ( 1927)lo 'phags pa lhas g.yo stod zar ma thang bcas chab bla nang gzhung gi rtswa rwa ngom nyin shog brgyad mi ser nas rtswa btu rgyugs dgos pa'i sngar lam de bzhin mi ser la dka' khag che rkyen phyin chad rtswa btu sgrub rgyugs ma dgos pa'i de tshab nang gzhung la rtsa ngo 'bab 'bul 'gyogs bya rgyu'i 'dzin tham gnang bas rtswa sa der zhing kha son khal brgya dang lnga bcu 'gro ba'i gsar sbol sa zhing rnams chab dgon spyi so'i mchod rtsa'i ngan skyor du gnang ba dang / spyi so blo dga'i khyim gzhis ma lag gnyis dang /'bo ro nas zur 'byed zhing 'etsher dkris dang dmar nyag ma bcas la son khal brgyad cu skor bcas gnang ba/ sa yos( 192rdo)lo srid skyong rwa sgreng gi srid tham 'go mchan du gsal ba ltar dang / yang lcags rta ( 1kha20)246
