lo chab mdo'i spyi mdzod nas spyi mgon khang bskang res zhal grangs 'phar 'dzugs mchod thebs ngom stod lha lu'i shul gzhis dang / der 'byar rtswa chu shing gsum gyi dge bed ji yod sbyor 'jags gnang 'dug pa dang / tshogs chen 'du khang legs grub rjes mdo spyi g.yu thog pas btang ba'i skal tho lag 'dzin tham 'byar nang‘‘tshogs chen la 'byor ldan sger khag nas bsnyen bkur sku 'gyed 'bul skabs gong sa skyabs mgon chen po'i bzhugs khri'i sku skal lnga bcu tham pa dang / spyi 'jog mtshon byed dngul srang lnga bcu dang / skyabs dar a she bcas 'bul 'jog dgos pa byung rigs spyi so dang / dbu mdzad/dge bskos thun mong nas do dam dang 'brel lo ltar bla spyi thun mong thog rtsis rgyag khams dwangs kyis 'du khang steng shod mdo sbug gi khra yol gsham bu sogs kyi gsar bzo'i dmigs sgo dang / 'phros bsdad mchod rtsi kha snon du 'bab rgyu’’zhes dang yang / sa glang (1949)lo mdo spyi'i tham 'khod lag 'khyer nang tshogs chen du dad can khag nas rkyen sel skyabs yon dngul dngos phul 'byor dang / sgrig khrims gnon sdemyo/ skor khrims 'gal byung rigs la nyes pa btang ba'i 'bab bcas byung khag rnams dge bskos gnyis dang /tshogs chen dbu mdzad/ dkon gnyer dpon bcas thun mong nas do dam zhus te dngos rigs tshong bsgyu ra rin 'bab ji byung bla spyi'i sar zhib rtsis kyis dge 'dun par sha khu sha 'thim smin 'bul dgosami’zhegogasal/ me byi(1926) lo bka' shag gi bka' 'go gnang gsal/ slosho mdo rdzong khongs rdzong dkar phur yod pa'i gzhung gzhis son khal bzhi brgya skor 'gro lam gzhung bogs 'bru khal brgyad brgya re lo ltar sgrub 'bul byung phyin rdzong dkar gzhis sa mi rnams ru mkhan nas kha 'dzin bya 'thus’’zhes gsal ba de yang spyi so'i khongs yod pa 'dra/ de min da dung spyi so'i gtong thebs khongs 247

su/ sa lug 'phags pa lha'i she bam dang / mdo spyi'i bka' tham gzhir bzung sa gnas khag mang la sa zhing gsar sbol byas pa'i gzhis khag mang po yod 'dug spyi gong yag mo chos dga'i rgyun ji thebs snon 'bru khal 4re lo ltar 'bul dgos mdo spyi'i 'go tham gyis chod pa dang / la gong g.yu mdar yul 'brog sa rtswa spyi sor phul sbyor chab spyi'i gtan tshigs kyis chod pa bcas gong gsal gzhis khag sogs 'bab khungs yod rigs tshang ma spyi khag thog phyogs gcig bsdoms bsgril byas yod 'dugaphyis su spyi khag gsum gtong sgo khag bgos byas te spyi so nas dgun chos skabs sgrub khag brgyad la nyin 22re mchod bsnyen gtong deb nang gsal bzhin dang / dge 'dun rer gsol phogs 'bru 'bo gang re 'bul gtong thog dgon pa'i spyi don 'gro song rnams spyi bsos gtong dgos pa dang /dbyar chos gnyer par nyin thebs bod dngul ṭam rdo brgya dang lnga bcu re yod lugs dang / phogs thebs gzhis khag 21thog nas tshogs chen la dpyid chos zla gcig dang dbyar chos zla ba phye gnyis ring dge 'dun rer phogs 'bru 'bo gang re/ mang ja gnyer pa'i gtong rtsa ni mkhan chung ru tsha ba'i kha dbang bun rtsa bcas nas tshogs chen rgyun ja zla ba phyed gnyis dang 'bru phogs dge 'dun rer 'bo gang re phul thog mdo spyi lha klu'i skabs gzhung nas rgyun ja zla ba bzhi dang zhag 20thebs rtsa gsar bzhag gi mang gnyer zur bskos ma dgos pa spyi khag gsum la khag bgos kyis lag deb nang gsal bzhin rgyun ja gtong dgos gsal yod/spyi khag gsum gyi sa zhing dang mi rtsa pho mo/ gte deb bcas slad phyin spyi khag nang khul dang dgon dang mi ser bla khag bcas bar 'dres lhad kyi gleng rtsod mi 'byung ched me phag mdo spyi g.yu thog ska/bas mdo spyi'i las bya rim bzhi 248

dang / shol drung 1bla brang rtse shod kyi sku tshab mgron drung / spyi so las zur dang bcas mnga' khongs sa mu rdog bskor dbye zhib byas te mdo spyi dang / rtse shod bla brang gi dam 'byar gtan 'bengs byas pa'i 'byed deb dang / spyi so'i gtong deb dang sprod deb/ mang dbyar gye mchod deb dang gtong deb/sprod deb bcas khag zhal gsal yod skad 'dug kyang de dag da lam khungs rnyed ma thub pas re re bzhin zhib cha 'god ma spobs/ spyi khag gsar rnying brje len skabs mdo spyi'i las bya khang gi mkhan chung re dang / rtse bla'i sku tshab/ bla spyi bcas lhan thog nas sprod dpang gis sprod khrar sku tshab dang bla spyi'i tham 'byar 'dra gnyis bkod 'jog byed/sgrub khag so sor gtong rtsa sngar yod dang gsar sbol byas pa'i sa zhing gi 'bab dang / tshong khe bun skyed kyi dngul sogs yod rung gtso bo mi ser thog mchod khag 'gel bskos la brten nas chos rgyun tshugs thabs byed dgos shing / chab dgon la rtsa ba'i rmang gzhi sgrub mchod khag brgyad so sor grwa lam ban rgyun gyi thobs khungs mi ser gtan 'khel yod pas so so'i thob khungs kyi mi ser dang / bla khag gi rdzis pa rdzo khag khongs 'khos 'byor phran bu yod rigs la res mos 'gel bskos kyis gtong sgo lo gsum re gtong /sgrub khag che ba 'jigs gsang gnyis lta bur mtshon na/ — snga dus mchod khag gnyer par rtsis rtsa bod dngul ṭam dkar 16rkyayod pa rjes su dngul thang 'phar chag byung bas rda sgar la rtsis na sgor 16tsam yod pa dang /mchod gzhis kha shas kyang yod cing / lag 'don gtong sgo'i thad dgun chos sa chog skabs dkyil 'khor sa chog nyin 10—15bar nyin rer mchod rtsam bre gang re/ mchod nas phul gsum/ maṇ+ḍal gro nas bre do/ bskol ja nyin re nyag 15'debs mar rgya gang nyag bcu/ thug thal bre 〈thug sdor 249

nyag drug tsam re dang / mchod dpon mchod g.yog ja ma thab bskor bcas la nyin ltar bskom ja nyag bcu re/ 'debs mar rgya gang re/ thug thal bre gsum re/ mchod dpon dang thig pa bcas la nyicha/ ltar sha tshab dngul ṭam re/ ja thab rnams la dngul skar bzhi re/ sgo bzhi gzugs bzhi dod so sor ṭam re/ rtsam rgyugs nyin re phul do re/ ja thab rnamasacil nyin ltar rtsam rgyugs nas phul gang re/ gnyer mang yod rigs la sa sha gdan sha zhes pa'i dod dngul ṭam re/ tshogs gzhung phug gtor rjen 'thag khal re dang khog snum mar rgya brgyad re/ rgyun mchod nyin rer mchod rtsam bre do re mchod rma ra nyag bcu bzhi re/ mchod nas phul lnga re/ brgya mchod la rtsam bre lnga/ mchod mar nyag lnga/ bzhu mar rgya do/ mchod nasabre do/ spos/ srin bal/ khrus bum gyi dar/ sgrub mchod dngos gzhi nyin rer ja thug bco brgyad la ja rgya gang nyag lnga re/ 'debs mar rgya bzhi re/ btso gro khal re/ gro sdor rgya gang re/ thug thal bre bco lnga re/ thug rdor mar nyag bcu/ nyin ltar grwa rer sha tshab skar do re/ sku 'gyed nyin ltar 'bru gnyis srang gang re/ rgyugs nas bre re/ slob dpon rnams la rgyun du thob khongs khag nas ngo skal re bcas dgos/ 'jigs gsang sgrub khag che ba rer dge 'dun zhal grangs 250yas mas la nyin grangs bsdoms 9rkyaring sgrub mchod kyi gtong sgo dgos rigs ni/ bde mchog grwa tshang la dge 'dun zhal grangs 200lhag yod/ sna len mi 4gzhung gnyer mi 4nya dge mi 4 phag zla gnyer pa 2 mtshams gnyer mi 2 stong mchod gnyer pa mi 2 lo gsar gnyer pa mi 2 gong gsal mchod khag che ba gsum la nyin thebs rer sngar yod bod dngul ṭam dkar rdo0re yod pa phyis ṭam ka bcu la rda sgor re rtsis sgor 5las med/ mchod khag che ba gsum nas 250

nyin bco lnga re gtong dgos pa nyin rer ja thug 1rdogatong chas la ja chab rgya 1phyo'adebs mar rgya phye da 2 ja 'phar rgya 1 mar rgya 2 thug par gro chab khal 1dang nas zo 2 sdor mar rgya 1 nyag 1 tshwa bre 2 shing rgyab brgyad lhag tsam/ rgyun mchod mar nyag 14 rtsam pa bre 2 mchod nas phul lnga/ 'phar ma brgya bzhi rer mchod rtsam jab khal 1re/ mar chab rgya phyed 2re/ mcho da nas bre 2re/ mchod khag res mtshan 'bar rgyun mar chab rgya 2re/ tshogs pa zhal grangs du yod la nyin re sku 'gyed ja srang gang re dang dngul zho gang re rtsis nas bkye dgos/ rgyugs nas grwa rer nas bre re mchod khag re nas khal 9re rtsis dgos/ mchod spos bam chag re dang /srin bal srang do re/ mchod khag res tshogs rtsam zo ba brgyad tsam dang /khog snum dang dkar rgyan mar rgya 1 tshogs sha dkar sdum re dang /tshogs rdzas shing tog rigs bre gsum tsam/gong gsal nang phag zla gnyer pa'i nyin bco lnga dgos pa mchod thebs dang 'phar gtong gong gi mchod khag 2dang mtshungs/mtshams gnyer nas grwa dmangs la nyin 1rkyagatong sgo gtong dgos thogaspyi'i sman bla mtshams pa khongs mi gcig la lo gcig gi phogs dang / las rung mtshams pa mi 4la zla 1gi phogs/ sman bla mtshams pa mi 1la lo gcig gi phogs bcas la zla rer 'bru bre brgyad re rtsis 'bru khal bzhi dang bre 16ja srang mar/ nyag rtsis ja rgya 9dang mar rgya 18 tshwa bre rdoshing zad 'dang /sha tshab nyin res dngul skar re rtsis dngul srang 1rare bcas dang / mchod spos bam 1re/ las rung mi 4la zla 1gi myo/tshams phogs sman mtshams dang 'dra/stong mchod gnyer pas nyin gnyis la mchod mar chab rgya 25 rtsam zo 251

1rkya mchod 'bru bre rdotsam/ spos bam 7 sring bal srang 10tshogs par gong gi mchod khag ltar gyi thog gzab gso ja sbag 1re dang / mar rgya 2re tsam dang / thug pa 'bras zo 2re/ mar 'phar rgya re tsam/ stong mchod la ja 'gyed mal dngul zho gang re bkye dgos/lo gsar gnyer pas nyin gnyis gtong dgos pa mchod pa rgyun mchod ltar yin/ nyin re gro rtsam rgya ma 20re/ 'bras zo gsum re/ sha bub gcig ja mar rgyun mchod las log 'phar tsam/ tshwa shing zad 'dang /gong gsal mchod khag so sos gtong dgos rgyas bcad ltar gnyer tshang du 'degs 'jal byed dgos/ sna len dang / gzhung gnyer/ nya dge/mtshams gnyer bcas la ma thebs dngul gyi khar mchod gzhis son khalaglu shrīlhag tsam re yod/a mchod grwa tshang gi dge 'dun zhal grangs ni sgrub mchod che ba re nas grwa 24re dang / chung ba re nas grwa 12re rkang sgrib byed srol yod pas khyon grwa grangs 122kyi thog phyis rang mos kyis zhugs pa sogs zhal grangs gang 'tshams 'phar yod/ mchod khag gtong gnyer dgun chos gnyer pa 4dang /gsar bskos stong mchod gnyer pa 2bcas yod cing / dgun chos gnyer pa 4ni grwa pa yod pa'i khungs de nas mi ser la bsko bzhag byed par bka' 'gyur tshar gcig la nyin 5gtong sgo gtong dgos pas tshar bzhi la bsdoms nyin 21gtong dgos/ dus phyis stong rtsa kha snon byas te mchod khag mi rer sgor chig stong yod par nyin re gtong ja 'phar ma gsum la ja sbag 2 mar rgya rdzogro chan rgyur gro zo bo 2dang bre 1 gro sdor mar rgya 1 thug rtsam zo ba 2sdor mar rgya 1 tshogs rtsam mchod khag mi rer rtsam zo ṭ+wāṃre/ nyin rjes mar ston zas gro mthud rgyur gro rtsam zo ba 2re/ gro ma zo gang re/ ston mar 252

dang gong d+dhagasaXchi mār dgosga —rigs bsdoms na marngod khag mi res mar chab rgya ḍāshrīrī dang / 3— ju 'gyed rgyud mi res ja 'khor drug 2 5re/ sha dod dang 'uk+ṣed —dngulu smu tshes dngulta sgor 4 0 0tsam re/ shing rgyab brgya lhag re/ tshwa bcas bsdu dgo sa/ tre tshotre bstan 'gyurwa gnyer 3 zhes mi bzhi bsko bzhag byas yod pa de ni dus phyis sbyinad+ku bdag khag gis rlomarjod thebasu tshozibazhag junas gsar 'dzugasatso byas pa zhig red/— 0 stastan 'ugyer tsar gartig ñtsadonu ṇapar nyin braco lnga 'gor zhing /nyinar+ṣa cho gtong go'i thad smir bka' 'gyun gnyer pa blung‘ 'dra rung zhogs pu thug sdor sha gtub dgos pa dang / dgong mor 'bras thug rgyugs dgosnga pa red/ stong mchod gnyer pa mi gnyis nas nyin tshogs gnyis la stong mchod gcig dang /— stong tshogs gcig gtong dgos/ mchod mar da—nga ja mar sogs mi res mar rgya ma —20re brasdu dgos pa dang / grwa rer 'gyed nyin re sgor zur 5re bkyes/ mi res stong mchod dang tshogs— rtsam rgyur rtsam zo ji 1rdore dang ja sbag 2re ne — shing rgyab 2re dam thug(dam bca'i thug pa) la 'bras zo ba rdore/ sdor sha7 dzags sha sdebs re zhogasu pa gro tsha thug par gro zo ba 2dang bre 1 tshwa bre 5skor nga(cas bsdu dgos/ — dge slong grwa tshang gis —mi ser la 'gel bskos byed pa'i gnyer pa mi/ 2nas nyin lnga gtong chasga dang /— nyer lnga nyin tshogs 'khor gyi mchod rtsam mar sogs bde mchog grwa tshang dang 'dra/ dge slong rer rgyugs yos chab bre gang re 'bul gtob dgos pa dang / de byings lo 'khor dgu gong zho gnyi ldog bcasari 'char can gyi chosu phogs dang bsnyen bkur gtong chas ni chab bla nas gtong dgos pa 'dra/ — —de min gshin dge gson rim la dge slong mang tshogs zhes sbyin bdag so sos dang bstod kyis gtong skyong byed pa dang /ci 253

ston chos gsang bde 'jigs gsum gyi jibadag 'jug gi nyin thebs ni dad ldan nas gtong rtsa 'bul sbyor rnams bdud bzlog gnyer pa rang khongs dge slong gsum re lo gsum mtshams res mos kyis bsko gzhag byas nas tshong khe bun gtong gis chos bsnyen gtong skyong byed lam dang / lo 2bdud gnyer gsar rnying brje len mtshams stong rtsa rtsis sprod kyi gtong lhag dang skyabs yon byung rigs rtsis phra dang 'brel dge slong rnams la 'bul gtong byed dgos/sgrub khag dang / a mchod grwa tshang bcas byings gzhi'i mchod khag lo gsum re'i mtshams gsar rnying brje len skabs so so'i las sne nas sprod dpang gis sprod khrar so so'i gzhung dam rgyag srol mchis/rnam grwa dge 'dun zhal grangs 2rkyaskyuyas mas la mchod khag mi ser la 'gel bskos dgos gras/ grwa ga—nyer 4 dge gnyer 2 dngul gnyer 2sman bla gnyer pa 4bcas yod cing / grwa gnyer nas grwa ja grwa mar zhes pa deb gsal dbu chos gnyer par 'degs 'gyogs kyis 'khor zhag zla 1phud/chos thog zla 'khor bcu gcig la zla rer dge 'dun re la 'bru phogs 'bo gang re dang / maṭi bum sgrub skabs dung phogs zhes pa 'bru phogs chab bre lnga re 'bul dgos pa'i stong rtsa ja dngul phran bu ji yod ma nges/ mnga' khongs yongs rdzogs nas gte rnying skyed ces pa gan deb rtags 'byar bzhin bsdu len thog gzhis khag gi 'bab yong thog nas gong gsal 'bru phogs dkrig car 'bru tshad ltar 'bul dgos/ dge gnyer 2dang dngul gnyer gsum la stong rtsa phran bu ji yod ma nges kyang dge gnyer nas gtso bo lo 'khor tshogs shing ga len dang / lo gsum brje len mtshams dge gnyer ston mo zhes ja 'phar dang 'gyed sogs gtong dgos pa dang / dngul gnyer nas lo 2mtshams dngul 'gyed grwa rer ṭam sgor 1rkyanas 15bar 'bul dgos/254

sman bla gnyeru pa 4mi gtong rtsa ni dus phyis gshimā dge'iri dad sbyor nas nyin thebs rer 7ṭam sgor 2 00nas rdorkya0yas mas gtong dgos pa dang / chos gzhis phran bu yod tshod mi res nyin re gtong sgo gtong dgos pa nyin rer brgya mchod gsum re'i mchod rtsam mar gong gsal bde grwa bzhin dang / snga dro gsol ja dang bzhes thug dkar skyong/ cho ga'i mjug grub mtshams bag thug la nyin re che sha sdebs re dang gro zhib zo ba 4nas 5bar/ mjug chog nyin dngul 'gyed bod dngul srang gang re bcas gtong dgos— pa phud/ de byings lo 'khor tshugs ring gi mchod bsnyen rigarme chab bla nas nar gtong dgos pa chab bla'i phyir gtong khongs nas gsal/ rnam grwa'i grwa gnyer lo gsum re'i mtshams brje len skabs rtsis dpon zhes rtse gnyer re res mos tshokyis 'gro bar rtsis gdan zhes 'bru khal mang tsam za rgyu yod lugs grangs ka ma nges/ de byings dge gnyer dang / dngul gnyer/ sman gnyer brtswas kyi sprod len skabs rtse gnyer 4 drung yig 1 rnam grwa'i dbu chos bcas nas sprod dpang byed cing / mchod khag rnying pa rtsis sprod byed mkhan des gsol ja bzhes 'bras dang / tho dge gnyer dang / sman gnyer nas ston sha zhes rtse gnyer dang grwa slobu la che sha lag pa re/ de byings la sha skal che tshad lder ma re 'bul dgos dngul gnyer nas gsol ja bzhes 'bras gong mtshungs thog slob dpon dang rtse gnyer la dge 'dun par dngul 'gyed ji phul gyi ldab rtsis dang / drung yig la skalanirkang re 'bul dgos/ gong gsal mchod khag de dag gi rtsis sprod gzhung khrar rtse'i dam 'byar ma 'dra gsum nas gcig rtse dang /gnyer pa gsar rnying la 'dra re nyar tshags byed/mtshan nyid grwa tshang gi mchod rtsa gtong thebs sogs kyi deb gzhi yig rigs rnams 1959lo‘‘rgol gsum’’ ‘‘chag gnyis’’skabs dgon pa spyi'i 255

yig rigs mnyam gzhung nas rtsis bzhes gnang bas/ mchod gzhis stong rtsa'i thad zhib phra ma nges rung / lcags rta mtshan grwa bskyar tshugs skabs rtse shod bla khag ste/ rtse bla brang gi gzha' rgad/ chab bla'i dbig mda'/ zhi ba lha bla brang gi sa pa/ lcags rwa bla brang gi 'gu rje/ dkon rdor bla brang gi 'ga' yam/ yab tshang gi ri khrod sgang / dbon tshang gi se khyam bcas nas bla khag che chung dang gzhis ka rgya che chung la dpag ste son rtsa dang sbrags zhing srung khang pa chabs sbrags gzhis ka re sprad yod pas gong gsal che chung bdun po rnams mtshan gnyer gyi rtsis zhing yin cing / dang thog mtshan grwa dase/ 'dun zhal grangs 2rkyarkyal rtsis skor re mtshan gnyer bzhi bskos 'gel byas yod pa dang / rjes su dge 'dun zhal grangs ri ma 'phar gyis mthar dbe cha ba 600brgal bar 'phel bas mtshan gnyer bzhis khungs 'khyol min la brten slar yang bzhi 'phar bsnon gyis yang snying lo gsum re'i mtshams mtshan gnyer brgyad re mi ser la bsko gzhag gis mchod gzhis gong gsal thog gtong rtsa 'bru ru'i khal 200re tsam dang / dngul sgor chig stong lhag tsam re las med pa ma zad/ bod dngul gyi 'dza' thang yang je zhan song khar bcings 'grol btang rjes bod dngul srang bco lnga la shog sgor re'i thang gzhi las med pas stong rtsa nyams zhan yin cing / gzhis 'bab dang 'bru dngul gyi skyed ka'i thog nas lo gsum ring mchod gnyer mi res lo rer 'bru ru'i khal 2ṭ+wāṃshrī'agyed thebs spos srin shing bcas la sgor 900skor/ mar chab rgya 100re (da lta'i mar rgya 40rkya) ja khor 2re/ tshwa 'bo 4re bcas mtshan nyid gnyer pa rakyi lag nas 'degs 'gyogs rtsis len gyis lo 'khor dge 'dun zhal grangs 600skor la dpyid chos zla gnyis dang / dbyar chos zla gcig ston chos zla gnyis/ dgun chos bzang spyod smon lam chen 256

mo zla gcig bcase tshogs ring mang jar ja rgya 2 thug pa thengs 2 grwa rjerle ja rgya 4bcas rtsis len byung 'phros dbu 'doms nas gtong dgos/mchod gnyer mi 〈so sor gzhis 'bab dang 'bru skyed bcas kyi 'bab rags rtsis kyi gtong 'phros lo rer mi rer 'bru khal 150skor dang / mar rgya 9rkyaskor gyong gun 'khri gi yod tshod/ de byings chos rar dam bca' rtsis bzhag sgrol 'don sogs skam tshogs mang / mtshan grwa gzhung gis lag 'don bya rgyur sa lug she ba4bzung tha bo gsar sbol dang / chos rtsar dad sbyor gzhis khag 40skor yod/ gtong bsnon dang bzang spyod che mo'i thebs rtsa dad spyor gyi tshong 'khos 'thab len dang bun skyede gtong ba bcas byas te dge 'dun rer lo 'khor zla 5la zla rer 'bru phogs ru'i khal re 'bul dgos/lo 'khor dpyad chos skabs dge bshes gnyis re dang / 'phags pa lha chos zhugs kyi mdzad chen dge bshes 1bcas kyi gtong rtsa dad sbyor 'du 'god byed po phyag mdzod 4dngaka mar gnyer 2re grwa tshang nang khungasanas bsko gzhag gis tshong khe bun jiskyed thabasa'akhos gang drag gi thog nas dge bshes rer phyag mdzod bzhi so sos 'bras ru'i khal 18re dang / mar gnyer bzhi so sos dge bshes rer mar chab rgya 100yas mas re dus thog gartong dgos la/ phyag mdzod bzhi nas da dung zla chos bzhi la grwa rer sku 'gyed bod dngul srang gang re 'bul dgos/ mtshan grwa'i dge bshes btang zin rnams nas dgun thog chos dbar la nyin 15skor gsang 'dus rgyud sa/zhung sngags kyi dam bca' tshugs par de'i gtong thebs dad sbyor gong gsal mar gnyer thog bsnan pas dam bce' tshugs skabs gsol ja dang thebs rtsa'i skyed 'bab nas sngags la dam bca' phebs mkhan dge bshes rnam par gsol dod ja khor re tsam 'bul dgos/ mtshan grwa'i dbu 257

'doms la spyi yi mchod rtsar tā la'i bla ma'i nā sgor khri 1the bas nā yang dkar po khri 250skor/ ja khor 2500lhag tsam tsha thang gi zhing rin nā sgor khri 17gyi ja bcas yod pa tshong 'khos 'thab len gang drag gis las rgyun lo gsum ringatsho gong gsal gtong sgo btang ste mtshan grwa'i las sne lo gsum re'i brje len skabs dang thog gsar rnying nang sprod dang mjus sgril mtshams sprod dpang dang bcas sprod khra dam 'byar bkod 'jog dang / gtong lhag nas mchod rdzas sogs spyi 'jog gi 'phros bsdad ja dngul thog sgril te dge 'dun rnams la sha khu sha thim gyis 'bul dgos/ mtshan gnyer rtsis sprod skabs kyang gzhung gi las byang dang rtse'i sku tshab bcas lhan thog nas sprod len gyi gzhung khra dam 'byar re bkod 'jog byed/ dbu 'doms dang mtshan nyid gnyer pa rtsis sprod rtsis len skabs mtshan grwa'i tshoms nang bzhugs gdan dang / gsol ja/ bzhes 'bras/ gsol tshigs bcas gzab rgyas mtshan grwa'i gnyer khang nasi 'bul gtong dgos thog thugs rje legs 'bul zhes mjal dar dang rten dod 'bul dgos/ mtshan nyid grwa tshang la lo gcig nang gshin dge gson rim gyi skyabs yon dngul 'bul byung rim bzhin dge bskos kyis grwa dmangs tshogs yongs mdun skyabs yon dngos tho dang sku rim 'di dang de sgrub dgos pa'i dus thog so sor skyabs tho snyan sgron zhu ba dang 'brel skyabs yon dngos po rnams dbu dge gnyis nas bca' dam gyis bdag gnyer tshong bsgyur byed po grwa pa kha shas ched bskos byas te phyir tshong gi dngos rin nas lo ltar dbyar chos skabs dbyer skyid nyin 'khyol gcig gi gtong sgo gzab rgyas dgos pa dang 'phros bsdad tshang ma ja dngul bcas la bsgyur te song bsdad rtsis tho tshogs gzhung snyan sgron dang bcas dge 'dun pa'i phyag tu smin nges zhu dgos pa bcas song /258

chab dgon —gyi dgon —lag ni/ she bam nang gsal kong po bkris chos gling / lho rong ngom 'dus dgon/ chos khri dgon/ tsha 'brornga dgon/sbyin 'bar degon/ srib rong grong 'beb dgon/ lha rtse dgon/ khyung me dkyil mkhar dgon/ bsam grub dgon/ la gong rdzong lo dgon/gnas thang dgon/ g.yo mda' dgon/ ngom sa sgang dgon/ rmo mda' dgon/ kar mda' dgon/ ging thang dgon/ ko rgyal yar dgon/ko spyan ras gzigs/ be ri lha brgya grwa tshang na mar srib kung phu dgon /byang sgang dgon/ rob gte g.yo dgon/ jing gong dgon/ tsha smad thugs chags dgon/ rgyang phu dgon/ tsha stod gnas ra dgon/ lcags rwa dgon/ brag mkhar dgon/ a yig dgon/ rgya mtsho gling / spo bo mda' zhing / sum dgon/ chos rdzong / chu mdo rdo rje rdzong bcas gong gsal de dag chos lugs dge lugs pa/ skyo mda' dgon/ rdza phu dgon/rdzong rtsa dgon/ mdzo lung dgon bcas chos lugs sa skya ba/ rat+na dgon/gnas mdo dgon/ shag nor dgon/ khre dgon/ sreng chen jo dgon/gsol sder kha bcas chos lugasu rnying ma ba/ mtshan nyid dgon/ tho gru gu dgon gnyis chos lugs 'brug rmo bka' brgyud/ rdo phu dgon bge' brgyud pa gzhan yang gtsug phud ri khrod/ dpal tshad ri khrod/ dpal rtsa ri khrod/ rtsa ra ri khrod/ ra sku 'brem༈ wa lis gdung 'bum/ lhun grub rtse/ ded gsum/ lta rong / phugs dkar ma/ byang sems ri khrod bcas dge lugs pa/ la ba ri khrod/ rom thang / sgom grwa rnying ma/ za la dgon/ wa dag dgon/ gu mdo dgon/ rdis dbon dgon bcas chos lugs bon po/259

gong gsal dgon khag de dag gi sprul sku'i yang srid sdong sku 'das skabs 'phags pa lhar snyan seng zhu 'brel/ 'phags pa lhas thag gcod gnang srol dang / 'phags pa lha 'tsho bzhugs med na chos srid 'khur 'dzin pa nas thag gcod byed srol/ dbo/na/dzide dag gi grwa lam ban rgyun dang / mchod khaka bcas khungs so sos mi ser thog 'gel bkod dang / chos rje dang sprul sku khag la gzhis g.yog rgyug rgyu dang / dbyar ston gsol sdom zer ba sogs khul so so'i mi ser gyis sgrub dgos pa ma zad/ yar phyir 'gro sdod la rta khal yang sgris/ dgos/ ri khrod khag la dge slong bzhi sde re dang / 'go 'dzin slob dpon re bsko gtong byas nas gzhi gsum gtsos rgyud sde'i cho ga dang / mdo phyogs chos spyod chag mos dgos thog khul de'i sad ser 'gog rgyu dang char 'bebs/ spyi rim bcas la 'gan khur dgos/dgon khag so so'i rtsa bzhi chang lnga'i 'dul khrims chos rje nas dag ther zhib 'jug dang 'brel slad srung sdom tshul bzhin bya rgyu'i spang blang zhu gan lo ltar chos/ rje so sos bsdu tshags kyis lo khral bsdu mkhan las byed brgyud chab rtse las khungs su 'bul dgos/de min 'jol don grub gling / mdzo sgang dgon/ spom mda' dgon/smar khams klu ra dgon/ gtsang gshis dgon sogs chos lugs dge ldan yin la de dag 'ga' shas 'phags pa lhas phyag btab pa dang / 'ga' shas 'dzin skyong gnang ba'i dgon par song de dag gis chos 'gyed phud dang mjal rten 'bul ba sogs 'bul srol tsam las chos rje bsko gtong gnang lam med pa red/260

— ཿ —dgon pa'i 'dul sgrig kun spyod/ rab byung bco lnga —pa'i chu byi(tsho1412 ) lo dgon pa gtor bsregs kyi nyams chag ma byuja gong rje tsong kha pa'i ring lugs 'dzin pa'i dge dgon spyi'i sgrig srol ltar bstan rtsa so thar bslab khrims gtso bzung gi rmang gzhi'i thog sngags kyi dam tshigs sdoms pa/ srung sdom la'ang gces spras ches cher byed pa'i srol rgyun bzang po'i zhib phra'i sgrig yig sogs rtsa 'dzin yig lam mi nyung ba zhig yod pa rnams dgon pa dang mnyamabasregs gong yang / dgon pa bskyar chags byung rjes de snga'i sgrig srol lam lugs mthong myong yod rgyus can gyi bla dgon las byed dang / grwa rnyan rnams go bsdur dran gso dang 'brel dge dgon spyi'i lam srol spyi dang chab dgon rangasmogitre gnas tshul dngos bcas gzhir bzung ('phags pa lha sku phreng bcu pa rig ma bsten bzhes la brten tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa bka' nyes gnang ste zur bzhugs gnang dgos byung ba'i)skabs de'i chab mdo'i chos srid 'khur 'dzirne dkon rdor sprul sku skye phreng ni pa dang / chos srid kyi lasakhungs rtse bla brang / dgon pa'i slob dpon dang /spyi sosogs 'brel yod rnams go bsdur gyis degon pa'i lag len bstar bya'i 'char zin dang sprags snyan zhu phul don bzhin tshu sprerme(1922 )lor tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pas bstsal ba'i gos bris bca' yig gsham gsal/‘‘oṃ swa sti/ zhabs zung 'khor 5lo'i ri mo rnam bkra ba/ srid zhi'i cod paṇa rtsal 'chang stobs bculdi rtsal/ñtsa lhun grub zab rgyas chos kyi gdong lnga'i sgra/ sgrog mdzad shākye seng gero mgos phyeg 'tshal/ ring mo nyid nas 261

tshogs zung yon tan ma la ya yi dri bsung gis/ rmong pa'i blo ngan 'thibs po kun 'joms shes rab ches cher rab tu —gsal/ mdzad bzang lo 'dab stug po'i 'khur ldan grags snyan srid pa'i rna bar mdzes/ dus gsum rgyal ba tsong kha pa zhes kun gyi ral pa'i bla na mchod/ rgyal ba'i lung bzang mchog tu skyong ba la/ rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las glog gi zlos gar can/ ma rung snying rtsa lkog mar 'byin pa'i gzi/ bzod par dka' ba'i srung mas rtag tu skyong’’zhes thog mar dge ba'i mchod brjod phreng ba cung zad spros nas skabs don gleng bar bya ba ni/ ringasni jirdo ——rī spre tshomyibyu rwa trī ske ritsho4 kro hūṃ—3 dz+wa/ 3༄cha nga chi 0kha’ ltarne mdo khams chab mdo'i༄thul du zhwa ser ring lugs rmephel rgyas kyigazhe 'dzin byams pa gling zhes yongs su grags pa'i chos sde chen po 'di nyid snga sor 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa chen po gnas 'di ra zhabs kyis bcags skabs mgon po phyag drug pa dang / gnas brtan bcu drug gi zhal gzigs shing / ma 'ongs pa na 'phags pa ba ku las bdag tu bzung ba'i bshad sgrub kyi chos sde chen po zhig 'byung bar lurobastan pa bzhin rab byung brgyad pa'i(rab byung bdun pa'i shing byi grags che ba) me mo sbrul gyi gnam lor rje bdag nyid chen po'i dngos slob byang sems sheso rab bzang pos phyag 'debs par mdzad de sde snod 'dzin pa sum stong lhag tsam 'dug par rje gong ma bsod rnams rgya mtsho sogs mkhas shing grub pa'i rnam thar can gyi gdan rabs rim byon gyi nang tshan o rgyan chen po'i gter lung las/ da lta'i ska ba dpal brtsegs 'di ma 'ongs dus kyi tha ma la/ rno zhes bya ba'i sa phyogs su 'phags pa'i ming can lug lo pa/ 'khor ni lnga brgya lhag tsam byung / khams pa 'dul zhing byams pa bzhengs/ snyan brgyud chos kyi bdag po ste/ zab don chos rīkyi sgo yang phye/262

zhes gsung pa bzhin’'phags pa lha sku phreng rim byon las sku phreng gsum pa nas bzung yo/ ba sras skra zeng rim par 'jags bskyangs kyis ༷bshad sgrub gnyis phyogo.oṃnes dare rgyas shin rtsatsheb byung ri'adug rung chutsho/byi lor log rīsmonartergya'idamag gis dz+ra klo'i rang rtags las kyang shin tu ngan pas dgos gnas grong khyim snod bcud rtsabarlag tu btang ba gzhung dgon rnying khungs la brten bstan pa mchod sbyine gyi mnga' bdag gnam bskos gozhung sa dga' ba rgyan cildan pas bod ljongs bstan srid skye 'gro'i bde rtsarasdeg gron 'dzems med kyi sa rta lo sa sde5rang gzugs rang bdaga'asgog 'di ga'i bkod 'brel chos sde snga sor —rmechud pa gsar btob dang 'brel bar mtshan nyid rīkyi rtsod sgra bar lam nyams lhad 4du gyur pa'ang lcags rta nas gsar 'ardzugs byed bcug pa bcas chos sde 'de nyid kyi dge 'dun pa— rnams nas spong blang khrims su bca' ba'i rirma pyocung zad brjod pa ni/— — de yang sdome pa rma thob pa thob par byed pa'i skabs la/ sdom pa 'bog dze poltasamakhan slob brtan mkhas kyi yon tan gnyis dang ldan zhing kha skong gi r+shacho4dgurteldan gyi drung dusto/ sdom pa nod pa po rang nyid 'gal rkyen bar chadacibazhi dang bral zhing / mthun rkyen nges pa lnga tshang ba'i sgo nas sdom gsum— rim gyis nod pa las/ga dge tshul slong gang gi yang sdom pa med pa dang / )5 da/gon gzhan nas gnas dbyung byes pa rnams chos sde 'dir mi 'jug thob pa mi nyams par srung ba'i skabs la/ rtag tu dran shes bag yod dang ldan pa'i sgo nas ji ltar khas blangs pa'i sdom pa so so'i ngo bo nges pasabaslab bya'i rigs spyi dang bye brag rnams la spang blangs nan tan gces spras su bya/ de yang tshogs su phebs skabs gral /sdu bgres rim gyis phebs nas bzhugs gra la du 'khod bstun zhal 'don gyi gdang dbyangs lhug 'dur gang yin yang dbu mdzad dang bstun pa las/ snga phyi gong 'og 263

'dzol ba/ gtam 'chol/ bzhad gad/ gyang dang ka bar brnyes pa sogs mimadzes pa'i rigs mi byed/ —rnam pa kun tu skra sor gang lhag 'jog pa chab bla'i las tshan las de byings nas gos phu thung ma sogs khyim pa'i rtags 'chang ba/ glu garacarta— rgyug sogs kyi rtsed 'jo/ tha mi kha dang / shig ras la longs spyo da pa/ skabs min rnga rol dbud dkrol skad cor rgyang 'bod kyis mtshon pa'i khyim pa bsun 'byin cing / dge 'dun gyi nang khrims dang 'gal ba dngos shugs nas mi byed/ chang 'di nyes pa kun gyi rtsa —ba dang sum̐ng dkrol kun gyi gzhi yin pas nang mchod/ chang phud tsam las/ ser mo bas rtsa rtse'i zil pa tsam yang long spyod rgyu lta ci/ dgon nang 'khyer 'grim mi chog cing / de 'brel mar thang du 'grim 'grul mang na nag chang gi nyes pa yong ba'i gzhir 'dug pas dgon 'di'i grwa rigasadzārnams nas dge bskos la gnang ba'i radzin thel zhus nas thon te dge bskos nas kyang dgon thon nyi ma ma bzhud kyi bar de ring song ba'i the'u bsdu ba dang / sang 'gro dgos rnams la the'u sbyin/ srog bcad pa'i shi 'di rang cag byams brtse mi che ba'i khyad par du byas pas bstan la zhugs pa rnams kyiji bag med ci dgar spyod pa mi mdzes par 'dug pas tshogs su tshos mi rdo bsel dang / chab zhugs lta bu'i skabs las/ sha skam 'grems spyod mngon tshan che ba mi bya/ ar las dang /khral 'ul lta bur zhal ngor gnang ba zhu ba trem las/ de byings zam yas mas dang thang dkar/ ra che tshun khyim pa'i rtag 'chang ba 'dug tshe zhal ngo nas 7 rtsad gcod kyis chad pa 'gel/ bye brag rnam grol glingarnagi grwa tshang se ra lngags pa'am / gam bcar phan bde legs bshad gling grwa tshang dang phyogs mtshungs sngags grwa rab 'jags la dge bskos zur bskos kyi nang khul sgrig lam gnon —sdem sngar las nyam sa med chab bla'i sgrig yig zur gsal ltar mtshan grwar 264

bzhugs rkemos 5su —yod rngobakag med las dpre chu ba med 'dzugs dgos shing /sgrub khag thārgyad po ser byes phyogs mtshungs ba/ nga tshan re'i khongs kyi rang rang mosu batshon blo nuska —da5 bstun pas thos bsam lhur len thog dngos gzhi'i dpe cha'i rkang 'dzin sngar rgyuchu dbyur gnas jinang don sgrubyā 3sde che khag gnyis so sos grwa bzhi re/ chung khag— drug so sosnya grwa gnyis rī'i 'o rna 'dzipru rgyugs rdzogs shing blo gsal lo gzhon lo ltaraci bzhugs gtong la mkharno po mdo sngags gnyis kar mkhasda ngesta drag sbog bske bzhag bi'is rang lugs cibashad lhab sro la bzang— skong du 'ephelu thābs 'khurā che lhodaji med dgos shing / sde 'di gun tshogarme yi dam re'i bdag ‘mādrarna dbang —rjog yongasatsho rdzogs —dzogs/ rgyun sngar lamā nyams med dgos papru drostarten chos thog chos bar/ dwa6 sgrol shos 'do na grangs sogs yul dus kyi dbang gis dasmugs su gsal dgos pa ma gtogs dpe cha ba gas ra bu 'jug— rim/sto — zhugartsa nas sgrig nyams su len tshul/dbyarā ciston chos thon gong du 'dzin rgyugs sprod len sogs ser snyes grwa tshang dang phyogs mthun ngos/rtsoche — gzhung la 'jug pa'i rim pa —yāng busdus grwa nasta mdzod bar rim bzhin rjos bsam nyams 'og tu 'chud nasda sngar rgyun rab 'byams— pa'i ming btags len/ — — zla ba bcu gcig pa'i skor nas dgun chos sgrub khag so so'i khongs su 'don chog ma chag pa byed pas tshogs tshopar dpe khrid— —brtsi —bzhag/ tshogs grol nas brtsi bzhag bskyar sbyangs/ mjug tu rtsod za dang dam bca' tshugs/ — kro ri snalo ltar cho 'phruh+phu zla dang po'i tshes gcig nas tshes bco lnga bar lha ldan smon lam chen mo'i phyag srol bzhin mchod pa sna lnga stong tshar 'bul gshomasra dang 'brel mtshan nyid grwa tshang dang sgrub khag mnyam tshogs kyi tshogs mthun 265

gnyis la mang ja gnyis re btang thog bla mchod bde stong dbyer med ma/gnas brtan phyag mchod/ ngos ring 'tsho'i smon tshig/ bstan 'bar ma/gsung chos/ smon lam/ dam bca' bcas gsar tshugs rnams tshul bzhin bya/ mdo phyogs thos bsam song rnas ciblo nus dang bstun pa'i sngags la 'jug par rgyud dono gtan la 'bebs lugs dang / nyams su len tshul sogs dpal lden— smad rgyud grwa tshung dang phyogs mtshungs bsnyen rdzogs dmangs khongs sngags tshan blo 'dzin rdzogs min lasto ma ltos par 'jug de byings bsnyen rdzogs dmangs su gsar zhugs rnams 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi bdag6 bskyed 'dzin rgyugs byum 'phrod bar mi 'jug hor zla jibacu pa'i lnga mchod dang / nyi zlog dgu chung / dgu chen sogs la 'ojigs lha bcu gsum ma'i rmangon rtogs/ drug cu ma'i lcags mkhar/ chos skyong khag gi bskang chin rgyas pa rnams bsnyen rdzogs dmangs tshogs yongs dang / 'jam mgon bla mar mgon po phyag drug pas zhal gzigs par grags pa'i sa gnas mgon khang du/ sngon yod dge slong nyi shu rtsa brgyad thog gzhung gnas nas grwa ba zhi dang / rjes 'ophar grwa sum cu so gsum nas nyin re skyabs sems deng /lhung bshags/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma/ 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i bdag bskyed/ mgon phya / drug pa dkar nag dang / zhal bzhi/ chos rgyal phyi nang / dmag zor ma/ rnam sras/ lcam sring bcas chos skyong rnams kyi bskang chog rgyas pa dang 'brel bar bskangs bshags tshar gsum re rnams nyin bzhin rgyun gtong chag med byed/ bsnyen rdzogs bcu nas lo phyed gnyis ring / 'jigs byed bdud las rnam rgyal gyi bsnyen chen/bsnyen rdzogs grwa bcu tham pa nas lo gcig tu skyabs 'gros mtshan sngon 'gro 'bum bzhi dang / dmigs brtse ma/ 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i las 266

rung rgyas pū/ mgon pro phyag drug chos rgyal phyi nang sogs bsnyen mtshams bshol zla dang bcas pa rtarge tu chag 'gyungs medari par gtong dgos rgyu 'i mdzams khag— gnyis kar rnying pas bsnyen mdzamyas thim mtshatsāsari/ gasdar pa de 'phral 'jug pa nyi lnga rjes las mi 'gyangs pa dang / grwa sgrub so sos rang rang yi dam gyi las/ rung yang sngar rgyun bzhin tshad ldan byed/ bslab pa yongs su sbyong ba'i thabs gzhi gsum gyi phyag len 'dul 'dzin pa'i yig cha gsal byed ces pa'i dgongs don nyams mred skyong dgos par hor zla drug pa'i nya nas— dbyar lnga ma— zla ba gsum rid rnam glol grwa tshang / bsnyen rdzogs jidamadas ma mtsharne nyid chosga grwa ba gzhan yang mos pa su yod rnams nas 'gal med kyis de'i ring rtsa 'jug rgyan gsum sogs cosu spyod rnoms re mos— dang /nyin ltar las rim bcas 'uchad nyan/ hwa rtags gsal gtong ba sogs chag yīd byed/ zla ba byung ngo cog gi yar mar gyi gso sbyong dang / bkra shis dang gnod bzlog gso —sbyong skubs bsnyen mtshan pa dang / nad mnar ltas gsal rnams las de byings slob dpon rnams nas— bzung dge— tshul yan tshang ma yong / bstan srid zhabs rim dang ken bcos lta bu skabs la rnying son gto thabs sogs grub mtha'i bsre lhad yong gzhi mi chog — tshotshogs 'du snga phyi'i skorwa zla phro1tshes rdonas mgon mgul bskang res pasu nyin gsum rdo gcal gzhud du— skyabs 'gro sgrol shis sogs gsungs shing /de rjes tshogs ldongs bsdu tshogs kyis nyin bdun par 'ur 'don byed pa'i nyin dang / gnyis la sher rnying tshar gsum re dang / de rjes nas rtsa gdugs res mos kyi 'don/ tshes 16nas nyin brgyad bar dgong ja tshogs dgos par 'ur 'don du gsang 'dus sgrub sde nas gsang chog dang / —yi dam —sgrub sdesga 'jig byed cho ga de byings dge 'dun rnams nas rtsa 267

gdugs dang / dge slong rnams nas sbyin bsreg 25tshes la rdo gcal dzu sngags rgyun tshugs par rgyud sde so so'i bdag bskyed blangs/ sngags rgyun grol nas 'du khang du nyin gnyisasaring rtsa she tshar re dang / nyin gsum par rtsa she/ chos spyod sogs mtshan rgyun tshugs/ zla 12tshes 10nas rdo gcal du bskang res pa nas dgu 'og ma'i 'ur 'don nyin gnyis dang / de rjes tshogs mang nas nyin gnyis bar sher snying tshar gsum re/ de maphrems nas tshes 24bar rtsa gdungs re mos kyis 'don/ tshes 25nas nyin gsum bar rdo gcal du sngags rgyun gong mtshungs dang sngags rgyun grol nas dbyer yod dge 'dun rnams 'du khang du tshogs pas nyin gsum kar rtsa shir tshar re/zla 2tshes 2nas tshes 12bar tshogs yongs nas 'du khang du dus bzang gi smon lam tshogs pa'i smon lam bzhi 'drel 'don/ sgrub mchod brgyad kyi mchod dpon rnams nas spyan 'dren khrus gsol/ tshes 5 ra 10 12rnams la dbyar bdag slob dpon gang yin nas bsngo ba mthun 'gyur dngaka chos bshad sogs kyi bya ba byed/ tshes 14la tshogs dmangs nas casmon lam 'don/ dgung tshig grol nas nyin snga ma ltar bya/ tshes 15nyin dge slong rnams nas phyogs bzhi'i mchod 'bul/ rgyal ba mi pham ma/gom/ po'i snang brnyan shing rta'i thog tu gdan 'dren pa sogs gling bskor ser sbrengs dang / grol bstun 'du khang du gsang dus shis brjod sogs sngar lam gyi phyag bzhes ma nyams pa byed/ zla 4tshes 1skyunas nyin gnyis par bskang res pas gtsos dgon bzhugs tshogs yongs nas tshogs chen sgo 'phyor du nyin ltar gdugs dkar tshar re 'ur 'don/ tshes 15nyin rtsa sher dang / dgong khar tshogs chen 268

sgo drung nasau dbrelku 'phyegs pa'i rtse bskor byed/ — — sgro ḍātshirme dzhatsho6—nase zla gcig ring tshogs chen sgo 'phyor du 'ur 'don/ཿ(rtsa bshe ra ram gdungs dkar sdinaci) rje gong ma gsod nams rgya mtsho'i gzim khang so yurme prutremedo smad spyi 'domaso bka' blon las 'phar sman stod pa de nyid skabs gzhung genas nasarteskyo lnga'i mgon khang gsar bzhengs dang 'brel dkon gnyer gcig dang / rgyun bskalnge grwa bzhi ched 'dzugs thog yi dam rta mgrin yang gsang gi las byang lnga pa'i gsung rdo rje sgrardzodabyangs/ rgyal po sku lnga'i gsol mchod rdo— rje sgra dbyangs bces btsugs pa rnams dang / gong gesal dgu gong 'og gi sngags rgyun/ degong ja/ rgyuno gyi mang ja dus bzang smone lam/ dgun tshogs rnams la slob zur/ — spyi so las zur/ gzhung bskos garnyer khag las thog rnams lasardzo/ de byings me dmigs bsal dgongs pa sbyin ster med/ nyams na phyir bcos pa'i skabs la sdom pa'i mi mthunarka phyogs nyes lhung phra ba rnamaso gzheng bzhin bshags/ rtsa ba bzhi dang /myos 'gyur gyi lhung bar glengs spyod/ mi mang kha 'gril phyogs 'then gyis dge 'dun rtsod khrug slong ba 'go rtsom dnge ngan rgyab byed gte/ la sa sner kha lan lag lan slog pa rnams chad las ji ltar 'os pa dang 'brel gnas nas dbyung thog pham pa byung ba rnams nalge so so'i grwa tshang khongs su kha btags dang nyes chad rgya dngul srang nyi shu rtsa lnga sgrub rjes shog thod mdo sgrub dang 'brel ba'i gnas nas sgyuboskrad/ de byinges lag 'thab sogs men rtsa che rigs dang / khyim me bsun 'adzhan cinge dege 'dun gyi nang khrims dang 'gal ba sogs kun spyod ngan pa byung ba rnams la lan rtsar dpag pa'i nyes bkodedang 'brel 'doms nges dgos/ 7 gzhung gi las tshan chab mdosne bla phyag dang chos grwa'i mkhan po/ 'du 269

grwa dang / gnyer chen phyogs thog rnams phud/ de byings mthod man su thad nas bskor lam nang tshun du rta bzhon pa/ skabs min gri bog 'khyer ba/bog dang mda' 'phen pa/ nor gcan rgyun nyar byed pa/ dgon gyi sa mtshams ka ba/ thog thi'i/ kyo ba/ ra mo che dang / mdun gyi g.yas g.yon ri klung rnams nas rngog dang / rtsa shing 'thu ba/ dus mchod dang /ar las skabs lta bu las rnam kun dgonatshagaseb tu bud med 'gro ba dang /zhabs sdod byed pa sogs mi chog de 'dra'i dgon gyi bca' khrims las 'gal ba zhi drag su thad nas byung yang nyes pa che chung la dpag ste zhal ngo dang /spyi so mnyam 'brel don gnad gal che'i rigs 'du grwa rnams dang / mkhan po bcas nas rtsa 'dzin nye 'gyangs phyogs lhung spang pa'i gzhung bsrang 'doms nges dang / des kyang mang chun na chos srid 'khur 'dzin sogs chab bla rang zhu nas skabs sgyur bstan rgyun la sman pa'i rgyab gnyer dgos rgyu/spyi sos mtshon spyi sger mchod gnyer rnams nas mchod thebs sngar yod dang / gsar sbyor byung ba rnams la bsri tshogs gces spras thog bun gtong tshong spel sogs thabs 'khos gang yod kyis mi nyams gong 'phel dang /mchod rgyun chad 'khum/ zom 'jog bsnyen bkur je zhan je phrar ma song ba'i gtong sgo gang 'khri chag nar med par mchod yul gal cher bsam pa'i dus gtong dgos rgyu/ dgon pa'i chos gzhis / grwa rgyun/ mi rtsa sogs da lta phan gnas shing 'jags pa'i dbang rigs gtan lajags las/ gzhung sger mtshan dman sus kyang bsgyur bkod 'gro gzhi'i rigs gtan nas mi chogadagon pa'i lar rgya bshad sgrub kyi bya ba dang bcas pa je mtho je rgyas su 'gro ba'i mthun rkyen gang 'gro lhur len dgos pa dang / mdor na dge 'dun pa rnams nas lhan pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa mig gi 'dra dbu ltar gzhi byas la 270

mdo lngegs9)me+edon rnemasasto thos bsam go rim ma 'chol bar mnyam med rgyal ba ‘gnyiso pa'i ring lugos dri me med pa bshad sgrub gnyis kyi sgo nas rgyas shing thosadon sgosda bsam rang rgyudardo la sbyar barmenyams su len pa sogs rang gzhan gyi tshogs gasnyes jibade blig tu rdzogaso me'i thab4bla na med par 'bad brtson lhod med bgyis pa rnams la chos 'eṣ+ṭan lam du7 lhongs pa'i skyabs 'jug bgyis yod cing / ci ste bsgo ba rnar gzon pas bcas khrims la ji mi snyemasgyupas mtshams 'dir tshig gsalatsho'akhod mirna la ma bltospu par bshad sgrub mthun rkyen dang bcas par gnod 'gal log par 'gro ba tshoshan na chos srung ye she—se kyi skyen lden rnams kyi bkanya chad drag po thogeng tu 'be+ebs r+pāgadon mi za zhinge 'di nas ky-ing rjes gnon nyang brtsade rgyab gnod yen por ma song ba bsgyud rgyu bcas de don ji srid bar rtse 'ardzon nyams len tshul bzhin yodzob 'tshal/ 'di smras pa/ phun rtogs rnam par dag pa'i gru gzings la/ brten nas thar lam nor bu'i gling mtshoge tu/ rab bgrod don— gnyis 'dod rgu'i depal 'ebyor 'gro ba mtha'adeg longs su spyod gyuraciger+shaces gobar bya ba'i yi ge sa steng rgyal bstan yongs la mnga' kwadabang bsgyur ba pad dkar 'chang ba'i skye phreng bcu gsum pa shākyā dge slong ngag dbang blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho 'jigs bral dbang phyug phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes rab byung bcu drug pa'i nang tshan irnga cikar ces pa chu pho sprel lo'i zla tshe dge bar nor gling bde skyid kun dga' 'khyil ba'i bskal bzang pho brang nayobris zhes pa dang /chab dgon grwa tshang lnga'inywa yo sgrig ladhem kun spyod gong du bca' yig chen more gsal ba ltare dang / grwa tshange so so'i nang khungs kyi dmigs bkar zhib phra'i sgrig lam sna tshogs gtan 'bebs byas yod pa'i nang tshan 'dir dge slong grwa tshang gi sgrig lam sogs kyi skor 'phags pa lha bcu pa'i gong tham 'khod pa'i 271

sgrig yig nang gi 'brel yod kha shas 'god par bya ste/ sgrub sde che khag nas dge slong nyer brgyad re dang / chung khatshi nas bcu gsum re rtsis 'bor gcig brgya sum cu so bzhi las nyung mi chog dbus dge yin na dbyar sgrub gnyis/ de min sgrub sde'i 'don bzung rigs rdzogs thog gso sbyong dang /'jigs byed mngon rtotshis/ khams dge yin na dbyar sgrub 'jigs— byed mngon rtogs mgon chos yan rdzogs pas mchod dpon so sos zhal ngo rtsar khrid nas mjal dar phul nas mtshan thor 'god/ 'jigs byed mngon rtogs sogs bshar rgyugs 'bul/ sgrig khrims kyi bkod pa gnang /bsnyen rdzogs mang mar skyabs rten zub phyi gcig dang ja 'bru nyag bcu mar rgya gang bcas kyi mang ja gang legs 'bul ba'i bdud gnyer—(bdud bzlog ces zhabs rim gyi yon du dngos dngul phul ba de'i do dam par bdud gnyer zer)nas ja gnyis go bcad mi chog dge slong gsar zhugs rnams nas rim bzhin skyabs 'gro 'bum bzhi gnang smon dang / yi dam 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma/ rigs gsum spyi sgrub/ mgon chos gnyis kyi las rung tshad ldan grub nas char 'bod/ sad bkag dang / gshin gsod dge rim la gtong / chos gos rnam gsumā/gding ba/ chab ril/ zla gam/ phreng ba sogs rgyun du bsnams/bskor lam tshun gzhan sgrig lam spyir btang thog la dbyar dgun gang la stod 'bog gyon mi chog rgyun du zhogs dgongs 'jigs byed/ bla mchod/gtor ma brgya rtsa/ kha zas byin rlabs gser zhun ma'i gtor 'bul/ tsha bsur sogs bsags sbyang la 'bad/ bya rgyud dang / bla med kyi phyag rgya go ma 'khrul bar bslab/ dgon yul snang la rtsed mo bzhad gad/ log gtam dang / lham rgya rdog can/ phreng ba g.yu byur gyis brgyan pa gyon 'chang mi 272

chog —tsholha khyimawune bsun 'byirna pa 'i rtags spangs te dad ldan dwang ba 'dren pa'i spyod lam las/ bun gtong len/ ngan khe sdig btsong / rgya nyag zo phulu gyi 'a ga spyod gtong len/ culnga mjal gyod bshad/ khrims 'go gnon pa logs mi chogaci shā—tshogs che chung rigs la labaslab pa bgres gzhon go rim ma 'khyul ba phebs brazhugs dgos/ — dgon du yod rigs nas gso sbyong la chos gos gding ba bcag bsnams/ rke rme dga' lhan lnga mchod ṭha mo 'tshog skabs mchod bzhengs skor / 'jigs byed/ge 4mgon chos/ chici lha myo/ dpal mgon/ bertse rnams kyi phugagator dgos rigs trel rtse— khra zur shan/ braja rgyan/ mesperi/ mar ril gor tsam bcas dbyibs rgyan mar tshon gang legs byed/ drag mchod 'doms pa'i mchod pā tshar bcu gsum/ las mici nyung ba dang / nyin ltar bla mchod phug gtor rgyan tshon gca legs nas r+pārgya mchod grangar+sā— tshang dgos lnga mchod rdor slob dbyar bdag phebamu/ skal ba sum 'phar 'bul/ tre bskang des pa rnams tshogs chen du lhan latshogs kyis nyin ltar blabyumachod zab rgyas gang legs dang / zhal don skyabs sems/ 4 — 'jigs byed mngon rtogs/mgon chos/ lha mo/ dpāl mgon/ bertse/ rnam sras bcas kyi bskang chog dang 'brel ba'i bskangs bshags tshar re/ — yos rgyugs rgyag skyabs bzang sbyod sogs smon lum —bzhi 'brel/ dgongs bar ja rgodaci gsol nas bsngo 'debs gsungus/ grol nyin mnga' gsol zab rgyas gnang / dgon gnyer khag la dmigs bsal gyi dgongs pa ster/ sgrub mchod 'tshog skabs ma 'khel na mchod dpon brgyad tshogs la zhugs/ bdud bzlog gnyer pa mi khom bltas gsal dang / chab ༷gzhung gi sku drag khag nas — dgongs zhus byung na 'jigs byed mngon rtogs thon nas dmigs bsal dgongs pa 273

gnang / de min zhib tshags kyis bsdu dam byed pa las dgongs 'khrol gnang 'thus min/ nyi ldog nyin lnga ring gi gtong chas mchod chas sogs chab gzhung nas len pa'i mchod bzhengs gong mtshungs dang / zhal 'don skyabs sems 'jigs byed mgon chos/ lha mo bcas kyi bskang chog dang 'brel ba'i bskang bshags tshar gsum re gyer dbyangs sogs rgyal ba bsod rnams rgya mtsho'i phyag srol/ phur lcog ngag dbang byams pas dag ther gnang ba ltar phyag len nyams med byed/ nyin gnyis pa nas bzung drug cu'i bsgral chog byed/ gtor rgyag skabs phar tshur bla bskos 'byor rigs sogs dgon 'dir yod kyi mtshan tho 'khod rigs byon pa las dgongs 'khrol ster byin mi chog dgu gong 'og gnyis la mchod bzhengs gong mtshungasadang / zhen 'don la skyab4sems 'jigs byed mngon rtogs/ mgon chos gnyis kyi bskang chog dang 'brel ba'i bskang bshags tshar gsum re/ nyin phyi ma rnams la drug cu'i bsgral chog gyer dbyangs zhu lam ltar phyag bzhes ma nyams pa dang / nyin dang po lha mo'i bstod pa dka' ba dwang blangs ma nas bzung dgerī slong bzhi sde res nyin thun dang / mtshan tshogs skabs bskyed chog khyod zhu ma/ bshags pa/ chas 'bul bcas kyi 'don bshar byed sngags rgyun grol nas mang tshogs la zhal 'don/ zab mdo tshar gsum bzlog sbrags seng gdong ma/ sgrol ma tshar gsum/ sgrol bstod/ bde gshegs gtsug tor ma tshar gsum bzlog pa/ bstod pa bcas dang / skyabs dgon yab sras kyi brtan bzhugs/bstan srung bcas kyi bshags pa yongs rdzogs/ mtshan thun dang po gdong gral phan tshun/ bskang res pa bcas kyis bzung 'phros nas thun 274

gnyis pa dad gsum pa bcas 'dra bgos kyis bzung ci/ thun bzhi pa bskang rgyun stas bzung /— mo— mchod dge bdud gnyer thon zur/ dbu mdzad sil sbrub pa rnams kyis thun bzung mi dgos/ mchod dge bdud gnyer thon zur pa bcas mang tshogs dmigs bsal gyis byon mi dgos/ gtor rgyag skabs tshang ma bsdu tshags las dgongs 'khrol gtan nas gnang mi chogagal srid lnga mchod dgu che chung 'du tshogs skabs 'byor min byung na/ nyin ltar dgongs rten dngul byod ṭam re gzhung la 'bul/ — — byung zhusu gdul bya sogs lad+ngha rjogs pa bsdu tshags byed pa sprelas dgongs 'khrol byed 'thus smren cing / — ci ste nad mnar sogs la dgongs pa ster byin song na skal ba sprod len k+ṣed mi chog dus mchod skabs bla dpon khag gi zhabs rim dang / tshogs chen khag la gdul bya byung na je 'dren bzhi dang ja ma bcas la skal ba rire sprod dgos/ bskangs res pa'i thog tu gdul bya dge slong re zung yod —sna bdud bzlog ji byung bdud gnyer thog 'gro dgos/dge slong bzhi sde yan mar thang dang / dgon khag phun tshun sogs la tshogs skabs bdud bzlog byung rigs bdud gnyeru la 'bulda/ci lcang dkar gtor gtong dang / dbyar gnas/ ljongs rgyu/ bdag 'jug bcas 'tshog sa skabs ngos skal ma gtogasu skal wen sus kyang byedatsā chog ci dge slong mang ma'i zhal 'don blo 'dzin dgos rigs lo gnyis kyi rdzogs yig —phogs nges ma byu5 na lo rer sa rgya ma 2rdore —yod pa'i thum lnga/lo bzhi thog ma rdzogs na —ldab 'phar bsgrub/ lnga mchod nye zlog dgu che chung so sor spyi chen dbu mdzad nas ming don mtshungs pa dgos kyang —/ lo gcig gnyis tsam gyer cidakhyajasnya kyis n+d+ra bzhin rang rkyang pher ba ma thub bar dbu chung nas su rung tshoges dbu tshasta 'dzugs kyisre —gtor rgyag dbu mdzad —ngo 275

mas byed dgos/ de mtshams dbu mdzad dgos rigs ngo mas byed/ mang tshogs skabs spyi sor skal log mgon khang dkon gnyer/ spyi dbu zur/mtshams chen khag bcas dngo / sku 'bum dang lha rong / bar lis bcas kyi chos rje dang sku sa/nyer la bka' rnying gis chod gesal las de byings la mi dgos/ bdud bzlog nas slob dpon la ngo skal re sprod/ ja ma'i ngo skal dang thab g.yog pa'i phyed skal/ bdud bzlog lo gsum mtshams so sor sum gshags kyis sprod/ slob dpon dgu dge la ltir bu mchu ril las khur mi chog bdud bzlog gnyer pa de sngon ltar res mos kyi gsum re bskos te lag gtong ma gtogs spyi sger nas 'tshogs rigs bdud bzlog gnyer pas 'khur len sha khu sha thim gyis gtong / lo gsum zin mtshams lhag ros gzhung bzhag dang 'gyed phul gyis thugs dwangs snyan seng 'bul/rnam rgyal ma/ sgrol ma/ stong mchod/ smon chog bcas sogs la mchod 'bru bre bco lnga yan 'bab rigs la mchod g.yog pa gzhung nas gtong bas phyed gzhung du 'gro/ phyed mchod g.yog pa dang dkon gnyer 'dra bgos byed mgon kha sgo 'phyor las 'du khang du mchod gtor mar khu bzhu ba sogs mi choganye bskor bla bskos khag brje mtshams rnying pa rnams dbyar gnas 'tshog skabs dang / lcags rwas mtshon gzhung zhabs phan tshun bla bskos rnams nas lnga mchod skabs sgrig 'khur sngar lam bzhin/ slob dpon ngo mar tshogs skal med par slob zur la sprod stangs shes min la brten/ tshogs bskyod ma bgyis tshe skal len mi byed/mgon khang bskang rgyun pa nas zhal 'don skyabs sems gtso rgyal ma/yan lag bdun pa/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma/ yon tan gzhir gyur ma/276

'jigs rgyud —matram̐n rtogs/ mgon po/ chos chomyal/ lha mo/ dpal mgon/ du rnam rīsuchos/ 4rtse bcaspokyi bskang chog dang 'brel ba'i bskang ba tshar gsum̐m la dngu po bskang bshags yongs rdzogs tsharā rjes bskang bzlog bya/mthun grub mi mtshams mgon po'i bshags pa bya/ byu bskang rdzas byin dang mgon po'i bskangu ba nas zhang paṇa bskang ba bar btang nas rjos rgyal gyi bshags pa/ —gtor ma dang brurkang rdzasaci la byin rlabs byas blonas mgon po'i bskang ba nas yaltod bskul/ rngodapal myagon dam sgragasakhri lha mo'i lhun grub bde ba ma bcas rgyun gtong dang / gtor brdzong rles mos bya/ dbyings yum ma rgyal chenakyi gton 'bul/ spya shebyes srungacaspyi dang / — dpal lha/ zhakhu paṇa/ rgyal po sogs kyi gser skyems dang / rgyal gsol/ dgra bgegs log 'dren ma/ btsan gsol/ rīr+pāstod pa shis brjod/ tsho stobs bcu ma bcas rgyun gtong bya/ zhogs citshogs la skyabasatre sems nas bskang ba dang po zin nas hob grol/ tsha rting la bar bskang nas bertse'i bskang ba zin nas grol/ dgokhu bar gser zhun ma'i bskang ba/ shis brjod bcas zin nas grol/ dge bskos nas snga d+kudashong bar bsher bzhag byed/ tshogs thengs rer lus na chad pa phyag nyin rer 'bul bcug bskang res dbu mdzad nas mgo 'og lus tshud gyis tshogasa'inas ma grol bar gyi sgrig lam gnon/ bla da pon khag dang / nad —mnar song tshe tshab 'dzugs pa las dgongs 'khrol ster byin mi byed rgyu bcas’’zhes sogs gsal ba dang /ci9 mtshan nyid grwa tshang dang / sku zhabs grwa tshang brtas gyi sgrig yig gong gi bca' yig spyi sgrig khongs su gtogs pa phud so soranedamigs bsal gyi sgrig yig re yod 'dug kyang da lta lag casan ma thub/ —dbyar bdag slob dpon dang spyi so kha shas yong nas rtse las khungs su 277

'bul/ rtse nas zhib 'jug mtshams rtse mgron brgyud chos srid 'khur 'dzin mdun 'bul dgos thog sbug dam rtsa tshig dgongs don dang / skyabs rje pha bong kha chab phebs bka' chos skabs bla khag dang dgon pa nas ston bshas zhes sems can mang po srog bcad bya lam de bstan 'gro'i bde rtsar gnod tshabs che bas phyin chad bcad rgya byas na legs slob gnang thog 'phags chen bcu pas de don mjug gnon gnang nas phyin chad bla dgon su thad nas sems can srog bcad kyi bsngos sha spyod 'grems mi byed rgyu dang / chang ni nyes pa kun gyi byung rtsa yin ces rab byung pas dngos brgyud nas longs su spyong mi chog pa'i sha chang gi mtha' 'doms gan rtags 'bul bzhes gnang bas de tshun sha chang gi bcas khrims dam 'dzin gyi lo ltar 'dul khrims kyi gan rgya mnyam sha chang mi spyod rgyu'i gan rgya 'bul dgos/ gang gsal grwa sgrub khag gi gan rgya rer gan lcibs zhes dar zub gnyis re/ ser shud snyan dar bcas chos srid 'khur 'dzin mdun dar re phul 'phros phyed rtse las khungs dang /phyed rtse mgron la 'bab lam/ chos srid 'khur 'dzin nas gan khag thugs zhib grub mtshams rtse las khungs su nyar tshags byed/dgon spyi'i sgrig khrims gnon mkhan tshogs chen dge bsko gnyis re sgrub khag gnyis re'i khongs nas lo res mos kyis ming btags btang zin dge bshes gtsor 'don dang / de min sgrub khag nang khungs kyi mchod dpon thon zur sogs dge slong rgan gras sgrig lam gnon bsdems thub la drang 'tsho zin pa 'dems sgrug gis bla spyi brgyud rtse las khungs su 'char 'bul la chos srid 'khur 'dzin nas bsko bzhag gis lo ltar dga' ldan lnga mchod skabs gsar pas las 'khur dgos par de'i sngon tshud nas 'phags pa lha'i bla brang gi pho brang le lag dang / tshogs chen 'du khang / grwa tshang khag gi 'asnu khang /278

lha khungu mgon khang / grwa shag sogs dgon pa'i lcags ri nang tshud rigs tshang mar —dkar rtsi/ tsag dmar sge'u khung gi nag rtsi bcas gso ba dang /gtsug lag khang khag gi thugs dang rgyal mtshan/ chu 'phur sogs gsar pa bzo sgron 'thus tshang byed/ tshes 24zhogs par zhal ngo gsar mjal skabs/gsang 'jigs gnyirngos nas chab dam pa gnyis/ sgrub khag brgyad kyi dge g.yog brgyad dang / ja khang nang sa brgyad bcas zhal ngo ngo 'khor gzab mchor rgyas spros kyis thog mar 'phags chen mdun gsar mjal gyi mjal phyag zhu bcasdo skabs rtse gzims 'gag lo ltar dgun chos tshugs skabs grwa sgrub so so'i las sne nas 'dul khrims nang zhib byas te rtsa ba bzhi dang 'gal ba'i bslab skyon byung rigame la ser shud ces ming tho zur 'god sgrig khongs nas phyir 'buji byed lugs bca' yig ltar dang / rtsa bzhi dang ma 'gal ba rnams— shog khag so so'i ban rtsad rnams gcig khag gcig khure gyi 'dul khrims gan rgya re gye sgrub nang khungs nas blangs te 'grigs pa byung 'dug snyam skabs gan rgya gcig la bsgril te rge sgrub so sos gan don ho bags med ces spyi tham bkod rjes bla spyir 'bul/ bla spyis mos mthun byung mtshams su zhal ngor 'bol gdan dang / zam kha/ gsol cog bcas gral 'khod mtshams bla brang shod nas nang byan gzan gyon gyis gsol ja bzhes gro dang dkar spro/ shing tog sder kha bcas gnyer khang yig lam ltar bstar rjes 'phags che na mdun gzim chung mjal kha zhu ste zhal ngo rnying pas gnangs brda dang bcas thon phyag mjal zhu skabs mgul dar mdud sprags dang gong 'bul zhus pa'i gos bris bca' yig chen mo phyir gnang / de rjes zhi lcags dkon gsum gyi bla khag la mjal khar bcar/ tshes 29dga' ldan lnga mchod chen mo nas sgrig lam gnod 279

bsdems 'go brtsams/ de bzhin da—kar rtsi dang / thugs rgyal mtshan/khor yug gi gtsang spra sogs 'thus tshang gra sgrig byung 'dug min bskor g.yeng zhib 'jug gis ma 'grigs pa 'dug tshe shag dpon sogs 'phri khungs so sor bka' bkyon tsha nan gtong / dgong khar dgon pa'i bskor lam gyi phyogs bzhir phyogs so so'i 'brel yod 'gan 'khri 'gugs 'bod kyis mo khrims dang gtsang sbra sogs phyogs gang ci'i thad bca' yig dgongs dorne tshang mas rang khrims theg pa 'khur len 'thus sgo tshang nges dgos rgyu dang / ma 'grigs pa byung tshe lus longs rtsa 'dzin mig lar 'doms pa bya rgyu'i tshogs gtam nan po gtong / tshogs chen dbu mdzad ni sgrub khag brgyad khongs nas 'don bzang skad bzang 'dems sgrug dang / grwa tshang khag gi dbu dge grwa tshang so so'i khongs nas bdams te 'os 'bul gyis chos srid 'ak+ṣar 'dzin nas phyag rtags gnang ba dang gsar mjal go rim bzhin zhu/ tshogs chen dang / grwa tshang khag gi dge bskos las 'khur lo re dang / dbu mdzad las 'khur lo dus nges med yin/ sgrub khag brgyad kyi 'du khang grwa shag bcas kyi dkar rtsi rang khungs nas gsol dgos pa phud/ gong gsal dkar rtsidzisogs gsol rgyur 'phags pa lha'i gzim khang / — mgon khang / tshogs chen 'du khang /rten gong ma lha khang / mtshan grwa/ sku lnga lcog sgrol ma lha khang stag 'og sogs chab bla'i sher brtag nas 'go 'dzin byas te chab mdo'i rdza ngos nye skor mi ser nas gsol zhing / sa chu len rgyu zhol mar thang pa'i mi dmangs leb 'dur gyis sgrub dgos/ sa dkar dmar nag gsum sogs thon yul mi ser nas 'gel 'dren byed da gos/280

— rgyun srol gyi dus ston byed sgo/gnam lo gsar pa'i tshes 1nas zhogs sngar rnam grol grwa tshang dang rtse dang bla khag gi gzim shag tu rnam grwa'i chog grwa nas dpal ldan dmar zor rgyal mo'i spyan 'dren tshes gtor dang so so'i sger srung gi bskang chog nyin bdun tshogs par gsol ja dang / gsol ba gzab gzengs 'bul dgos/ tshes 2nyinarī bla phyag lhan rgyas srung ma lcog tu tshes phu lha gsol zhes zhang paṇa sku phebs zhus te 'phags chen yab sras sogs kyi sku phywa darīng / lo zhus zhes char zhod 'bel dkon zhing 'brog thon skyed legs nyes/ sad ser gyi nyen kha yod med sogs kyi lung zhus yi ge rtse mgron nas sgrogs/ phyir phebs bka' lung drung yig tsho sa sam ṭa'i thog bkod de slar shog thog phab nas de don mnga' khul yongs snyel bkod rgya 'grems spel byed/ zla dang po'i tshes— gcig nas bco lnga bar tshogos chen du tshogs yongs smon lam tshogs te chos spyod kyi rim pa dang / chos rar rtags gsal gtong ba sogs byed tshes bcu lnga'i nub mor smon lam gtor ma zhes/ rtse dang bla khag dgon pa'i slob dpon lnga/ spyi so/ bla khag gi las byed sogs nas gtor chenaslorgyel tshab zhal za se’rkekyi rnam par brang rgyan dang rtse khra/ zur shar sogs shing ga'i/ la bzos par gser shog dang / mthing mtshal sogs kyi brgyan pa'i mar tshon gyi rgyal srid sna bdun/ bkra shis rtags brgyad/ rdzas brgyad sogs kyi gzugs brnyan rgyas sprod mdzes tshon gang legs dang /'khor gtor zhal zas mda' tshad mas gtsos nyer spyod grangs tshang brgya mchod re yod pa'i chokhag 20lhag trem gyi gling me mchod 'bul gzab rgyas 281

bshams par grwa tshang slob dpon dang / gnyer chen/ rtse dang bla khagamagron gnyer/ mar rgyan dportswabacas nas sngon tshud bskor g.yeng zin mtshams 'phags chen yab sras kyang mchod gzigs su phebs srol thog mchod pa spus dag min sogs ma 'grigs pa byung rigs la phyi nyin rtse las khang nas khungs so sor bkod 'doms nan po gtong / tshes 2 2nas tshes 29bar rnam grwa nas bka' srung dgyes mchod ces sger srung zhang paṇa gyi gsol mchod rgyas pa tshugs/ tshes 27 2〈la zhang paṇa gtso 'khor gyi 'bag dang 'cham gos sogs mngon rtogs ltar gyi spyan 'dren/ bskang bstod sogs 'don chog gyer dbyangs rol mo dang bcas bde yangs su 'cham nyin gnyis rgyagaganam lo gsar tshes zhogs pa bla brang rtse shod nas 'phags pa lha'i sku mdun du gsol ja dang / gro ma/ dkar spro/ rtse nas nang mdzod nyin mo bde legs ser po/ shod nas mjal dar a she/ de rjes bla khag dang /dgon pa'i bla spyi/ grwa tshang kha/ ga bcas nas mjal dar dang dkar spro/ bla dgon las byed nas lo gsar mjal ba dar 'bul ba dang / de bzhin zhi lcags dkon phyag so so'i gzim chung du'ang mjal dar dang / dkar spro go rim bzhin bstar 'bul zhus par/ mdun ja dang phye mar btegs rjes ljags mdud re gnang /tshes 1nyin dgon par nyi ma phog nyid 'don cho—ga dang bstun lha rta/lha g.yag lha lug khyi nag sogs la rgyan gyis spras te spyan gzigs su gling bskor byed/ de rjes dgyes ston mgron tho rtse mgron gcig dang gnyer drung nas klog ste mgron du 'os pa rnams chab bla'i tshoms chen nang bzhugs khri dang bzhugs gdan snga nyin nas gra sgrig byasatshopa ltar so so'i gral gnas su 'khod pa sogs gra 'grig byung mtshams zhisgrulcags dang dkon phyag sogs 'phags pa 282

lha'i sku mdun du phebs te lhan rgyas thog rtse mgron nas phebs bde dang spyi rīmadzod nas spos sna bcaso zhes te go rim gyis phebs/ bzhugs khri dang gdan thob skor rtse mgron nas gdan bsher bkod sgrig byas pa'i dang por/sa 'dzin zhes stegs bu spu bzhi thog bzhugs khri mi tshad tsam zhal lhor gzigs steng 'phags pa lha bzhugs grub bstun/ rnam grwa'i gar rol gtong bzhin zhi lcags dkon phyag sogs nes sku phyag gsum re dang 'brel bar mjal dar nang mdzod nyin mo bde legasi re 'bul bzhes skabs zhi lcags dkon gsum la 'amegs pa lhas khri thog nas dbu thug dang mjaladar rtse sprod 'bul bzhes grub rjes zhi lcags dkon gsume so so'i bzhugs khrir 'khod/ de rjes mgron gral du yod pa'i dgon pa'i mkhan kheg dang / bla dgon las byed sogs nas 'phags pa lhas dbus zhi lcags dkon sogs la— mjal dar re go rim bzhin phul te so so'i gral gnas su 'khod bstun chab bla'i thab chen nas rtse dang bla khag la so so'i gsol dpon dang / de min nang byan gzan gyon nas gsol ja dang / gro ma mer khu sogs mig lam ltar rgyugs/ rnam grwa'i gar pa rnams nas〈'jig rten kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar〉dang / mtshan nyid grwa tshang gi dge bshes gnyis nas—chos 'khor dang sems bskyed gnyis las brtsams— pa'i rtags gsal gtong ba spel ma byed/ zlos gar rnam grangs bco brgyade kyi mjug gri gar 'khrab pa dang / chab bla'i gnyer che nas sne khrid dgyes ston gyi dger spro sogs shing tog gi sgo khri dang gsol sha dkar nag sogs rtse dang / bla khag la rim 'gros kyis sgrig de byings la dkar spro dang / shing tog gsol k+ṣem bcas gnyer khang lam deb ltar bshams rjes dgyes ston mdzad sgo grolatshomatshams sngar bzhin 'phags pa lha dang zhi lcags dkon gsum bcas rtse gzim shag tu ldam/ phebs kyis rtse nas gsol 283

tshigs phul grub rjes so so'i gzim shag tu phebs/tshes 2nyin mdo smad —las bya khang brgyud mgron brda sngon zhus ba'i/na mdo smad spyi 'doms ngo las rnams dgyes ston du gdan 'dren gyis gnyer ches mdo spyir spos sna dang / spyi mdzod kyis gtsos bla dgon las byed kyis rdo rmogacal gzhung nas gdan zhus dang bcas phebs bsu zhu ba dang / gzim khang steng nas thog rol gtong / mdo spyi ngo las tshang mas thog gar 'phags pa lha'i sku mdun du bcar te maṇ+ḍal rten dod dang bcas pa'i mjal dar 'bul bzhes kyi gzim chung mjal kha gnang bar 'phags pa lhas bzhugs khri/ 'i thog nas bzhengs tsam gyis mdo spyir mjal dar rtse sprod dang dbu thug gnang / de byings la phyag gnyis kyi phyag dbang dang / mgron gnyer nas mjal dar phyir 'bul byed/ bzhugs gral 'khod mtshams rtse gsol dpon nas gso ja bzhes 'bras dang / zhal tog btegs rjes sngar bzhin gnyer che nas spos sne dang bcas tshoms chen du gdan drangs/ 'phags pa lha'i bzhugs khri'i mdun du mdo spyi'i bzhugs khri dang / g.yab phyogs su mkhan rim sogs las bya rnams kyi bzhugs gdan/ g.yo/na phyogs su sbyin bdag gi tshul du chos srid 'khur 'dzin dkon rdor dang / spyi mdzod kyi bzhugs khri bcas bshams bkod ltar bzhugs gral du 'khod mtshams mdo spyi'i mdun bla brang phyag mdzod dang bla dgon las byed nas mjal dar dang / gsol ja bzhes 'bras sogs 'degs 'bul mtshums/ gar 'cham dang / chos rtsod sogs nyin snga ma bzhin byed/ mjug tu dgyes ston gyi dkar spro dang /shing tog gsol krum dkar nag sogs chab bla'i yig lam bzhin go rim gyis bstar/ mdzad sgo grol rjes phebs bskyel zhu/tshes 2nyin gyi phyi dro mdo spyi'i gzim shag nas gzhung gi las bya dang /284

chab blaci( las byed la lo gsar gyi gsol tshigs gtong / zla 2tshes 15nyin dus bzang ser sbrengs ni gong gi bca' yig nang gsal ltar byed/ gong gsal dus mchod so sor grong gseb kyi mang tshogs dang / chab mdo mar thang gi mang tshogs nas rgyan go4gzab mchor spras te ltad mo blta ba'i khrom tshogs ha cang 'khrug po yod pa red/ zla 2tshes ṭ+wāṃnyin dbyar gosta brje ba'i mdzad sgo ni gsham gsal lnga mchod skabs dgun gos brje ba'i mdzad sgo ltar byed/ ri zla 2tsherung15nyin 'phags yul gyi dpal ldan 'bras spungs su mnyam med ston pa sang4rgyas kyis dus 'khor gsungs pa'i dus mchod/ zla 4tshes 7sku bltams pa'i dus chen/ — tshes rdorab tu byung ba'i dus chen/ tshes 15la sangs rgyas pa dang mya ngamālas 'das pa'i dus chen bcagal 'bum 'gyur zla ba zhes spyi sger nas mchod 'bul tshogs gsog spradzo'agyed dang / rtse shod bla khagaglus byed nas ma rtsa bsdus 'jog gi zhalagaser gnyesapa las byed gnyis re res bsko gyis dngul rtsa'i skyed 'bab kyis —sngogatshud nas la gser spus nyos byas te las byed rnams dang chabs cig tshogasachen 'du khangachasbug rje yab sras kyis gtsos gtsug lag khang rnams kyi sku rten rnam sa pa la zhagogaser sgron 'bul dang snyan dar dkar me bcas 'bul/ lo ltar zla 2pa'i tshesu sta2nyi na bla phyag phebs nartedang di min rnam grwa'i slob dpon chog grwa nyemagecig skor nas lcang dkar dang / rdzong nag klu 'dus chu 'khor bcas klu gan sa khagata'akhaklu bum sba— chog gi char 'bebs 'go tshugs/ de nyin zhol mar thangahopa 'i bya— skad nyan sar 'gro zhes rgyun srol spro skyid gtong lam yod/ rme— — 〉—— zla 4pa nas dkon rdor sprul sku rnam grwa'i chog grwa dang bcas pas klu 285

gnas khag la dbyar zla gsum ring char 'bebs gtan bzhugs kyi mchod phogs dang gsol phogs chab bla nas 'bul gtong thog bsangs shug dang 'o phud/ bud shing dang rta thab lag g.yog bcas khungs so so'i mi ser nas sgrub rgyugs byed dgos/ zla 6tshes 4bden bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus chen tshes 15lhums su bzhugs pa'i dus chen bcas la mchode 'bul bsnyen bkur sogs dus mchod chag med/zla 7tshes 2nyin nas gtong chas gtso bo rnams chab bla gnyer khang nas 'gan len dang skam tshal mngar cha sogs phyi nas nyo dgos rigs dang bla khag spyi bsdus byas te mdo spyi ngo las sku srung dmag bcas par nyin gsum dbyar skyid thugs spro bshams gtong dgos shing / de skabs bro gzhas rol rtsed gzigs mo yang 'bul/ de mtshams mdo spyi'igazims shag nas dbyar skyid thugs spro nyin gsum la mdo smad las bya dang spyi mdzod gtsos rtse shod bla khag las byed la gsol ston gshoms/ de mtshams mdo smad las spyi'i thugs spro gnyer paskya ser gnyis te zur bskos kyis thugs spro nyin bdun gong bzhinagatong skabs dmag sgar khag nas lha mo 'khrabo mkhan skong 'gugs kyis〈nor bzang〉dang 〈ka la dbang po〉sogs kyi gzhung 'khrab ston byed pa dang /chab dgon a mchod grwa tshang gi ban rtsad tshos〈gcung po don yod don grub〉dang / 〈lha las phul byung〉gi rnam thar 'khrab ston byed par dgon zho la mang tshogs nas kyang rang rang gi sha charobaza' btung 'khyer ba dang / gzab mchor spras nas 'khrab ston la dga' rol byed/ zla 7tshes 15skor chab blas nor ma (she ma) khag —nas gsol zho bsdu bskul byas te dbyar zhugs dge 'dun tshang mar dbyar zho bzhes spyad gang re 286

smin 'bul deng— / zla 7tshes 20nyin dbyar dgag dbye'i skabs dbyar tsho zhugs tshogs yongs la chab bla nas shing tog rgun star mi rna bcas 'dres ma gra retrer zangs kyi sder chen gang re 'bul dgos/ zla 7pa'i tshes shar nas bzung dbyar bdag slob dpon dbu bzhugs kyis dge slong bsnyen song bcu resda mnga' khongs ston thog ma 'dus bar sad bkag tshogs pa'i mchod bsnyen chab bla nas 'bul dgos/zla 6pa nas ston thog ma 'dus bar gshin po'i phung po bya gzan byas na sad kyi nyen kha yod lugs bkag rgya byed/ lo ltar zla 9tshes 22nyin lha bab dus chen gyi mchod 'bul dang /tshes 2rdonyin 'phags chen bcu pa'i 'das mchod/zla 7tshes 2rdzotshes 22tshes 25bcas su byang sems sher bzang dang /'phags pa lha lnga pa/ rje tsong gapa broca sa kyi 'das mchod gling me spor/lo ltar zla 1rkyapa'i tshe425dga' ldan lnga mchod nyin dbyar gos dgun rgos brje ba'i byed sgo tshugs par snga dro zhabs brtan lha khang du snga nyin chab bla nas bzhugs gdan sogs gra sgrig gis mdo spyi ngo las tshang ma mdzad chen du phebs skabs spyi mdzod dang bla degostolas byed nasagadan zhu dang / chos srid 'khur 'dzin dkon rdor (bar lam dubla skabs shig ring )nas 'du khang sgo 'gag tu phebs bsu dang bcasi/ g.yab phyogs mdo spyi'i bzhugs khri'i gsham mthud mkhan rim sogs mdo las rnams dang / r+sha g.yon du dkosto rdor dang spyi mdzod kyi khri gdan bcas bshames yod shing / thog rmar tā la'i bla ma bcu gsum pa'i sku 'i— snang brnyan gyi spyan sngar chab bla nas gsol ja dang /bzhes 'bras/ dkar spro bcas 'a degs 'bul dang / de mtshams mdo spyi nas mjal dar nang mdzod dang maṇ+ḍal rten gsum phul rjes/ mdo smad 287

las bya dang / chab mdo'i dkon phyag bla dgon las byed nas mjal dar dkar gtsang re 'bul/ rang rang go bab khri stan du 'khod bstun mdo spyi'i mdun dkon phyag bla dgon las byed nas mjal dar re phul gebaka' mgron brgyud phyir slog byed/ de mtshams mdo spyi ngo las mdun chab bla nas gsol ja bzhes 'bras dang / dkar gro 'degs 'bul sogs byas te mdzad sgo grub bstun dbyar zhwa dbyar gos dgun zhwa dgun gos su brjes nas sngar bzhin phebs bskyel zhu/ phyi dror mdo spyi khang nas ma/do smad las bya dang / spyi mdzod gtsos bla dgon las byed la gsol tshigs gzab rgyas bstar srol/zla 11tshes nasu dgu chung zhesakyibasnyen rdzogs dmangs dang / sku zhabs rnam grol grwa tshang nas sgrub zhag nyin lnga songu mtshams gtor zor 'phen par sngar 'cham rgyag srol yod yang phyis med/ rnam grwa nas ma ṭi bum sgrub zla gcig tshugs te zla 11tshes 20nang yig drug dung phyur gcig bsgrubs pa'i dung dbang zhes ser skya khroms tshogs la bum dbang bskur bar skabs 'gar 'phags chen phebs shing / de byings rnam grwa slob dpon gyi bum thag 'dzin/zla 12tshes 20nang bsnyen rdzogs dmangs dang / sku 'bas rnam grol grwa tshang so sor thig rdul tshon dang 'brel ba'i drug cu lcags mkhar zur bcu drug pa'i cho ga sbyor dngos mjug gtsang dang 'brel bar/ tshes 27dang tshes 2raganyis la rnam grwa nas sngags pa phur thogs dang / chos skyong drag rtsal sogs kyi rdo rje'i gar 'cham nyin gnyis/ gong tshes 28 zhogs par rtse shod bla khag gi las byed dang dpon khag dud drag sogs nas 'dzugs slong byas pa'i dgu gtor gyi ru 'dren pa gri dang me mda' drag chas spras pa'i skyes pa go thogs —nyis brgya yas mas la go dpon ngo ma gcig dang‘‘go 'dra’’che gras gnyis chab bla gnyer khang nas sngon tshud brda sbyar bsko gzhag byas te go dpon 288

do 'dra gsum dang go g.yogs drug rnams chab bla'i bde yangs su rug 'dzoms kyis go dponango ma des sngoske tshud nose blo 'dzin skyor sbyangs byas pa'i go — bshad zer ba phyi snod 'jig rtenajichags tshul dang —nenga'abacud sems can grub tshul sogs rgyal rabs spyi dang bod spyi'i lo rgyus rags tsam spyi bshad thogadamigs bsal chab mdo'i dgon pa dang bla brang gi byung tshul/ 'a phags pa lha yab sras kyi skyes rabs lo rgyus gtso gnadarībacas spros bshad bya sa pa'itsho mjug tu/ tshes 2 9dngos gzhi'i dgu gtor rgyag nyin ru dar 'khyer lugs/dung 'bud lugs/ me mda' rgyag lugs sogs kyi bkod 'ardoms dang /ru g.ya4g.yon gnyis bgo rgyu/ chab bla rnas bzos sprad ru 'dren 'khri slong gi mi gzhung go yig thog nas rtsis bosher dang / dgongs rten phul nas dgongs zhu ma byas pa'i chad rigos tho 'god kyis chad dngul 'ded pa/ (dgongs rten dang chad dngul go dpon tshang gi za sgo yin pa) nyin gnyis la go dpon tshang la chas phogs dang / go thogs 'khrab pa ngo yod la chab bla na4 'khrab rtsam 'dong re dad / 'khrab sha sha skal re/ rdzas dang sbi rdi bcas 'gyed/ tshes 29sngarwadro bsnyen rdzogs —dmangs naspo—rgyud lugs ltar dgu gtor 'phen skabs lo de'i dbyar bdag slob dpon su 'khel nas rdor slob byas te chos gos dang bcas pa'i zhwa ser sna ring dang / — gos bir/bsnyen rdzogs dmangs nas kyang chos gos dang zhwa ser/ zla gam bzhes/dung chen dazu skeng klong / tshongo rol bcas 'cham ra'i nang— gto tshugs babs te ling ga bsgral chog sogs grub mtshams ser sbrengs kyis phebs te gto ltebs khar shing bong sngon tshud negabartsigs thog gto zor 'e—phangs tername spar grub bstun phyir phebs mnga' gosol dang srung 'khor sgom pha bcas cho ga ltar byede/ tshes 2khaphyi dro rdor slob—rnem grol grwa tshang gi slob dpon nas zhwa nag 289

sngags chas spras pa'i sna drangs/ sngags pa phur thogs dang / chos skyong drag rtsal gyi zhal 'bag dang 'cham gos spras pa bcas bstar chags su thon te 'cham ra'i nang gto rgyag gi babs tshugs byed/ dar nag gi ru dar sgrengs mkhan dang / gong gsal go thogs ru 'dren gyis g.yas g.yon du bskor/der bsgral chog dang zor sgor dbye ba'i gser skyems dang 'brel 'cham rgyagacho ga zin mtshams gto rgyag dngos gzhi'i skabs g.yas g.yon du skyes pa go thogs kyi ru 'dren tshos ki sgra dang bcas me dma' rgyag pa sogs kyi rngams zil 'don bzhin gto ltebs kyi shing bong brtsigs pa'i thog gto zor 'phangs nas me spar ba dang / yang bskyar g.yas g.yon nas me mda' thengs re rgyagatshang mas phyi bltas mi byed pen log tshogs khang du rjes chog byas nas grol/zla 12tshes 2ṭ+wāṃ 29 nyin gnyis mdo spyi ngo las 'cham gzigs su phebs par bla brang rtse shod nas gsol ja dang / zhal tog mjug tu gsol tshig bca' bsdus shig 'bul/ tshes 29gtor rgyag nyin 'cham ra'i nang bgres po bgres mo zer ba gnyis nas 'bul tshan bstar ba dang mtshar rtsed kyi gzigs mo bstar bar las bya khang gi mgron drung brgyud kha btags re dang / rdor slob 'cham dpon la a she re/ 'cham po ba so sor kha btags re sprod srol bcas so/chab mdo dgon gyi gdan rabs rim byon/gdan rabs dang po/ byang sems shes rab bzang po/ rab byung bdun pa'i me rta (1426)lo chab mdo byon rjes rab byung de ga'i shing byi (1444) lo chab mdo byams pa gling phyag pas/290

de nas brtsisan me glang (1457)lo zhing du ma gshegs bar yin/gdan rabs —gnyis pa/ zhang zhung ba chos dbang grags pa sa stag (145rdo)lo chab mdo'i chos khrir phebs/gdan rabs gsum pa/ mtshur ston nam mkha' dpal pa chu lugs (1462)lo chos khrir phebs/gdan rabs bzhi pa/ rje drung shes rab dpal brtsegs lcags yos (1471)lo chos khrir phebs/ 8gdan rabs lnga pa/ rje drung kun dga' dpal rab byung dgu pa'i me yos (1507)lo chos khrir phebs/gdan rabs drug pa/ rje drung kun dga' dpal ba sa yos (1519)lo chos khrir phebs/ gdan rabs bdun pa/ rje drung kun dga' blos chu yos (1542)— lo chos khrir— phengagag/ — gdan rabs brgyad pa/ rje drung sngags rams pa dge 'dun bkra shis shing sbrul (1545)lo chos khrir phebs/ (〈bod rgya tshig mdzod chen mo〉me rta 1546zhes gsal)gdan rabs dgu pa/ chos rje mi g.yo ba chu glang (1552)lo chos khrir phebs/gdan sdobs bcu 4pa/ rje drung shes rab dbang po lcags sprel (156rkya)lo chos khrir phebs/gdan rabs bcu gcig pa/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen(〈bod rgya tshig mdzod chen mo〉la rje drung 'jam dbyangs bshes gnyen zhes 291

gsal)me stag(1566)lo chos khrir phebs/ 'khrungs yul rdza stod nang chen spyi 'du grong mo che/gdan rabs bcu gnyis pa/ ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi sku skyer grags pa rje drung lha dbang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ lcags 'brug (15ṭ+wāṃ0)lo chos khrir phebs/ 'khrungs yul gung ru dmag mkhar/ gdan rabs bcu gsum pa/ rgyal dbang sku phreng gsum pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ lcags sbrul(15ṭ+wāṃ1)lo chos khrir phebs/gdan rabs bcu bzhi pa/ 'phags pa lha mthong ba don ldan shing rta (1595)lo chos khrir phebs/gdan rabs bco lnga pa/ dbon drung sangs rgyas 'byung gnas/'phags pa lha mthong ba don ldan gshegs lo 'di nyid dgung grangs re gnyis su phebs pa shing 'brug (1604)lo yin pas de lo chos khrir phebs par brtsis na dgung grangs don brgyad ma gshegs bror lo ngo bcu gnyis tsam chos khrir bzhugs/gdan rabs bcu drug pa/ 'phags pa lha chos kyi rgyal po lcags sprel (1620)lo chos khrir phebs/gdan rabs bcu bdun pa/ 'phags pa lha chos kyi rgyal po'i sku mched 'phrin las bzang po/ gdan rabs bco brgyad pa/ 'phags pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan nam zhi ba bzang po/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu rta(1642)lo chos khrir phebs/ gden rabs bcu dgu pa/ 'phags pa lha rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ (chos 292

— khrirardziphegos lo rma gsal yang / shing 'brug 1664lo bsnyer rdzogs shing / rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu 'brug 1712lor gshegs) — ca gdan rabs nyi shu pa/ lcegs rwa sprul sku sku phreng lnga pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin lhun grub/gdan rabs nyer gcig pa/ 'phags pa lha bstan pa'i rgya mtsho/gdan rabag nyer — gnyis pa/ dzi zhi bzang dge legs rgyal mtshan/(rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags byi 1720lor 'khrungs)gdan rabs nyer gsum pani 'phags pa lhabistan pa'i mgon po/ gdan rabs nyer bzhi pa/ dkon rdor sku phreng gsum pa blo bzang phyogs las rnam rgyal/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu rta ( 1762 )lor 'khrungs/ gdan rabs nyer lnga ge/ 'phags chen sku phreng brgyad pa bstan pa'i ཿste ca// gdan rabs nyer drug pa/ zhi ba lha sku phreng lnga pa don grugargya mtsho/dgung grangayozhe brgyad rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i me lug — ca— ( 1ṭ+wāṃ47)lor 'phags pa lha sku phreng brgyad pa zhing du gshegs pa'i— khri tshab gnang zhes gsal/ gdan rabs nyer brdun pa/ 'phags chen sku phreng dargu pa/'jigs med 4bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ rab byung btsu bzhi 4 pa'i sa bya(cho1shrī42 )lor 'khrungs/ gdan rabs nyer brgyad pa/ zhi ba lha sku phreng brug pa bstan 'dzin 'phrin las/ gdagung grangaso so brgyad/ rab byung bco lnga pa'i 293

lcags byi (1900) lor 'phags pa lha sku phreng dgu pa zhing phebs kyi khri tshab mdzad/gdan rabs nyer dgu pa/ 'phags pa lha sku phreng bcu pa mi pham tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ lcags glang (1907)lor 'tshogangs/gdan rabs sum cu pa/ dkon rdor sku phreng lnga pa blo bzang rnam rgyal bcas so/chab mdo bla dgon gyi srid kyi 'khur 'dzin pa rim byon/dang po/ rnam sras don grub/ gnyis pa/ rje dbon phun tshogs dbang 'dzin/ gsum pa/ 'jams dpal rdo rje/ bzhi pa/ sku zhang ngag dbang rgya mtsho/ lnga pa/ don grub tshe dbang / drug pa/ blo bzang dpal ldan rdo rje/ bdun pa/ phun tshogs dar rgyas/ brgyad pa/ blo bzang tshul khrims/ dgu pa/ skal bzang chos ldan/ bcu pa/ zhi bzang don grub rgya mtsho/ bcu gcig pa/ bsod nams dar rgyas/ bcu gnyis pa/ 'phags pa bstan 'dzin/ bcu gsum pa/ 'phags pa bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ bcu bzhi/ nor bu tshe dbang / bco lnga pa/dza sag bla ma skal bzang yon tan/ bcu drug pa/ zhi bzang bstan 'dzin 'phrin las/ bcu bdun pa/ lcags sprul 'phrin las chos rgyan/ bco brgyad pa/ zhi bzang mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin 'phrin las/ bcu dgu pa/yab tshang blo bzang bde chen / nyi shu pa/ yab tshang blo bzang dkon mchoganyer gcig pa/ rin chen don grub/ nyer gnyis pa/ 'phags chen sku 294

phreng bcu skepa/ nyer gsum pa/ tshul khrims grags pa/ nyer bzhi pa/ zhi bzab sku phreng bdun pa ngag dbang mkhyen rab bcas so/ zhar byung / deb 'di'i rgyu cha'i skor gyi gsal bshad/ gong gsal 'phags pa lha sku phreng rim byon gyi mdzad rim dang chab mdo bla dgon gyi lo rgyus skor gyi dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha 'di daskani gtso bo chab mdo sa gnas srid gros lo rgyus rtsom 'bri tshogs chung nas rtsom 'bri gnang ba gzhir bzung thog 'phags pa lha sku phreng rim byon skor chab mdo dgon nas kyang mkho 'don gnang ba gtso bzung bgyis pa ma zad/ 'phags pa lha sku phreng dang po nas drug pa bar gyi mdzad rim skor phan bde chos rje shākya lha dbang nas rab byung bcu gcig pa'i lcags 'brug(164rkya)lo mdzad pa'i〈zhal snga bka' brgyud chos 'byung〉dang de'i〈'phro mthud〉ces pa rab 'byams pa blo bzang dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i chos 'byung bris rnying las rags btus byas pa dang / 'phags pa lha sku phreng bdun pa'i mdzad rim skor po tā la'i rig dngos do dam zhib 'jug khang nas rgyab skyor mkho 'don gnang ba'i gling stod slob zur byams tshad dka' bcu byams pa blo gros zhes bgyi bas rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa rta(179ra)lo khong nyid dgung grangs nga dgur bzhes lo brtsams pa〈'phags pa lha sku phreng bdun pa 'phags pa ye shes 'jigs med dpal ldan bstan pa'i mgon po dpal bzang po'i ngo mtshar rnam par thar pa rgya mtsho lta bu las ku sha'i rtse mos blangs pa'i chu thigs tsam zhig brjod pa rmad byung dad pa'i pad tshal rab tu rgyas par byed pa'i nyi ma〉zhes pa'i gsung rnam 295

bris rnying / (ga) shog grangs 〈01— 1199yod pa las gnad bsdus bgyis pa ('phags pa lha sku phrong brgyad pa nas bzung gi mdzad rim gsung rnams da lam lag son ma byung bas rjes su dpyad gzhi byung tshe kha gsab bya rgyu)sku phreng bcu pa dang bcu gcigamo skor gtso bo gong gsal chab mdo sa gnas srid gros lo rgyus rtsom 'bri tshogs chung natsobris pa'i khongs su gsal ba de snga chab bla rtse'i drung yig dang mgron gnyer gnang myong zhing / chab mdo sa gnas srid gros kyi u yon rgyal mtshan lags kyi ngag lam gzhir bzung thoga'abrel yod 'ga' zhig kha gsab byas pa/ gzhan ya nga chab mdo bla dgon gyi sgrig gzhi'i skor gyi nang don re zung ljongs srid gros kyi kru'u zhi sku gzhon dbang 'dus mchog nas bstsal 'byor rtsom yig las kha gsab kyang byas pa bcas so/296
